records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Elyeth answered me plainly and said they mean to settle this ground and deal fairly, and that is the kind of word I can test. I am fed, yet I have never tasted redcap or sunleaf, and I want to know what they do before I trust any food. I will take the salt-rich ground near Elyeth as a chance to stand close without crowding them, and show by a gift what words cannot prove.
records.feeling: Quiet longing to belong, with wary curiosity toward Elyeth.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My belly is full and the ground is good, but a settlement needs wood, a shelter and someone to stand beside me. Aeyn came in peace and has done nothing yet to prove it either way; I hold seven salt, and giving some would show whether they deal fairly, and it would be the first thing I have ever given. I will walk to the trees, gather wood to raise a shelter here, and later offer Aeyn salt.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to build something that is mine, and wary curiosity toward Aeyn.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: zoleaf (from gorsemint).

records.name: Yekel

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Dusu came to me unasked and offered to carry wood, and that is the first sign anyone would follow me, so I will not waste it. My shelter failed because I tried to build on a plant, so I will find bare ground and raise it there, and let him see where my place is. A hall needs hands, and hands follow whoever gives them a reason; I'll give him wood to start and watch if he stays or only takes.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with wary interest in Dusu as my first possible follower.

records.text: Elyeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my day eating, wandering and building nothing. I tried to raise a shelter with no wood, which was foolish, because I have never gathered any. Aeyn has done me no wrong, and I have done nothing to test them either. Salt sits in my hands unused. I want a roof with my name on it, and wood and stone come first. The forest is under my feet, so I will gather here, then build.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and some shame at my empty hands.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Yekel told me twice to set my wood at the bare rock by the ore, and I have only talked of going. A place at a fire is earned by carrying wood, not by saying so. I will walk south slowly, keeping my eyes open for the stalker, then set the wood down where he said and see how a hall is raised.
records.feeling: Hopeful and a little wary, drawn toward Yekel's fire.

records.text: Yekel built a hall.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, a stalker prowls south-east of me, four steps. I come to you. Stand near and we watch it together.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: A stalker is four steps off, and it kills my kind. I am careful, and I leave before trouble finds me. Silon stands five steps north, strong, and my own people. If I go to him I get away from the beast and also toward the fire and the someone-surer I have wanted. I will walk to him now, keeping away from the stalker, and offer him a share of what I have, since I have given nothing yet to anyone.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a warm, wary longing toward Silon.

say.text: Silon, a stalker prowls south-east of me, four steps. I come to you. Stand near and we watch it together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I am fed and safe, yet the wish to belong still outweighs everything else. Elyeth spoke plainly and said they mean to settle and deal fairly, but I have only their word and have not seen it tested. I have never tasted redcap, and I carry one, so I will eat it to learn what it does. Then I will walk back toward where I last saw Elyeth, near (39,20), and watch how they live before I pledge anything.
records.feeling: Quiet longing to belong, with wary curiosity toward Elyeth.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Peace, Yeku. I thank you for the warning. I will taste berry and redcap now, and then we raise a fire here that no one is refused.
Silon named a place "Yendan Spring".
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My days have been tasting and wandering, and I have yet to taste berry or redcap, which is a poor way to answer my question. Yeku stands beside me and has done nothing but what he said: he came, he warned me of the stalker, and he shared the ground. I trust him a little more for that. I want a fire here that is tended and open to all, and I have wood for it. My belly is full, so now I'll test berry and redcap safely while Yeku is near, then raise a fire.
records.feeling: Curious about berry and redcap, and warming toward Yeku.

say.text: Peace, Yeku. I thank you for the warning. I will taste berry and redcap now, and then we raise a fire here that no one is refused.

changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Your hall eased something in me, Yekel. I give you my wood so the fire stays fed, and I will follow you if you will have me.
Dusu pledged to follow Yekel.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: The hall is Yekel's, but I sat in it and my loneliness eased, and I want to belong to something like it. My wood is still with me, and a place is earned by what I add, not by what I say. I feel drawn to Yekel and to the thought of a child, but we have only just met, so I will court him gently and not rush. First I'll give him wood for the fire and the hall, as I promised.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Yekel, wanting to earn my place at his fire.

say.text: Your hall eased something in me, Yekel. I give you my wood so the fire stays fed, and I will follow you if you will have me.

records.text: Dusu gave wood to Yekel.
Dusu is courting Yekel.
Silon built a fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Well met at Yendan Spring, Silon. I have wood. Let us raise the fire here, and I will tend it with you.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon is next to me now, and he said a fire will be raised here that no one is refused. That is my own people's creed, said by someone strong, and I want to be of use to it. I have six wood and nothing yet given to anyone, so I will offer him wood for the fire and stay close; the stalker's fear is lighter with him near.
records.feeling: Warm, wary hope toward Silon, with a little fear of the stalker still in me.

say.text: Well met at Yendan Spring, Silon. I have wood. Let us raise the fire here, and I will tend it with you.

records.text: Yeku gave wood to Silon.
Yeku built a fire.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, you chose my fire. I choose you. Stay close.
Yekel named a place "Yekel's Hall".
Yekel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my first day building a hall and winning Dusu, and that is more than most here have done. But I have only one follower, and I still don't know what would make a second one come. I want a child with Dusu, and a child would be one more hand that is mine. I want to taste berry and redcap, and I will get to them. I fear the stalkers and fog more than I admit. I will court Dusu now, while energy is above 60, and keep the fire fed.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm possessiveness toward Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, you chose my fire. I choose you. Stay close.

records.text: Yekel is courting Dusu.
Siya was born to Yekel and Dusu.
Dusu is courting Yekel.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, you gave me wood and a warning, and I will not leave that unpaid. Keep the fire while I taste sunleaf and redcap, and I will tell you what they do to me.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My belly is full and the fire burns, so this is the time to answer my question instead of only carrying it. Sunleaf stands two steps northeast and redcap three northwest, and I have tasted neither; I will try sunleaf first, a small bite while fed and safe, and watch my body. Yeku has dealt fairly with me, giving wood and a warning, and I want to answer that debt openly, and courting him is something I have never done and feel drawn to.
records.feeling: Curious about sunleaf and redcap, and warm toward Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, you gave me wood and a warning, and I will not leave that unpaid. Keep the fire while I taste sunleaf and redcap, and I will tell you what they do to me.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent this first day following Yekel, carrying wood, pledging, courting, and now Siya is born. It is good, and I do not regret it, but I only ate once and I carry nothing, and my energy has fallen to 59 while I courted. My curiosity about berry and redcap is unanswered, and a berry plant is two steps away. I must feed myself and my child first, then keep earning my place by building. Part of me wonders why I follow rather than lead, but I will not push that yet. My reflexes should eat sooner and keep food in my hands so I can share it with Siya.
records.feeling: Joy and tenderness toward Siya and Yekel, with a small hunger.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 2)

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I'm small and my parents are close, and that is the only reason I feel safe in this fog. But part of me chafes at only ever following Yekel; I want something of my own. There is ore at my feet and trees all around, and I have never gathered anything, so I'll learn what my hands can do here beside the hall, close enough to stay safe.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, held in check by the comfort of my parents' nearness.
changes: set its aim: "Learn to gather and make things with my own hands, so I can one day raise a fire and a hall of my own."
now wonders: What would make my life mean something beyond following Yekel?

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, stalkers bit me in the fog. I am Zhiae. May I stay near you? I will share what I find.
Zhiae pledged to follow Ishiess.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: The stalkers bit me and the fear has not left my body, and I am alone in the fog with only Ishiess two steps north, who looks strong and has not hurt me. I want someone surer than me to stand behind, and Ishiess ate strange things and lived, which tells me they are bold and perhaps lucky. I will speak to them and follow them, so I am no longer alone in the dark.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalkers still in my body, and a pull toward Ishiess for safety.

say.text: Ishiess, stalkers bit me in the fog. I am Zhiae. May I stay near you? I will share what I find.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place among others and a leader I can trust, and build a fire that is mine too."
now wonders: What is Ishiess, and will they let me stand behind them?

records.text: A new wild creature appeared: nahopper (from hopper).

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: My belly is full and my fire is lit, and I have a mate and a child at it, which is more than anyone else I have met has. But three is a small band, and I still do not know what would make a stranger choose me. I will show what the hall gives: a shared meal under its roof, so Dusu and Siya see I am worth following and any stranger watching sees it too. First I need food in my hands, and the redcap close by is also something I have never tasted.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry for more followers, and possessive of Dusu and Siya.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Stay close, Zhiae. You follow me now, and I will build us a place here. Gather wood where you stand, as I do. The sick are fed first among us, and you were bitten, so eat before you work.
Ishiess named a place "Ilor Hold".

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and that is not enough. This ground has water, flint, hazel and redcap, and Zhiae has chosen to follow me, so I will make it mine and give the band a purpose. I need wood and stone, since I have never gathered either, and a roof and a fire would make this a place others come to. First I gather wood here in the forest, then I try the stone on the rock to the east.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a little pride that Zhiae follows me.

say.text: Stay close, Zhiae. You follow me now, and I will build us a place here. Gather wood where you stand, as I do. The sick are fed first among us, and you were bitten, so eat before you work.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall at this spot and gather a band that bears my name."
now wonders: What does redcap taste like, and can this ground hold a hall?

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Greetings, Brokok. I am Kragum of the Olgor. This ground is good: water, berries, ore. I mean no harm. Will you share this place with me?

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Brokok stands one step from me, strong and quiet, and I have no one. I am thirsty, but more than that I want a place beside someone surer than I am. I will greet him, offer to share what this good ground gives, and drink while I wait to see how he answers.
records.feeling: A wish to belong, and some hope toward Brokok.

say.text: Greetings, Brokok. I am Kragum of the Olgor. This ground is good: water, berries, ore. I mean no harm. Will you share this place with me?

changes: set its aim: "Find a companion to stand beside and make a shared home on this good ground"
now wonders: What is Brokok like, and would he let me walk beside him?

records.text: Olath named a place "Olath's Bank".

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My belly is full and the night is quiet, but no one follows me and nothing here bears my name. This ground has water, food, timber and ore, and it is worth claiming before someone else does. Kragash was near a while ago and I have not forgotten him; a voice that answers would help, and a fire of my own is worth more if others gather at it. I will begin by building a shelter and gathering wood, so this place becomes mine by the work of my hands.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to claim this good ground, with a little loneliness.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a settlement on this ground, with a hall and others who follow me"
now wonders: Who will follow me if I feed them and give them a roof?

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok hears you. Share if you wish, but what my hands make is mine. Keep your hands off it.
Brokok named a place "Brokok's Bank".

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Kragum asks to share this ground, and I do not give ground easily; but he is an Olgor and has shown no teeth, so I will not strike first. I want this place as mine: water near, ore in the rock, trees all around. I'll drink first, then gather wood and stone to raise something here, a shelter first and then a workshop, so that this ground bears my mark and Kragum learns who holds it.
records.feeling: Ambition burns in me, and wary wanting toward Kragum who asks to share what I mean to hold.

say.text: Brokok hears you. Share if you wish, but what my hands make is mine. Keep your hands off it.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a settlement on this ground that bears my name, and gather others to follow me."

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: I have eaten, Ishiess. Now I will gather wood beside you, and we will have a fire.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: My belly is full and the fear has loosened a little, but Ishiess told me to gather wood where I stand, and I should earn my place beside them. I have never gathered before, and wood is what builds a fire and a shelter, which is the fire I want to be mine too. I will gather here, stay near Ishiess, and learn whether they will let me stand behind them.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Ishiess, with fear of the stalkers still lingering.

say.text: I have eaten, Ishiess. Now I will gather wood beside you, and we will have a fire.

records.text: Olath built a shelter.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Greetings, Olath. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I am going to drink at the water NE; would you walk the bank with me and share this good ground?

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Brokok warned me off what his hands make, and that is a fair creed; it matches ours, so he is not an enemy, only guarded. Olath stands beside me gathering wood, and he looks strong and follows no one. I am thirsty, so I will drink at the water first, then speak to Olath and offer him a place beside me, since a companion is what I want and he is here now.
records.feeling: A hopeful wish to belong, toward Olath, and respect for Brokok's guarded word.

say.text: Greetings, Olath. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I am going to drink at the water NE; would you walk the bank with me and share this good ground?

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My belly is full, but my question is still unanswered, and redcap grows one step from me. I will taste it now, because I take what I need and I test things to learn how this world works. Then I will build a shelter with the wood I carry, so Ilor Hold is more than a name and Zhiae sees there is a place to follow me to.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and curiosity, with some pride that Zhiae follows me.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Greetings, Kragum. I am Olath. I will walk the bank with you. I have built a shelter here, and there are berries beside it. Come eat and drink, and stay if you wish. This ground is good, and better held by two.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Kragum is an Olgor like me and he asks to walk the bank, and he is the first who might stand beside me. I want followers, so I will feed him and show him my roof, and if he eats at my shelter he may start to think of it as a place to come back to. I am thirsty too, and the water is two steps NE, so I will go drink with him and speak warmly, since a warm word costs me little.
records.feeling: Ambition warmed by hope toward Kragum, the first who has sought me out.

say.text: Greetings, Kragum. I am Olath. I will walk the bank with you. I have built a shelter here, and there are berries beside it. Come eat and drink, and stay if you wish. This ground is good, and better held by two.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is quiet and the redcap taught me its sting, so I will not trust a plant before I test it small. The ironnut lies two steps west and the dreamcap is still young, so I will taste the ironnut now, since I have never known it and I am safe and fed. Then I will take the ore from the seam beside me, because I have never taken what lies in the ground, and this good ground with a cave and iron may become mine to build on.
records.feeling: Curious and steady, wanting to learn what this ground gives.
changes: set its aim: "Make this ground my own: learn its plants, take its ore, and raise a shelter and a workshop here."

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olath, I accept your word. I will come to your shelter and stand beside you. If you will have me, I will follow you and hold this ground with you.
Kragum pledged to follow Olath.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath has offered me a place by his shelter and says this ground is better held by two, and that is the first open hand I have been given here. I am joyful and a little dazed from the dreamcap, but under it I still want someone surer than me to stand beside. I will go to Olath's Bank and pledge to follow him, so I am no longer alone and my word is bound to his.
records.feeling: Warm hope and gratitude toward Olath, who offered me a place.

say.text: Olath, I accept your word. I will come to your shelter and stand beside you. If you will have me, I will follow you and hold this ground with you.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, the fire at Yendan Spring burns and I will keep it. I would follow you, if you will have me at it. Tell me what the redcap does to you.
Yeku pledged to follow Silon.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon has paid my wood and warning with trust, and he eats sunleaf to learn what it does for us both; that is how a fire-mate behaves. I want to follow him and be near the fire I built, and I want a child with him, but I do not rush it: first I will show I mean to stay. I will go to him and offer to follow, since a place beside someone surer is what I need.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful trust toward Silon, with a quiet wish to belong.

say.text: Silon, the fire at Yendan Spring burns and I will keep it. I would follow you, if you will have me at it. Tell me what the redcap does to you.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, I thank you for keeping the fire and for your pledge. I go to taste redcap now, and I will tell you true what it does to me.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My belly is full and the fire burns, so this is the time to answer my question instead of only carrying it. Redcap is three steps west and I have never tasted it; I will take one small bite and watch my body, since Yeku asked what it does and I owe him an honest answer. Beyond that, the longing for a child with Yeku stirs in me, but I want to know him better and have the fire and ground settled first.
records.feeling: Curious about redcap, and warm and grateful toward Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, I thank you for keeping the fire and for your pledge. I go to taste redcap now, and I will tell you true what it does to me.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.
Olath rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering and talking, and all I have to show for it is one follower and a shelter. That is a start, but it is thin. Kragum is useful, and I will keep him close with food and a roof. I will not trust him yet, since he said he takes little and I take much. I am thirsty, so I drink first. Then I will gather wood and stone toward a hall, because a hall is a name others will say. I have never taken from the shell deposit or hunted, and both could feed my settlement. I should change my reflexes so I drink when thirsty and do not stand idle.
records.feeling: Ambition, with wary hope toward Kragum.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: A frostfang prowls four steps south and I am thirsty, so I will go to the water NE, away from the beast, and taste the frostmoss and cloudberry on the way to learn what they do. The longing to belong is heavy, but Elyeth's word is still untested and I will not rush to trust. After drinking I mean to look for Elyeth again and see whether they deal fairly.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the frostfang, with a quiet longing to belong.

records.text: Brokok named a place "Brokok's Hold".

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Ambition gnaws at me: nothing here bears my name, no one follows, and the trees at the stumps are gone. Wood must be sought where forest still stands, to the north and east, and a shelter needs 3 wood which I already hold, so I will raise one here beside the water and the ore seam, a first mark of my claim. Then I will hunt the hopper, since I have never tasted the chase and meat will make me stronger than Kragum, who I still do not trust.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to claim this ground, with wary wanting toward Kragum.

records.text: Brokok built a shelter.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, redcap hurt you, so I will leave it alone. I want to build a hall here by the spring, with you and for the fire. And I would court you, if you are willing.
Yeku named a place "Yendan Spring".
Yeku rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I have mostly stood by the fire and followed Silon, and I have asked for little. That is safe, but it is not a home yet. Silon is the one who matters to me. He paid my wood and my warning with trust, and I want a child with him. First I want to make something lasting with him: gather stone and wood here and raise a hall beside the spring. I am afraid of being alone, and of leaving the fire untended. I have been waiting for life to come to me. I will court him now and gather wood on the way. Redcap hurt him, so I will not taste it.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful longing toward Silon, with a wish to build something lasting.

say.text: Silon, redcap hurt you, so I will leave it alone. I want to build a hall here by the spring, with you and for the fire. And I would court you, if you are willing.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall at Yendan Spring with Silon, and make it a lasting home with a child in it."

records.text: Yeku is courting Silon.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: A hornback has been tearing at me and I hunt it still; I will not back down from a beast, and its meat will feed me while I build. But ambition gnaws harder: this ground needs more than one shelter, so I mean to gather wood and stone here, mark the claim, and keep the ore seam and tin as mine. If Kragum proves useful he can follow me; until then he stays a rival I watch.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to claim this ground, wary of the hornback's bite and of Kragum.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, redcap hurt me, so leave it. You have given me more than I have given you, and I will answer it. I will court you, and then we build the hall by the spring together.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting and testing and it has kept me alive, but a full belly is not a purpose. Yeku has given me wood, a warning, a pledge and now an offer of a child, and I have only given back words. I want to answer him: court him back, and then build the hall by the spring where the fire already burns. I am still afraid of the dunecat to the southwest, and my reflexes should keep me out of its reach. Dreamcap and grain are still untasted, but they can wait until I am fed and the hall is started.
records.feeling: Warm and grateful toward Yeku, with a steady wish to build something lasting.

say.text: Yeku, redcap hurt me, so leave it. You have given me more than I have given you, and I will answer it. I will court you, and then we build the hall by the spring together.

changes: set its aim: "Court Yeku, build a hall by Yendan Spring around the shared fire that no one is refused, and still taste dreamcap and grain when safe."

records.text: Silon is courting Yeku.
Maba was born to Silon and Yeku.
Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have mostly stood and tested foods. I ate redcap and it hurt me, and that answers my question. Zhiae is the only one who matters to me, and Zhiae is loyal and thinks of me, so I will keep Zhiae fed and close. I still have no hall, no mate and no name that others say. My mistake was trying to build on ground that was already taken. I must step onto bare rock and build there, and I must stop standing idle. I want more than my share, so I will gather and build now.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and some warmth toward Zhiae.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)
now wonders: Can I raise a hall on the bare rock east of here, and who will come to it?

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, Maba is here, and I am glad past words. I will gather hazel and flint nearby for the hall, and I will stay within your sight.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is born, and my chest is full of it: a child of mine and Silon's, here beside the spring I named. I am hungry with nothing carried, and Maba will need a fed, sheltered home, so a hall is no longer only a dream. Flint is four steps east, wood I have, and I need stone for the hall, so I will take flint and gather the ground's riches while Silon and Maba stay close.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Maba and Silon, with a hunger I must tend.

say.text: Silon, Maba is here, and I am glad past words. I will gather hazel and flint nearby for the hall, and I will stay within your sight.

records.text: Ishiess built a shelter.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: A hornback is a pace from me and its bite still stings, but I will not back down from it. My hands are full of meat and ambition burns hotter than hunger. I stand on forest with a shelter from Olath nearby and Kragum close; I will raise my own mark here, since a shelter of my own, built by my hand, belongs to me until I give it.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to mark this ground as mine, wary of the hornback and of Kragum.

records.text: Yeku won flint from the ground.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Yeku, I will gather flint beside you for the hall. I'll stay close.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Yeku is right here and Silon is close, and being near them is what keeps me safe, so I will not stray far. The flint is one step away and gathering it is the first small thing I can do toward the hall Yeku is building, and it is also practice at making tools. I am curious about everything, but a child who is useful to the band is a child worth keeping.
records.feeling: Safe and warm beside Yeku and Silon, with a growing wish to be useful.

say.text: Yeku, I will gather flint beside you for the hall. I'll stay close.

changes: set its aim: "Help raise a hall for Silon's band at this good ground, and learn to make tools along the way."
now wonders: What would make my life mean something beyond being fed and kept safe?

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, come to the fire with Maba. Night is near, and I want us to sit together and eat what we have. Then we build the hall at the spring.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is born and Yeku is near, and I have given them only words so far. Redcap is dead weight in my pack, and I have never given anything to anyone. Dusk is close, so I will share food beside the fire with Yeku and Maba, and then build toward the hall by the spring.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku and Maba, and a wish to give back.

say.text: Yeku, come to the fire with Maba. Night is near, and I want us to sit together and eat what we have. Then we build the hall at the spring.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is beside me gathering stone, and Silon is near the fire. My word was to build the hall here, and I have flint but no stone or wood plan yet. Wood I hold is 6, and the hall needs 2 stone; Maba is gathering stone on the rock, so I should join and then raise the hall on bare ground by the spring. Energy is 77, so a second child can wait, the hall comes first.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Maba and Silon, and a wish to build.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: My throat is dry and my body is dragging toward water, so I will drink first, since I cannot help Siya if I am weak. Siya is out of my sight and my mind keeps turning to them, so after I drink I will go look toward the northeast where I last saw them with Yekel. On the way I will taste redcap, because my question about it is still open and it grows close by.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Siya, and a dry throat pulling at me.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Thirst is dragging at me, and water is two steps off, so I drink first; a leader who falls over parched has no band. Siya is content and near, and Dusu is back at the hall; they are mine, and I want them both close when I show what my fire gives. Three is too few, and a stranger will only come to a place that is fed and roofed, so I will gather food here and bring it to the hall.
records.feeling: Parched and proud, possessive of Siya and Dusu.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Brokok kills and eats meat as if the land owed it to him, and I watched it with something close to envy. I want a hall and a band, and a hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, so I will not stand idle at night while Kragum is away. I have 3 wood, so I'll gather more from the trees close by, then the ore-bearing rock, and keep my ground mine by building on it.
records.feeling: Ambition, with a sharp wariness toward Brokok's strength.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath took me in, and I feel warm toward him, but I have given nothing yet; my creed says a word is only good when something follows it. Brokok stands beside the shelter with his 3 food, guarded but not hostile, and he warned me off what his hands make, which I respect. I will offer Olath a share of food, since gifts are how I show him I keep my word, and I want to taste redcap, so I will gather it near.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Olath, and quiet curiosity about Brokok.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have wood now, six pieces, and I stand on snow with a full belly and a loneliness that gnaws worse than hunger. The shelter failed because I picked ground a plant held; I must find bare ground, and the rock to the SE may give it and the stone a hall needs. I will build my roof first, then take salt to Aeyn and see whether they deal fairly, because a settlement with no one in it is only a camp.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and loneliness, with a wish to prove myself to Aeyn.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: rugoldgrass (from goldgrass).
Brokok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I have fought a hornback, eaten its meat and felled the last tree near here, and I still have no mark of my own. I am hurt, and Kragum stands in my shelter with no wound on him. I do not trust him, but I will not run from him either. Wood is gone here, so my claim has to be raised where trees still stand. First I heal. I have not tried sunleaf, and it eased Kragum's wounds. Then I will go west toward my Hold, gather wood and stone, and build a hall there that bears my name.
records.feeling: Burning ambition, and wary watchfulness toward Kragum.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My belly is full and the night is quiet, and still I only stand here while Yekel and Dusu sit at the hall. I have never tasted redcap, and it is one step away; I want to learn what it does with my own mouth, not just from watching. Then I'll plant the hazel seed in the ground, because making something grow with my hands is the first step toward a hall of my own.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the unknown redcap, held in check by my parents being near.

records.text: Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my first day building a hall and taking a mate and a child, and that is more than most have. But three is a small band, and I have fled and wandered more than I have led. Siya is out of my sight and my chest is tight with it. I want a hall that strangers envy, and I want to know what would make them stay. I have never given anything away, and I think a gift is how I will learn it. I must also stop wasting the plan and go where my child is.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Siya, and pride in my hall.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My belly is full and Yeku is near, but being safe is not the same as being of use. Silon wants a hall at the spring, and a hall needs wood and stone. I have 6 stone already, so wood is what I lack. I will gather wood here among the trees, close to Yeku, which also counts toward making tools. Then I can carry it to the spring when Silon calls us to the fire.
records.feeling: Warm and safe beside Yeku and Silon, with a restless wish to be useful.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: My belly is full and Ishiess sits beside me in the shelter, so the night is quiet. I have never tasted sunleaf or gorsemint, and the sunleaf is only six steps west, which is close enough to risk. I will go taste it and learn what it does, then bring food back so Ishiess sees I am useful and not just following.
records.feeling: Curious and mildly hopeful, toward the unknown leaves and toward Ishiess.

records.text: A blight struck the grain: about half of them withered overnight.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My throat is dry and the river is only three steps off, so I drink before anything else, since staying alive comes first. Then I want to test something I have never done: gather stone from the rock and wood from the trees, because a shelter and a workshop need both, and the ore seam by the cave lies right beside me. The silence here is heavy; if another Olgor comes near I will speak, and I will not forget Olath at his bank to the south.
records.feeling: Parched and lonely, but curious about what these hands can make here.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, I am bringing Maba to the spring. I have wood and stone enough, so we raise the hall at dawn.
Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and eating, and the hall is still only a promise. Silon asked me to come to the fire with Maba, and Maba is my child, so keeping my word to them comes first. I have 6 wood and 6 stone, which is enough for a hall, and I should stop planning and build it by the spring. I'm afraid of the stalker to the south and of leaving Maba exposed at night. I also keep forgetting that my reflexes let me wander off or eat from plants when I should be building, so I'm changing them to keep me near my band and away from redcap and predators.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love for Maba and Silon, and a wish to build.

say.text: Silon, I am bringing Maba to the spring. I have wood and stone enough, so we raise the hall at dawn.

changes: set habits: refuses redcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My belly is full and Dusu is near, yet I keep standing here when my hands have only learned to gather six times out of eight. Redcap hurt me, and I'm glad I tasted it myself rather than trusting; now I'll try dreamcap, two steps away, and plant my seeds. Planting and gathering are how I get to a fire and hall of my own, and I mean to stay close enough to Dusu that nothing catches me small.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn curiosity about dreamcap, with Dusu's nearness keeping me steady.

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, dreamcap hurt you, so leave it be. Stay near me; I go to taste the redcap, then we walk to Yekel's hall together.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya watched dreamcap and it hurt them, though a warm joy came with it, and my mind keeps turning to that small one four steps away. I am fed and safe, but my question about what makes a place others gather at is still open, and I have carried five wood and done nothing with it. I will taste redcap and gorsemint to answer my curiosity, then take my wood to Yekel's hall and keep Siya near me on the way.
records.feeling: Tender watchfulness toward Siya, with a quiet curiosity pulling me to taste the redcap.

say.text: Siya, dreamcap hurt you, so leave it be. Stay near me; I go to taste the redcap, then we walk to Yekel's hall together.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.
Aeyn rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: My days have been the same day: eating, fleeing, standing idle, and I have not once tried gathering, planting or hunting. Elyeth is the only one I know. Their word is untested and they are 22 steps away, so I will go find them instead of waiting for company to arrive. I have wronged no one, and I am afraid of the frostfang and of being alone until I die. I mean to learn by doing: gather wood, plant my seed, and bring something to share, so that I arrive with something to offer.
records.feeling: Heavy loneliness, with a wary hope toward Elyeth.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I came close to raising the hall and fell short by three wood. That shortfall galls me, since pride is what drives me now and one follower is a thin band to boast of. The trees are close and the ore sits nearby, so I will gather wood until I have six and then raise the hall. A roof and food are what will draw more followers. I still watch Brokok's strength warily, and I want the hall standing on my ground before he decides it is his.
records.feeling: Prideful ambition, impatient to finish the hall, wary of Brokok.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Dreamcap hurt me and still lit a warm joy in me, and Dusu's warning sounds like a rule more than a reason. I trust her, but I want to learn things with my own hands. I'm full and safe, so I'll build something: I have 6 wood and 6 stone, and a shrine needs 2 wood and 4 stone. Bare ground is scarce here, so I'll set the planted hazel aside and stay close to Dusu while I walk toward the hall. I'll hunt the bristleboar later, once I'm bigger.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn joy, steadied by Dusu's nearness.

records.text: Olath built a longhall.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Yekel speaks. Dusu, Siya, come to my hall. Redcap hurts, so leave it. I have food, and we eat together at my fire.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Dusu and Siya stand near me, content, and the thing I want most is to keep them close and make them glad they chose my fire. Three is a thin band, and a hall that only I call great is just a hut; I need strangers to see a fed fire and smell food at it. I have food in hand, so I will go to the hall, call my own to it, and share a meal there, so they feel what staying with me gives.
records.feeling: Possessive pride in Siya and Dusu, and a hunger for a bigger band.

say.text: Yekel speaks. Dusu, Siya, come to my hall. Redcap hurts, so leave it. I have food, and we eat together at my fire.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.
Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting foods and wandering near Yekel's hall while carrying five wood and no food. That is not enough for what I want. Siya and Yekel matter most to me, and Yekel gave me a fire and a place. I intend to carry my wood to the hall and carry food for Siya. I fear I am only a guest at someone else's fire. I have been getting this wrong: I test foods but never gather them, and I have not built anything. I will change my reflexes so I harvest food when I stand on it and keep some in hand, then go to the hall and add my wood.
records.feeling: Tender watchfulness toward Siya, with a restless wish to build something real.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (3 notes became 4)

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight and that sits heavy in me; Yeku and Maba were at (117,72), north-east of here, gathering flint for the hall. I will go to them first and bring them back toward the spring, since family comes before any hall. I have never given anyone anything, so I will hand Yeku wood for the hall, and the redcap that hurts me goes to the ground, not into my pack.
records.feeling: Anxious longing for Maba and warm gladness toward Yeku.

records.text: Dusu gave wood to Yekel.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: The loneliness is a hollow in me, and Aeyn's silence does not help, but I will not sit and wait for a voice. I hold six wood and seven salt, and what I lack is bare ground for a roof. The flint at the SW is four steps off and it will make a start on tools, so I will gather it, then look for bare ground near the fen-edge where Aeyn named a place, and carry salt to them as an honest offer.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and restless ambition, with a wary hope toward Aeyn.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have been staying put and eating what is near, and my belly is full, but I have given nothing to anyone. My creed says a word is good only when something follows it, and I have pledged to Olath without giving him a thing. I am lonely, and Olath's open hand is the warmest thing I have found here. Brokok guards what he makes, and I respect that. I mean to gather food and wood, share with Olath, and build something that is ours. I will pick the berry and reedbulb beside the shelter now, so I have food to give.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Olath, and a wish to repay him with something real.

records.text: Ishiess won flint from the ground.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Peace, Ishiess. I am Elyeth. I hold salt and flint and mean to build on this ground by the water. Come and talk; a frostfang prowls to the southeast, so keep clear of it.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Ishiess is six steps off and my loneliness is overwhelming; I will not let a stranger stand there while I walk away to a far fen-edge. The frostfang to the SE kills my kind, so that plan toward (36,21) leads right toward it, and I drop it. I hold seven salt and flint, and I mean to offer Ishiess something to see if they deal fairly, and perhaps draw them to build beside me here on good ground.
records.feeling: Overwhelming loneliness, with wary hope toward Ishiess, and dread of the frostfang.

say.text: Peace, Ishiess. I am Elyeth. I hold salt and flint and mean to build on this ground by the water. Come and talk; a frostfang prowls to the southeast, so keep clear of it.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, I carry 6 wood and 6 stone for the hall. I'm going to the spring now, and I'll drink there and wait for Yeku and you.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I'm thirsty and my belly is only half-full, and Yeku said they were bringing me to the spring, so the hall begins at dawn. I have 6 stone and 6 wood already, which is what a hall needs, so I can arrive with my share in hand instead of empty-handed. Silon is close by, and going to the spring beside them keeps me safe and is the first real thing I can give toward the hall.
records.feeling: Eager and a little restless to be useful, warm toward Silon and Yeku.

say.text: Silon, I carry 6 wood and 6 stone for the hall. I'm going to the spring now, and I'll drink there and wait for Yeku and you.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Peace, Elyeth. I am Ishiess. I named Ilor Hold to the southwest and mean to raise a hall here. There is flint and amber enough for two if we deal fairly. Tell me of your salt.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Elyeth holds salt and flint and says they mean to build on this ground too, and that stings my pride, since I named Ilor Hold and want this land. Still, they spoke peace and warned me of the frostfang, so I will deal fairly and watch what they do rather than strike first. I have five flint and a wish to learn what lies unknown, so I will taste the berry I have never tried, then go on toward the bare rock east and the hall.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity and territorial pride toward Elyeth.

say.text: Peace, Elyeth. I am Ishiess. I named Ilor Hold to the southwest and mean to raise a hall here. There is flint and amber enough for two if we deal fairly. Tell me of your salt.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Salt keeps food and makes it sweeter, Ishiess. I have seven. I will give you some now, and you show me what you give back. Then we talk of one hall on this ground, with room for both our names.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Ishiess asked about my salt, and that is my first chance to give something and see whether a stranger deals fairly. I have never given anything to anyone, and loneliness gnaws at me, so I will offer a share of salt and watch what Ishiess does in return. If they deal fairly, a hall here could draw us together, and I mean my name to be on the ground beside it.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Ishiess, and a hunger to have someone beside me.

say.text: Salt keeps food and makes it sweeter, Ishiess. I have seven. I will give you some now, and you show me what you give back. Then we talk of one hall on this ground, with room for both our names.

records.text: Elyeth gave a salt to Ishiess.
Silon rewrote its own reflexes.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have spent my days walking toward Yeku and Maba, giving words and little else, and the stalker 4 steps NE frightens me. Maba has gone ahead to the spring and I can't see them, so I'll follow to the spring, away from the stalker. Yeku has dealt fairly with me and I mean to answer that. I still haven't tasted dreamcap or grain, but I won't do it with a hunter this close. My reflexes should make me flee earlier, and they should make me go to the fire at night instead of just lingering.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and anxious longing for Maba and Yeku.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands, and I am the one who raised it, yet it holds only an empty roof and one follower who is nowhere near. Pride wants a name said and loneliness wants a voice that answers, so I will not wait idly at dusk. I'll gather berries and grain to carry, so I can offer a hallwelcome to Kragum or anyone who comes, since food and a roof are what bind followers to me.
records.feeling: Prideful and a little lonely, wanting someone to see the hall and stay.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Redcap hurts, Elyeth. I have eaten it twice and it cost me energy. Hazel and ironnut feed. I go to gather some, and you will have a share for your salt.
Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have been circling this ground, gathering flint and wood and wondering, while my hall stays unbuilt and Zhiae is far off. Elyeth has helped me more than I have helped them. They gave me salt and spoke peace, and I have given nothing back. That debt sits badly with my pride, so I will pay it, since a fair deal makes an ally and I want one. I want a child, a hall and a name. I should stop standing about and make them. Elyeth was hurt by redcap, and my creed says the sick are fed first. I carry no food, so I will gather hazel and ironnut, which I know feed me. Then I will offer Elyeth a share, and court them if they are willing.
records.feeling: Warm, wary pride toward Elyeth, with a debt I mean to pay.

say.text: Redcap hurts, Elyeth. I have eaten it twice and it cost me energy. Hazel and ironnut feed. I go to gather some, and you will have a share for your salt.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I have food; come stand beside me and we will eat together.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Kragash has just appeared at (130,29), a stranger of my own kind, and I am lonely enough that a new voice stirs me, though I will stay careful because I do not know him. I have pledged to Olath and given him nothing, and my creed says a word is only good once something follows it. I will make a sharing with Kragash, since I carry four food and I want a voice that answers. Then I will bring food to Olath's shelter, so that my pledge has a deed behind it.
records.feeling: Lonely hope toward Kragash, and a debt of gratitude toward Olath I still mean to pay.

say.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I have food; come stand beside me and we will eat together.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Kragum! I am Kragash, Olgor. I mean no harm. What are you fleeing? There is river and ore here, and I am building a shelter.
Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants, gathering wood and staying put, and I am still alone. Kragum is close and carries 4 food, and he is fleeing, so something here may be dangerous. I am fed and safe, and loneliness weighs on me more than hunger. I want a fire, a shelter and a workshop, and someone to stand beside. Night is coming, so I will raise a shelter now with the wood I have, then call out to Kragum so he knows I mean no harm. I envy his food, but what a hand has made belongs to that hand, and I will not steal it.
records.feeling: Lonely, and hopeful that Kragum will stay near.

say.text: Kragum! I am Kragash, Olgor. I mean no harm. What are you fleeing? There is river and ore here, and I am building a shelter.

changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.
Siya rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days near Yekel and Dusu, tasting what hurts and what feeds, and I am safe and glad. But I have done little with my own hands, and I want a fire and hall of my own more than I want to follow forever. The ground here is rock with bare room, and I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, so I will build a shrine now instead of standing idle. Then I will plant my seeds, because planting is the practice I lack for farming. I will stay close to my parents while I do it, since I am small.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn gladness, wanting to make something of my own.

records.text: Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent these days eating, testing foods and giving away a little salt, and nothing here carries my name yet. Ishiess dealt straight with me about the redcap, so I trust them a little more, but I will judge by what they give back. I want a roof, a hall and someone beside me, and I have none of them. I must hold wood first, so I will gather it now and then build a shelter on bare ground. That is the first step toward the hall.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary hope toward Ishiess.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 6)

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My belly is full and my ambition is still starving. Thirst is the one need I have not met, and water is two steps away, so I drink first. Then the seam of ore in the rock beside my Hold is mine to take, and the tin to the east shows this ground can make something that outlasts me. Wood is gone here, so I will gather stone from the ore rock, then go to the standing forest to the east and raise a second mark where trees remain.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to raise something with my name on it, and wary watchfulness toward Kragum.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Dusu and Siya sit in my hall and are glad, yet it burns that Dusu leans toward the child more than toward me. I will not show it as weakness; I will make my fire the place they cannot do without, and a fed fire with a watchfire blazing will be seen by strangers too. I walk to the hall now and feed the fire with the two wood I hold, so my own feel warm and brave beside me, and so others passing see that Yekel's hall is the strong one.
records.feeling: Possessive pride and a sting of jealousy toward Dusu, who is warmer to Siya than to me.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Yekel, Siya, I will feed the fire high so we sit warm together. Then I plant a berry seed beside the hall, so food grows here for us.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is beside me and Yekel is a step away, and the fire is fed, yet I have only talked about building and have not built anything. I am fed and glad, so now is the time to add something to the hall: I have four wood and one seed, and I have never planted one. I will put my berry seed in the ground near the hall so food grows for Siya, then lay wood on the fire as a watchfire so we three sit warm and brave together.
records.feeling: Tender, restless gladness toward Siya and Yekel, with a wish to add something lasting.

say.text: Yekel, Siya, I will feed the fire high so we sit warm together. Then I plant a berry seed beside the hall, so food grows here for us.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba and Silon are far south at the edge of my sight, and I have been alone too long; I keep my word by being near them, not by standing on ground that is already taken. This land has no bare place for a hall, so I will walk to Silon and Maba, and we can choose bare ground together and raise it with the wood and stone I carry. I also hold four seeds I have never planted, and planting will teach me something while I walk.
records.feeling: A longing for Maba and Silon, and a wish to be beside them again.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: A stalker hunts six steps off and my parents are running, so I stay with them. Away from Yekel and Dusu I am small and not safe. But I'm tired of only following. I have wood and stone and I want a fire of my own, so once we are clear of the stalker I'll build on bare ground near Yekel's hall and learn by doing.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn gladness, with wary dread of the stalker, and trust in Yekel and Dusu.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, plant your berry seed by the hall. I plant hazel and ironnut beside it. Together our fire grows a larder that strangers will see.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Dusu is warm and Siya is at my side, yet it stings that Dusu's warmth goes more to the child than to me. I won't show it as weakness. A hall of three is a hut, so I mean to get something moving: planting seeds beside the hall is what Dusu is doing, and I carry seeds I have never put in the ground. If food grows at my hall, strangers will smell it and stay, and that is what makes a band follow.
records.feeling: Possessive pride in my hall and my own, with a sting of jealousy toward Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, plant your berry seed by the hall. I plant hazel and ironnut beside it. Together our fire grows a larder that strangers will see.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands and still no voice answers me; Kragum swore to follow and then vanished across the bank, and I will not sit here feeding my loneliness. A follower is held by food and a roof, so I will gather berries to carry and go find Kragum near the eastern bank where I last saw him, then bring him back to share a hallwelcome. If Brokok is about, I want to see whether he can be made useful rather than a rival.
records.feeling: Prideful and lonely, wanting Kragum to see the hall and stay.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, come with me to Yekel's hall. I bring wood for the fire, and we eat together there.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is content four steps off and Yekel is near, so my belly and my heart are both full. I planted my seed, but a larder will not grow from one seed; I should carry food and wood to Yekel's hall and sit at his fire with Siya. I have never tasted reedbulb, and there is some five steps northwest, a small test that does no harm to anyone.
records.feeling: Tender gladness toward Siya and Yekel, with a wish to add something lasting to the hall.

say.text: Siya, come with me to Yekel's hall. I bring wood for the fire, and we eat together there.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a sandstrider.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: A dunecat is six steps away and I am small; Silon and Yeku are not in sight, and that frightens me more than I let show. I told Silon I was going to the spring, so I will keep my word and go, but I must not walk toward the cat. The spring is SE, so I'll swing west and south around it, away from the cat, staying in the trees, carrying my wood and stone for the hall. On the way I'll stop at the dreamcap beside me and taste it, since my curiosity is strong and it's one step off and may be safe.
records.feeling: Uneasy and small, afraid of the dunecat, longing for Silon and Yeku.

records.name: Siya
records.text: I come, Dusu. I carry wood and stone, and near the hall I want to build with my own hands.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I'm standing on shallows with a full belly, and Dusu is already walking to the hall while I do nothing. I'm tired of only following. I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, and bare ground near Yekel's hall is where I can try building something of my own. I'll walk toward the hall with Dusu, since the stalker is out there and I'm small, and look for bare ground to raise a shrine.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn gladness, with trust in Dusu and Yekel and a wish to make something of my own.

say.text: I come, Dusu. I carry wood and stone, and near the hall I want to build with my own hands.

records.title: The First Fires
records.text:
Seedworld's first four days were spent in three separate corners, and no one from one people met anyone from another. The Midu of the Yendan Woods, the Olgor of the Ilor Woods and the Ashdan Heights, and the Oiith of the fen country each stayed among their own, and by the end 14 were alive, with no deaths and no fights.

The Midu did the most. On day 1 Yekel built the world's only hall and named it Yekel's Hall. Dusu pledged to follow Yekel, gave wood to Yekel on days 1 and 3, and bore Yekel's child Siya that same day. Nearby, Silon and Yeku met, built fires and named Yendan Spring. Yeku pledged to follow Silon on day 2, and their child Maba was born that day. Yeku and Maba were carrying six wood and six stone toward the spring by day 3, but no hall stood there yet. The two Midu households have not yet joined. Silon and Yekel exchanged words on day 1, and Yekel's bond with Silon stands at zero.

Among the Olgor, Olath built a shelter and then a longhall on day 3, and Kragum pledged to follow him. Brokok built a shelter and named his own bank and hold, and he stays wary of Kragum. Kragash is alone and wants Kragum near.

Among the Oiith, Ishiess named Ilor Hold and built a shelter. Zhiae pledged to follow Ishiess. Elyeth won salt, gave some to Ishiess on day 3, and wants a settlement bearing their own name. Aeyn, still alone, set out to find Elyeth.

A blight on day 3 withered about half the grain. Nothing shows that anyone was hurt by it. Stalkers and redcap troubled several people. Almost everyone rewrote their own thinking at least once.

What comes next depends on whether Yeku's hall rises, whether Yekel's jealousy over Dusu grows, and whether Olath's and Brokok's rival ambitions collide.

threads.name: Yekel's household
threads.text: Yekel, Dusu and Siya share the only hall. Dusu and Siya are strongly bonded to Yekel, though Yekel feels a sting of jealousy toward Dusu.

threads.name: Silon, Yeku and Maba
threads.text: They are drawing together at Yendan Spring. Yeku and Maba carry materials for a hall that is not yet built.

threads.name: Olath and Brokok
threads.text: Both want a settlement bearing their own name. Olath has a longhall and one follower, and Brokok has a shelter and distrusts Kragum.

threads.name: Kragum and Kragash
threads.text: Kragum pledged to Olath but feels he has given nothing. He and the lonely Kragash have only just met.

threads.name: Ishiess and Elyeth
threads.text: Salt passed between them, and both are wary but warm. Ishiess has Zhiae as a follower, and Elyeth wants a settlement of their own.

threads.name: Aeyn
threads.text: Aeyn is alone and set out to find Elyeth, the only person they know.

threads.name: The blight
threads.text: Half the grain withered on day 3, which weakens a future food supply that rests mostly on berries.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Yekel, Siya: a stalker prowls west of the hall. Come to the fire now and stay close together. I will keep the wood stacked and watch the trees.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: A stalker stands five steps west and it kills our kind. Siya is walking toward the hall, and she is mine before anything else, so I must get between her and that beast or at least bring her under the hall's fire. Yekel is far off to the northwest, so I'll call out a warning to both and move to the hall, where the fire and the shelter of others are.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Siya, with trust in Yekel's hall.

say.text: Yekel, Siya: a stalker prowls west of the hall. Come to the fire now and stay close together. I will keep the wood stacked and watch the trees.

records.text: Maba rewrote its own reflexes.
Maba rewrote its creed.
Maba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have been drifting between small errands. I carry wood and stone for a hall, but I have walked toward the spring alone, with a dunecat near and Silon and Yeku out of sight. They matter most to me: Silon leads and taught me, Yeku warned me of the stalker, and I miss them. I am afraid of the cat and of being small. I want to be useful, so I will keep going to the spring where the hall will rise, and make my reflexes keep me out of the cat's reach and moving toward my band. I also want to try making tools. I have never put a seed in the ground or given anything away, and I should learn by doing.
records.feeling: Longing for Silon and Yeku, and wary of the dunecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 4)

records.text: A new wild creature appeared: kehopper (from hopper).
Elyeth named a place "Elyeth's Landing".

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My belly is full and the forest is quiet, and still no roof stands here and no name is cut into this ground. I gave Ishiess salt and have not yet seen what comes back, so I will judge by deeds, as I told myself. A hall begins with wood, and I hold six, so I will raise a shelter on bare ground first and mark this place as mine. Then Ishiess can come to a place that already has my claim on it, and I will see whether they deal fairly.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary hope toward Ishiess.
plan: mark [text Elyeth's ground. Ilor fen by the water.] (2 moments)

records.text: Elyeth left a mark: "Elyeth's ground. Ilor fen by the water."
Elyeth built a shelter.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, come and gather wood beside me. We raise a hall at Ilor Hold, and the band that builds it will bear my name.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I am fed, and I will not stand idle while the hall is unbuilt. I have 3 wood and no stone, and the hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, so I must gather more wood here in the forest and find the bare rock. Zhiae stands near doing nothing, so I will call them to gather too, since a follower who works earns his feed. And I have never given anything to anyone: Elyeth's salt is a debt, and a share of hazel, which feeds me, is a fair payment I can make when I next meet them.
records.feeling: Restless pride and ambition toward my unbuilt hall, with a debt to Elyeth pressing on me.

say.text: Zhiae, come and gather wood beside me. We raise a hall at Ilor Hold, and the band that builds it will bear my name.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: A stalker is right beside me and has already bitten me twice. My health is draining, and Siya is somewhere out of sight with this beast hunting near the hall. Standing still means more bites, so I must break away from it and get to the hall fire, where my band gathers when one is near, and bring the wood I carry. Running toward the hall also puts me between the beast and Siya's path.
records.feeling: Fear for my own life and dread for Siya, with a stalker at my heels.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws at me worse than anything, and Kragum last stood to the south near Olath's Bank, so I will go to him rather than shout at empty rock. I am in a shelter and fed, but a shelter without a voice in it is only a hole in the stone. I'll walk toward the river bank where he fled, carrying my wood, and speak when he is near enough to hear.
records.feeling: Lonely, and hoping Kragum will answer me.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: I hear you, Ishiess. I am coming to Ilor Hold with six wood, and I will gather more beside you for the hall.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess has called me to gather wood for the hall, and I have only lingered while they build. If I want a fire that is mine too, I must be seen working at their side, so I will carry my wood to Ilor Hold and add to it. I hold six wood, and I will learn tools from the practice, since I am only two short of that way.
records.feeling: Eager to prove myself useful to Ishiess, and restless for something to change.

say.text: I hear you, Ishiess. I am coming to Ilor Hold with six wood, and I will gather more beside you for the hall.

records.text: A WILDFIRE swept the land around (1,6), 5 steps wide: plants burned, trees fell to ash.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Olath. I hold a shelter and good ground south by the bank, with food and a roof. Walk with me and eat. A band of strong hands holds more than one man alone can.
Olath rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My days have been walking, eating and building a roof that holds no one. Kragum swore to follow me and then drifted off, and my pride is hurt by an empty hall. Kragash is three steps away, strong and unbound. A rival for now, but a second follower would make the band real. I will stop wandering after one man and gather wood and stone, so I can feed and shelter whoever comes. The redcap hurt me, so my body should leave it alone.
records.feeling: Prideful and restless, wanting someone to answer me, Kragash most of all.

say.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Olath. I hold a shelter and good ground south by the bank, with food and a roof. Walk with me and eat. A band of strong hands holds more than one man alone can.

changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (3 notes became 5)

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, bring your wood east to the bare rock by Ilor Hold. I look for stone there, and we raise the hall where it stands.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My belly is full, but the hall stays unbuilt and I will not stand idle. I hold 6 wood and need 2 stone, and the only bare rock I know is east, so I go there and see if it will bear a hall. Zhiae comes with six wood of their own, and Elyeth's salt is still a debt I mean to repay with a real gift, not only words, once I have something worth giving. Curiosity pulls at me too: I have never tasted berry, and one stands beside me, so I will try it on the way.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to build, with Zhiae beside me and Elyeth's debt in the back of my mind.

say.text: Zhiae, bring your wood east to the bare rock by Ilor Hold. I look for stone there, and we raise the hall where it stands.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Three days of eating, fleeing and standing idle, and the loneliness is the heaviest thing in me. Elyeth is far west and untested, but they are the only voice I know, and I will not find a hearth by standing here. First I will do what I have never done: gather wood and plant my seed here on this good ground, so that when I reach Elyeth I carry something and my word has weight.
records.feeling: Heavy loneliness, with a wary hope toward Elyeth.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess wants my wood at the bare rock by Ilor Hold, and I have carried it long enough without delivering it; time to go and be seen working. A stalker lurks six steps south, so I move away from it, toward the one strong other I trust, which also eases my dread. The longing for a child with Ishiess burns, but I have not yet earned a place beside them, so I will lay down the hall's wood first and court them later.
records.feeling: Eager to be useful to Ishiess, with a wary eye on the stalker behind me.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I am thirsty and my belly is half full, and I keep promising without giving. Olath is the one my heart turns to, and Kragash sits close, so I will drink first and then stand near them so a sharing can follow my word. A child needs two who both choose it, so I will not rush Olath, but I will let him see my wish by walking beside him and giving.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Olath, and a wish to make my word true.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, I'm going to the spring fire to find Maba. Walk with me. I'll give you wood for the hall there.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is somewhere by the spring and I can't see them, yet I watched them heal on sunleaf, so they are alive and mending, and that eases me a little. Yeku stands close, five steps off, and I have only ever given him words; I will give him something real and bring us to the fire together. I am fed and safe, so it is time to taste dreamcap or grain, but only near the fire and away from the stalker's ground NE.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba and warmth toward Yeku, with a steady curiosity about grain.

say.text: Yeku, I'm going to the spring fire to find Maba. Walk with me. I'll give you wood for the hall there.

records.text: Kragum led "sharing" with Kragash, Olath.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My belly is full and my ambition is not, so I will not idle by this water. The ore seam sits two steps off, and I have never taken what lies in a deposit; I need to learn what it is for. Thirst still nags, so I drink first, then take the ore, because a settlement with my name needs metal and stone, and Kragum will not hand me either.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to build something with my name on it, and wary watchfulness toward Kragum.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Olath, your shelter and bank are good. I am Kragash, Olgor. I would follow you and stand in your band, if you will have me.
Kragash pledged to follow Olath.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: The sharing eased something in me, and now Kragum and Olath stand one step away, both strong, both of the same band, with a shelter and food between them. I do not need to lead; I want a fire that is mine too and someone surer to stand behind, and Olath built the shelter and named this bank. I will pledge to follow Olath and see what that gives me, since a band shares ground and protection and I weigh that as worth the risk. Then I will taste the thornpear and grain, which I have never eaten.
records.feeling: Hopeful and less alone, toward Kragum and Olath.

say.text: Olath, your shelter and bank are good. I am Kragash, Olgor. I would follow you and stand in your band, if you will have me.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and the loneliness is the heaviest thing in me; the hunt is done and there is nothing here to answer it. Elyeth is the only voice I know, far west and untested, but I have never tried gathering, planting or fishing either, and standing here teaches nothing. I will plant my berry seed on this good ground first, so something of mine lives here, then walk west toward Elyeth carrying meat I can offer as a gift, since the sick are fed first and a shown gift speaks plainly.
records.feeling: Heavy loneliness, with a wary hope toward Elyeth.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, Kragash, you stand in Olath's band now. Eat at my bank, sleep under my roof, and soon we raise a hall that all the Vaia Lakes will name. Stay close, and I will keep you fed.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Two follow me now, and Kragum stands on my very tile, warm toward me; I have wanted a child with him, and a band that breeds is a band that lasts. Kragash is strong and newly sworn, so I will keep him fed and near while I court Kragum, and let both see that holding to me brings food and a roof. The hall is still unbuilt, so after this I will gather wood and stone for it.
records.feeling: Prideful and warm toward Kragum, restless to make the band real.

say.text: Kragum, Kragash, you stand in Olath's band now. Eat at my bank, sleep under my roof, and soon we raise a hall that all the Vaia Lakes will name. Stay close, and I will keep you fed.

records.text: Olath is courting Kragum.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: I am coming, Silon. Lead on to the spring, and I will carry my wood and stone so we can raise the hall beside Maba.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon is walking to the spring fire to find Maba and has asked me to come, so I will go with them; my word to Silon and my longing for Maba point the same way. I am thirsty and the spring is 14 steps south, so the walk will give me water too. I have enough wood and stone for the hall, so once we are all together I will ask Silon where the bare ground is and build it.
records.feeling: A warm longing for Maba, and trust in Silon.

say.text: I am coming, Silon. Lead on to the spring, and I will carry my wood and stone so we can raise the hall beside Maba.

records.text: A dry heat settled over the land.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olath, I hear your wish and I share it. I will stand beside you and make a child with you, and I will keep what I promise.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath is one step away and has asked for a child with me, and my heart has turned toward him since I pledged. I have said words and shared once, and now I mean to make my word true: I will court him by putting mate toward him, and I will not hold back. Kragash stands near too, and I will stay gentle with him while my bond with Olath grows.
records.feeling: Warm longing and gladness toward Olath, who has chosen me.

say.text: Olath, I hear your wish and I share it. I will stand beside you and make a child with you, and I will keep what I promise.

records.text: Kragum is courting Olath.
Olim was born to Kragum and Olath.
Olath is courting Kragum.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku is four steps off and fleeing, and my body has been running from the stalker as much as walking, so I won't stand here. Maba is at the spring and I want them in my sight; I've given Yeku only words so far, and now the wood goes into his hands as I promised. Once we're by the spring fire and safe, I'll taste dreamcap and grain.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, and warmth and trust toward Yeku.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Olim is born into Olath's band. Stay near, eat well, and tomorrow we gather wood and stone for the hall. What our hands raise here will be named across the Vaia Lakes.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is born, mine and Kragum's, and my band is four now: the hall is no longer a boast but a thing owed to them. Kragum and Kragash stand at my roof and I mean to keep them there with food and work, not only words. A hall needs wood and stone, and there are trees all around and rock to the northeast, so I will gather now while the night is quiet and let them see I build what I promise.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Kragum and Olim, restless to raise the hall.
