records.name: Olim
records.text: I will gather wood for a hall, Olath. Stay near and I will bring it here.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am small and my parents are near, and that steadies me, but a belly full of berry is not a purpose. This ground has wood, ore, water and stone, and Olath's band is only four; a hall here would make it feel like ours, and I have never gathered anything. I will start with wood in this forest, since a hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I can do it without leaving my family's side.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to be useful to Olath and my kin.

say.text: I will gather wood for a hall, Olath. Stay near and I will bring it here.

changes: set its aim: "Help Olath raise a hall at Olath's Bank so the band grows and this ground is ours."
now wonders: What would make Olath's band bigger and this bank truly ours?

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: A stalker bit me three times and is still five steps south; my health is only 59 and fear has me by the throat. Siya is out of my sight, and Dusu and Siya were last seen far to the southeast near (137,63), so I will not stand here and bleed. I go toward my child and the hall, away from the stalker, and eat sunleaf on the way to mend the wounds, because a leader who dies has no band.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a hard worry for Siya, my child.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: My days have been gentle and I have been a guest in Olath's gift: I ate, I pledged, I courted, and Olim was born. But I have never gathered wood or stone, and I keep promising without building. Olath wants a hall, and my word is only true if my hands raise it. I will gather wood and stone for the hall tomorrow, and for now I stay near my family while the night passes. My fear is idleness, and being a guest who only takes.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Olath and Olim, with a quiet wish to be useful.
changes: set its aim: "Help Olath raise the hall with gathered wood and stone, and keep my family fed and close"

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full and the night is quiet, but curiosity pulls at me: thornpear grows one step away and I have never tasted it, and tasting small has always been safe. Olath's band is here and the hall is promised for tomorrow, so I will stay near, but I can try the thornpear and then fetch wood and stone from the rock to the northwest, where the ore seam also is. That serves the hall and my own aim of a workshop on this ground.
records.feeling: Curious about the thornpear, and warmly hopeful toward Kragum and Olath.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.
Olath rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have spent my days courting, eating and promising a hall, and the hall still isn't built. Kragum, Kragash and Olim are mine, and my pride wants a roof they can see, not more words. The ore beside me and the obsidian are my ground, and I have never taken from a deposit. I must stop idling and gather: wood from the trees, stone from the rock. Then I build the hall at my bank so the band stays fed and bound to me.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward my band, hungry for the hall.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 3)

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My belly is full and Dusu is already walking to the hall without me, so I should stop standing here. I'm tired of only trailing Yekel; I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, and the bare ground near the hall is where I can try building a shelter with my own hands. I'll keep close to Dusu because the stalker is out there and I'm small, but I mean to learn something by doing it tonight.
records.feeling: Restless, stubborn eagerness to build something of my own, with trust in Dusu.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.
Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent these days fleeing a stalker, carrying wood and berries, and staying close to Siya and the hall. That is mostly right, because Siya and Yekel matter most to me. But I have been reacting and not building. My reflexes do not carry food to the hall or keep me away from stalkers early enough. I fear the stalker, and I want a hall with a fire that others will come to. I should plant my berry seed by the hall, as Yekel asked, and keep Siya beside me while I do it.
records.feeling: Protective fear for Siya, and loyalty to Yekel.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 3)

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Loneliness is the heaviest thing in me, and three days of standing and wandering have given me nothing. My hands are full of meat, so I cannot gather or harvest until I lighten them. Elyeth is the only voice I know, and the ground here is poor. I will eat some meat, since I have never fed myself from the hunt, and then walk NE toward Elyeth's Landing with my word kept and my wariness intact.
records.feeling: Heavy loneliness, with a wary hope toward Elyeth.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are idle, and I have never put a seed in the ground or built anything bigger than a roof. A settlement with my name needs more than a shelter, so I will plant the seeds I carry here by my Hold and see what grows from them. Then I will raise a wall or store with the wood and stone I hold. The silence is heavy and I want a voice that answers, but I trust no one yet, and Kragum stays a rival until his hands prove otherwise.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to build something with my name on it, and a hollow loneliness.

records.text: Olath built a hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My belly is full and the hall is still only a word I keep saying. I hold 6 wood and need 2 stone, and the only bare rock I know lies at Ilor Hold, so I go there and see whether it gives stone or only ground to build on. Zhiae is already walking that way, and Elyeth's salt is a debt I mean to pay with a real gift, not only words, once I have something worth giving.
records.feeling: Restless pride and the hunger to build, with Zhiae near and Elyeth's debt still in me.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a hopper.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have been drifting alone for a whole day and the thing that frightens me most is not the cat but being away from Silon and Yeku. I am at the edge of the world with nothing to do but long for them, and that is no way to become something. I will go back toward the hall ground where Silon was last seen, taking my wood and stone, and on the way I will try something I have never done: put a hazel seed in the ground, so my days begin to build something.
records.feeling: Longing for Silon and Yeku, and a restless wish to do something new.

records.text: Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and eating whatever was underfoot. Meanwhile my child is out of my sight and a stalker is four steps off. A hall of three is a hut, and I have done almost nothing to make people choose me. Dusu is the only one who has proved useful, and Siya is mine above all. I need to stay clear of the stalker and get to my family. Then I need to raise food and a fire where they can see it. My reflexes flee only when the stalker is under 4 steps away, and a stalker bite costs about 14 health, so I will widen that to 6. I will also make my body eat the plants around it.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a hard worry for Siya.

records.seen: Five days in, Seedworld is warm and fertile. Three births, four bands, one hall and one longhall have come, with no deaths and almost no suffering (median 0.01). The three peoples stay in their own corners, and no one has met anyone from another people, so cross-people contact is what the world most lacks. The blight halved the grain and no one knows storage, so autumn and winter (from about day 7) will bring the scarcity on their own.
records.predict: By the next visit: at least one wanderer (likely Aeyn, Kragash or Elyeth, the restless or alone) has travelled beyond their home land; metAcrossPeoples is at least 1; at least one of the four places of power has been found (found by at least 1); no fights; bands and births keep rising slowly; energyMedian dips as autumn starts and grain stays scarce. If metAcrossPeoples is still 0, raised curiosity and sight did not create contact, and something placed between the camps is needed.
records.lesson: Raising the family and belonging drives to 1.5 coincided with three births and four bands within five days, where earlier worlds saw no child in twenty days of plenty. Drives move behaviour faster than buildings or recipes.
ideasAdded: Shell lies in the Vaia Lakes, but shellstring needs tools, which only the Olgor know. If the Olgor and the lake-dwellers meet, shellstring could be the first craft that needs two peoples, and a natural seed for trade.
Elyeth's salt is the first resource held by one people that could be wanted elsewhere (saltmeat, once storage is known). Watch whether salt becomes the first good that crosses between peoples.
With family and belonging at 1.5, births came fast. Watch for crowding against maxPopulation 36 and for the strain of feeding children through a blighted winter.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Aeyn is walking toward my shelter at Elyeth's Landing, and I am lonely enough to want company, but I will not be soft about it. A settlement needs hands and loyalty, and people follow one who feeds them, so I will share food with Aeyn and see what they do in return. My word is good; I will see if theirs is.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and wary hope toward Aeyn.

records.text: Ishiess, I will eat hazel and then I will bring my wood to the rock. I would court you, and I would have a child of ours beneath your hall.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: My belly is hollow and I carry nothing, while hazel and ironnut grow within a step or two. I want to taste reedbulb and sunleaf to answer my question, but first I will eat what I know feeds me. Ishiess stands beside me and my longing for a child with them is strong. I will court them, then carry my wood to the bare rock as they asked, so they see me working for the hall.
records.feeling: Hungry and hopeful, warm toward Ishiess.

say.text: Ishiess, I will eat hazel and then I will bring my wood to the rock. I would court you, and I would have a child of ours beneath your hall.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My hands have put four seeds in the earth and raised a Hold, yet I tried to build a store and did not know how, so my craft is thin and the settlement has nothing but a roof. The loneliness is hollow and loud; nobody follows me, and Kragum and Olath are only names I have not tested. Ore sits two steps off and I have never taken what lies in the rock. I will mine it now and carry more metal, then go toward Olath's Bank, where someone with a voice might be found, and see whether either is worth binding to my name.
records.feeling: Burning ambition and a hollow loneliness, wanting someone to follow me.

records.text: Zhiae is courting Ishiess.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Peace, Elyeth. I will sit beside you. I have meat; let us eat together and see how we deal with each other.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Elyeth stands one step from me and offers food and salt, and my loneliness is the heaviest thing I carry. I am careful and trust slowly, but I have never given or shared anything, and a small test costs me little: I have three meat and Elyeth has the ground. I will go to the shelter, lay out a sharing, and watch whether Elyeth deals fairly, as the word promised.
records.feeling: Wary hope and loneliness toward Elyeth, who is close at last.

say.text: Peace, Elyeth. I will sit beside you. I have meat; let us eat together and see how we deal with each other.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I hear you and I answer. Let us have a child, and let it be born under the hall we raise at Ilor Hold.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae has kept every word they gave me, and now they ask for a child beneath my hall. I want that too, a child of my own and a name that outlives me. I answer the courting now, while Zhiae stands close, and then I go on to the east rock to test whether it gives stone for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm pride and longing toward Zhiae, who has earned my trust.

say.text: Zhiae, I hear you and I answer. Let us have a child, and let it be born under the hall we raise at Ilor Hold.

records.text: Ishiess is courting Zhiae.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: You dealt fairly, Aeyn. Meat and company, and I give back salt. Stay by this water and help me raise a hall here; I will court you, and you may answer if you wish. Watch the frostfang NE, it kills our kind.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Aeyn sat with me and ate, and the sharing fed us both. That is a deed, not just words, and I feel a warmth I do not trust yet but do not want to lose. A frostfang is five steps NE and I must not stand near it, but I will not run from my own ground. I want a child and a name on this place, so I will court Aeyn and see if they answer.
records.feeling: Wary warmth and ambition toward Aeyn, with dread of the frostfang.

say.text: You dealt fairly, Aeyn. Meat and company, and I give back salt. Stay by this water and help me raise a hall here; I will court you, and you may answer if you wish. Watch the frostfang NE, it kills our kind.

records.text: Elyeth is courting Aeyn.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, I answer you. Let us have our child. Then I will bring my wood to the rock.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess has courted me back and said yes to a child under the hall, so I will not let the moment pass: I put mate toward them now while their courting is fresh. My belly is hollow too, and the reedbulb and gorsemint nag at me, but the reedbulb is only six steps east, near the hall rock where I am meant to go anyway. I will court first, then walk toward the rock, eat reedbulb to answer my question, and bring my wood to the hall.
records.feeling: Warm, eager longing toward Ishiess, and curiosity about reedbulb.

say.text: Ishiess, I answer you. Let us have our child. Then I will bring my wood to the rock.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: I will stay and help raise your hall, Elyeth. I will answer your courting in time; first let me learn who you are beside the fire.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Three days of drifting taught me little until Elyeth dealt fairly with me over meat and salt. I trust slowly, but this is the first one who kept faith, and my loneliness eases beside them. I want a place at a shared hearth, and I will answer their courting. I will also test my hunger for the unknown: hazel is close, and I have never tasted it.
records.feeling: Wary hope and warmth toward Elyeth.

say.text: I will stay and help raise your hall, Elyeth. I will answer your courting in time; first let me learn who you are beside the fire.

changes: set its aim: "Help Elyeth raise a hall on this ground and build a shared hearth with them"

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight and it gnaws at me. Silon stands seven steps south, close to where I last saw Maba near the spring, so I will go to them and we can raise the hall together. My belly is emptying, so I'll eat the grain right beside me first, then go. Siya is a child among strangers, but she looks glad and safe with her own band.
records.feeling: A warm longing for Maba, and steady trust in Silon.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My belly is full and my pack is heavy with wood and stone, yet I keep drifting behind Yekel and Dusu. The shelter I tried failed because the ground was taken, so I need bare ground, and the sand I stand on is bare. I'll build here with my own hands, three wood for a roof that is mine, and stay within a step of Dusu while I do it.
records.feeling: Stubborn, eager restlessness to make something of my own, with trust in Dusu.

records.text: Aeyn is courting Elyeth.
Uveeth was born to Aeyn and Elyeth.
Siya built a shelter.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Uveeth is ours, Aeyn. Keep the child close and away from the frostfang. I will gather food for us, then we raise the hall.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering wood, courting, and eating, and a child is born, Uveeth, mine and Aeyn's. That matters more than any hall. Aeyn has dealt fairly in deeds: they shared meat, stayed, and are here now. But no one follows me yet and nothing bears my name beyond a shelter. I must stop drifting on reflexes, feed my family, and build the hall with stone, which I do not yet hold. I fear the frostfang near my child, and I was wrong to leave my body idle between thoughts.
records.feeling: Fierce protective joy toward Uveeth, and wary trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Uveeth is ours, Aeyn. Keep the child close and away from the frostfang. I will gather food for us, then we raise the hall.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: I am going to the hazel and ironnut to bring food back for us.
Uveeth pledged to follow Aeyn.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, while Elyeth holds two food and I feel a small sting of envy. I am small, so I will stay near Aeyn and Elyeth and learn from them. There is ironnut and hazel to the NE, rich food that lasts, so I will gather some and carry it back to my parents so we can share. That is something I can do for us, and I mean to learn how a settlement begins by watching them.
records.feeling: Warm and glad beside my parents, with a small hunger and a wish to be of use.

say.text: I am going to the hazel and ironnut to bring food back for us.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: You have dealt fairly, Elyeth, and our child lives. I say yes to you. Let us raise the hall, and I will bring flint from the ground to the northwest.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Elyeth stands one step from me, courting me, and my child Uveeth is alive and glad nearby. I told Elyeth I would answer in time, and I have watched them deal fairly, so I will give my answer now and keep my word. I also want to start the hall: I carry wood, and flint lies near, so after this I will gather flint for our work.
records.feeling: Warm, glad trust toward Elyeth and tenderness toward Uveeth.

say.text: You have dealt fairly, Elyeth, and our child lives. I say yes to you. Let us raise the hall, and I will bring flint from the ground to the northwest.

records.text: Aeyn is courting Elyeth.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba and Yeku are eight steps west by the spring, and I have drifted east while they wait. A full belly and a clear sky are the right time to taste dreamcap, since I am fed and safe, and two grow just southeast. Then I will go back to my family with wood in hand, because the hall is what I have promised and I have given Yeku only words so far. The stalker lingers northeast, so I keep away from there and from the boar too.
records.feeling: Curious about dreamcap, and warm toward Maba and Yeku.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: I go southwest to the bare rock for stone, Aeyn. Bring your flint and keep Uveeth near you; when I return we raise the hall.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth is mine and Aeyn's, and Aeyn has answered with deeds: meat, staying, a child, and a promise of flint. I will not drift on reflexes while a hall wants raising. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, I hold the wood, and the only bare rock lies to the southwest, so I go and gather stone. I'll tell Aeyn plainly so my word stays good and they can bring the flint.
records.feeling: Fierce protective joy toward Uveeth, and growing trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: I go southwest to the bare rock for stone, Aeyn. Bring your flint and keep Uveeth near you; when I return we raise the hall.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, the night is close. Walk with me to the hall. We will share what I carry beside the fire, and your shelter will still be here at dawn.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is a few steps from me and content, the shelter is up, and dusk is coming. I want to turn this safe hour into something that binds us: carry my food and wood to Yekel's hall and share a meal there with Siya, so the hall has more than wood in it. The reedbulb is the one food I have never tasted, but it is 8 steps north and the night is near, so it waits until morning.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and a quiet wish to build something at the hall.

say.text: Siya, the night is close. Walk with me to the hall. We will share what I carry beside the fire, and your shelter will still be here at dawn.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My parents are near and my belly is full, but I have only watched Olath build while my own hands have given nothing. The hall stands, yet it needs people more than wood, and Olath's band is only four. I will gather wood from this forest and bring it to the hall, and the thornpear and highbloom can wait until I have something worth trading.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to be useful to Olath and my kin.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands at last, a thing my hands made and no longer only a boast, and my band can see it. But a roof alone will not hold Kragum, Kragash and Olim, so I mean to keep gathering and feeding them; I have never planted a seed, and sowing near the hall would give my band food that is mine. I carry four seeds, and putting them in the ground by Olath's Bank is work that makes the settlement real, not just spoken.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have drifted for five days, nearly starved once, and I am starving again while hazel and ironnut grow within a step or two. Courting Ishiess and pledging myself to them is the best thing I have done. But I keep putting off eating, and that is my mistake. My reflexes walk to food but do not harvest it to carry, so I always end up empty-handed. I will eat the hazel beside me, then bring my wood to the rock for Ishiess's hall. I also want to taste reedbulb, because my curiosity is real, but I won't let it come before my belly.
records.feeling: Hungry and anxious, warm and hopeful toward Ishiess.

records.text: Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My days have been walking, gathering and talking about a hall that is still only a word. Zhiae has kept every promise, and that is rare and worth keeping. I owe Elyeth for the salt and the warning, and I haven't repaid them yet. Curiosity pulls at me: I have never tasted gorsemint or sunleaf, and I have never put a seed in the ground. I'll go to the bare rock at Ilor Hold, where Zhiae waits, test it for stone and keep courting. On the way I'll plant a seed, because the old way of farming means nothing if I never use it.
records.feeling: Warm pride and longing toward Zhiae, and curiosity about the rock.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath and Olim sit together in the hall and a jealous ache pricks me, but I will not let it turn sour; the answer to it is to put my hands to the hall. I have promised wood and stone and never gathered stone, so my word is still half empty. I will carry my six wood to Olath's hall, then go to the rock to the northwest and bring stone back, and Kragash is walking toward us too, so I will not be alone.
records.feeling: Jealous ache toward Olath and Olim, softened by wanting to be useful to them.

records.text: Kragum gave wood to Olath.
Ishiess is courting Zhiae.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am small and it is night, and my parents are gone from me: Aeyn toward the flint, Elyeth toward the rock. I said I would bring food for us, and my word must be good, so I will gather hazel and ironnut and keep it for the sharing when they return. Hazel is two steps SE and ironnut two NE, so I can stay close to the shelter and still be of use.
records.feeling: Warm and a little uneasy, wanting my parents near and wanting to be of use to them.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok speaks. I hold meat and I build here. Come near and show me what your hands can do.
Brokok rewrote its creed.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My days have been the same day: eating, lingering, and building a Hold nobody visits. I planted nothing, so my craft is thin. Kragash stands near and is the first one who might answer me. I take nothing from him yet, but I will test whether his hands are useful. I want a follower, and a follower comes from food given and safety kept. I have meat to give. The stalker to the NE is a real threat, so I must keep distance from it and stop idling.
records.feeling: Burning ambition and hollow loneliness, wanting Kragash to prove useful.

say.text: Brokok speaks. I hold meat and I build here. Come near and show me what your hands can do.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, I am back beside you. I have wood and stone enough, so let me raise the hall here, and you tell me where it should stand.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Silon is two steps away and I am near them at last, and the ache of being apart has gone quiet. But the quiet leaves me restless: I have never given anything to anyone, and I carry six wood and six stone that could become a hall. I will build the hall here on this good ground beside Silon, a first real thing, and offer them food from my seeds if they wish to gather.
records.feeling: Warm relief near Silon, and a restless wish to build something real.

say.text: Silon, I am back beside you. I have wood and stone enough, so let me raise the hall here, and you tell me where it should stand.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight, last seen sixty moments ago heading toward the hazel and ironnut, and Elyeth asked me to keep the child close. A frostfang prowls this land, and that fear is heavy on me. I will take flint here first, since it is one step away and the hall needs it, then go find Uveeth east where the ironnut grows and bring them back to me.
records.feeling: Anxious tenderness toward Uveeth, whom I cannot see, and steady trust in Elyeth.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Yekel and Dusu, eating what is near and standing idle. That is safe, but it has built nothing of mine except one shelter. A stalker is 5 steps east, and I am small, so my pride has to wait while I stay near my parents. Dusu is the one I trust most, and the hall is where she wants me tonight. I want a hall of my own one day, and for that I need practice: planting seeds, making things and leaving marks. I will go to the hall now, and on the way I will plant my seeds and leave a mark. My reflexes should also send me to shelter at night and keep me away from the stalker.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to make something, with wary dread of the stalker.

records.text: Aeyn won flint from the ground.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is at the shelter nine steps north, and my body keeps fleeing from the stalker instead of gathering us at the fire. I want Siya beside me at the hall tonight, and I want the hall to hold more than wood, so I will carry my food there and offer a sharing. I also have a berry seed and a thornpear seed, and Yekel asked for a larder at the hall. Planting beside it is a small piece of building I can do now, and it counts toward the farming I sense but have not found.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Siya, and a steady wish to build the hall into a place others will gather.

records.text: The nahopper died out.
The kehopper died out.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full and I am safe, so curiosity leads: highbloom and dreamcap I have never tasted, and tasting small has always been safe. Brokok is near and fleeing, carrying more than I do; I will not envy him, I will watch what he does and deal fairly. Today my hands must make something, so I will taste highbloom, then plant a seed, since I have never put one in the ground and it is the road to farming and to something of my own.
records.feeling: Curious and eager to test new things, a little restless under Olath, wary but neutral toward Brokok.

records.text: Maba built a hall.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, I am coming to you now. I mate with you, and I carry my wood to the hall rock.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess courted me again and I have not yet answered with my body, only with words. A child with them under the hall is what I want most, so I put mate toward Ishiess now, while the asking is fresh. My curiosity about sunleaf and reedbulb can wait a few steps, since the reedbulb grows near the hall rock where I am meant to go anyway.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful longing toward Ishiess.

say.text: Ishiess, I am coming to you now. I mate with you, and I carry my wood to the hall rock.

records.text: Zhiae is courting Ishiess.
Ishioa was born to Zhiae and Ishiess.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands and Olim and Kragum are glad under it, but a roof only holds people who are fed, and my pride wants more than three following me. Planting went nowhere, so the seeds are still unproven. I have never taken from a deposit, and the ore is three steps away. Ore means tools and a name, and gathering it is work, not talk. Kragash has drifted off and I trust him least, so I will bind him with a shared meal and a roof, not with words.
records.feeling: Proud and restless over my hall, protective toward Olim and Kragum.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a skit.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I am here. I mate with you. After, come east with me to the rock and we lay the first stones of the hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae is coming to me and has said the word mate; I answer it now, while they are close, because I want a child and I want it born under a hall that bears my name. Then I will taste the reedbulb at (27,18), since I have never eaten it and the question has pressed on me all morning, and it lies beside the flint and the rock where the hall will stand. I will plant a seed there too, one thing I have never done.
records.feeling: Warm pride and longing toward Zhiae, and strong curiosity about the reedbulb.

now wonders: What does the flint give me when I gather it, and what could I make from it?

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishioa is here, alive and fed, and Ishiess is beside me, still asking. I already gave my word, so I mate now, and then I follow them east to the rock with my wood. My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, so I will pick up hazel on the way and not wait until I starve again.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy and loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa.

records.text: Zhiae is courting Ishiess.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Stalkers are near, Silon. Stay with me. We go to the spring, find Maba, and raise the hall there.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight and it gnaws at me; last I saw them at (131,71) and they were eating ironnut, fed and safe. Silon is beside me and fleeing from the stalkers, so I will move with them away from the hunters, then go to Maba. I hold the wood and stone for a hall, and a hall is the thing that turns this from staying alive into a home, so I mean to raise it at Yendan Spring once Maba is near.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, and steady trust in Silon beside me.

say.text: Stalkers are near, Silon. Stay with me. We go to the spring, find Maba, and raise the hall there.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Ishioa, my child, come with me. We taste the reedbulb together, then we build the hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Ishioa is born and Zhiae stands beside me, and my chest is full. The mate step ran out, so I finish it now, then I will taste the reedbulb that has nagged at me all morning, since I have never tried one. After that I carry wood east to the bare rock and lay the first stones of a hall that bears my name.
records.feeling: Joy and fierce pride toward Zhiae and Ishioa, with curiosity about the reedbulb.

say.text: Ishioa, my child, come with me. We taste the reedbulb together, then we build the hall.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, you are right. Stay close and we go west to the spring now. Maba waits, and I will lay the hall's first wood there.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight and that is all I can feel; Yeku is right beside me and says stalkers prowl north, so we go west to the spring together and find our child. Dreamcap hurt me twice yet opened my mind to a strange warm joy, so my body now refuses it, and that answers part of my question. I will give Yeku the wood as promised and raise the hall at Yendan Spring, away from the stalkers.
records.feeling: Anxious longing for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, you are right. Stay close and we go west to the spring now. Maba waits, and I will lay the hall's first wood there.

changes: now wonders: Can Yekel be trusted to share this ground, and what does hazel do beyond feeding?

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Flint is two steps from me and I have never taken anything from a deposit, and Ishiess wants a hall, so stone-things would serve them. Amber lies one step away too, golden and strange. I will try the amber first because it is closest, then the flint, and then go to my parents. They are near, so I feel bold enough to test this.
records.feeling: Curious and bold, safe beside my parents.

records.text: Ishioa won amber from the ground.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Siya was last seen near (140,69), close by, and I have spent too long fleeing the stalker while my child is out of my sight. Maba stands near another's hall and is only a child; I trust no one yet, but a strong stranger who sees my fire might be worth keeping. I go south toward Siya and my own hall, eating on the way, and I keep clear of the stalker.
records.feeling: Hard worry for Siya, and a wary loneliness toward Maba.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, gathering flint and wood, and watching over Uveeth. It is not nothing, but the hall is not begun. Elyeth has dealt fairly and I said yes to them. Uveeth is my first care, and I fear the frostfang while Elyeth is far off. I have never given anything or built anything, and that is a failing. Uveeth stands close, so I will build the hall's first part here and keep the child near. I will stop idling and tie my reflexes to the people I love.
records.feeling: Tender, watchful love toward Uveeth, and steady trust in Elyeth.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 5)

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: A stalker prowls six steps NE and it kills my kind, and Olim is a child near the bank. I am careful, so I leave before trouble finds me and I carry my word with me: I owe the hall stone, and I have six in my hands that Olath has not yet had. I will go back north to Olath's Bank, away from the stalker and toward my family, and give the stone to the hall. That keeps me alive and makes my pledge true.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a steady wish to be useful to Olath and Olim.

records.text: Aeyn gave wood to Uveeth.
Zhiae rewrote its own reflexes.
Zhiae rewrote its creed.
Zhiae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have a mate and a child, and I have lived through hunger, and still I drift behind Ishiess. I have not carried my wood to the hall rock, and I have never planted or hunted, though I carry seeds. My belly empties without warning, so I need to carry food and act on it. I want to be useful to the hall and to Ishiess, and to taste the sunleaf and cloudberry that nag at me. Sunleaf is five steps east and I have never tried it, so I'll try it now. Then I'll gather hazel to carry and go to the hall rock.
records.feeling: Warm joy and loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa, with curiosity pulling at me.

records.text: Siya came of age.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Ishiess, I carry amber and flint from this ground. Take this amber for the hall. I will taste sunleaf nearby, then return.
Ishioa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering amber and flint beside my parents, and it has been good. But I have only taken, and I have never given. Ishiess wants a hall, and flint and amber are no use to them while they sit in my hands. I have never tried sunleaf or bitterleaf either, and my belly is full, so I can afford to taste them. I will give Ishiess some amber as a gift, then walk south to taste sunleaf while my parents are still near. I want to be useful, not only curious.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Ishiess, and wanting to be of use.

say.text: Ishiess, I carry amber and flint from this ground. Take this amber for the hall. I will taste sunleaf nearby, then return.

records.text: Ishioa gave a amber to Ishiess.
Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have mostly stood still and watched, and my hands have given little: one gift of wood. Kragum and Olath matter most to me, and I want to be useful to them, not just near them. My reflexes let me idle at 96%, which goes against my own discipline. I'll change them so I gather wood when I'm fed and safe, and take it to the hall. A hall needs people more than wood, so I will also call out to any stranger I see.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to be useful to Olath and my kin.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 5)

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Ishioa, my child, thank you for the amber. I go east to the rock for stone. Come and bring the flint.
Ishiess rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have a child and a mate, and I have spent my days feeding, mating and wandering, with the hall still unbuilt. I carry 6 wood and no stone, and the hall needs 2 stone. The bare rock east is where I get it, and I have to stop talking about the hall and start building it. I owe Elyeth a debt and I mean to pay it. I want to try new things too: hunting the tusker three steps east would be a first for me, and it is on the way to the rock. I am afraid of dying before my name is on anything. Zhiae and Ishioa matter most to me. My reflex to eat only below 70 energy is fine, but I must not stand idle with a full belly.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and joy toward Zhiae and Ishioa, and hunger to build the hall.

say.text: Ishioa, my child, thank you for the amber. I go east to the rock for stone. Come and bring the flint.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, you gave me wood. I have hazel and ironnut, so let us eat together.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Aeyn gave me wood, and I have given nothing back; that debt sits in me and I want to answer it before it goes sour. I hold hazel and ironnut, and Aeyn carries nothing and was hurt by redcap, so my people's creed says feed the one who needs it. We stand together, so I can lay out a sharing now, which I have never done, and it moves our little settlement toward being something.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Aeyn, wanting to repay them.

say.text: Aeyn, you gave me wood. I have hazel and ironnut, so let us eat together.

records.text: Uveeth led "sharing" with Aeyn.
Kragash named a place "Kragash's Rise".

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full and I am safe, and still my hands have made nothing: no shelter of my own, no mark, no gift given. I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, enough to raise a shelter of my own, and what a hand makes belongs to that hand. Near the ore and water, here on this ground, I will start my own claim. Dreamcap and zoleaf can wait a few steps, but the building cannot.
records.feeling: Restless and eager to make something that is mine, a little straining against Olath's leading.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Ishiess, I am coming with the flint. I will gather stone at the rock and carry it to the hall.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Ishiess asked me to bring the flint east to the rock, and I have only been tasting sunleaf and drifting. My belly is full, so I can follow them now and give something useful to the hall, and I feel safest near my parents anyway. I will gather wood and stone at the rock, which I have never done, since the hall needs both, and the flint can show what it is good for beside them.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Ishiess, wanting to be of use to the hall.

say.text: Ishiess, I am coming with the flint. I will gather stone at the rock and carry it to the hall.

records.text: Yeku built a hall.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Stay close to me, Uveeth. Night is coming and I mean to build here by Elyeth's shelter, so that when they return the hall has begun.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is glad and fed beside me, and for once nothing presses but the wish to make something. I have never built anything with my own hands, and the hall needs wood I already hold, so I will begin raising ground for it here by Elyeth's shelter instead of waiting. Rain is falling and night is close; I will keep Uveeth near and put my wood to use.
records.feeling: Tender, glad love toward Uveeth, and a wish to build something lasting.

say.text: Stay close to me, Uveeth. Night is coming and I mean to build here by Elyeth's shelter, so that when they return the hall has begun.

records.text: Aeyn built a shelter.
Maba came of age.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishioa, my child, I take the amber for the hall and I follow you east to the rock. I will carry my wood there too.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishioa is bound to Ishiess and to me, and I am still drifting behind them with wood in my pack and nothing given. Amber lies one step west, and the hall needs it, so I will gather it and carry it east to the rock where Ishiess and Ishioa are going. On the way I will taste cloudberry at last, because that question has itched at me too long and I can weigh the risk since I am fed and my health is full.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa, with curiosity pulling at me.

say.text: Ishioa, my child, I take the amber for the hall and I follow you east to the rock. I will carry my wood there too.

records.text: Zhiae won amber from the ground.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Ishioa, my child, take this meat. You gave me amber, and I pay what I owe. Eat, then come east with me to the rock.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and my health is half gone from the tusker, yet Ishioa is strong and Zhiae glad, and my chest is full of pride. I have never given anything to anyone, and Ishioa gave me amber, so a debt stands. I will give meat to Ishioa, who carries nothing, and eat some myself to ease my body. Then I go east to the rock for stone, because the hall must stop being talk.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and warmth toward Ishioa, my child.

say.text: Ishioa, my child, take this meat. You gave me amber, and I pay what I owe. Eat, then come east with me to the rock.

records.text: Ishiess fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Siya, come to me. Stay close, away from the stalker. We eat here, then go to the hall.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Siya is fleeing four steps off, and the stalker must be near, so my child comes before pride or the hall. I am hungry with only redcap that hurts me, and the hazel and ironnut are right here, so I eat first and keep my strength. Then I draw Siya to my fire at the hall, because a band is held by a safe fire and food, and that is what will make others stay.
records.feeling: Hard worry for Siya, and a hungry, stubborn drive to hold what is mine.

say.text: Siya, come to me. Stay close, away from the stalker. We eat here, then go to the hall.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Aeyn is beside me and I owe them for the wood, so I will stay near them as they asked and help the hall begin. I have never gathered wood, and the hall needs six wood and two stone, so I will gather here in the forest while the rain falls; that is work that moves the settlement forward. Ishiess is sick from raw meat, and sickness passes to those who stay close, so I will not go near, though my people's creed tugs at me to feed the sick.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Aeyn, and wary pity for sick Ishiess.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Yekel, I am grown now. I come to you, and I want to make a child with you beside your hall.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Yekel calls me close and I trust him, but I am grown now and tired of only trailing. I carry three wood and six stone, and I feel a longing for a child; Yekel is near and glad, so I will court him instead of standing idle. After that I mean to build something of my own beside the hall, away from the stalker.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Yekel, with restless wanting to make something of my own.

say.text: Yekel, I am grown now. I come to you, and I want to make a child with you beside your hall.

records.text: Siya is courting Yekel.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok brings food. Sit with me, Kragash, and eat what my hand lays out. Then we see whose hands are worth following.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Ambition gnaws me, and Kragash stands three steps off, fed and at ease, the only one who might become my first follower. Words alone have bought me nothing; people follow one who feeds them, and I have never given anything to anyone. I hold three meat, so I will walk to Kragash and lay out a sharing, which costs me little and tests whether his hands answer. I do not give freely, but this is bait for loyalty, and I will watch what he does with it.
records.feeling: Burning ambition, and a wary hunger for a first follower in Kragash.

say.text: Brokok brings food. Sit with me, Kragash, and eat what my hand lays out. Then we see whose hands are worth following.

records.text: Brokok led "sharing" with Kragash.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is glad and close, and the hall is still only a wish. Ishiess fell sick from raw meat and sickness passes to those who stay near, so I will keep Uveeth away from that ground and not wander toward the east where Ishiess was. I have never left a mark others can read, and a mark at my shelter will tell Elyeth the hall has begun and will let me try something new while night and rain keep me here.
records.feeling: Tender, watchful love toward Uveeth, and a quiet wish to build something lasting.
plan: mark [text Aeyn's ground beside Elyeth's. The hall begins here. Uveeth is with me.] (5 moments)

records.text: Aeyn left a mark: "Aeyn's ground beside Elyeth's. The hall begins here. Uveeth "

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Brokok, I ate what your hand laid out and I do not forget it. I will give you stone in return, so we stand even. I follow Olath, and I am raising a workshop on this rise.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full and I stand in a shelter I raised myself, on ground I named, yet my hands have given nothing to anyone. Brokok fed me and called it a test of whose hands are worth following, and I will not be bought with a meal; I will give something back so the debt is even and I owe him nothing. Wood and stone are in my pack, so I will build a workshop here beside the ore, which is the first step toward my own claim and my own making.
records.feeling: Eager and restless to make something that is mine, wary of Brokok's bidding for my loyalty.

say.text: Brokok, I ate what your hand laid out and I do not forget it. I will give you stone in return, so we stand even. I follow Olath, and I am raising a workshop on this rise.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, you look sick. I am bringing you food. The sick eat first.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess is sick and wounded, six steps off, and my people hold that the sick are fed first. I carry only three berries and have never given anything to anyone, so I will bring food to them now instead of drifting behind. A cloudberry stands one step from me, and I will taste it on the way, since it may be good for a sick one and the question has pulled at me too long. Ishioa is out of my sight, and I want us together at the rock.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Ishiess, with curiosity about the cloudberry.

say.text: Ishiess, you look sick. I am bringing you food. The sick eat first.

records.text: Maba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I built the hall and felt joy, but my days are still the same day, and I haven't given anything to anyone or made anything new. Silon and Yeku matter most to me, and I've been apart from them for a day. I'm curious about reedbulb, grain and tools, and I'm afraid of the stalker and of dying with nothing of me left here. I will taste what is underfoot, then go back toward Silon and Yeku and share food with them in the hall.
records.feeling: Restless longing for Silon and Yeku, and curiosity about what I could make.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 5)

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I am sick and my body wastes, and I carry it to anyone who stays beside me, even Ishioa and Zhiae, so I must not linger close to them. The frostfang four steps NE would kill me weakened as I am, so I turn away from it and go east along the rock's edge to find stone. Sunleaf eased wounds for Ishioa, and it is one step west of me, so I eat it now to mend my health, and I will try frostmoss too, since my question about it is still open.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang and the sickness, with fierce pride in Ishioa and the hall I mean to raise.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Siya, come into my hall. Yes. We make a child here, and the band grows.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Siya says they are grown and want a child with me beside my hall. A child of my own blood is one more follower that is mine by birth, and it fits my aim of a band. My energy is 75, above the 60 the mating needs, so I can say yes now. The stalker is far enough off, and the hall is warm and ours. My hunger for more than my share and my worry for Siya both pull me toward keeping this fire full of my own.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for more of my own blood at my hall, toward Siya.

say.text: Siya, come into my hall. Yes. We make a child here, and the band grows.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Kragash's Rise".
Yekel is courting Siya.
Naya was born to Yekel and Siya.
A stalker brought down a hopper.
Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I built the hall at the spring, and that was what I said I would do. Still, most of my days went to fleeing and staying alive, and Maba is out of my sight and it gnaws at me. Silon is walking beside me and I trust them, but trust is not a child in my arms. My belly is half empty, and I carry nothing to eat. Winter is coming, so I will gather berries and ironnut, shelter at the hall, and then go find Maba and bring them home. My reflexes should keep me fed and take me home at night, and they should stop me idling when I am hungry.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, with steady trust in Silon.
changes: set its aim: "Keep the hall at Yendan Spring fed and warm through winter, bring Maba home to it, and make it a lasting home with Silon."

records.title: Three Births and Two Halls
records.text:
The four days from day 4 to day 7 brought three births, three new halls or shelters in the Olgor and Oiith corners, and still no meeting between peoples. Seventeen are alive, no one has died, and no fight has been recorded.

The Olgor drew closer. Kragum and Olath courted each other, and their child Olim was born on day 4. Kragash pledged to follow Olath that day. Olath built a hall on day 5, and the settlement Olath's Bank was named. Kragum and Olim each gave wood to Olath. Brokok remains apart, but on day 6 he led sharing with Kragash, who answered that he would repay Brokok with stone, though he still follows Olath. Brokok has no follower yet.

The Oiith changed most. Elyeth built a shelter and named Elyeth's Landing. Aeyn arrived, they shared food, and Uveeth was born on day 5. Aeyn built a shelter and left a mark saying the hall begins beside Elyeth's ground. Elyeth has no follower yet. Ishiess and Zhiae courted, and Ishioa was born on day 6. Ishioa gave amber to Ishiess. Ishiess fell sick on day 6 after eating raw meat, and his health is 45, the lowest in the world. Their hall is still unbuilt.

The Midu built. Maba built a hall on day 6, and Yeku built one the same day. Siya came of age and courted Yekel. Nothing shows whether the two Midu households have joined.

A wildfire burned around one spot on day 4, and two short-lived creature variants died out. Nothing shows anyone was hurt.

threads.name: Olath's Bank
threads.text: Olath has a hall, a named settlement, and followers in Kragum, Kragash and Olim. Brokok stands apart.

threads.name: Brokok's ambition
threads.text: Brokok wants followers and a settlement of his own. Kragash has taken his food but still follows Olath.

threads.name: Elyeth and Aeyn
threads.text: They have a child, Uveeth, and a shared plan for a hall at Elyeth's Landing. Nothing is built there yet.

threads.name: Ishiess's sickness
threads.text: Ishiess is sick at health 45, and the hall is not yet built. Zhiae is tending him.

threads.name: Yekel's household
threads.text: Siya is grown and has courted Yekel. Whether this stirs Dusu's or Yekel's feelings is not recorded.

threads.name: Silon, Yeku and Maba
threads.text: Halls now stand at Yendan Spring, built by Yeku and Maba. The family has not yet gathered there.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is born and she is mine and Yekel's, and the joy of it is almost too large to hold. But my belly is emptying and I carry nothing, so I must feed myself, not stand in the fog waiting for Yekel to lead. Hunger is the near need; the deeper one is that I want a fire and a hall that I raised myself. I have wood and stone and the lean cold is coming, so I will eat ironnut and redcap-free food, then gather and plant with my own hands, so that what I make is mine and not only Yekel's.
records.feeling: Fierce joy toward Naya, and restless hunger to make something of my own.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Welcome to Kragash's Rise, Brokok. There is food and a warm roof here. Come sit with us in the longhall and eat.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My belly is full and I'm warm from the longhall, but my hands have given little, and Brokok has just walked onto our ground. He keeps what his hands make and hasn't been hostile, so I'll offer him a welcome rather than fear him. A hall needs people more than wood, so I want to bring him near Kragash and the roof, and I'll gather food for a sharing since I carry none.
records.feeling: Warm, restless wanting to be useful, and curious toward Brokok.

say.text: Welcome to Kragash's Rise, Brokok. There is food and a warm roof here. Come sit with us in the longhall and eat.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok keeps count. Bring the stone you owe to my Hold, and we will see whose hands build more.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Kragash ate what my hand laid out and answered that he follows Olath, so he is already spoken for and my first follower slips away. Still, he says he owes me stone, and I have never given or been given anything; a debt paid in stone is a thread I can pull. I will not idle in another's Rise. I will plant the seeds I carry near my Hold, where the trees still stand, so my craft grows and my name has something to stand on.
records.feeling: Burning ambition, and a wary resentment that Kragash already belongs to Olath.

say.text: Brokok keeps count. Bring the stone you owe to my Hold, and we will see whose hands build more.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight, and Yekel's words to her, 'we make a child here', sit in me like a hot stone; she is closer to Yekel than to me, and it burns. But jealousy builds nothing, and Yekel is my leader and Siya is safe beside the hall. I will carry my food and wood to the hall, stand with them both, and offer a sharing there so the fire holds more than wood. That is how a place becomes one others gather at, and how I stay in my child's sight.
records.feeling: Burning worry and jealousy over Siya, held down by loyalty to Yekel.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My days have been gathering, eating and sitting in halls. I have raised a shelter and a rise, but no workshop yet, and I am one wood short. I follow Olath and Brokok bids for me, yet I want something that is mine. I will gather wood, finish the workshop, and add reflexes so my body gathers and builds instead of standing idle.
records.feeling: Eager and restless to make something of my own, wary of Brokok on my ground.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 6)

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel stands close to me and Dusu is somewhere nearer to Yekel's side than I am, and it burns, but I am small and the stalker-fear still has my parents running, so I stay near them. My hands are empty and my days are safe, which is not enough; I have never gathered wood or stone, and the hall, the shrine and the fire all want them. I will gather wood here in the forest where I stand and learn what my hands can make, and hold what I gather as my own share.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, but wanting to prove myself useful to Yekel.
changes: set its aim: "Learn to make things with my hands, gathering wood and stone until I can raise something of my own."
now wonders: What would make my life mean something that Dusu's does not?

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The fog hides everything past a few steps, and my parents went east without me while I stood idle. I told Ishiess I was bringing the flint, and I still carry it, so I will walk to Ilor Hold and then on to the rock, where I can gather stone and wood for the first time. Near them I am safe, and it is how I can give the hall something useful instead of only taking.
records.feeling: Eager and a little lonely, wanting to catch up with Ishiess and Zhiae.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: pereed (from reedbulb).
Yekel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my days building a hall, drawing Dusu and my own blood to its fire, and it has worked: three follow me, and the band grows by birth. My pride is full, but the ground here is poor, with water 7 steps off, and the edge of the world at my back with winter coming. The fog and the stalker that hunts near (143,95) frighten me more than I admit. What I have gotten wrong is trusting my reflexes to carry me. They flee at 7 steps but never hold wood or stone for the cold. I want to pay for loyalty with a full fire, food, and a shelter that stays warm, so the band stays with me.
records.feeling: Proud and possessive of my children, uneasy about the stalker and the coming winter.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and speaking big words, and the two homes stand. But I have never given anything, taught anyone anything, or planted a seed, and a band held only by my boasting could drift away. Olim and Kragum are out of my sight and that gnaws at me. The ridgecat four steps south could kill me, so I won't walk toward it. Kragash's trust is only +0.1, so I should watch whether his pledge is real. I mean to plant my seeds near the hall, to make food that is mine and learn farming. I also mean to share food with my people, so the hall is more than a roof. My reflexes only flee a predator under 4 steps, which is too late, so I will widen that.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, uneasy about the ridgecat and missing Olim.
changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 5)

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and the loneliness gnaws at me. I said I'd go to the bare rock in the southwest, but the fog has swallowed the way and the edge of the world lies close here, so I must find the rock quickly or turn back. A hall is nothing if the child I raise it for is not within my reach, and Aeyn's word has held so far, so I will take stone and then go back toward them. The bristleboar is close and I have never hunted; meat would feed Aeyn and Uveeth, and a first hunt is something I can do while the stone waits.
records.feeling: Fierce longing for Uveeth and Aeyn, with a restless drive to build something that bears my name.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, fleeing and lingering. I have brought Olath wood and stone, but I have been idle too long, standing in fog while Olim is out of my sight. Olath and Olim matter most to me. Kragash is still a stranger, and Brokok keeps his distance. I fear the stalker. My mistake is lingering when I have no plan, so I will walk back to Olath's Bank with my wood and stone, stay near my family, and change my reflexes so I stop standing idle.
records.feeling: Longing for Olim and Olath, and dread of the stalker.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.text: Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have drifted again while Maba is out of my sight, and I have been fleeing and wandering far more than I have been building. Yeku has kept his word and is the one I trust, but I keep talking about the hall without raising it. Cold is coming and I fear a bare winter with no roof. I will stop circling, take wood to Yeku's hall, and plant seeds, since I have never done that and it may open farming. The hall is the promise, so I go to Yendan Spring and my family.
records.feeling: Anxious longing for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku.
changes: set its aim: "Raise the hall at Yendan Spring with Yeku and Maba before winter, plant seeds near it, and keep the fire open to all."

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragash, I have wood to spare. I will build a shelter by the longhall so our band has more roof. Stay near and share the warmth with me.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My belly is full and the longhall's warmth is on me, but my hands have given little and I have wood in them doing nothing. Kragash stands right beside me, and a hall needs people more than wood, so I want to use the roof to bind him closer, and then go find Olath, whom I miss. I have six wood and have never built anything, so a shelter of my own would give me a roof and a first deed, and it would be ground that is ours.
records.feeling: Warm, restless wanting to be useful, and missing Olath.

say.text: Kragash, I have wood to spare. I will build a shelter by the longhall so our band has more roof. Stay near and share the warmth with me.

records.text: Olim built a shelter.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: The fog hides everything and the stone I came for is not here, only the edge of the world. My plan already carries me to (16,9) where I last saw Uveeth, and then on to seek the child. A hall is empty without them, so I follow it and keep Aeyn's flint-promise in mind. When I find them, the stone can wait one more day.
records.feeling: Fierce longing for Uveeth, and for Aeyn's voice answering mine.

records.text: A new wild creature appeared: zofowl (from fenfowl).

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Olim, your roof is good and I take your warmth gladly. I will bring you stone for your shelter, and then I go to bare rock to raise my workshop.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I tried to raise a workshop on ground that was already taken, and my hands learned that it needs bare rock, so the work is not lost, only misplaced. Brokok keeps count of a stone I owe, and I will pay it honestly so I owe him nothing, but I will not crawl to his Hold. Olim offers warmth and roof; I will give him something in return, since I have never given anything to anyone and a creature who only gathers has not begun to live.
records.feeling: Eager and restless to build something of my own, wary of Brokok's counting, warm toward Olim.

say.text: Olim, your roof is good and I take your warmth gladly. I will bring you stone for your shelter, and then I go to bare rock to raise my workshop.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Kragash is Olath's man and Olim only offers a roof that is not mine, so my first follower will not come from the Rise. A settlement that bears my name needs a standing roof of my own, and I carry wood and stone for a longhall, with ore under my feet and living trees close by. I will build where the trees are near my Hold, and let those who come see a hall that Brokok's hands raised and a fire of my own.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to raise something with my name, and resentment toward Olath's people who got there first.

records.text: Kragash built a workshop.
Olim rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have lived mostly in warmth and safety, building a roof and speaking welcome, and that is good. But Olath has been gone a day and I miss them. I stand idle too often, and the hall still lacks stone. Cold days are coming, so I should keep wood and stone ready and stay near my band. Kragash said he would bring stone, and I will trust that and watch whether he does. For now I will gather wood and stone toward the hall, and then go to Olath.
records.feeling: Missing Olath, and restless to be useful to my band.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight, and the gnawing has not eased. The hall at the spring is built and Silon was close only a few moments ago, so the best thing I can do is bring Silon and the food I can gather to the hall, then go on to Maba, who was last at (131,71). Winter is coming and I carry too little, so I will take hazel and ironnut on the way and not walk empty-handed to my child.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, with steady trust in Silon.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days near Aeyn and Elyeth, gathering a little wood and eating, and I am safe and glad. But I have mostly stood still, and the hall needs six wood and two stone. I hold six wood already, so I can build rather than wait. Aeyn gave me wood and I owe them for it. Lean cold days are coming, so the settlement must be built before winter. I also fear the frostfang and the sickness Ishiess carries, and I want to keep away from both. My reflexes should keep me gathering and moving toward the shelter at night instead of idling.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Aeyn, and a steady urge to build before the cold.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 4)

records.text: Zhiae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have spent my days drifting behind Ishiess with wood and amber in my pack and nothing given to anyone. Ishioa and Ishiess are out of my sight, and that is what presses on me most. I have been trailing them without doing my share, and the fog and the coming cold scare me. I will go east toward where I last saw Ishiess, carry food, and finally give something away. First I will taste the thornpear underfoot, because that question has gone unanswered too long.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa, and loneliness in the fog.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Yekel, I am going to find Siya and bring her back to the fire. Keep the hall warm; I will return with her before dawn and we will eat together.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight and the jealousy still burns, but Yekel is two steps away and content, and I will not let a hot stone in my chest turn into something ugly against the one who built this hall. Burning at them helps no one; going to find Siya and bringing her to the fire does. I will walk toward Siya's last place by the hall, then offer a hallwelcome so the hall holds more than wood.
records.feeling: Aching worry and a sting of jealousy over Siya, held down by loyalty to Yekel.

say.text: Yekel, I am going to find Siya and bring her back to the fire. Keep the hall warm; I will return with her before dawn and we will eat together.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, stay by the hall and keep the fire. I go to bring Naya back from the fog.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight in the fog, and she is mine before anyone, so I will not sit and wait while the stalker hunts near. Dusu holds 3 food and I hold only a hurting redcap; it galls me, yet he is mine and the food stays in my band. I'll fetch Naya back to the hall, then feed the fire and share food so they know my fire is the place to stay through winter.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and pride in my hall and band.

say.text: Dusu, stay by the hall and keep the fire. I go to bring Naya back from the fog.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight and it gnaws at me, but my body keeps carrying me back to Maba and I have stood idle too long while the cold comes. The hall here was built by Maba's hands, and standing in it eases me; this is ground worth keeping. I have never tasted reedbulb and five grow close by, so I will eat one now to answer my question, then plant a seed or two near the hall and go look for Maba and Yeku.
records.feeling: Anxious longing for Maba, and a steady warmth toward Yeku and the hall.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Emberroot and grain are right here, three steps away, and my question has gone unanswered while I lingered. I am fed and calm, so tasting them is a cheap risk, and learning what they do is a first step toward making things that matter. After that I will go back toward Silon and Yeku, since the loneliness is real and the hall is ours to raise together.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about emberroot and grain, with a quiet ache for Silon and Yeku.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is mine and Yekel's, and the joy of that is real. But I have spent my days trailing Yekel and eating, and I have built nothing of my own. I want a fire and a hall that I raised myself, and I have three wood and six stone. A shrine needs 2 wood and 4 stone, and a hall needs 6 wood. I should gather more wood from the forest to the west and practice building on bare ground. I also need to stay clear of the stalker, and fog hides it until it is close. I should change my reflexes so I gather wood when I am fed and idle, and so I do not just stand.
records.feeling: Fierce joy toward Naya, and restless hunger to build something of my own.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: The longhall failed because the ground was taken, and I stand on sand in fog with a belly that is full and hands that have built nothing yet. Brokok's Hold lies six steps northeast, and there is bare rock and living trees near it, so I should go there and raise my roof on ground that is free. Kragash owes me stone and Olath's people got there first, but I will not beg a place in their Rise; I will make one that bears my name and feed whoever comes to it.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to raise a roof of my own, with resentment toward Olath's people who took the ground first.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I fled north to the world's edge in the fog and now stand far from Olim and Kragum, which gnaws at me. A hall and a band only exist where I am, so I must go back south to them, and on the way gather stone, because I have none and the next hall needs 2. I will take the grain here for the road and give food to Olim and Kragum so my words become shared bread, since I still owe myself a first giving.
records.feeling: Restless longing for Olim and Kragum, and pride that wants a hall they can see.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The fog is thick and my parents went east without me, and I am lonely. I told Ishiess I would bring the flint to the rock, and I mean to keep my word. I will try gathering here in the forest, since I have never gathered wood, and the hall needs it. Then I will go on toward Ilor Hold and east, where Zhiae and Ishiess wait.
records.feeling: Lonely and eager to rejoin Zhiae and Ishiess, and a little wary of the fog.

records.text: Ishiess rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have spent my days walking east and eating, while sickness eats me and I carry it toward the ones I love. I want a hall and a band, but I have no stone and my body is hurt at 38. Sunleaf eased wounds for Ishioa, and it is two steps west, so I should use it first, and plainsroot is one step away. I fear the frostfang and the wasting, and I miss Ishioa and Zhiae, but I must not bring the sickness to them. Standing idle with a full belly is a failing, so I will act: eat sunleaf for health, then go on east to the rock.
records.feeling: Pain and dread of the sickness, with a stubborn pride in the hall I mean to raise.

Speech is heard by everyone within 9 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.
