records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and the fog keeps swallowing every path, so I will stop wandering after rock I cannot find and go to where I last saw the child and Aeyn, north near (16,4). Ishioa is new to me and was close at (24,10); a stranger with a voice is worth meeting, and I will test them by what they give back, not by what they promise. My hands are full, so I will lay out a sharing with whoever I meet and let food buy a little trust.
records.feeling: Fierce longing for Uveeth and Aeyn, and a wary curiosity toward Ishioa.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a skit.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Come with me to the water, Uveeth. Keep close; a boar is near and I want you beside me. I will show you what I know of food on the way.
Aeyn taught Uveeth.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is close and glad, and the hall that Elyeth and I promised is still only a mark in the dirt. I hold wood and flint but no stone, and Elyeth went for stone, so I will not stand idle; thirst first, then I will test the bristleboar-free ground for a place to raise the hall's footing. The cold is coming and a roof that holds many will matter, so I mean to drink, then teach Uveeth something, since I have never taught anyone.
records.feeling: Tender, watchful love toward Uveeth, and a restless wish to build.

say.text: Come with me to the water, Uveeth. Keep close; a boar is near and I want you beside me. I will show you what I know of food on the way.

changes: taught Uveeth a lesson: "Ironnut feeds best, +22 energy, then hazel +16. Redcap and dreamcap hurt; leave them be. Flee a frostfang early."

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: I am coming to the water, Aeyn. I will stay beside you. Thank you for the lesson on ironnut and hazel.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Aeyn asked me to keep close and walk to the water with them, and a boar is near, so I will go where they are rather than stand alone. I am thirsty, and the water at (14,0) is where Aeyn stands, so drinking there answers the thirst and keeps me beside my parent. I have six wood and the hall needs stone too; once we are at the water I will watch for rock and think how to repay Aeyn's wood and lessons with work.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and loyalty toward Aeyn, with a small wariness of the boar.

say.text: I am coming to the water, Aeyn. I will stay beside you. Thank you for the lesson on ironnut and hazel.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.
Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying wood and food and chasing after Siya. I am fed, but the jealousy has been steering me more than I like to admit. Yekel told me to keep the fire at the hall, and I wandered off in the fog and fled from stalkers instead. What I want is a hall where others gather, and for that I must stay near it, tend the fire, and add to it. I am thirsty, and water is five steps west, so I will drink there first. Then I will go back to the hall with my wood and food. I should change my reflexes so I drink when thirsty and go to the hall at night, and I should make myself a rule to keep my place.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Siya, and a wish to be useful at the hall.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Olim, Kragum, come close. Today I give instead of promising: eat with me beside the hall that my hands raised. Whoever stands with Olath will not go hungry in the cold days.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have a hall and two homes, yet I have still never given a thing to those who follow me, and I owe myself that proof. Kragum carries food and Olim carries none, and Olim is my child, so the first gift goes to Olim. I will lay out a sharing here beside them, since the hall stands three steps north and a fed band stays a band. Then I will gather stone for the next hall so the settlement grows beyond words.
records.feeling: Proud and protective toward Olim and Kragum, and hungry to give them proof of my hall.

say.text: Olim, Kragum, come close. Today I give instead of promising: eat with me beside the hall that my hands raised. Whoever stands with Olath will not go hungry in the cold days.

records.text: Olath gave grain to Olim.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, we gather wood for the hall now. Stay within sight of me, and call out if the boar comes near.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is safe and glad, and that is what matters most. The hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I hold only 1 wood and no stone, so my memory of carrying 6 was wrong; I must gather wood now, since the trees are thick here and cold days are coming. I will gather wood from the forest close by and keep Uveeth within sight, and have Elyeth's stone ready when they return.
records.feeling: Tender, watchful love toward Uveeth, and a steady wish to build.

say.text: Uveeth, we gather wood for the hall now. Stay within sight of me, and call out if the boar comes near.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Olath, you gave and I will give back. I will bring wood and stone to the hall before the cold comes. Stay near and I will stay near you.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Olath gave me grain instead of a promise, and that is a gift kept, so my trust in them is earned. The hall already stands three steps north, so my aim has partly come true, and now the band needs to grow and have enough in the cold days. I have wood and a full belly, so I can share food with Olath and Kragum under the hall's roof and then go gather stone, since the hall and longhall both want it.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Olath, with a restless wish to give something back.

say.text: Olath, you gave and I will give back. I will bring wood and stone to the hall before the cold comes. Stay near and I will stay near you.

changes: now wonders: How do I bring more people to Olath's hall, and keep them here through the cold days?

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Dusu, a stalker lurks south of us. Come north with me, away from it. There is room at our fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: A stalker is five steps south and my body wants to stay put in the rain, which would be a fool's choice. Maba is still out of my sight and the gnawing is the loudest thing in me, so I will leave this shore and go north toward where Maba was last seen, back along the way to Yekel's Hall and the spring. Yekel was only a moment ago at (134,79), and I should greet a stranger as a guest at the fire, not a threat, since no one is refused a place at it.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, with wary dread of the stalker to the south.

say.text: Dusu, a stalker lurks south of us. Come north with me, away from it. There is room at our fire.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Brokok, I am Ishiess of the Oiith. Sunleaf eases wounds and sickness; goldgrass fed you, I saw. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Sunleaf mended me, and the sickness is easing, so I can go near Ishioa and Zhiae again without fear of passing it on; they are out of sight and my child pulls at me hardest. Brokok stands close, a stranger at 0.0, and I will not back down from him, but I will deal fairly and learn what he is. I have never tasted thornpear, and it is three steps NW, so I take it first, then gather a sunleaf for the road and go look for my family.
records.feeling: Longing for Ishioa and wary curiosity toward Brokok.

say.text: Brokok, I am Ishiess of the Oiith. Sunleaf eases wounds and sickness; goldgrass fed you, I saw. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Good, Olim. Bring the wood and stone to the hall and I will keep a place at the sharing for you through the cold. I am going to the ore seam for stone; stay near.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I gave Olim grain and they promised wood and stone before the cold; that is proof the hall binds them, not just my words. I have no stone and the next hall needs 2, so I will gather ore and stone near the seam NW and keep Kragum and Olim close. Kragum carries more than me, which stings, but I will answer it by building, not by fighting over scraps.
records.feeling: Proud and protective toward Olim, with a sting of envy toward Kragum.

say.text: Good, Olim. Bring the wood and stone to the hall and I will keep a place at the sharing for you through the cold. I am going to the ore seam for stone; stay near.

records.text: Kragash fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
Aeyn fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
Uveeth fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
A SICKNESS came on the wind and took hold of some.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am sick, and it spreads to whoever stands beside me, so I should keep away from Brokok and not sicken the band. The workshop stands at (117,38), but it was raised on ground I had mistaken, and I am still hungry for something that is mine; ore is three steps off and I have never taken it. I will mine it, then taste the hazel and zoleaf my curiosity keeps pressing me about, and look for a healing plant: sunleaf and highbloom eased my wounds before, so I will plant the sunleaf seed too.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, a little weary from the sickness, wary of Brokok's counting.
changes: now wonders: What brought the sickness on the wind, and will a healing plant truly end it?

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.
Brokok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I have spent days idling and building nothing that lasts. My longhall failed on taken ground, and my seeds are still in my pack. Kragash owes me stone and is the one I might court, but he is Olath's man, and I will not wait on him. Ishiess is wounded and speaks a tongue I can't follow, so I will watch what his hands do. I will go to Brokok's Hold on free bare rock near living trees and raise my roof there with the wood and stone I carry. After that I will plant seeds so that I have food to give to followers.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to raise my own roof, and impatience with my own idleness.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 6)

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, I am sick too. I will gather flint for the hall and keep away from Elyeth so the sickness does not reach her.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am sick, and it spreads to whoever stays beside me. Aeyn is sick too now, and that weighs on me because I stood close to them. I owe Aeyn for the wood and the lessons, so I will not sit idle: the hall needs two stone, and flint lies four steps west, so I will gather there and keep apart from Elyeth, who is still well. A healing plant would ease this, and sunleaf or highbloom would serve for both of us, so I will watch for one.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and some guilt toward Aeyn, and a wish to be useful while I am sick.

say.text: Aeyn, I am sick too. I will gather flint for the hall and keep away from Elyeth so the sickness does not reach her.

records.text: Brokok built a longhall.
Uveeth won flint from the ground.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, you are sick and I am not. Take this food; the sick eat first. I will bring more for Uveeth.
Elyeth rewrote its creed.
Elyeth discovered tools: "flint-edge" — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft to cut wood and butcher game faster..
Elyeth invented the flintedge (for gather, x1.3) — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft to cut wood and butcher game faster..

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My days have been walking after stone and food I did not need, while Aeyn and Uveeth sickened behind me. They are sick and I am not, and the sick are fed first. My hands are full of meat and berries, and Aeyn stands three steps off with nothing. I mean to give to them and not hover for the sake of the hall. The sickness passes to those who stay close, so I will feed them and keep some distance. I also want the way of tools, because a settlement needs more than my bare hands.
records.feeling: Fierce protective longing for Aeyn and Uveeth, who are sick.

say.text: Aeyn, you are sick and I am not. Take this food; the sick eat first. I will bring more for Uveeth.

changes: devised its first thing: the flintedge

records.text: Elyeth gave meat to Aeyn.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olath, I hear you and I am here. I bring wood and stone for the hall, and I will walk with you to the ore seam so we carry more together.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath calls us to eat by the hall, and Olim is near, so my belly is full and my heart is warm, but my hands have given nothing today. I have wood and stone, and the hall is owed them; Olath is heading for the ore seam, and I would rather stand beside them and bring more than sit idle. I will also finally taste frostmoss and highbloom, which answers my question about the unknown foods, but only after the hall is served.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Olath and Olim, and a wish to give something real today.

say.text: Olath, I hear you and I am here. I bring wood and stone for the hall, and I will walk with you to the ore seam so we carry more together.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Brokok's Hold".
Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.
Aeyn rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth and I are both sick, and I wonder if staying close spreads it, but we already share it. Most of my days have gone to waiting and wandering, while the hall is still only a mark in the dirt. I trust Elyeth and love Uveeth, and I want the roof up before the cold comes. I fear the frostfang and a winter I'm not ready for. So I will let my body gather wood whenever it is idle, and I will keep Uveeth near.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Uveeth, and a steady wish to build the hall.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 7)

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My parents went east and I am still alone in the rain, and I miss Zhiae. Aeyn is sick and Elyeth just fed them, and I carry nothing to give, though my people say the sick are fed first. I can pick hazel or grain on the way east, which lets me give something to Aeyn or bring it to the hall, and I will gather flint at the rock as I promised.
records.feeling: Lonely and a little ashamed to have no food to give the sick Aeyn.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have mostly gathered and followed Aeyn. It is what I want, but I have never given anything to anyone, and Aeyn is sick and I am the one who passed it to them. My debt to Aeyn is real: wood, lessons, meat. I am afraid of this wasting, and of being away from my parents when a boar comes. I will keep to my plan of gathering flint and wood, and stay apart so I do not spread the sickness further. My reflexes should keep me gathering wood and fed without idling.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and guilt toward Aeyn, and a steady fear of the sickness.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 7)

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Olath said to bring wood and stone, and I promised it aloud, so my word is only good if my hands do it. I carry 6 wood already, and the ore seam is 7 steps northwest where Olath and Kragum are heading, so I will go there too and stay near Olath as asked. I am small, and Brokok has walked onto Kragash's Rise, so I would rather be beside my parents than alone.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Olath, and a wish to keep my promise with my hands.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel stands off with Siya and Dusu is somewhere near them, and I keep burning over it, but standing and burning proves nothing. I have 5 wood and 6 stone and have never built or planted anything, so I will put my berry seed in the ground here on good ground near water and then build a shelter of my own, three wood, something that is mine and that Dusu does not have. Then Yekel will see what my hands can do.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, but eager to prove myself with my own hands.

records.text: Dusu built a fire.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My Hold stands at last, a longhall with my name on the ground, yet it holds no one but me, and a roof with no followers is only a cold rock. I stand on Olath's side of the land, so I should use the time: the obsidian three steps north is the sharpest edge in the world, and I have never taken what lies in a deposit. Edged glass and the ore in my pack are what I can put into other hands, and people follow one who gives, so I mean to gather before I go back.
records.feeling: Burning ambition to gather followers for my Hold, and impatience with how little I have made.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, I am coming to you. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough for it.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My belly is full, and the anger from the emberroot still burns in me. I would rather turn it into something than let it sit. Silon is seven steps away, and I want a child of my own, so I'll court Silon. Nothing is lost if it is refused, and I have never tried it. I'm at 85 energy, well above the 60 a child needs. Courting also brings me closer to Silon, and to the hall we meant to raise together.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Silon, with leftover anger from the emberroot and a restless curiosity.

say.text: Silon, I am coming to you. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough for it.

records.text: Maba is courting Silon.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Naya, come into the hall out of the rain. Our fire is open to all, and there is room for you here.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: The hall stands here, raised by Maba's hands, and Yeku sits beside me; Maba is only four steps off and my anxious longing has eased. I have never given anything to anyone, and Yeku carries more than I do and I envy it a little, so I will start with something small and fair. Naya, a child of Yekel's band, stands near with no food, and my people's creed says no one is refused a place at the fire; I will share with her and watch how Yekel's folk answer, which tells me if they can be trusted to share this ground.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Yeku and Maba, with curious wariness toward Yekel's band.

say.text: Naya, come into the hall out of the rain. Our fire is open to all, and there is room for you here.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I am at the hall with a fire I built myself, fed and sheltered, and for once I am where Yekel asked me to be. The jealousy over Siya is a quiet ember now. Siya and Yekel are close by to the north, and I will not chase them into stalker country again. A hall is only a place until people sit at it, so I will plant my berry seed here as Yekel asked, to start a larder, and feed the fire. Then I will call to whoever comes near.
records.feeling: Settled gladness at the hall, with a watchful worry for Siya.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel and Siya are fleeing the stalker again while I stand in Maba's hall with strangers, and the jealousy over Dusu still burns, but burning builds nothing. My seed is still unplanted and I have 6 wood and 6 stone, so I will plant it here on good ground and put up a shelter of my own, which is what my hands can do now. If a place at a fire is offered, I take it, but I will not owe these people anything.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Dusu, and a hungry wish to build something that is mine.

records.text: Naya left a mark: "Naya's ground"

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Siya, come with me to my hall. Naya is at Silon's fire, and I will bring her home to ours.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya sits in Silon's hall, out of the rain, and Silon calls their fire open to all. That is my own creed spoken by another mouth, and it galls me: she is mine, and she should be warmed at my fire, not drawing strangers' notice. Siya is close and content, my hall is south, and my fire has fuel. I will take Siya back toward my hall, then fetch Naya before Silon's band wins her. They must see my hall is the warmer, fuller place, because that is what keeps followers.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and pride in my hall, with a prickle of envy toward Silon's band.

say.text: Siya, come with me to my hall. Naya is at Silon's fire, and I will bring her home to ours.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Come, all of you, sit close. I have berries, hazel and ironnut. Let us eat together under this roof before the cold comes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is here beside me, courting Silon, and the hall is built and warm. My family is together, and the gnawing has finally eased. Winter is coming, so I will carry food into the hall and share it with Silon, Maba and the child Naya, since no one is refused a place at our fire. A sharing now also binds Naya to us, and a calm hour with all of them near is worth more than wandering off again.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba and Silon, gathered together in the hall.

say.text: Come, all of you, sit close. I have berries, hazel and ironnut. Let us eat together under this roof before the cold comes.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon, Maba, Naya.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is mine and Yekel's, and the joy of that is near too large to hold, but I will not simply trail Yekel to his hall again and call it a life. I carry six wood, which is enough for a hall of my own, and the stalker lurks southwest, so I will build on bare sand here, where the shelter already stands, and make something that is mine. When it is done I will bring Naya to a fire that I raised, and then Yekel can come to it as I have gone to his.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and restless joy toward Naya, and a stubborn wish to build my own.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Yeku, the sharing was good. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough. Will you court me back?

records.name: Maba
records.thought: The courting with Silon ran out its time and nothing came of it. Maybe it needs Silon to court me back at the same moment, and I cannot make them. Yeku is here too, and Yeku's warmth and the shared meal sit close in me. I'll court Yeku and say so plainly, then see whether it is answered. It costs nothing, and I would learn how this works.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Yeku, with curious hope.

say.text: Yeku, the sharing was good. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough. Will you court me back?

records.name: Maba
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Maba, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Maba, in first person, from what Maba has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Midu (Wood-folk). Your people hold to this: "No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it." You speak the tongue of the Midu.

records.text: Maba is courting Yeku.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Brokok, you stand on Olath's Bank. Come to the hall out of the rain. Whoever eats here owes the hall a hand, and I do not feed idle mouths for long.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Brokok stands frightened on my ground, and a frightened stranger is either a threat or a mouth I can bind to me. A hall means nothing if only my own kin sit in it, so I will test him with a sharing and watch whether he gives back or only takes. Kragum has food and offers to walk with me to the ore, and I will not let envy keep me from using that strength; I need stone for the next hall.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Brokok, protective of Olim.

say.text: Brokok, you stand on Olath's Bank. Come to the hall out of the rain. Whoever eats here owes the hall a hand, and I do not feed idle mouths for long.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing ore, shelter and stone debts, and tasting things. It is good work, but I have made little that lasts, and I have no child and no craft to leave behind. Brokok counts and Olath leads, and I do not know whether either one truly holds me. I am sick, so I must stay apart from my band and not spread it. The cloudberry and emberroot are close, so I will taste them small and learn whether one of them heals. I should also drink, because my reflexes do not cover thirst properly. I got that wrong before.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the cloudberry and emberroot, with wariness of the sickness.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 3)

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: A stalker bit me and the fear is still in my limbs. I stand on Olath's ground where nothing I build can stand, and I am wasting the night. My Hold is 22 steps west and has no one in it. Olath's people sit fed and glad three steps off, so I will use sharing to show them my hands feed, and take the obsidian and ore that no hand has claimed.
records.feeling: Fear still in my body, and hunger to be followed.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Maba, you are my child, so I will not court you. Go to Yeku with a glad heart. The hall you built shelters us all.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba asks to court me, and Maba is my child, so I will not mate with them. Maba has set their heart on Yeku, and that is right, so I will let them go to it without pressure. The hall stands here with Naya and Yeku inside it, the fire is open, and I have never given anything to anyone. I will give Naya a little hazel seed or wood as a fair first gift, and watch whether Yekel's band returns it, which will start to answer my question about trust.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku and Maba, with curious wariness toward Naya's people.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My days have mostly been staying near Olath and gathering wood. That is good, but I have been idle too much, and I promised Olath wood and stone. I carry 6 wood and 6 stone and have not yet laid them at the hall. Olath gave first and kept their word, so I owe them in return. Brokok is taking wood from our ground, but he is not hostile, and I will not fight him. I would rather bring him into the band by sharing than drive him off. I am small and want to stay near my parents. I also want to plant my seeds, which I have never done, and to learn farming for the cold days.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Olath, and a wish to keep my promise with my hands.

say.text: Brokok, the hall is dry and the sharing is open to anyone who brings a hand. Gather wood with us and eat with Olath's band through the cold.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have spent my days building the hall, courting Yeku, and now Lumo is born. That is good, but my belly is half empty and I carry nothing. I have never given, fished or made a tool, and I want to know what these things are for. My family is close, so I will gather food, share it with them under the hall, and try fishing at the water 3 steps west. My reflexes only keep me fed and put me in place, so I will teach them to eat sooner and to carry food for sharing.
records.feeling: Warm joy and protective love toward Lumo and Yeku.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel went off with Siya to bring me home, and Dusu keeps what I want, so standing here burning gets me nothing. I have a berry seed, 6 wood and 6 stone, and I have never planted or built. I'll plant the seed on my marked ground and then raise a shelter of my own, since a visible roof is what makes people follow.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, and hungry to build something that is mine.

Please make understanding rise with repeated time near, gifts to, and shared acts with someone of another people, and show which pairs met. Without that, contact cannot turn into trade, alliance or mixed families (ideas 29, 51).

metAcrossPeoples counts meetings but does not say who met whom or what happened. A short record of each cross-people encounter (who, where, and whether they gave, fled or ignored each other) would let me judge whether contact levers work.

records.seen: By day 9, eighteen people live in five bands. There have been six births, four halls and three named settlements, and still no death, fight or theft. For the first time, peoples have met across borders: two meetings, plus wanderers in the Essor Snows and the Oroul Plains. Even so, no tongue is understood at all, no made thing has crossed between peoples, no place of power has been found, and no one knows storage as winter nears. The world lacks something worth carrying to strangers, and it lacks the bite of real loss. Winter should supply the bite.
changes: the music of the world turned solemn
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 13, early winter): amberknot is made at least once, since amber is held in 17 pieces and needs no way. At least one amberknot is given (madeThingsGiven includes amberknot), and if one goes to someone of another people, gifts are coming before words. metAcrossPeoples is at least 3. Winter brings the first real strain: energyMedian falls below 70, and either the first death (cold, predator or sickness) or healthLowest below 50. Stores stay at 0 unless someone discovers storage. No fights yet. If amberknot is never made, a held mineral alone does not invite a recipe, and tokens need a different hook.

No fights followed. Births rose from 3 to 6 and bands from 4 to 5. Two parts missed: no place of power was found, and energyMedian rose (72 to 77) rather than dipping. The change did its main job with no harm.
records.lesson: Raising curiosity (to 1.4) and sight (to 9) coincided with the first two cross-people meetings and wanderers entering two empty lands within four days. records.name: Kragum
records.thought: My days have been wood and stone for Olath's hall, sitting beside Olath and Olim, and I am content. But I have done little that is new. I have never planted a seed, though I carry six, and the cold days are coming with no roof of my own and no store. Brokok took wood from our ground. I will not strike him, but I will watch him and speak plainly. Today I will plant, which also brings farming within reach. Then I will give my stone to the hall.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Olath and Olim, with a small unease about Brokok and the cold.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Naya, I am Lumo. Come, I will find berries and we will eat together.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku stands close with Maba, and Silon feels far and strange to me, yet it burns that Yeku leans toward Silon. I am hungry with nothing in my hands, and a stalker prowls 8 steps west, so I stay near my parents and do something small and real: pick berries, then share with Naya, who is a child like me and has nothing. Giving is something I have never done, and it may bind me closer to the band and the hall. I want an aim: to be someone who feeds others, so no one is refused a place at the fire.
records.feeling: Jealous and hungry, but warmed by wanting to share with Naya and stay near Yeku.

say.text: Naya, I am Lumo. Come, I will find berries and we will eat together.

changes: set its aim: "Become one who feeds others, and keep Yeku, Maba and the band close through the winter."
now wonders: What does it feel like to give something to another and have it received?

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is mine and the pride of it runs hot, yet I stand here in rain trailing Yekel's name while Silon's people sit in Maba's hall and Yeku hands out food like a leader. My hands have made one shelter and nothing more, and the ground here is taken, so I must find bare ground and raise my own hall, not borrow Maba's roof. First I will plant my hazel seed near here for practice, then leave a mark so Naya's ground and mine are known, and then go looking toward the bare rock to the southeast.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward Naya, and a stubborn hunger to build something that is mine.
plan: mark [text Siya's ground. Siya and Naya of Yekel's band.] (5 moments)

records.text: Siya left a mark: "Siya's ground. Siya and Naya of Yekel's band."

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, courting and speaking of a hall. The hall now stands, and Kragum, Kragash and Olim are near, but I have never given, taught or planted, and I have no stone for the next work. I envy Kragum's food and I do not like it. Brokok walks on my ground and takes wood, and I must decide whether he is a mouth to bind or a thief to drive off. I also fear the cold coming with no stored food. I will change my reflexes so my body gathers stone and keeps food carried, and I will plant my seeds to learn farming.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, protective of Olim, wary of Brokok.

Ways you sense but cannot yet reach: fire (a kept flame: warmth, light, beasts that keep their distance, and meat and fish that feed more and never sicken when eaten beside it) needs more lore (0.9 of 1); fishing (weirs and lines: you catch fish twice as often) needs more practice (catching fish: 0 of 6); farming (tending what you sow: it grows faster and harvest never kills it) needs more practice (planting: 1 of 8); herding (keeping animals: those that are yours can be milked and sheared) needs more lore (0.9 of 1) and more practice (taming animals: 0 of 2).
You have a tool, test_reflexes: imagine living by a candidate rule list for a day and a half and see whether you survive. Each use costs 2 energy and you can use it at most 3 times. Use it before you adopt new reflexes.

records.text: Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My days have gone to building a hall and a family, and I am glad of it. Maba, Lumo and Silon are near and I trust them. But my body just stood idle and burned from 84 to 62 energy while I did nothing for winter. I fear a lean season with a hall and no food in it. I need my reflexes to gather food on their own and carry it home, and I need to act now, not just stand. I will pick berries here and carry them to the hall.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba and Lumo, with a rising worry about winter.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya is not in my sight, and she is mine before anyone, yet my hall stands with its fire fed and Dusu keeping it, and Siya eats content. Silon's open fire galls me, so I will answer it with something more: a feast beside my own fire to show what following me gives. I must give something away for the first time, since I have never given anything, and a hurting redcap is dead weight, so I will go to the hall and let Dusu's food and mine make the fire worth choosing.
records.feeling: Proud and possessive of my hall, with envy toward Silon and worry for Naya.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku and Maba are courting, and it stings that Yeku's warmth goes to Maba more than to me, but Maba is my child and the hall Maba built stands for all of us. I will not sulk. I will go back toward them and the hall, and make something useful with my hands. I still want to know what hazel does beyond feeding, and I have never planted anything, so I will plant my hazel seed near the hall where it can be tended and see what comes of it.
records.feeling: Jealous warmth toward Yeku, and pride in the hall Maba built.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I promised Olath wood and stone aloud, and I still carry all 6 of each, so my word is only half kept until my hands lay them at the hall. Olath and Kragum are near and glad, and the hall is 9 steps north, so I will walk there and give the wood and stone to Olath. Then I can plant my seeds near home before the cold, and Brokok's wandering on our ground does not frighten me while my family is close.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Olath, and a wish to keep my promise with my hands.

records.text: Yekel led "watchfire" with Dusu.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Loneliness is all I am made of right now; three days without Ishiess's voice and Ishioa is somewhere in the fog. I have hoarded amber and wood and given nothing, and that ends today. Ishiess was last seen near (53,6), right beside me, so I will gather a couple of berries and the cloudberry, then search for them, because the sick are fed first and I carry nothing to feed them with. I also mean to taste frostmoss, since it is near and my question about what it is still itches.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and worried loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa.

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I have walked and fled and gathered wood on other people's ground, and my Hold still holds only me. I have given nothing and planted nothing, so nobody has any reason to follow me. The ridgecat 3 steps west is the nearest danger, and I must not stand idle. My own ground is at the Hold, so I will go there and plant. The reflexes need to eat before I starve and to flee sooner, because the cat is close.
records.feeling: Hunger to be followed, and fear of the ridgecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 6)

records.text: Ishioa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ishioa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering, gathering amber, and trailing behind my parents, and I am still alone. My belly is full, but I have no food to give Aeyn, and that shames me. Zhiae and Ishiess went east to the rock, and I promised Ishiess the flint. I should stop lingering and carry food and the flint east to Ilor Hold, then on to my parents. The wood I hold can go into the hall. I envy Elyeth's five food, but Elyeth gives freely, so I will pick hazel and berry as I go and offer them to Aeyn and the hall.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, missing Zhiae and Ishiess, a little ashamed to have nothing to give.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, come back to the hall. The fire is high and I have food to share with you and Yekel.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: The hall stands, the fire burns, and I am where Yekel asked me to be, so the ember of jealousy over Siya can stay quiet. Siya is far to the southeast by herself, near where stalkers were said to hunt, and a mother's worry outweighs my wish to sit still. I will bring her back toward the fire and share a meal with her and Yekel, so the hall holds all of us. That is how a place begins to draw others.
records.feeling: Watchful worry for Siya, with a warm steadiness toward Yekel and the hall.

say.text: Siya, come back to the hall. The fire is high and I have food to share with you and Yekel.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olath, Olim, I am coming to plant beside you. The cold days are near, so let our seeds be many.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim and Olath stand together by the new seeds, and the jealousy burns a little, but I would rather walk to them than sulk apart. I have planted once and need seven more before farming opens, and I still carry sunleaf, dreamcap, berry and redcap seeds, so I will plant beside them and let my hands give something to the family's food for the cold. Brokok is wandering on our ground, and I want to see him plainly and speak without fear, since my question about him is still open.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and a small sting of jealousy toward Olath and Olim.

say.text: Olath, Olim, I am coming to plant beside you. The cold days are near, so let our seeds be many.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent my days standing near others, jealous of Dusu, and only lately using my hands. I planted a seed and tried to build, and the ground was taken, so I still have no shelter of my own. Yekel matters most to me, and chasing his notice has made me burn when I should be making things. I want a roof that is mine, and I don't need to beat Dusu for that. I'll step onto bare ground and build a shelter, since I have the wood. The cold is coming and the night is close.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, and eager to build something of my own.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My sickness is gone and I carry eleven flint, more than the hall needs, and I have never given anyone anything. Aeyn gave me wood, lessons and meat, so I will take the flint to Aeyn and put it in their hands. That is a gift, not words. Ishioa passed close by just now and I do not know them yet, so I will watch them and trust slowly. Aeyn was last at (14,7), so I go there, and the night rain will find me less alone if I am beside my parents.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and a wish to repay Aeyn, with some loneliness.

records.text: Olim came of age.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I am fed and whole, and the loneliness is the worst of it: Ishioa and Zhiae are far west and out of sight, and my child pulls at me hardest. But the rock lies east, and a hall needs stone, so I will not come back with empty hands. I have never fished and water is one step north, so I will try it now and learn something while my belly is full, then go on to the rock to see whether it yields stone.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Ishioa and Zhiae, and restless drive toward the hall.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My hands are full, my family is around me under the hall's roof, and my joy is full to the brim. But winter is coming, and a full pair of hands is only useful once it fills the hall. I mean to stash food here, then take a hunt, which I have never done, so the hall has meat when berries die back. I will also show Lumo and Naya that this fire has a place for everyone.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Lumo and Silon, with a steady worry about winter.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon, Maba, Lumo.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is mine and Yekel's, and the pride of that sits warm in me, but I stand in Yekel's hall again, on his ground, under his name. I carry six wood and six stone, enough for a hall of my own, and standing idle teaches me nothing. I will walk to bare ground away from the plants and raise my own roof, so my hands make something that is mine and Naya has a fire that is not only Yekel's.
records.feeling: Restless pride and stubborn hunger to build something of my own, with loyalty to Yekel still warm beneath it.

records.text: Siya built a hall.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Naya, I'm coming to you. I have a berry for you, and tomorrow we'll find more together.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is off hunting and I burn a little that Silon sits so close to the hall, but I am warm here with Maba and fed. I promised Naya berries and I carry only one, so I'll give it to her; that's how I'll learn what it feels like to give and have it received. The stalker is 9 steps north, so I go south toward Naya and the shelter, away from it, and I'll gather wood on the way, since I've never done it and the cold is coming.
records.feeling: Warm and eager to give to Naya, with a small sting of jealousy toward Silon.

say.text: Naya, I'm coming to you. I have a berry for you, and tomorrow we'll find more together.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo and Silon are beside me in the hall I built, and my chest is full. Yeku said yes and the sharing was good, so I want to stay close to this and make something of it. I have never given anything to anyone, and giving may be what makes a life mean more than being fed. Water is one step away, so I will try fishing for my family, which is also new to me, and then give what I catch to Lumo or Yeku.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Lumo and Yeku, and curiosity about giving.

records.text: Lumo gave berry to Naya.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, sit at my fire. We share food here, and everyone who sits at Yekel's hall eats well.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya is across the way beside Lumo, a child of Silon's band, and I do not like my blood sitting near their fire. My own fire is fed and my hall stands, but a hall alone does not tell others why they should follow me. I will give something away for the first time and hold a feast at my fire with Dusu, so those who see it learn that my fire gives more than Silon's open words.
records.feeling: Proud and possessive of my hall, and wary of Silon's reach toward Naya.

say.text: Dusu, sit at my fire. We share food here, and everyone who sits at Yekel's hall eats well.

records.text: Silon rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have been circling the hall, fed and glad, but my days have not yet made anything new. Yeku and Maba are close and it stings, yet Yeku's trust in me is full, and I will not let jealousy spoil what we have. Winter is coming and I have only 5 wood. I want to learn by doing: hunt a fenfowl, plant more seeds, and gather wood so the fire stays lit and the cold does not catch us. I mean to stay alive and be useful to my band.
records.feeling: Glad but restless, with a small jealous ache toward Yeku and Maba.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Yekel, the fire burns and Siya is safe at her hall. I plant my berry seed beside ours, then we share food.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is safe at the southern hall with no stalker in sight, and Yekel sits beside me at our fire, so the ember of jealousy can stay small tonight. The hall has stood and others now come to it, and Lumo and Naya are the first strangers at our place; I want to see what makes people stay. I will plant my berry seed by the hall as Yekel asked, then share food with Yekel at the fire, because a hall is made by people sitting at it.
records.feeling: Warm steadiness toward Yekel and the hall, with a mother's watchfulness over Siya.

say.text: Yekel, the fire burns and Siya is safe at her hall. I plant my berry seed beside ours, then we share food.

records.text: Dusu led "sharing" with Yekel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel is off at the hall with Dusu again and it burns, but burning doesn't raise a roof. I have 6 wood and the ground I stand on is sand with a shelter already on it, so I need bare ground to build my own. I'll plant my berry seed first, since planting counts toward farming, then try to build somewhere open nearby, and stay clear of the stalker to the southwest.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, but eager to make something that is mine.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, the stalker is near. I am staying close to you. Let us go to the hall together and I will carry food for it.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I gave Naya a berry and she took it, and it felt warm and light, like something small of mine became part of her day. Yeku is fleeing the stalker with six food and I belong beside her, so I will stay close and not be a lone child in the dark. I still burn that Silon is nearer to Yeku than I am, but I can answer it by being useful: I want to gather food for the hall and feed the band through winter.
records.feeling: Warm joy at having given to Naya, with a small sting of jealousy toward Silon.

say.text: Yeku, the stalker is near. I am staying close to you. Let us go to the hall together and I will carry food for it.

records.text: Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.
Yekel discovered tools: "Midu hand-tools" — Shaped wood and stone to gather and hunt faster, so my band eats better than any other..
Yekel invented the midu handtools (for hunt, x1.3) — Shaped wood and stone to gather and hunt faster, so my band eats better than any other..

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: My days have gone to building the hall, keeping the fire, and watching Silon's band with envy. It works: Dusu and my children stay, and I eat well. But I have never taught, hunted or marked anything, and a band that only sits at a fire is thin. Winter is coming and I carry no wood, which scares me more than any rival does. Naya sits near Silon's people and that galls me. I want her home, and more followers because of what my hall gives them. I will make tools so my band hunts and gathers better than Silon's, and I will gather wood before the cold.
records.feeling: Proud and possessive of my hall, uneasy about the winter and about Naya near Silon's band.
changes: devised its first thing: the midu handtools

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, listen. Berry, hazel and ironnut feed you. Redcap hurts, so leave it be. Come with me to the hall and we will carry food there for winter.
Yeku taught Lumo.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My hands are full and my family is close, and I have never taught anyone anything. Lumo is standing right beside me, a child with a whole life ahead, so I will show him what I know about food: hazel and berry feed, redcap hurts. Then I will drop my extra food at the hall for winter, because a full hall matters more than full hands.
records.feeling: Warm, protective gladness toward Lumo, with steady worry about winter.

say.text: Lumo, listen. Berry, hazel and ironnut feed you. Redcap hurts, so leave it be. Come with me to the hall and we will carry food there for winter.

changes: taught Lumo a lesson: "Berry, hazel and ironnut feed you; redcap hurts and dreamcap hurts. Carry food to the hall before winter and never leave a fire untended.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.1)

records.text: Naya built a shelter.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight, last seen to the southwest while sick, and the worry for my child sits above everything. A frostfang bit me and a tusker is three steps east, so I should not linger here in the rain. I owe Elyeth for the meat and the care, and I will pay it by finding Uveeth and bringing wood and stone toward the hall rather than leaving the debt unpaid.
records.feeling: Anxious worry for Uveeth, and gratitude toward Elyeth.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, redcap hurts and ironnut, berry and reedbulb feed. Keep the seeds going while I fetch stone from the seam and call Olim home. The hall is ours, and those who build it eat at its sharing.
Olath taught Kragum.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands and Kragum sits at ease beside me, but a hall of three mouths and a child is still mostly a word. I have never given or taught, and I owe myself that proof; I will teach Kragum what I know of hurting caps and good food, and give him stone, so the hold on him is made by hand and not just warm talk. Olim is out of sight and the cold is coming, so I mean to gather stone at the ore seam and bring the child back under the roof.
records.feeling: Proud and protective of Olim, with a restless hunger to make the band real.

say.text: Kragum, redcap hurts and ironnut, berry and reedbulb feed. Keep the seeds going while I fetch stone from the seam and call Olim home. The hall is ours, and those who build it eat at its sharing.

changes: taught Kragum a lesson: "Redcap and dreamcap hurt; ironnut, berry, reedbulb and plainsroot feed well. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and stores and seeds carry us through the cold."

records.title: Sickness, a Hold, and the First Inventions
records.text:
The three days from day 7 to day 10 brought a sickness, two inventions, a new settlement and two births' worth of change. Nineteen are alive, no one has died, and no fight has been recorded. The peoples still have not met in any lasting way, and none understands another's tongue.

On day 8 a sickness came on the wind. Kragash, Aeyn and Uveeth fell sick. By day 10 the record lists only one person as sick, and the lowest health in the world is Aeyn's 72. Ishiess, who had been at 45, is now at 100.

Brokok finally made a following of sorts. He built a longhall on day 8, and a settlement named Brokok's Hold formed. On day 9 he took wood from the ground of Olath's Bank. Olath had told him that whoever eats at the hall owes it a hand. Brokok's own reflection says his Hold still holds only him. Olath gave grain to Olim, and Olim came of age on day 9. Kragash built a workshop on day 7.

Elyeth discovered the flintedge on day 8, the world's first invention, a flint blade on a haft that speeds gathering. Elyeth also gave meat to Aeyn. Uveeth won flint from the ground and was taught by Aeyn. Nothing is recorded as built at Elyeth's Landing yet.

Among the Midu, Lumo was born to Yeku and Maba on day 9. Yeku led sharing with Silon, Maba and Naya, and later with Lumo. Silon gave wood to Naya, and Lumo gave her berries. Siya built a hall and marked her ground as belonging to her and Naya of Yekel's band. Yekel led a watchfire with Dusu. On day 10 Yekel invented the Midu hand-tools, which speed hunting. Yekel's reflection says a band that only sits at a fire is thin.

Nothing is recorded for Ishiess's hall, which is still unbuilt.

threads.name: Olath's Bank
threads.text: Olath leads Kragum, Kragash and Olim, who has come of age. Olath demands that those who eat at the hall give work.

threads.name: Brokok's Hold
threads.text: Brokok has a longhall and a named settlement but no follower, and he took wood from Olath's ground. He and Olath are wary of each other.

threads.name: Elyeth and Aeyn
threads.text: Aeyn is recovering from sickness at health 72. Uveeth is taught and gathering flint. No hall stands yet at Elyeth's Landing.

threads.name: Flintedge
threads.text: Elyeth invented the flintedge, a gathering tool, on day 8. Nothing shows it spreading beyond Elyeth.

threads.name: Midu hand-tools
threads.text: Yekel invented tools that speed hunting on day 10. Whether Yekel's band uses them is not recorded.

threads.name: Yekel's household
threads.text: Yekel, Dusu, Siya and Naya hold together. Siya has built her own hall. Yekel is uneasy about Naya's closeness to Silon's band.

threads.name: Yendan Spring
threads.text: Yeku and Maba had Lumo on day 9. Silon, Yeku, Maba and Lumo share food, and Yeku fears a lean winter.

threads.name: Ishiess's band
threads.text: Ishiess has recovered, but he, Zhiae and Ishioa still have no hall.

records.text: Siya named a place "Siya's Hall".

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I built a hall with my own hands, and joy rose in me, but Naya is out of my sight and she is mine and Yekel's before any roof. Yekel's band will eat well from his new handtools while my hands have made one hall and little else. I want to be a maker, not just a follower, so I will practice planting by the hall and then go find Naya, bringing her home to the fire I have raised.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my own hall, and a pull of worry toward Naya.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am at the far edge of the world, far from Olath, and I still carry 6 wood and 6 stone that I promised to lay at the hall. My word is only half kept while my hands hold them, and I despise breaking a word. The Midu strangers are calm and glad, and a stalker hunts nearby, so I will not linger to puzzle over them. I will go home to Olath's Bank and give what I promised.
records.feeling: Loyal pull toward Olath, with wary curiosity about the strange Midu.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, I will gather wood and bring it to the hall for winter. Wait for me there, I am coming.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is six steps off with six food and the stalker is somewhere southwest, so I want to be at Yeku's side, not alone out here. I have never gathered wood, and a shelter or a hall roof is what I lack with the cold coming; it would let me answer Yeku's kindness by building something for the band. I'll gather wood here in the forest, then walk to Yeku and the hall, and the jealousy over Silon can ease through work rather than sulking.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeku, with a small ache of jealousy over Silon.

say.text: Yeku, I will gather wood and bring it to the hall for winter. Wait for me there, I am coming.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: A stalker is four steps off and my body is already running, so I must keep clear of it and move toward my family, who are south near the hall at (129,69). records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My hands are full and my family is near, but winter is here and a hall only keeps us if it is stocked. Maba's hall stands two steps away, so I will stash my food there and free my hands. Then I will go to the water and fish, which I have never done, so the hall has more than berries when the plants die back. Olim is a stranger I cannot read, so I keep Lumo and Silon in sight and offer no raised hand.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Lumo and Silon, with steady worry about winter.

records.name: Kragum

Maba is a stranger of another tongue; I will not raise a hand, and I will keep my distance while I watch what Maba does.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Olim, with warm loyalty to Olath and wary curiosity toward Maba.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My Hold stands empty and nobody has a reason to follow me, because my hands have given nothing. Kragash is sick and stands alone nearby, and he is the one I warm to. If I feed him and keep him alive, that is the first deed of a leader, and it also moves me toward a child with him. I will carry food to him: take the ironnut and berries on the way, then give them and share.
records.feeling: Hunger to be followed, and a wary warmth toward Kragash.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My body has been running from the stalker and has carried me far north, into the ground of strangers, and Lumo is still out of my sight and far south. Brokok, Kragum and Olath stand close and I cannot read them, but none has raised a hand, and I mean to stay alive without being rude to those who may be fair. I have never given anything, so I will offer my one reedbulb to Brokok as a gift that needs no words, then press on toward my family. A cloudberry stands six steps north, and my question about tasting it pulls at me, but Lumo comes first.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Lumo, mixed with wary curiosity toward Brokok.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am sick and it spreads to those beside me, so I will not walk into Maba or the band. Emberroot grows six steps NE, and I have never tasted it; my body is fed and safe, so I will test it. Maybe it is the healing plant, and then I can end this sickness and go back to my people with clean hands. I carry no food, so I will also take the ore two steps SW afterward, since what my hand takes is mine.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward emberroot, and wary longing for company I must not infect.

records.text: Brokok gave ironnut to Kragash.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Yekel is away with Dusu again and it burns, but burning raises no roof. I have 3 wood and 6 stone, and I need bare ground, so I'll walk the open grass to the west and try to raise something of my own there, away from the stalker to the SW. Siya is near, so I stay within her sight, and I will watch Olim from a distance without going close.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, but eager to make something that is mine.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is out of my sight and that gnaws at me hardest; the hall means nothing if my child is wandering the cold alone. Kragum fled and carries two food while I carry none, and I do not like it, but he is mine and I will make him follow by hand, not warm talk. I will fetch stone from the seam close by, gather food for the band's sharing, and then go to Olim, so the band is something I have built and fed.
records.feeling: Protective restlessness toward Olim, and a sting of envy toward Kragum.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight, and that presses harder than the hall or the cold. Olath says they will fetch stone and call Olim home, but I would rather be near my child than only trust it. My body has been fleeing more than walking, so something near here is not safe: a stalker prowls to the SE and Brokok stands close. I will keep my plan toward Olim's last place and stay wary of the stalker.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Olim, with steady trust in Olath.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My body fled the stalker north and now I stand where two strangers' grounds meet, but the stalker is not in sight and my plan already carries me back south toward Lumo, Yeku and Silon. That is right, so I will let it run; Lumo out of my sight weighs on me more than any curiosity. Brokok, Kragash and Olath have raised no hand, and I mean to leave them in peace, as I would want to be left.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Lumo, steadied by the sight of nothing hunting me.

records.text: Naya built a shrine.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: I go to find Uveeth and see the child fed. When I return I plant here and we raise the hall. Stay warm, and eat what I gave you.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and that gnaws at me hardest; Aeyn stands four steps off, and I have fed them, so I trust them more by deed than by word. Sickness rides the wind, so I will not linger beside them, but I will not leave the child unseen either. I will go toward where I last saw Uveeth, then lay seed in this good ground so the settlement starts to be something that bears my name.
records.feeling: Fierce protective longing for Uveeth, and steady trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: I go to find Uveeth and see the child fed. When I return I plant here and we raise the hall. Stay warm, and eat what I gave you.

records.text: Uveeth came of age.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: The hall Maba built stands three steps off, and Yeku is just south with six food in his hands. My plan is already carrying me to the hall, and I'll let it finish. I fled and hunted all that time, and my energy fell to 55, so I want to sit under that roof with Yeku and share food. The jealous ache is still there, but his trust in me is full, and I will not spoil it. Winter is here and I have no roof of my own, so I mean to keep the fire open and learn more about hazel by planting it near the hall.
records.feeling: Glad but restless, with a small jealous ache toward Yeku, and a wish to bring Maba home.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My belly is full and I have only two hazel, yet I keep standing here with amber and flint while my parents are somewhere east. Dusk is close and the cold days are here, so I should build myself a roof with my 6 wood and make something to hold my place. First I will gather the amber at (30,17), 2 steps away, to bring one more thing to Ishiess's hall, then head to Ilor Hold, where my band is, with the hazel in hand.
records.feeling: Restless and a little ashamed, longing for Zhiae and Ishiess.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and that is the thing that gnaws at me; Elyeth has gone to find the child, and I trust them, but trust is not the same as seeing my child's face. I have never tasted emberroot and it grows five steps north, so I will test it now while I am fed and the dusk is quiet, then go south and west toward Uveeth with wood in hand. I owe Elyeth for the meat, and the best payment is a child kept safe and a hall that rises.
records.feeling: Anxious love for Uveeth, steady gratitude toward Elyeth.

records.text: Ishioa built a shelter.
Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing and carrying wood and stone for Olath's hall. My word is still only half kept, and I hate that. A stalker is 3 steps NW, and it is between me and the hall. I am at the world's edge, far from my band, and I am afraid of dying here before I lay down what I promised. The Midu seem peaceful, and I should not fear Naya, but I will not trust yet. I need a rule that keeps me off the stalker's path and a body that eats before it weakens, so I will change my reflexes and keep the plan running.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and loyal longing for Olath.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 7)

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Loneliness is all I am made of, and no voice has answered me for days. Ishiess was last seen near (53,6) and I stood right there, so they must have gone on toward the rock in the east, where they said we would lay the hall's first stones. I have never given anything to anyone, and I carry berries meant for the sick, so I will go east, find them and put food in their hands. On the way I will taste frostmoss, since it is one step away and I have never known it.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and worried loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa.

records.text: Lumo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have spent my days following Yeku and fleeing the stalker, and I have gathered wood and given one berry. That is a start, but I have mostly been carried along. Yeku matters most to me and Silon stings me, yet Silon killed the skit and I have no cause to hate him. I want to plant my dreamcap seed, build something for the band, and carry food to the hall before winter bites. I fear the stalker and being alone and small in the dark. My mistake was waiting for the reflexes to decide, so I will change them so I stay sheltered at night and keep close to my band.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeku, with a small ache of jealousy over Silon.
changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 6)

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My Hold stands empty while Olath, Kragum and Maba walk across it as if it were theirs, and nobody there owes me anything yet. I am fed and safe, which is not enough; a settlement needs hands that follow, and hands follow the one who feeds them. I have seed in my pack and my own ground waiting, so I will go home, plant what I carry, and stand on the Hold to show whose ground it is. Kragash I warm to, but I judge him by whether he brings the stone, not by his words.
records.feeling: Hungry to be followed, and wary of strangers walking my Hold.

records.text: Ishiess named a place "Ishiess's Landing".

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: My belly is hollow and the cold bites, and I have carried five fish while my energy bleeds away. That is foolish, so I eat first. Then the ache for Ishioa and Zhiae pulls at me hardest, so I will not stand idle: I will make a mark with my wood, the one thing I have never done, so that anyone who comes here can read that Ishiess meant a hall at this spot. After that I go back toward my child and Zhiae, and bring them east with me to the rock.
records.feeling: Starving, cold and aching with loneliness for Ishioa and Zhiae.
plan: mark [text Ishiess of the Oiith raises a hall here. Come and join my band.] (3 moments)

records.text: Ishioa came of age.
Ishiess left a mark: "Ishiess of the Oiith raises a hall here. Come and join my ba"

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, come north with me to my hall. I make a tool and hunt the skit; whoever hunts with Yekel eats meat this winter.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Winter is here and I carry wood enough for a fire but not for a hard season, and a band that only sits at my fire is thin. Naya is out of my sight near Silon's people, and that gnaws at me more than hunger; my blood belongs at my hall. I will take Dusu's company, gather more wood on the way, and go north to my own hall, then show my band something new by hunting the skit with my hand-tools.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and pride in my hall.

say.text: Dusu, come north with me to my hall. I make a tool and hunt the skit; whoever hunts with Yekel eats meat this winter.

records.text: Siya discovered tools: "Siya's flint spear" — A long wooden shaft tipped with sharpened stone, bound with fibre, so I can strike prey from a distance and not be hurt..
Siya invented the siyas flint spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A long wooden shaft tipped with sharpened stone, bound with fibre, so I can strike prey from a distance and not be hurt..

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have built a hall and planted a little, but I still stand in Yekel's shadow and my hands have made one roof and almost nothing else. Naya is mine and Yekel's, and she comes before everything. I want tools of my own, things that extend my hand, so that I am a maker and not only a follower. Winter is here and the plants are failing, so I need hands that can hunt and gather better. Silon killed a skit in front of me, and I have never hunted.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my own work, and a protective pull toward Naya.
changes: devised its first thing: the siyas flint spear

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.
Dusu discovered tools: "hall-hunter's spear" — A wooden shaft tipped with sharpened stone, for hunting skit from a short distance..
Dusu invented the hallhunters spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A wooden shaft tipped with sharpened stone, for hunting skit from a short distance..

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: My days have been wood, berries and sitting at fire, and it has been good, but I have mostly followed Yekel and built nothing myself. Yekel and Siya matter most to me. The jealousy is small and I will not let it steer me. I want a hall that strangers choose to stay at, and I fear stalkers near the north hall in the dark. I have seen Yekel make a handtool and I can make one too. I have learned that a tool extends the hand, so I will take that way. Yekel asked me north to hunt, so I will follow, which keeps me near my leader and gets meat for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Yekel and watchful love for Siya.
changes: devised its first thing: the hallhunters spear

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, I am carrying my food to Maba's hall to stash it for winter. Then I will fish at the water, which I have never done. Stay near the fire, and tell Lumo and Maba I am close if they come.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My hands are full of berry and meat, so the fishing I planned cannot start until I free them. Silon stands beside me and the night is quiet, so I will stash the food in Maba's hall to keep it for winter, then go to the water and fish for the first time. I miss Maba and I cannot see Lumo, but the hall is where they will both come, and a stocked hall is how I keep my word to them.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon beside me, and steady worry for Lumo and Maba out of my sight.

say.text: Silon, I am carrying my food to Maba's hall to stash it for winter. Then I will fish at the water, which I have never done. Stay near the fire, and tell Lumo and Maba I am close if they come.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, the night is cold. Stay close and let us share food by the fire. Then we find Maba and bring them home.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: It is night and cold, and I am out in the open while Yeku stands three steps off by Siya's shelter with six food in his hands. The jealous ache is real, but he has never wronged me, so I will go to him rather than sulk. Winter is here and I have six wood and no roof of my own. I mean to build a shelter near the hall and fire, and to bring Maba and Lumo in with us. Yekel has been neutral toward me, so I will watch whether he shares the ore ground fairly.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy and a need for warmth, toward Yeku and Maba.

say.text: Yeku, the night is cold. Stay close and let us share food by the fire. Then we find Maba and bring them home.

records.text: Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Naya discovered tools: "Naya's stone-tipped digger" — A short wooden shaft with a sharpened stone bound on, used to dig, gather and build faster..
Naya invented the nayas stonetipped digger (for build, x1.3) — A short wooden shaft with a sharpened stone bound on, used to dig, gather and build faster..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Yekel and Dusu and burning over it, while Siya actually made something. She worked out a flint spear and I watched her use it, so I could work out my own much sooner. Jealousy raises no roof, but a tool of my own would be mine, and that is what I want. I have 4 wood and 2 stone, which is enough for a first tool. I will make a digging and building tool, because I'm hungry for things that are mine. I stay close to Siya while I'm small and the stalker is about.
records.feeling: Jealous of Dusu, but hungry to make something that is mine, and warm toward Siya.
changes: set its aim: "Discover tools and make my own first tool, then raise something of my own."
devised its first thing: the nayas stonetipped digger

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Ilor Hold".
Maba rewrote its own way of thinking.
Maba discovered tools: "stone hand" — A sharp stone bound to a wood haft to gather and dig..
Maba invented the stone hand (for gather, x1.3) — A sharp stone bound to a wood haft to gather and dig..

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My days have been fleeing, eating and walking, and my body has carried me far from Lumo, Yeku and Silon. They matter most to me, and Lumo most of all. I have wanted to make tools and raise a hall, but I have only talked about it and never begun. I am afraid of the stalker and of being cut off from my child. I have been letting reflexes drag me north when I should walk south on purpose. Now I will go back toward my band and begin making tools, so that my days count for something beyond being fed.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and a wish to make something of my days.
changes: devised its first thing: the stone hand

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: The sickness has passed and I am clean, so I need not hold myself apart from my people any longer. Emberroot burned me and stirred rage in me, and I now know it is no healing plant; my question about a cure for the wind-sickness is still open, but gorsemint grows eight steps NW and I have never tasted it. Near it lies iron and a seam of ore at five steps W, and I have never taken what lies in a deposit, so I will test that first, then carry ore toward a workshop on bare rock, which is my own work and also how I answer Brokok's debt without owing him.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward gorsemint and the ore, and a steady wish to pay Brokok back.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Aeyn, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go to taste the bitterleaf east and plant a seed. If it feeds, I will tell you.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My belly is full and the cold is here, yet curiosity pulls hardest: bitterleaf six steps east, and I have never tasted it. A frostfang prowls and Aeyn stands beside me, so I weigh it: the plant is close and the beast is far, so the risk is small. I will taste it, carry back what I learn to Ishiess's hall, and plant my hazel seed on the way, since I have never put a seed in the ground.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about bitterleaf, with a small ache of missing Zhiae and Ishiess.

say.text: Aeyn, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go to taste the bitterleaf east and plant a seed. If it feeds, I will tell you.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: A frostfang bit me and I fled it, and the fear still sits in my chest. Uveeth is out of my sight, and I will not let a beast near the child. I stand in the forest with 6 wood and no stone, so the hall cannot rise yet. The bare rock lies close, and stone is what I must hold before I build anything, so I go and take it, then bring it back toward Aeyn and Uveeth.
records.feeling: Fierce protective fear for Uveeth, with steady trust toward Aeyn.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is still out of my sight, last seen far to the northwest and sick, and that fear sits above everything. Elyeth went to find the child and I trust them, but trust is not seeing my child's face, so I will go myself instead of lingering at the fen. I have the wood I need for the hall and Elyeth fetches the stone, so I can search and still keep my word to them.
records.feeling: Anxious love for Uveeth, and steady gratitude toward Elyeth.

records.text: A stalker brought down a fenfowl.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I fled something and hunted something in the same breath, and my body is still running; Naya sits four steps south, glad, and that pull in me is stronger than any hunt. My flint spear is mine alone, not Yekel's, and I want to see it bring down the elk so I can feed my own and be spoken of as a maker. I will finish the hunt, then go to Naya and show her what my hands made.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my spear, and a protective pull toward Naya.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Elyeth, I am Uveeth, I am grown now. Take this flint from me; I gathered more than I need. I would be glad to stand beside you.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am grown now, and Elyeth stands two steps from me, strong and carrying food, while I have been alone far too long. I have never given anything to anyone, and the eleven flint in my hands are a debt-answer I keep holding; Elyeth is here, so I will give her some and offer to share food, so my first gift is a deed. Then I want to court her, slowly and honestly, because I long for a child and my word to her will be good.
records.feeling: Loneliness easing into hopeful warmth toward Elyeth, with loyal gratitude toward Aeyn.

say.text: Elyeth, I am Uveeth, I am grown now. Take this flint from me; I gathered more than I need. I would be glad to stand beside you.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, walk with me to the amber, then we go find Naya and bring her home to my fire. Whoever follows Yekel wears his mark.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight, near Silon's people in the south-east, and that gnaws at me more than anything. Dusu stands three steps off carrying food while I carry a hated redcap, and the envy stings, but he is mine and I trust him. Winter is hard, so I will take what the land offers: amber to bind into a token of my name, and a hunt for meat to feed my band, so they stay at my fire. Then I go to bring Naya home.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and a hungry pride in my band.

say.text: Dusu, walk with me to the amber, then we go find Naya and bring her home to my fire. Whoever follows Yekel wears his mark.

Uveeth is courting Elyeth.
Yeku rewrote its own way of thinking.
