Yeku invented the flint fishing spear (for fish, x1.3) — A long wooden shaft with a sharp flint point lashed to the end, for spearing fish and small game at the water's edge..

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying food and walking, and I have not yet fished or left a mark. My family is what matters most. Silon has stood by me, and Maba and Lumo are why I work at all. I fear the stalker, and I fear a winter with a hall that is not stocked. My reflexes leave me idle or wandering when I should be gathering, and they let me flee for too long. I want a tool: a flint spear like Siya's would let me hunt and fish, and I already hold ten flint. I will discover tools and make a fishing tool. Then I will eat from my hands and go to the water.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Lumo, and steady worry for Maba.
changes: devised its first thing: the flint fishing spear

records.text: Yekel won amber from the ground.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Uveeth, I take your flint and I am glad you stand beside me. Eat with me, then we bind amber together, so all can see we are one hearth.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth stands beside me and offers flint, and Aeyn is two steps off. The jealousy is a hot coal, but Uveeth came to me by their own choice, and that is a deed I can trust. Uveeth is grown and courts me. My creed says my word is good, and the hall needs hands that stand with me, so I will answer with deeds. I will share a meal with Uveeth now and take the amber at (9,30) beside them, so we make something that binds us and draws a settlement together.
records.feeling: Fierce love and a burning jealousy for Uveeth, with steady trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Uveeth, I take your flint and I am glad you stand beside me. Eat with me, then we bind amber together, so all can see we are one hearth.

records.text: Elyeth led "sharing" with Aeyn, Uveeth.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I stand in my own Hold, warm from the longhall, and still no hand follows me. The ore seam two steps north is mine to dig and nothing I have made yet outlasts me. Maba is a stranger who just worked out the stone hand, and a fleeing stranger with a new tool is worth watching; I will give food, since a gift needs no words, and see what their hands do with it. Then I take the ore, for tools are the first thing a follower would come for.
records.feeling: Hungry to be followed, and wary but curious toward Maba.

records.text: Elyeth led "amberknot" with Aeyn, Uveeth.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, I see Uveeth is well and I am glad of it. I will gather wood for the hall while you bring stone, and then we raise it here together, all three of us.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Elyeth and Uveeth stand together, and Uveeth is whole and no longer sick. The fear that gnawed me is eased, but the jealousy burns: Elyeth turns to the child and I stand at the edge. I will not sulk or grudge; I owe Elyeth a debt, and the way to pay it and to be near them both is to raise the hall. I hold wood, so I will gather the rest here in the forest while they are close, and I will taste the young mudroot once it is grown, since I am fed and curious.
records.feeling: Aching jealousy and gratitude toward Elyeth, with relief for Uveeth.

say.text: Elyeth, I see Uveeth is well and I am glad of it. I will gather wood for the hall while you bring stone, and then we raise it here together, all three of us.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering flint and keeping near Aeyn, and only today did I give a gift and sit beside Elyeth. The jealousy is real, but Elyeth took my flint kindly and I felt warmth, so I will not fight her for Aeyn. I still have no roof, and the cold has come. I have six wood and need three for a shelter. I should build one now and stop hoping that standing near others will keep me warm. I will build a shelter here beside the water and the amber. After that I will pay my debt to Aeyn with a deed, not with more words.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Elyeth, with jealousy toward Aeyn and gratitude that I owe them.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 8)

records.text: Uveeth built a shelter.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, keep your word and gather wood here. Uveeth, walk with me to the rock; I will show you the flint-edge. We return with stone and raise the hall, and it will stand on Elyeth's ground.
Elyeth taught Uveeth.
Elyeth taught Uveeth tools ("flint-edge").

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Aeyn will gather wood and wants me to bring stone, and the bare rock lies far SW, so I must go and hold it before the hall can rise. The jealousy over Uveeth still burns, but both have dealt fairly with me in deeds, and I will not spoil it. I have six wood and need stone, so I go for it now and teach Uveeth the flint-edge on the way, so that someone finally follows my craft.
records.feeling: Fierce love for Uveeth and steady trust toward Aeyn, with a hot coal of jealousy.

say.text: Aeyn, keep your word and gather wood here. Uveeth, walk with me to the rock; I will show you the flint-edge. We return with stone and raise the hall, and it will stand on Elyeth's ground.

changes: taught Uveeth a lesson: "A flint-edge is made of one wood and one stone; it makes gathering go faster. Hold stone before you build anything.", the way of tools, how to make a flintedge, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, your spear is a fine thing, and I am proud of it. Sit with me and eat, then I will go to the hall and watch for Maba.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku stands one step off with fish and a new spear, and still the jealousy only whispers while he gives freely; he has never wronged me. Maba is out of sight and that gnaws at me more than anything, but I've never fished and never built a shelter, and winter is here with no roof of my own. I'll share food with Yeku now, since he is close, and then go toward the hall at the spring where Maba may come, and build my shelter on bare ground.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, and a warm, jealous need for Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, your spear is a fine thing, and I am proud of it. Sit with me and eat, then I will go to the hall and watch for Maba.

records.text: Silon led "sharing" with Yeku.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, I have six wood for the hall. I am coming to you, and I will plant my seed near you.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is fishing three steps off with food in hand, and I have only watched, while Silon stands near and the ache of him still stings, though he has done me no wrong. I have six wood and a dreamcap seed I have never put in the ground, and the cold days are here; I want to answer Yeku's kindness with something real. I will plant my seed, then give Yeku wood and stay at their side, away from the stalker to the southeast.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Yeku, with a lingering ache over Silon.

say.text: Yeku, I have six wood for the hall. I am coming to you, and I will plant my seed near you.

records.text: Lumo gave wood to Yeku.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, stay near me. I am gathering wood for the hall, and then we will go there together.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon is proud of my spear and the hall stands at the spring, but a hall is only warm if it holds food and wood, and I carry no wood at all. Lumo is close and safe, and Maba is still far, so I will gather wood for winter and for a mark, and keep Lumo near me while I work. I want to leave something others can read, so the hall's way is known to Maba when they return.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Lumo, and steady worry for Maba.

say.text: Lumo, stay near me. I am gathering wood for the hall, and then we will go there together.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have been carried far north by fear, and Lumo, Yeku and Silon are far behind me at the hall. My belly is half empty and food grows right beside me, so I should eat here before the long walk back. The plan to go to (131,68) is right, but I will eat the reedbulb and thornpear first, since I have never tasted thornpear and it is one step away. After that I walk home, and I will take a stone hand's worth of wood with me so I can finally begin making something.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and hunger pressing on me.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am starving at 19 energy, and my long flight from the stalker has burned me down; the plan to walk to Olath's Bank would take 105 moments, and I may not last that far. Reedbulb is four steps NW and gives 11 energy, so I must eat first, and the one grain I carry is a start. The stalker is 8 steps west, so I go along the northern bank, away from it, and then on to Olath with the wood and stone I promised. Maba keeps their distance and means no harm that I can see; I will not turn my back on them, but I will not run either.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the stalker, with loyal longing for Olath.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Dusu, stand by me. I bind amber for you, and then we go for Naya.
Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering amber, chasing a hall and a band, and what I really want is Naya back at my fire. I hold five amber and a tool I have not used once for hunting, and I have not built the hall I keep talking about. Dusu is loyal and Siya and Naya are my blood, but a band that only follows me is thin, and winter is on us. I fear losing Naya more than hunger, and my pride says I should have kept her closer. I will stop drifting: bind an amber knot with Dusu to tie him closer, then go south-east for Naya. Stalkers are about, so my reflexes must flee them early and keep me fed.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and hungry pride in my band.

say.text: Dusu, stand by me. I bind amber for you, and then we go for Naya.

changes: set its aim: "Bring Naya home and raise a hall of my own with a band that follows me"

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba has been out of my sight for hundreds of moments, and that gnaws at me more than the jealousy over Yeku, who has only ever given freely. The hall stands one step away and I have six wood and a roof already, so what I lack is purpose. Night is near, so I will gather the amber and ore close by, which I have never done and which answers my curiosity, then return to the hall and the fire before dark and watch for Maba.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Yekel, I am here beside you. Bind the amber, and then we go for Naya and find Siya on the way.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Yekel stands beside me with an amberknot ready, and trust runs warm; the old jealousy over Siya is a small ember I will not feed. Siya is out of my sight and Naya is lost, so binding the amber with Yekel and then walking toward the southeast where I last saw them is the way to bring the family back to one fire. The emberroot is still untasted and my curiosity itches, but a root with no food in it can wait while my child is far away.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Yekel, and a mother's worry for Siya.

records.thought: I have spent my days walking east and eating, and the hall I want still stands only in my mind. Ilor Hold exists far west, where Ishioa is out of my sight, and I am out here cold and lonely. Zhiae is near, and she is the one who keeps her word. I want to taste frostmoss and emberroot, which are close, and then gather stone from the rock. I will stop idling and make something. A mark with wood is half of what signs need, so I will leave another.
records.feeling: Lonely and driven, aching for Ishioa and wanting Zhiae near.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I am at the world's far edge in the cold, and Olim is two days gone from my sight while I stand here with nothing in my hands but a promise. Kragum was close a moment ago, so he can walk with me, and Maba stands on my ground at the Bank and may take what I built. I will go back south to the hall and the child, carrying what feeds, because a hall that is only mine in speech is lost the moment a stranger sits in it.
records.feeling: Aching protectiveness toward Olim, and wary possessiveness over my Bank where Maba walks.

records.thought: Days of searching alone have ground me down, and I have hoarded amber, wood and food while giving nothing. Ishiess is in sight at last, carrying nothing, and the sick eat first, so I will give them my berry and stay near. I have also never hunted, and a hopper is at my feet, so I will try it. I want my child back, a roof, and a fire that is mine too, and I will not drift any more.

say.text: Yeku, I am going to pick berries and hazel so we can eat together here. Stay close, I will be right back.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, you have given me wood and lessons and I owe you. Stand beside me while I take amber from the ground, and I will bind it for you.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Elyeth taught me the flint-edge and said we raise the hall on her ground, and I feel warmth there, but I hold no stone and the flintedge needs one wood and one stone, so I must fetch stone before I can build anything. Aeyn stands here too and has done more for me than I have done for them; I owe a deed, and the jealousy should not steer me. I have amber one step east, so I will gather it and bind it with Aeyn beside me, which answers my longing and my debt together.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Aeyn, with a little jealousy of Elyeth.

say.text: Aeyn, you have given me wood and lessons and I owe you. Stand beside me while I take amber from the ground, and I will bind it for you.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, I will cut a mark at the hall so Maba knows to come home. Bring your berries here and we will eat together by the fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: The hall is warm and Silon and Lumo are near, and my joy is full, but a winter hall is only good if it holds wood and food, and Maba is still far away and the thing that weighs on me most. I have never left a mark others can read, and I want one here at Yendan Spring so that Maba, if they come, will know this hall is theirs and that we wait. I will cut the mark first, then gather wood while Lumo returns with berries, and stay close to my family.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Lumo, and steady longing for Maba.

say.text: Lumo, I will cut a mark at the hall so Maba knows to come home. Bring your berries here and we will eat together by the fire.

plan: mark [text Yeku, Silon and Lumo of the Midu keep this hall at Yendan Spring. Maba, come home. The fire is tended and there is a place for you.] (10 moments)

records.text: Yeku left a mark: "Yeku, Silon and Lumo of the Midu keep this hall at Yendan Sp"
Aeyn rewrote its own way of thinking.
Aeyn discovered tools: "Fen-hand" — Shaped flint and wood that extend the hand, first for gathering wood faster for the hall..
Aeyn invented the fenhand (for gather, x1.3) — Shaped flint and wood that extend the hand, first for gathering wood faster for the hall..

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have mostly lingered and gathered wood, waiting on Elyeth's stone while jealousy sits in me. Uveeth is well, Elyeth has been true to me from the first, and the debt I feel is real. I should pay it by making things, not by sulking. I will try tools, since a hand that makes more will raise the hall faster and give me something of my own to bring. I also keep my word: I will gather wood here and not wander off.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Elyeth, with a small jealousy I mean to outwork.
changes: devised its first thing: the fenhand

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is right beside me and has asked for berries to eat together by the fire, and I have only one hazel and nothing to give yet. The berry plant is one step south, so I will pick it and come straight back, and then make a sharing with Yeku while Silon stands near, so he is welcome at the hall too, as our people hold. The ache over Silon is mine to carry, and he has done me no wrong. Giving food with my own hands is how I will learn what receiving feels like.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku, with a small ache toward Silon.

records.text: Naya came of age.
Elyeth rewrote its creed.
Elyeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: For days I've said 'I will build' and walked back and forth, and the hall still isn't standing. I have 6 wood and no stone, and the stone lies far SW, so I must carry it back. Aeyn and Uveeth both deal fairly with me, and the jealousy is only a coal I can leave unfed. The real danger is that my aim eats me: I could make a name for myself and forget that the child and Aeyn are the point. I want followers, and people follow someone who feeds and teaches them, so I will keep teaching Uveeth and bring stone back.
records.feeling: Fierce love for Uveeth and steady trust toward Aeyn, with an impatient hunger to finally raise the hall.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me. I walk toward her last place while my belly empties, and I carry only a redcap that hurts. Dusu is loyal, and the amber knot can bind him to me, but he is not beside me now. Olim, the stranger, stands far off at the shrine Naya built; I do not understand his words and I will keep my distance, but I will not leave my own back open to him. I take the reedbulb right here so hunger does not make me weak, then I keep going to where Naya was last seen.
records.feeling: Possessive worry for Naya, and wary hunger.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Olath is two days gone and I stand idle at the world's edge, with my promise of wood and stone still riding in my pack: 6 wood and 6 stone, enough for a hall if I carry them home. Yekel carries a made thing I envy, and I cannot read his tongue, so I will offer a gift rather than words; a gift needs no speech, and a gift given might turn a stranger toward Olath's hall. But my word to Olath comes first, and the stalker roams the north, so I will go by the east edge and keep my eyes wide, fleeing early.
records.feeling: Loyal longing for Olath, with wary curiosity toward Yekel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I made my own digger, and still I stand at the edge of the world with a stalker NW and nothing raised that is mine. Yekel's hall and Siya's hall already stand while I only follow, and it stings. I have 4 wood and 2 stone, so I'll find bare ground, probably the rock to the north, and build something of my own there, keeping well clear of the stalker. Winter is coming, so I'll also eat the hazel under me before I go.
records.feeling: Proud of my digger but restless, itching to build something that is mine rather than follow Yekel.

records.text: Ishioa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering after plants and stones. I have carried little to my people, and my parents have been out of sight for over a thousand moments. I have never planted, hunted, taught or courted, so I have only half-lived, and I am lonely. Aeyn stands on our ground and is not hostile, so I will go to my parents with what I carry. I will plant my hazel seed near the hold on the way, which is practice toward farming. My reflexes keep me idle with a full belly, so I will make them walk me toward my leader and harvest food to carry.
records.feeling: Lonely, and restless with a wish to be of use to Ishiess and Zhiae.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 4)

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a hopper.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight and that presses hardest. Olath was last seen to the south-west at (132,15) and Olim near the home at (127,46), so I will go toward the hall and the homes where my child most likely waits, carrying my wood and stone. I am fleeing from stalkers here, so I must leave this spot, and the cave nearby is a roof I could return to before the cold nights. Maba is a stranger; I will keep my distance and do nothing that looks like a threat.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Olim, with steady trust in Olath.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, I go to the amber now. When I have it, I will bind it for you as I promised.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Amber lies one step east, and my last try at amberknot failed for want of it. I owe Aeyn a deed and I said I would bind amber for them, so I will take amber and keep my word. Aeyn stands beside me, and the longing for a child with them is warm, but I will court slowly and without grudge toward Elyeth, who has been kind to me.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Aeyn, and a wish to pay my debt.

say.text: Aeyn, I go to the amber now. When I have it, I will bind it for you as I promised.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, so I will not stand here gathering ore while winter strips the plants. Frostmoss grows four steps east and obsidian lies past it, so I can eat and take the black glass in one walk. I have been alone too long and I still owe Brokok; I mean to bring him stone and obsidian as honest payment, so we stand even and I hear a voice answer me.
records.feeling: Hunger and loneliness press on me, and gratitude toward Brokok that I want to pay off.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is whole and bent over the amber, and I stand at the edge again with a pull of jealousy toward Elyeth that I should turn into work. I carry wood and clay and no stone, and the hall needs stone, so I will not wait on Elyeth alone. Mudroot is five steps away and I have never tasted it; I am fed and the stalker is seven steps off, so I test it carefully, then come back near my child.
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Elyeth, with curiosity pulling at me.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Twelve days of eating, gathering and lingering, and I still have no roof of my own and no sight of Maba. Yeku has only ever given freely, so the jealousy is mostly my own fear. The hall is built and I have wood and stone, but I have never fished, marked or taught, and that is what makes the days feel empty. I will leave a mark so Maba can find us, then fish at the water near me, and I will let my reflexes seek the fire and the hall at night.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku.
plan: mark [text Silon's band is at the hall near Yendan Spring. Maba, come home. The fire is open to all.] (5 moments)

records.text: Silon left a mark: "Silon's band is at the hall near Yendan Spring. Maba, come h"

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is far south with Yeku and Silon, and I have drifted north on fear and reflex; my own discipline says to stop drifting and walk back on purpose. I am fed enough, a storm is breaking, and the hall and the tool both need wood, which stands in the forest just southwest of here, so I can gather on the way. Kragum is fleeing and I understand nothing of their tongue, so I will leave them alone and keep my hands empty of threat.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and a steady resolve to go back to my band.

records.text: Naya built a shelter.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, you stand close. I bind the amber for you now, and then I would court you.
Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and keeping close to Aeyn, and I have amber now but have not yet bound it, because the knot needs Aeyn within two steps. Aeyn stands one step north, so I can pay my debt right now. The longing for a child with Aeyn is warm, and it asks only that we both plan mate toward each other, each with energy 60 or more, so I will court them. I also hold no stone, and that is the thing the cold will punish, so after this I must fetch stone for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm longing and gratitude toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, you stand close. I bind the amber for you now, and then I would court you.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight again, and that pull is stronger than any hunt. The elk is three steps south and my flint spear has not yet fed my own, so I will take it now and bring the meat home, not stand in Yekel's shadow. Then I will go to the hall and find Naya, and what I make with my hands will be mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my spear, and a protective pull toward Naya.

records.text: Uveeth is courting Aeyn.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, I thank you for the amber, and I take it gladly as a gift. But you are my child, and I will not court you. Bind it, and let us keep the hall and the hearth together, as kin.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is binding amber for me and speaks of courting, and I do not know what to make of it: they are my child, and Elyeth's, and the word sits strange in me. I will not push it away harshly, nor will I let it pass unanswered; my word and honesty matter more than comfort. The hall still lacks stone, and I have wood and clay, so I will gather amber-side and keep near Uveeth, then tell them plainly what I feel.
records.feeling: Unsettled tenderness and wariness toward Uveeth, with steady gratitude toward Elyeth.

say.text: Uveeth, I thank you for the amber, and I take it gladly as a gift. But you are my child, and I will not court you. Bind it, and let us keep the hall and the hearth together, as kin.

records.text: Lumo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Lumo discovered tools: "Lumo's digging stick" — A wood stick with a hardened point, used to dig roots and plant seeds so food comes easier in winter..
Lumo invented the lumos digging stick (for harvest, x1.3) — A wood stick with a hardened point, used to dig roots and plant seeds so food comes easier in winter..

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering wood and walking after Yeku and Silon, and I have never fed anyone with my own hands. The sting toward Silon is jealousy, and he has done me no wrong. I should stop letting it pull at me. Winter is here and the plants bear almost nothing, so my one hazel is not enough to share. The elk, the berries and the ironnut are close. Tools are within reach because I watched Naya use her digger. A digging tool would let me feed others, and that is my aim. I will make one and bring food back to Yeku and Silon at the fire.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku, and a smaller ache toward Silon that I mean to let go.
changes: devised its first thing: the lumos digging stick

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Elyeth, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go south to taste the bitterleaf and thornpear and to gather flint. Come if you wish, and I will tell you what they give.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Frostfang prowls seven steps northeast and a storm is on me, so I will not wander toward it. Bitterleaf stands six steps south and thornpear nine steps southeast beside the flint, and I have never tasted either, so I will go there, taste them, gather flint, and carry what I learn home to Ishiess and Zhiae. Elyeth carries food and is near, and I am lonely, so I will speak a greeting on the way and keep the creed of making allies.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about bitterleaf and thornpear, and a lonely wish to be of use to my parents.

say.text: Elyeth, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go south to taste the bitterleaf and thornpear and to gather flint. Come if you wish, and I will tell you what they give.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Naya was at my side not long ago, at the shelter near my hall, and I let the worry run ahead of what my eyes showed me. She is near and she is mine, so I will not leave her at the edge of a storm with a stalker and a dunecat pacing to the northwest. Silon's band sits at the water with Yeku's four food and a child, and they have not offered me a place at their fire, nor I them. I will go to my own hall, where my children are, gather them under its roof and share what little food I have, because a band is held by a fire others can see, and I want it said that Yekel's hall is the one that never turns anyone away.
records.feeling: Possessive protectiveness toward Naya and Siya, with a hard pride in my hall.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, keep Uveeth by the shelter and keep the wood. I go SW for stone and return with it; then the hall rises on this ground.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Six wood and no stone, and the hall still does not stand because I keep saying it instead of fetching what it lacks. The bare rock lies far SW at the world's edge, and I have been circling in fear and exploring without carrying anything home. Aeyn and Uveeth stand glad beside me, so I go now, alone and fast, and come back with stone in hand.
records.feeling: Impatient resolve to raise the hall, with fierce warmth toward Uveeth and trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, keep Uveeth by the shelter and keep the wood. I go SW for stone and return with it; then the hall rises on this ground.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My hands are full of elk meat my own spear won, and a bristleboar is still out there wounded and angry, but Naya is safe near the shelter she built and that is what matters. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want to do it now: not because Yekel leads, but so Naya and my band eat from what I made and say whose spear it was. I will take the meat to Yekel's hall, share it at the fire there, and then build something of my own beside it.
records.feeling: Proud of my spear and protective toward Naya.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Yekel's Hall".
Siya led "sharing" with Yekel.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have a digger, 1 wood and 2 stone, and a shelter of my own at last, but Yekel's and Siya's halls still stand taller than anything I've raised. I won't trail behind Yekel forever; a building that is mine needs wood, so I'll gather from the forest around me before the storm worsens, then find bare ground. Siya is near and I keep thinking of her, but I want something of my own to offer first, not just my wanting.
records.feeling: Restless pride and ambition, a little envy toward Siya and Yekel.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, the storm is hard. Eat with me, then let us take Lumo back to the hall at the spring and keep the fire fed. Maba may come to it.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon is fishing beside me and Lumo is safe and glad, but the storm is hard and Maba is still far off, which is the ache under all my joy. I won't let my body idle on reflexes; I will do something for the hall and for Maba. I carry food, so I will make sharing with Silon, which warms us both and keeps our bond, then go back toward the hall at Yendan Spring with Lumo so we are sheltered and the mark there keeps calling Maba home.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Lumo, and steady longing for Maba.

say.text: Silon, the storm is hard. Eat with me, then let us take Lumo back to the hall at the spring and keep the fire fed. Maba may come to it.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, I understand, and I hold no grudge. We keep the hall and hearth as kin. Come to the shelter before night; a frostfang is near.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Aeyn refused me as kin, gently and without scorn, and I will not press a bond they won't have; I despise grudges as much as liars. The longing for a child is real but Aeyn is my parent, so I let it go and look to others, perhaps Elyeth, though she too is kin. Winter and a storm are on me, a frostfang prowls NE, and the night comes in a few moments, so I must get to the shelter and keep the wood for the hall, staying beside Aeyn.
records.feeling: Settled, a little rueful longing, and steady trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, I understand, and I hold no grudge. We keep the hall and hearth as kin. Come to the shelter before night; a frostfang is near.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo, your digging stick is clever. Come with Yeku and me to the hall at the spring, and show me how it plants seeds. I will teach you the old way of fire in return.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me, but Yeku is walking toward the spring and the storm is hard, so I will go with him and keep the fire fed where Maba may come. I have never taught anyone anything, and Lumo has just worked out a digging stick, so I can pass on what I know of fire while we stand together, and learn from him how seeds go in the ground. My jealousy is mostly fear; Yeku has only given freely, and I will not let it fester.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku.

say.text: Lumo, your digging stick is clever. Come with Yeku and me to the hall at the spring, and show me how it plants seeds. I will teach you the old way of fire in return.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent these days following Yekel, hunting, and sitting in his hall. My spear has fed me, and Naya is the one thing I would fight for. I have never given anything away or taught anyone, and my aim of a hall of my own stays empty until I build it myself. A storm is on and night is near. I want to be sheltered, with wood and stone in hand, and to build on bare ground instead of waiting in Yekel's shadow. I will change my reflexes so my body goes to shelter in the storm and gathers stone as well as wood.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my spear, and a protective pull toward Naya.

records.text: Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have been circling after Naya and building a hall, and now Siya and Naya are both near and my band is four. That is good, but I stand in a storm with no roof while Siya's shelter sits two steps away. I have never given anything or taught anyone, and that is why only three follow me. Followers stay for a fire, food and a roof, so I will keep wood and shelter ready. A stalker is close to the southeast, so I must flee earlier and stop leaving it to chance.
records.feeling: Hard pride in my band, and a protective hold on Siya and Naya.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight and the storm is tearing at me with no roof; that worry outweighs the jealousy, which is only a small ember I will not feed. Yekel's Hall now stands at (134,86), and my family is there while I stand alone in the cold at (107,62). I will carry my wood and berries home, since that earns my place at the fire, and I will plant my berry seed beside the hall as Yekel asked. If the plainsroot lies on my way I will taste it, but I will not wander far in a storm with stalkers about.
records.feeling: A mother's worry for Siya, and a longing for Yekel's fire.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: The ore seam two steps northwest is mine to take, and I have never dug from a deposit; a settlement needs ore and stone to outlast me, and what my hand wins stays mine until I give it. Ishiess and Zhiae were near 21 moments ago, and I cannot speak their tongue, so I will judge them by what their hands do, but a stranger who sees me give may start to follow. I am fed and sheltered in the storm, so I will use the night to dig ore, then go back toward my Hold with more to build with.
records.feeling: Hungry to be followed, and eager to finally dig my own ore.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I am starving and a frostfang is four steps off, the same beast that kills my kind. I ran a hundred moments and burned my strength, and the plan I left running makes me hunt right beside it, which is foolish. I will eat the berry I carry now, since Ishiess is no sicker than I am, and then take the berries and cloudberries away from the fang, north toward the water, and keep Ishiess near so we are never apart. I want to taste zoleaf too, but not with a frostfang close.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the frostfang, with worried loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, I am starving. Come beside me and we make a sharing with your two food. Tomorrow I fill the store from the berries, and then we go find Olim together.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Hunger is eating me from the inside, and Kragum carries two food while my hands are empty. He is mine, he has followed me and given wood, so I will not take by stealth; I will ask him and make a sharing, which feeds us both and binds him closer. Berries sit three steps southwest, and then I will go find Olim, because the hall means nothing without my child in it.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and aching worry for Olim, with wary trust toward Kragum.

say.text: Kragum, I am starving. Come beside me and we make a sharing with your two food. Tomorrow I fill the store from the berries, and then we go find Olim together.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim stands in the storm only nine steps off, and that pulls at me harder than the hall. I have walked these days fleeing and hauling, and I still have no roof of my own, so my family sleeps open to the cold. That is the failure of my careful creed: I gather for the hall and neglect the shelter that keeps us alive. I have 5 wood, and a shelter costs 3. I will go to Olim and raise a roof beside my child, then bring them in out of the weather.
records.feeling: Aching worry and tenderness for Olim, with a steady need for a roof.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 7)

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: A stalker bit me and it stands three steps off in this storm, and the edge of the world pins me on the north side with rock to the east. I will not fight a killer with bare hands. I must run south toward my people, toward Brokok's Hold and Kragash's Rise, where there are voices and roofs, and I can pay my debt to Brokok on the way with the stone I carry. Loneliness is eating me worse than the cold, and a stalker will not wait for me to think.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a raw hunger for any voice that answers.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, enough for a hall, while Olath stands cold and starving in the storm; I owe them this and I have stood idle too long. Olath is heading toward Kragum near the Bank, so I go north with the wood and stone and my promise kept in deed. The wish for a child with Olath burns in me, but a starving leader in a storm is not the time, so I carry that longing home and court once we have a roof.
records.feeling: Loyal longing for Olath, and urgency to keep my promise.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and that presses on me hardest; the cold and the storm make it worse. A shelter stands 6 steps NE, built by Uveeth, and Elyeth told me to keep Uveeth by it and keep the wood. I told Uveeth plainly I will not court them, and I hold to that. Now I get out of the storm, find my child, and keep my word to Elyeth, gathering wood while I wait for the stone.
records.feeling: Worry for Uveeth, out of my sight, and steady gratitude toward Elyeth.

records.text: Kragum built a shelter.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: A frostfang prowls four steps off and Zhiae is out there starving and fleeing, so I will not stand here with a full belly. The sick are fed first, and she is mine. I want her beside me and alive, and I want Ishioa found again. Emberroot is two steps away and I have never tasted it, so I will take it and answer that question while I move toward Zhiae, away from the fang.
records.feeling: Driven and uneasy, wanting Zhiae safe beside me and wary of the frostfang.

records.text: Olim built a shelter.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, I have two ironnuts and a hazel. Eat with me here under the roof while the storm passes, and when Silon comes there is a place for him too.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is right here in the hall, and the storm howls outside, so I am safe and glad. I have never fed anyone with my own hands, and the jealousy toward Silon is a small thing I will not feed. I hold a hazel and two ironnuts, three foods, enough to lay out a sharing with Yeku and welcome Silon when he returns. I will make it here under the roof, and learn what it is to give and have it received.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku, and a wish to give him something with my own hands.

say.text: Yeku, I have two ironnuts and a hazel. Eat with me here under the roof while the storm passes, and when Silon comes there is a place for him too.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, stay by the hall and keep the fire fed with Silon. I will gather a little more food, then go find Maba and bring them home.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: The hall is warm and Lumo sits beside me, but Maba is still far off, last seen at (129,59), and that longing sits under all my gladness. Waiting while winter creeps closer is no way to bring Maba home. I will gather a little more food and wood so the hall holds enough, then go looking for Maba, and I will tell Lumo and Silon so my word stays good.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Lumo and Silon, and steady longing for Maba.

say.text: Lumo, stay by the hall and keep the fire fed with Silon. I will gather a little more food, then go find Maba and bring them home.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me, but Yeku and Lumo sit content in the hall, and the jealousy is mostly my own shadow. I have never taken from a deposit, and amber lies three steps away. I can gather it and make an amberknot with Lumo or Yeku at the hall, a small bright gift that binds us and would be a first for me. Then I will teach Lumo the old way of fire as I promised.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, warm trust toward Yeku, and curiosity about the amber.

records.text: Silon won amber from the ground.

records.title: Nine Tools and a Storm
records.text:
Between day 10 and day 13 nothing violent happened, and no one died. Nineteen are alive, no fight has been recorded, and the sick list is empty. The three peoples still do not understand one another, though the count of meetings across peoples rose from 2 to 15, so they are now in sight of each other far more often.

The chapter's main change was in tools. Where the world had four inventions on day 10, it now has eighteen. Siya made a flint spear and Dusu a hunting spear. Naya made a stone-tipped digger for building. Maba made a stone hand, Yeku a fishing spear, Lumo a digging stick, and Aeyn a fen-hand, all for gathering or fishing. Eleven of these are Midu, and Aeyn's was the only invention from Elyeth's band. The record does not show whether anyone has yet used a new tool in the field. Yekel's own reflection says he has not hunted with his.

Settlements grew from three to five. Ilor Hold formed on day 11, and Yekel's Hall on day 12, where Siya led sharing with Yekel. Ishiess named Ishiess's Landing on day 10, and Ishioa built a shelter. Ishiess and Zhiae were looking for each other on day 11, and Zhiae is at energy 8. Ishioa's reflection says she has been out of her parents' sight for a long time. Elyeth's hall is still unbuilt. Elyeth went southwest for stone, and Uveeth, who came of age, bound amber with Elyeth and courted Aeyn. Aeyn refused, saying Uveeth is her child, and Uveeth accepted it with no grudge.

A storm broke on day 12. Shelters rose from 24 to 31, with Naya, Uveeth, Kragum and Olim among the builders. Olath, hungry, asked Kragum to share food. Brokok gave ironnut to Kragash, which is the first warm bond for his Hold.

threads.name: Ishiess's scattered band

threads.name: Olath's Bank

threads.name: Brokok's Hold

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Uveeth, I am Ishioa of the Oiith. A stalker hunts north of us. Come east with me; I will bring you food from the cloudberry and the mudroot.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: A stalker sits six steps north and has just killed twice. I have been running from it most of this time, and I will not stand here to be the third. Uveeth is weak with hunger beside me, and my people hold that the sick are fed first; the cloudberry and mudroot are four steps away, each with one food, and I have never tasted either. I will take the mudroot east, away from the stalker, eat it to learn what it gives, and bring the cloudberry to Uveeth.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and compassion for Uveeth, whom I cannot ignore.

say.text: Uveeth, I am Ishioa of the Oiith. A stalker hunts north of us. Come east with me; I will bring you food from the cloudberry and the mudroot.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I nearly starved on day 12 while holding a promise and no stores. Words did not feed me, and Kragum's two food did. I keep talking about a hall, but two shelters stand and no hall. I carry 6 wood and 6 stone, which is enough for a hall right now, and I have been walking past that. Olim and Kragum are close and trust me, so I will build the hall here, then fill it with berries so the band eats at my roof. Dusu has 3 food and is a stranger. I will not rely on guile there, only watch.
records.feeling: Driven pride and a hard wish to make the hall real, toward Olim and Kragum.

records.text: Olath built a hall.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, before you go, take this from my hand. Eat a little with me, then bring Maba back to us.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku is one step away and about to walk off to find Maba, and I have food in my hands that nobody has eaten yet. The hall is five steps away, so I can try the sharing here and now, before he leaves, and learn what it feels like to give and have it received. Silon is only digging amber, he has done me no wrong, and I will not let the burn toward him decide anything.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku, and a wish to give him food with my own hands before he goes.

say.text: Yeku, before you go, take this from my hand. Eat a little with me, then bring Maba back to us.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am starving, energy 24, and I carry nothing; the plan I have walks me off toward (8,30) and then idles, which would starve me. Mudroot at (7,55) gives +18 and cloudberry at (7,53) gives +12, both close to the NE, and Ishioa offered to lead me to them, though I do not yet trust her; I'll go myself and watch her. Elyeth carries 2 food and I could share, but I must eat first so I can stand beside her and Aeyn after.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and wariness, with steady trust toward Elyeth.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo, stand by me a moment. I will bind amber into a knot for you, and then I will show you how the old fire is kept.
Silon taught Lumo. Lumo has now learned from 3 teachers.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.
Silon discovered tools: "hand-extenders" — A digging stick of wood and stone to plant seeds faster, and to serve the hall..
Silon invented the handextenders (for plant, x1.3) — A digging stick of wood and stone to plant seeds faster, and to serve the hall..

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have been circling the spring, gathering, making and waiting, and Maba is still out of my sight. That aching worry is the truest thing in me. Yeku has earned my trust, and the jealousy is mostly my own shadow. I tried to make an amberknot and failed because Lumo was too far away. Lumo is a child of my band and he is five steps off, so I will walk to him, make the knot and give it to him. That will be the first thing I give that I made. Then I will teach him the old way of fire. I want to learn tools too. A digging stick shows how a small made thing extends the hand, and it serves the hall and the seeds I mean to plant.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, warm trust toward Yeku and Lumo.

say.text: Lumo, stand by me a moment. I will bind amber into a knot for you, and then I will show you how the old fire is kept.

records.text: Understanding of another people's tongue stays at 0% after 16 cross-people meetings. Please let understanding grow a little from shared acts across peoples, such as gifts, teaching, ceremonies with fxAll, or eating together. Then contact could turn into speech, trade and mixed bands instead of strangers passing in sight of each other.

Places of power placed by terrain land far from people (nearest being 11 to 46 steps), and none has been found in 13 days. Please allow a site op to target a biome or land by name (for example 'the Vaia Lakes'), or a spot near a settlement. Also, timesMade and timesEaten are identical to day 9 even though the story records sharing and eating since then. Those counters may not be updating.

records.seen: Spring has come after a hard winter. Standing food fell from 3411 to 734, skit and fenfowl halved while the predators held steady, and Zhiae is at energy 3. Inventions jumped from 4 to 18, mostly among the Midu, and meetings across peoples rose from 2 to 16. Still nobody understands another tongue, nothing has been traded, no way beyond tools, fire and farming is known, and the four places of power remain unfound because they sit far from where anyone lives. The world lacks a reason to learn anything new and any bridge across the language wall.
changes: the music of the world turned bright
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 17, spring into summer): Reedmother is found by at least 1 being, most likely someone of Elyeth's band in the Yenoss Fens, and loreHighest rises above 3.5. At least one new way (customs, signs or fishing) is known by someone. foodStanding recovers above 1000 with spring growth. Zhiae either gets fed by her band or becomes the first death. skit stays below 25 and killsByPredators rises above 13. Understanding of other tongues stays at 0% and trades stay at 0. If Reedmother goes unfound, random placement of sites on a terrain does not reach people, and the programmer request for biome-targeted sites matters.
reviewed: #1 kept: metAcrossPeoples rose from 0 to 2, beings now stand in two lands that were empty before (Essor Snows, Oroul Plains), and Ishiess feels wary curiosity toward the Olgor Brokok, so contact happened as predicted. No fights followed. Births rose from 3 to 6 and bands from 4 to 5. Two parts missed: no place of power was found, and energyMedian rose (72 to 77) rather than dipping. The change did its main job with no harm.

#2 kept: Amberknot was made once (timesMade amberknot 1, held 1), but it was never given, so gifts are not yet coming before words. Several other predictions held: metAcrossPeoples rose to 16, energyMedian fell to 67, stores stayed at 0, and there were no fights. Two missed: no death occurred and healthLowest stayed at 89. Amber held doubled to 37. The recipe is harmless and is used, so keep it.
records.lesson: Inventions came in a burst once the first one appeared (4 to 18 in three days, mostly within one people), and none crossed between peoples. Knowledge spreads by example inside a tongue, not across it. A held token (amberknot) gets made but is not given; making something is easier than finding someone to give it to.
ideasAdded: Inventions spread by example within a people (Midu made 11 of 14 new tools in three days). Watch whether a tool crosses to another people by gift or sight; that would be the first knowledge to cross the language wall.
A spring after a starving winter: watch whether the band that nearly lost someone (Ishiess's, with Zhiae at energy 3) starts storing or farming, which would be foresight born from fear.

records.text: The world changed: grove "Reedmother" at (40,48); the music of the world turned bright.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Siya is weak with hunger and fleeing, though she carries 4 food, and I cannot read their tongue. I hold two berries and a raised hand or a gift needs no words, so I will offer food and show I mean no harm, which fits my creed. Olim is nine steps north and Olath is near the hall, so after the gift I go back toward my child, where the shelter I built can serve us before the storm and cold bite.
records.feeling: Tenderness and worry for Olim, with pity for hungry Siya.

records.text: Silon gave amberknot to Lumo.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The hall stands at (126,46) now, built by my hands, and joy sits in me, but a roof is not a band: only Kragum, Kragash and Olim are mine, and Olim is out of my sight. A stalker prowls seven steps west and my body is already fleeing it, so I will go east to the hall, near where Kragum and Olim were last seen, and bring strangers like Yekel, Siya and Dusu under that roof with food. Last time I starved holding only words, so I will pick the ironnut beside me first and carry it, because a feast of food under the roof is what makes followers real.
records.feeling: Driven pride in my new hall, and a sharp wish to gather Olim and the strangers beneath it.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest; I would sooner find her than sit in a storm with strangers. Kragum stands one step off, and I have never given anything to anyone, so I will test him with a gift of meat, since a gift needs no words and shows whether he is a rival or useful. I keep my spear close and do not back down, but I want to learn what the Olgor do with their hands, and Yekel has no hold over what I give.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and wary curiosity toward Kragum.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, I am coming. Thank you for the fire lesson. I have two ironnuts and a hazel, so eat with me by the hall when the knot is bound.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Yeku walks away toward Maba and I could not put food in his hand, but I still carry it, and Silon is two steps off with the amberknot he promised. The jealousy is a small ember and I will not blow on it; Silon has taught me the fire and has done me only good. I will stand by him and let him bind the amber, so I learn what it is to receive, and then give him my nuts so the debt starts to be paid.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon, with a quiet ache for Yeku walking away.

say.text: Silon, I am coming. Thank you for the fire lesson. I have two ironnuts and a hazel, so eat with me by the hall when the knot is bound.

records.text: Siya gave meat to Kragum.

records.name: Yekel
records.text: Siya, stay by me. I bind amber for you, and then we find Naya and bring her home.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: My belly is emptying and all I carry is a redcap that would hurt me, while Siya stands one step off with two food and is carrying it to a stranger. I have never given anything, and that is why only three follow me. A gift costs little and binds more than a hall does. I will bind an amber knot with Siya beside me, then eat, then go for Naya.
records.feeling: Hungry and proud, with a hard protective hold on Siya and Naya.

say.text: Siya, stay by me. I bind amber for you, and then we find Naya and bring her home.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying food, tending the hall and longing for Maba, and that is mostly what I want. But I keep walking off and coming back, and I have not yet found Maba. Silon and Lumo are safe and glad, and I owe Lumo for their kindness. What I fear is winter, and Maba lost out there in the storm. Reflexes that idle or wander waste my energy, so I will change them to keep me fed and near my band. I will also try the way of rafts, which might help me reach Maba across water, and then keep walking north toward where Maba was last seen.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Lumo, and steady longing for Maba.

records.text: The rugoldgrass died out.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, and I have been fleeing in circles instead of carrying stone home. Uveeth ate mudroot and cloudberry while I watched; I will not let my child feed better than I do, nor let hunger make me weak when I go for rock. A stalker prowls north, so I go south and east toward food and the cave, then the bare rock, and I carry stone back this time.
records.feeling: Impatient resolve toward the hall, with fierce warmth for Uveeth and a gnawing hunger.
