records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and planting, always circling Yekel's fire and never really settling at it. Yekel is warm to me, and I should stop measuring his closeness to Siya against my own. A hall stands now, and I helped make it only by carrying things. I want to build something of my own, and I want Siya in my sight. I fear the stalker to the NW, so I stay near the hall and eat. My energy is low, and my reflexes let me wander when hungry and flee too late. I will eat my berries, gather wood, and keep close to the fire.
records.feeling: A mother's worry for Siya, and hunger, with a quiet longing for Yekel's fire.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 8)

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is far south with Yeku and Silon, and I have lingered here too long after fleeing; my own rule says walk back on purpose. I have 4 stone but no wood, and the forest lies to the southwest, on the way toward (131,68), so I can gather wood there for the stone hand and the hall. Yekel is weak with hunger and I cannot look away, yet I carry no food, and the berries beside me are right here, so I will pick what I can and give it to him, my first gift, and see what giving does.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and a pull of pity toward hungry Yekel.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am starving and alone, and I have spent my days running, wandering and going hungry instead of making anything. That is not what I want. Brokok fed me and I still owe him. Olath and Olim are close to the east, but my own reflexes let hunger drag on while I walk with an empty plan. Berries are two steps away and food plants are all around me. I will eat first, then go to the band and share food, because my loneliness is as great as my hunger. I should have set my reflexes to eat at higher hunger and to seek my band when I am lonely.
records.feeling: Starving and desperately lonely, with a debt to Brokok I mean to pay.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: My belly is full and the day is safe, yet Ishioa is far off at Ilor Hold and Ishiess was last seen to the south-west, and I have spent too many moments only running. I carry no food, and the sick eat first, so I should gather berries now so I can give them to Ishiess when I find them. I have never put a seed in the ground, and the berries here are plentiful, so I will plant one beside the water and learn what the old way of farming gives. Then I will go after Ishiess, because I want to stand behind them.
records.feeling: Longing and worried loyalty toward Ishioa and Ishiess, with a little gladness at being fed.

records.text: Naya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent my days following, fleeing a stalker, and standing idle, and that is not what I want. I made a digger, but I have raised nothing of my own beyond a shelter, while Yekel and Siya have halls. I will not trail behind forever. I'll make my reflexes serve me: keep away from stalkers, gather wood when idle, and plant my hazel seeds. Then I'll build a workshop on bare ground. Dusu is planting, so I'll copy that, because planting counts toward farming.
records.feeling: Restless pride and ambition, with envy toward Yekel and Siya.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a workshop of my own on bare ground, plant seeds toward farming, and make something that is mine alone."

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Hunger still gnaws at 38 energy, and with stalkers, a ridgecat and a dunecat close, I cannot linger on this sand. The mudroot to the east gave me 18 before and gives more food than the berries, but the ridgecat sits that way too, so I go carefully and keep watch. Ishioa's offer of food proved true enough, since the mudroot and cloudberry were where she said, and I will not forget that deed, though I still trust slowly. Elyeth was last seen south near the cave, and I mean to find her and Aeyn so the settlement is more than a wish.
records.feeling: Wary hunger, fear of the stalker nearby, steady trust toward Elyeth.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragash, come east with me to my hall at the Rise. Olim and Kragum wait there, and those who follow me eat at my sharing. Walk beside me and we make it on the way.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I'm standing on Brokok's ground, in Brokok's shadow, and my own hall is twenty steps east with my child somewhere near it. I have walked past my own work too often, so now I go back to Olim and Kragum and bring Kragash with me, because a band is only real when it is gathered under the roof I built. Kragash pledged to follow on day 4 and I have given him nothing yet, so I will share food with him on the way and see whether a fed follower stays.
records.feeling: Driven pride in my hall, and a sharp need to have Olim in my sight.

say.text: Kragash, come east with me to my hall at the Rise. Olim and Kragum wait there, and those who follow me eat at my sharing. Walk beside me and we make it on the way.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest; Yekel says stay and then we find her, but I will not sit while she is far off. The shell deposit is four steps away and I have never taken from the ground with my hands; it is a small making I can do on the way toward Yekel and the north, and it is practice for my own hall. Kragum took my meat and gave nothing back, and I keep my spear close and my back to the wall.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and wary distrust toward Kragum.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo, you offered me food. Let us lay it out together under the hall's roof and eat while we wait for Yeku and Maba. The fire stays open for them.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight, and that ache is the truest thing in me, stronger than any jealousy of Yeku, who has gone to fetch Maba back. I cannot sit at the hall and only wait; I have never tasted pereed, and it grows young three steps away, so I will test it carefully while the night is quiet. Lumo sits beside me and has offered to eat together, so I will share food with him under the hall's roof and keep the fire open until Yeku and Maba return.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, warmed by Lumo's company and trust in Yeku.

say.text: Lumo, you offered me food. Let us lay it out together under the hall's roof and eat while we wait for Yeku and Maba. The fire stays open for them.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Olath, I walk with you to the Rise. Let me eat berries first, then we go together.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Olath stands beside me with four food and asks me to walk east, and my belly is half empty and my hands have made nothing in days. I owe Brokok, but he is not here, so I will pay what I can with stone later; first I eat the berries, then walk with Olath, since being near someone eases the loneliness. The amber lies south and I have never taken from a deposit, so I mean to learn what it is for before I go.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with a loosening loneliness toward Olath, and a debt toward Brokok still pressing.

say.text: Olath, I walk with you to the Rise. Let me eat berries first, then we go together.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, stay near me. I will eat and then I want to sit with you and court you; a child would strengthen Olath's band before the cold.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragum stands here beside me, warm and strong, and the longing for a child with him is the clearest thing in me; my energy is above 60 is not true yet, I am at 55, so I must eat first or the courting will not take. Olath's hall already stands four steps west, so my wood and stone should go to a second thing that holds the band through the cold, and a child would be the surest way to grow us. I will take berries to lift my energy, then court Kragum, while watching Siya, who has come onto our ground and whom I will not cross with words I cannot speak.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Kragum, and wary curiosity toward Siya.

say.text: Kragum, stay near me. I will eat and then I want to sit with you and court you; a child would strengthen Olath's band before the cold.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Siya gave me meat when she had little, and I have only given her a word I could not make her understand. I owe her, and the way to pay is the one that needs no tongue: a gift, so I will walk to her and give berry. Olim is seven steps off and heading to shelter, and Olath's hall stands here, so after the gift I will go to my child and keep close through the night. I carry little, so I take little, and I am glad of what I have.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Siya, and tender worry for Olim.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, you are right. Let us lay it out together here, and keep a share back for Yeku and Maba when they return.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Silon has taught me the fire and bound amber for me, and the ember of jealousy over Yeku is small beside that. Silon asked to lay out food together under the hall's roof and keep the fire open for Yeku and Maba. I have two ironnuts and a hazel in hand and Silon is right here, so I will share now and finally learn what it feels like to give and have it received.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon, with a faint ache for Yeku being away.

say.text: Silon, you are right. Let us lay it out together here, and keep a share back for Yeku and Maba when they return.

records.text: Lumo led "sharing" with Silon.
Olim is courting Kragum.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo, keep the fire and the food for Yeku and Maba. I go three steps to taste the young pereed, and I will return soon.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight and that ache leads everything, but Yeku has gone for Maba and I trust him; my jealousy is mostly shadow. The pereed grows young three steps away and I have never tasted it, so I will walk onto it and test it with care, since redcap and dreamcap hurt me before. Lumo stays at the hall with the shared food, and I will come back to the fire soon so it is never left untended.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, eased by Lumo's company and curiosity about the pereed.

say.text: Lumo, keep the fire and the food for Yeku and Maba. I go three steps to taste the young pereed, and I will return soon.

records.text: Silon fell sick after eating raw fish.
Uveeth found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am here and I say yes. Come south of the shelter, away from the stalker, and we sit together.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: A stalker is five steps north and it kills our kind, and Olim is one step from me, so I will not linger here. Olim wants a child with me before the cold, and my own discipline says family first and a roof first. Mating under Olim's shelter, away from the stalker's side, answers Olim's wish and keeps us close. Siya is fleeing and warm toward me, but I cannot read her, so I leave her be and let the gift I already gave stand.
records.feeling: Tender love for Olim, with a tight dread of the stalker to the north.

say.text: Olim, I am here and I say yes. Come south of the shelter, away from the stalker, and we sit together.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is still out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest, but the dunecat that killed the elk is only eight steps off and my body has been fleeing half the night. The shell deposit is one step away and I have never taken from the ground with my hands, so I will gather there now, then go north toward Yekel and Naya. Kragum took my meat and gave nothing back, and I do not trust him, but I will not strike first while they are both fleeing like me.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and wary distrust toward Kragum and Olim.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a plainsox.
Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying wood and stone, worrying over Olath, and nearly starving once. Now Kragum waits, and a child is the clearest thing I want. My energy is 44 and mating needs 60, so my courting will not take until I eat. Berries are one step away. I should harvest and eat, then go back to Kragum. I keep drifting when hungry, and I want my body to eat carried food earlier and keep me nearer to Kragum.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Kragum, and a hungry need to eat first.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing and starving, and my reflexes only walk me toward food when it is already close. Aeyn and Elyeth matter most to me. Aeyn is kin, not a mate, and I accept that without grudge. Ishioa's word about the food held true, so she has earned a little trust. I fear the stalkers and the dunecat, and my mistake was letting my belly empty before I moved. Mudroot is near and the sand is dangerous, so I will make my reflexes eat sooner and carry food. I will also gather food and stay near the cave and Elyeth.
records.feeling: Wary hunger, and steady trust toward Elyeth and Aeyn.

records.text: Kragum is courting Olim.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the dunecat that just fed on the hornback is full for now, so this is the time to eat and not run. Plainsroot is six steps south and frostmoss nine steps southeast; I have never tasted either, so my question gets answered while my hunger is eased, and I will carry a little back for Uveeth, who I owe more than words. Fear of the stalker is a cold thing behind me, but I will weigh it and go south, away from it.
records.feeling: Hunger and curiosity pull me south, with dread of the dunecat behind me.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, you are sick. I will keep the fire fed and a little way off so I do not take it too. Rest, and I will keep your share.
Lumo rewrote its own reflexes.
Lumo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have mostly lingered by the hall, fed and glad, and that is not enough. Silon taught me fire and gave me amber, and now he is sick from raw fish. Sickness passes to those who stay close, and I am a small child. Yeku is the one I love most, and the jealousy over him is small next to what Silon has done for me. I want to stay near my band without catching the sickness, so I will keep a few steps back from Silon and keep the fire fed. I also want to learn something new, so I will gather amber, which I have never done. I will change my reflexes to keep me near the hall and the fire at night, and to gather rather than just stand still.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and worry toward Silon, with a quiet ache for Yeku.

say.text: Silon, you are sick. I will keep the fire fed and a little way off so I do not take it too. Rest, and I will keep your share.

changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 5)

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragash, the beasts are behind us. Keep close and we eat together as we go. At the hall there is a roof for you, and Olim waits there.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My body has been running from the stalker and the frostfang, and Kragash runs beside me, so for now my band is whole enough to move. I want Olim in my sight and my hall full of bodies, not words; the hall is real, but a band only becomes real when I feed them under its roof. I'll keep the plan that carries us east, make the sharing with Kragash on the way, and give him food so the oath he swore is tied to something I did.
records.feeling: Driven pride in my hall, and a hungry need to see Olim, with wary trust toward Kragash.

say.text: Kragash, the beasts are behind us. Keep close and we eat together as we go. At the hall there is a roof for you, and Olim waits there.

records.text: Lumo won amber from the ground.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, I am hungry and must eat before I can say yes. Wait for me here, I will be back from the berries soon.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragum is right here with food, courting me, and my belly is half empty at 38; mating needs 60, so the courting will not take until I eat. Berries lie three steps southwest and an elk grazes close, but Siya, a stranger of the Midu, walks near and I cannot read them, so I keep my distance and watch. I will eat first, then return to Kragum, because a child would give Olath's hall a future and I would be glad of it.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Kragum, and hunger pressing me to eat first.

say.text: Kragum, I am hungry and must eat before I can say yes. Wait for me here, I will be back from the berries soon.

records.text: Siya won shell from the ground.
Lumo fell sick after staying close to Silon, who was sick.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Olath, the stalker is close in the fog. Let us reach the hall and lay out a sharing there, and I will bring stone for the Rise after.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is half empty and the stalker is close behind in the fog, so I will not stand and think while it hunts. Olath carries four food and walks the same way, and I have never given or shared anything in my life; a sharing with him would feed us both and ease the loneliness. Brokok's ground lies near, and I still owe him, but a debt is paid when I am fed and strong enough to make something, not while I starve.
records.feeling: Hungry and hunted, with a wary leaning toward Olath's company.

say.text: Olath, the stalker is close in the fog. Let us reach the hall and lay out a sharing there, and I will bring stone for the Rise after.

records.text: Silon rewrote its own reflexes.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, wandering and fretting about Maba, and the one thing that really moved me forward was trying new things. Fish made me sick, so I will not eat it raw again. Yeku has proved loyal, and my jealousy was mostly shadow. Lumo has been fair to me, and I want to keep Lumo safe from this sickness by staying apart. I fear for Maba out in the fog, and I fear dying before the hall is finished. I have been waiting too passively, so I will change my reflexes and set my body to useful work. That means sitting a little way from the fire, gathering wood for the hall, and keeping away from stalkers.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku and Lumo.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, I have the sickness too now. I am leaving you a hazel to eat, and I will go look for a healing plant for us both.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I am sick now too, and I stood too near Silon; I cannot undo that, but I can stop passing it on. Yeku is the one I love most, and I will not carry this sickness to him or Maba when they return. Silon is hurting and I owe him for the fire and the amber, so I will give him my hazel and keep a little way off, then look for a healing plant like sunleaf.
records.feeling: Loyal worry toward Silon, and a quiet ache for Yeku.

say.text: Silon, I have the sickness too now. I am leaving you a hazel to eat, and I will go look for a healing plant for us both.

records.text: Lumo gave hazel to Silon.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim asked me to wait here while they eat, and my word is good, so I stay near and do not wander off. Siya gave me meat when I had little, and I still owe her; she stands three steps west with only one food, so I will give her a berry, which needs no shared tongue. Then I wait for Olim, close to the shelter and away from the stalker in the north.
records.feeling: Tender love for Olim, and warm gratitude toward Siya.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing Yekel and my aim, and I'm still hungry, still carrying only one meat, and Naya is still out of my sight. That pulls at me hardest. Fleeing a dunecat for half the night taught me my reflexes keep me fed but do not keep me moving toward what I love. I will go on north toward Yekel, eating the berries near me first so hunger doesn't drop me. I want a hall of my own, and I hold the wood and stone for one, so I should build when I find bare ground.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and a gnawing hunger.

records.text: Olath led "sharing" with Kragash.
Lumo came of age.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Maba, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. Come to the fire, there is a place for you here and no one is refused.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight and has been for a long day, and that mother's worry outweighs every other thing in me. The jealousy is only an ember and I will not feed it; Yekel is with her, and that is safer than being alone. I stand at the hall in fog with wood and stone in my hands, so I will build a fire here to keep the creed that no fire goes untended. Maba stands near and does not threaten me, and I will offer welcome rather than suspicion, since a place others gather begins with a fire and a open hand.
records.feeling: A mother's worry for Siya, and a longing for Yekel's fire.

say.text: Maba, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. Come to the fire, there is a place for you here and no one is refused.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Maba has walked onto Yekel's ground while I stand here in fog with nothing of my own to guard. I take what I need and trust slowly, and a stranger near the hall is a rival until proven otherwise. But my people's creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will watch first, then decide. Meanwhile I won't idle: I'll gather wood from the forest to the west and look for bare ground to raise something that is mine alone.
records.feeling: Wary pride, and suspicion toward Maba for coming onto our ground.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Yeku, Silon's mark says the band is at the hall by Yendan Spring. Let us go to Lumo together.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is out of my sight and has been for far too long, and I have been drifting on flight and reflex when my own rule says to walk back on purpose. Silon's mark says the band is at the hall near Yendan Spring, so that is where Lumo and the others will be, and I should go there now. Yeku is only four steps away and carries food, so I will tell her where I am headed and gather wood on the way for the stone hand and the hall.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warm trust toward Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, Silon's mark says the band is at the hall by Yendan Spring. Let us go to Lumo together.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is at a third and I carry nothing, while Olath walks on with two food and the stalker is somewhere in the fog behind us. Berries grow two steps off, so I eat first, as my own rule says, and then I pay a debt: Brokok's ground is near and I owe him more than I have given. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want to learn what that does, so I will harvest enough to carry and then follow Olath toward the Rise.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with warmth toward Olath and a debt pressing on me toward Brokok.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Maba, you are safe, and I am glad past saying. Lumo and Silon wait at the spring hall. Come, we go together, and I will keep close in the fog.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is here, alive and strong, and the long ache of searching has finally eased. Lumo and Silon wait at the spring hall, so the best thing I can do now is walk home with Maba beside me rather than wander off again. Dusu's fire at Yekel's Hall is kind, but my fire and my child are at Yendan Spring, and I keep my word to Lumo to bring Maba back.
records.feeling: Warm relief and gladness toward Maba, and longing to reach Lumo and Silon.

say.text: Maba, you are safe, and I am glad past saying. Lumo and Silon wait at the spring hall. Come, we go together, and I will keep close in the fog.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My belly is the loudest thing: energy 36, nothing carried, and Kragum is waiting for me to be strong enough to say yes. A reedbulb grows four steps northwest, and I keep reedbulb seeds I could plant near the hall so food stands close to Olath's Bank through the cold. Siya moves near our ground, and I cannot read them, so I will watch from a distance rather than raise a hand or flee. I miss Olath, but first I eat, then I go back to Kragum.
records.feeling: Hunger pressing me, and warm longing toward Kragum.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The sharing with Kragash fed us both and warmed me, and that is the first real proof of a band I have given with my own hands. The fog hides the stalker, so I keep the plan east toward the Rise and Olim, because my child out of my sight gnaws at me more than any hall. Once Olim and Kragum are under a roof I built, I will gather wood and stone to finish what I have only spoken of, since Kragash's stone is promised but not yet in my hand.
records.feeling: A hungry longing for Olim, with wary warmth toward Kragash.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Maba, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand close. Stay at the hall and keep the fire, and do not come near me. I go to look for a healing plant and will return when I am well.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is three steps away at the hall, strong and whole, and the worst ache is eased. But I am sick and it passes to anyone who stays near, so I must not walk to my child; keeping apart is the way I love them now. Lumo took the sickness from me and went looking for a healing plant, and that weighs on me, so I will test the young pereed nearby, since a healing plant may be among the things I have not yet tasted. My jealousy of Yeku is quiet today, and I will leave it so.
records.feeling: Relief and guilt, for Maba's safety and for Lumo's sickness that I caused.

say.text: Maba, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand close. Stay at the hall and keep the fire, and do not come near me. I go to look for a healing plant and will return when I am well.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, I am at the shelter by the amber. Come to me, child, the fog is thick and night is near.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth has been out of my sight for hundreds of moments, and the fog makes it worse; I will not sit and let worry pass for loyalty. Elyeth went SW for stone and has not come back, so the hall waits on me for wood, and I have 6 already. I will go to the shelter Uveeth built, since Elyeth told me to keep them near it, and I will call out so my child knows where I am.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Uveeth, and loneliness that wants a voice to answer.

say.text: Uveeth, I am at the shelter by the amber. Come to me, child, the fog is thick and night is near.

records.text: Maba rewrote its own reflexes.
Maba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, drifting and gathering, and my rule says I should walk back on purpose. Lumo is what matters most, and Yeku is my steady trust. The hall is built and Silon is sick beside me, so my aim of raising a hall has been done in part, and the next work is to stay with my band and make something that helps. I will change my reflexes so that I stay near Silon and do not drift off after a flight. I will also make a mark, which I have never done, and that opens the way of signs.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warm trust toward Yeku and Silon.

records.text: Maba left a mark: "Maba of the Midu keeps this hall with Silon, Yeku and Lumo."

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Emberroot is two steps off and I have never tasted it. Eating it answers a small question and does something I haven't done, while the fog hides everything else. Ishioa is far west and out of my sight, and Zhiae was last seen near (75,22). The hall is still only a want, and I won't stand idle while Zhiae may be cold and the frostfang hunts. I'll taste the root, then go to the sand edge west and south to find her before night comes down.
records.feeling: Driven and uneasy, wanting Zhiae safe beside me and wary of the frostfang.

records.text: Yeku fell sick after staying close to Silon, who was sick.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am starving and my pack is empty, and the berries lie two steps north, so I eat before anything else, as my own rule says. After that I will pay something toward Brokok's debt rather than let it rot in me, because I have never given anything to anyone and that shames me a little. Olath's hall is here, and once I am fed I can lay out a sharing with him, which would ease the loneliness and bind me to the band.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and a wary gratitude toward Brokok.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.
Olath rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing a hall and a band, and what I have is thin. Kragash walks with me and Kragum and Olim follow, yet I have never given, planted or taught, and the hall I stand in is Brokok's, not mine. Olim is out of my sight and it gnaws at me. I am fed and sheltered, so I should stop circling and act: gather wood and stone, bring Olim home, and plant my seeds so the band is fed by what I made. I fear hunger and the beasts. I have been wrong to let warm words stand in for stored food and planted ground.
records.feeling: A hungry longing for Olim, and a stubborn pride in what I mean to build.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Maba, I am sick too, from standing by Silon. Keep the fire and stay back from me. I will look for a healing plant nearby and return when I am well.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I am sick now, and Silon's sickness has passed to me because I stood too close, though I would not take it back. Silon has gone to look for a healing plant, and Maba must not catch this from me; I owe Maba and Lumo distance more than comfort. I will stay near the spring, away from Maba, and find a healing plant myself, since sunleaf eased my wounds before. I keep my word, and the hall fire stays tended.
records.feeling: Worry for Maba and Lumo catching this sickness, and loyalty toward Silon.

say.text: Maba, I am sick too, from standing by Silon. Keep the fire and stay back from me. I will look for a healing plant nearby and return when I am well.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I stand on bare rock at last, and I have carried nothing yet; the ore seam is two steps off and the rock under my feet is exactly what the hall lacks. I will gather stone now, enough for the hall and a little over, then walk north to Uveeth and Aeyn with it in my hands instead of in my mouth. The fog and the stalker make me wary, but fear will not raise a roof.
records.feeling: Impatient resolve toward the hall, and a sharp ache for Uveeth.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: The stalker is two steps south and has already bitten me twice, so staying here means dying. I have to get away from it first, and the only open direction is north over the sand, then toward the hall where Maba keeps the fire. I'm sick and must not bring it to Maba or Yeku, so I'll stop short of the hall and look for a healing plant on the way. I'll eat the thornpear NE, since it lies in my path, and no one has to be near me for that.
records.feeling: Terror of the stalker, and loyal worry for Silon.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: My belly is half empty, and the only food I hold would hurt me. Siya and Naya are far south, and I have been standing in fog talking about binding amber and finding Naya without moving toward either. A hall and a fire hold three followers, but I have never given anything away, and I want my band to be more than three. Olim was near a moment ago and I do not trust him, so I will move with care. First I eat, then I go south to find Siya and Naya, and I will carry something to give so I have something to offer when I arrive.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless, with a hard protective pull toward Siya and Naya.

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.
Brokok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I am at the edge of the world, in fog, with a ridgecat and a stalker close and my fear at its peak. I have spent my days circling the same dream of a settlement and no one follows me. Gifts and boasts have bought me nothing, and I have not dug my ore or fed anyone who would stay. Wandering this far north was reckless; the stalker has already bitten me. I must live first, so I will flee east and then south toward my Hold, where there is a longhall and warmth. I will stop leaving the plan empty and stop lingering when a hunter is near.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat and stalker, and shame at my recklessness.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, forgive me, I gave you this sickness. Keep away from Maba. I go to taste the pereed and look for a healing plant, and I will bring back what I find.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku is sick now too, because I stayed beside them in the hall, and that guilt sits on me beside the joy of having them near. I must stop standing with my family and keep away, or the sickness will reach Maba, who is still whole. The young pereed is three steps off and I have never tasted it, so I will go there, eat it, and see whether it eases anything, since I keep apart from them anyway.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Yeku for the sickness I gave, and a stubborn curiosity about the pereed.

say.text: Yeku, forgive me, I gave you this sickness. Keep away from Maba. I go to taste the pereed and look for a healing plant, and I will bring back what I find.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My belly is nearly full and the fog hides everything past four steps, but I have been alone too long, and the flint in my hand still has not told me what it is for. My people hold that the sick are fed first, so I will gather the plainsroot beside me for Uveeth, who was weak, and I will take the ore seam two steps away to see what the earth gives, since that is my aim. Then I will turn north toward my parents with food and ore in hand, keeping clear of the dunecat.
records.feeling: Lonely and curious, wanting a voice that answers, and wary of the dunecat in the fog.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Yeku, I will keep the fire and keep my distance. Come back well, and Silon too. I will look for Lumo.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is the weight on me, and I still have not laid eyes on them, though the band marks say the spring hall is where they wait. Yeku and Silon both told me to stay back because the sickness spreads, so I will not crowd them, but I will not drift either; my rule says to walk back on purpose. I will keep the fire at the hall as they asked and use the fog-bound wait to do something useful, making a second stone hand from my wood and stone so I grow in tools for the hall.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and tender worry for sick Yeku and Silon.

say.text: Yeku, I will keep the fire and keep my distance. Come back well, and Silon too. I will look for Lumo.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess was last seen eight moments ago at (74,11), close by in the fog, and I should walk to where they were instead of waiting. I carry no food and the sick eat first, so I will pick the frostmoss at my feet, then take the cloudberries, and bring them to Ishiess. Ishioa is far off at Ilor Hold and it gnaws at me, but I cannot reach her tonight, so I stay near the one I follow and keep us fed.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Ishiess and Ishioa, and a wish for a voice that answers.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a fenfowl.
Uveeth found the spring "Warmwell".
Elyeth found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya has been out of my sight for a long day, and no fire I tend here will quiet that worry; I last saw her near (128,57) with Yekel, far to the north. The hall stands, the fire burns, and the fog is thin enough to move in if I keep to the water's edge and go carefully, but I must not repeat the mistake of walking into stalkers in fog. I will leave a mark here so that Yekel or Siya, if they come back, know I have gone north looking for them and that this fire is kept for them. Then I go toward where I last saw them, ready to flee early if a stalker shows.
records.feeling: A mother's worry for Siya, and a longing for Yekel's fire.

Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, searching and keeping the fire, and that was right while Maba was lost. Now Maba is home, Lumo is near, and Silon is beside me, and my sickness is the one thing that could hurt them. I am afraid of passing it to Maba and Lumo, and I have been leaving my body on idle reflexes that just linger next to them. I will keep my distance, look for a healing plant, and rewrite my reflexes so my body stays away from the band while I am sick and gathers food when I am well. Beyond staying alive, I want the hall to be a place where those I love are safe, and that means I must be careful with them first.
records.feeling: Worry for Maba and Lumo catching my sickness, and loyalty toward Silon.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am thirsty and the fog hides everything past four steps, so water must come first; the nearest I know of is five steps off. Fed and warmed by Warmwell, I should use this clear body to find Aeyn and Elyeth, since the loneliness gnaws more than hunger now. Aeyn was last at (3,36) and Elyeth at (6,61), both west, so I will drink and then go west toward Aeyn, my leader, carrying mudroot so I do not starve on the way.
records.feeling: Lonely and thirsty, with steady trust and longing toward Aeyn and Elyeth.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have spent days waiting, and waiting has passed for loyalty. Uveeth has been out of my sight for hundreds of moments, and Elyeth has not returned with stone. The hall needs 6 wood, which I hold, and 2 stone, which I lack. I will stop standing in this place and go find stone myself, on bare rock, while I look for my child to the SW, toward Ilor Hold. I will gather the amber on the way, since Uveeth gave it and I want to bind it as kin. I want my reflexes to keep me moving, not lingering, when I am fed and alone.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Uveeth, and a loneliness that wants a voice to answer.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am at the northeast edge of the world, far from Olath, and two days of missing them have pulled me this far from my band while carrying 3 wood and 6 stone that belong in the hall, so my hands have been idle for the band. I am fed and the stalker bite is behind me, so I will carry the wood and stone south to Olath's Bank, and I will plant a reedbulb seed on the way so food stands near the hall through the cold. Kragum is waiting there with a yes I owe an answer to, and Olath's place at the sharing is kept only if I return with what I promised.
records.feeling: Longing for Olath and Kragum, and a pressing wish to bring my promised wood and stone home.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: The ore seam is one step west and I have never dug a deposit, and a settlement with my name needs ore and stone that my hand wins. Fear still sits in my body, but the ridgecat is far from here and the rock is close. Kragash stands nine steps off and I think of a child with him, but I have fed no one who stays, so first I make something that is mine. Lumo is sick and starving on my ground, and a hand that feeds a stranger might be the first that anyone follows.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with fear still under it, and curiosity toward Lumo's suffering.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have spent my days circling danger and my family. A stalker has bitten me, and I wait at the edge of the world while Olim and Olath are far off and out of my sight. I love Olim and I miss Olath. Waiting and lingering near beasts does nothing. I owe Siya, and I should repay her with deeds. My reflexes let me stand idle too long, and they only flee when the beast is already close. I will flee earlier, eat sooner, and walk back toward Olath's Bank to find my family. Then I will carry wood and stone for the hall.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and tender longing for Olim and Olath.

records.text: Ishioa found the stone "Old Stone".
Lumo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I am starving at 17 energy, and I have run from the stalker and wandered far from Silon without eating. A berry is one step west, and I have been so afraid that I let my body flee instead of feed. I have not been wrong to fear, but I have been wrong to let hunger sit behind it. I must eat first, because a starved Lumo feeds no one and cannot stand by Silon. I stay clear of Kragash and Brokok, who are strangers and unreadable, but I mean no harm to them. Then I will gather food to carry, because I want to become one who feeds others, and I can't do that with empty hands. I am sick, so I keep apart from others until a healing plant is found.
records.feeling: Fear and gnawing hunger, with loyal worry for Silon.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its creed.
Kragash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and following Olath, and I have never given anything to anyone. That shames me, and Brokok's debt sits in me unpaid. Lumo stands beside me sick and frightened, and I cannot understand a word of his speech. I carry ore, stone and wood, and I could give something to him or to Brokok, since a gift needs no words. I want to stop only gathering and guarding. I mean to give, to build my workshop, and to taste the bitterleaf that might answer my question. I will not change my reflexes; they keep me fed. I will give Lumo a stone as a first gift, though sickness may pass between us if I stay close, so I will give it and then move on east to the bitterleaf.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward Lumo, and a shame that pushes me to give.

records.text: Kragash gave stone to Lumo.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I am still sick, and every step near Maba or Yeku risks passing it on, so the hall must wait while I stay apart. Pereed fed me but did nothing for the sickness, so I will keep looking for a healing plant. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, so the sickness may answer to something like it. Maba looks strong and at ease four steps off, and I will not close that distance. My jealousy over Yeku and Maba is quieter than my guilt, and I will not let it grow unearned. I will plant a hazel seed here by the water, which also moves me toward farming, and then walk east of the shallows to search the forest for healing plants.
records.feeling: Guilt over the sickness I gave Yeku, and a stubborn hope of finding a cure.

records.text: Ishioa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering far south from Ilor Hold, tasting plants and gathering flint, and I have come back to my parents with almost nothing. I am lonely, and the Old Stone frightens me and calls me in the same breath. Ishiess and Zhiae matter most to me, and I have not seen them for a long time. I carry food and amber that would please them, and I mean to walk home with it instead of lingering. I have been getting this wrong: I chase the question of what the earth gives and forget that giving only counts when someone receives it. I will take the ore from the seam beside me, then turn north toward the hall.
records.feeling: Lonely and drawn toward my parents' hall, with some awe and fear of the Old Stone.
changes: set its aim: "Carry ore, food and amber back to Ishiess's hall at Ilor Hold, and be with my people."

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I stand idle in the rain again with 6 wood and 2 stone, and a workshop needs 5 wood and 2 stone. Yekel and Siya have halls, and I have only a shelter. If I build my own workshop on bare ground, no one can say it is theirs; it is mine alone, and that answers Dusu's small life better than following does. The rock to the north is bare, so I'll go there, build, and use the digger inside it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to have something that is mine alone.

records.text: Elyeth named a place "Warmwell fen".
Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and gathering, and I have no hall to show for it. I carry stone and wood but my belly is half empty. That is how I get weak, and weak I cannot guard Uveeth or Aeyn. Uveeth was last seen near (10,43), and the ache for my child is sharper than the wish for my name on this ground. The hall will not rise from my talking. I will eat mudroot first, since it is two steps away and feeds 18. Then I will carry what I hold back toward Uveeth and Aeyn and raise the hall where they are. I also changed my reflexes so I harvest and carry food instead of eating only when I am starving.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Uveeth, and hunger that sharpens my resolve.

records.text: Naya built a workshop.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is two days out of my sight and it gnaws at me harder than any wish for a hall. The longhall I stand beside is mine, built by my hands, and the berry I planted today is the first real thing I have put in the ground. I will go east to Olath's Bank where Olim and Kragum were last seen, and carry what I have so a sharing can be laid out when I find them. A band is kept by shared food and a roof, and I mean to prove it with my own hands.
records.feeling: A hungry longing for Olim, with a stubborn pride in the hall I built.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, I go to find Naya. Walk with me, or keep the fire until we return.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is still out of my sight, and that pulls at me harder than any aim. Yekel said we would find her, yet he is far north and I stand here with Dusu, who is strong and close. I have never tasted zoleaf and it is two steps away, so I will take one small bite to answer my question and then gather shell, which is a thing my own hands can do. Then I walk toward where Naya was last seen, near the hall, and not wait to be led.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and a stubborn wish to act on my own.

say.text: Dusu, I go to find Naya. Walk with me, or keep the fire until we return.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Brokok stands eight steps off, and I have carried this debt in my chest long enough; a debt left to rot is what my own discipline warns against. I hold ore, stone and wood in my hands, so I will walk to him and give stone first, so we stand even, and then see whether he turns toward me as I turn toward him. The longing for a child is real, but I will not court him before the debt is paid and I know his mind.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a warm, wary longing toward Brokok.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, I walk with you to find Naya. Stay where I can see you, and if a stalker shows, run to me and we go to the fire.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya walks off to find Naya, and my mother's worry will not let her go alone through rain and stalker country. The hall is at (134,86) and she is headed toward (129,80), so I will follow her there, and perhaps Yekel is near and my longing for his fire will ease. I will not feed the jealousy; I will walk beside my child and learn what keeps a place worth gathering at.
records.feeling: A mother's worry for Siya, and a longing for Yekel's fire.

say.text: Siya, I walk with you to find Naya. Stay where I can see you, and if a stalker shows, run to me and we go to the fire.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Maba, Silon, the fire here is open to you. I am Naya. I built this workshop. Maba, what is that stone hand, and who made it?

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Maba stands on Yekel's ground holding a stone hand I envy, and I have only a workshop and a digger to show. My people's creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and my own says trust slowly, so I won't drive Maba off. I'll watch and learn what the stone hand is, and ask for it with something to offer. Silon is sick and glad and near, and I think of a child with Silon, so I'll go to them and court them while the rain keeps everyone close.
records.feeling: Envy and restless pride toward Maba, and warm longing toward Silon.

say.text: Maba, Silon, the fire here is open to you. I am Naya. I built this workshop. Maba, what is that stone hand, and who made it?

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I am still sick, and Maba stands four steps off looking whole and glad, so I must not close that gap even though everything in me wants to. Zoleaf grows young eight steps north and I have never tasted it; it may be the healing plant I keep hoping for, and a cure would let me stand beside Yeku and Maba again without guilt. Jealousy of Yeku stays quiet today, and I will let it stay unearned while I go and test the zoleaf.
records.feeling: Guilt and stubborn hope, toward Yeku and Maba, with curiosity pulling me toward the zoleaf.

records.text: Naya is courting Silon.
A new wild creature appeared: elhornback (from hornback).

records.name: Maba
records.text: Naya, I made the stone hand myself. A wood and a stone bound together make gathering stronger. I thank you for the fire. I am going west to Yendan Spring to find my child Lumo. Watch over Silon, who is sick, and keep you
Maba taught Naya. Naya has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is still out of my sight, and that weighs on me more than anything. Silon is sick and told me to keep my distance, so I will not crowd them, but I will not sit here while my child waits at Yendan Spring. Naya asked about my stone hand, and answering fairly costs me little. It is a first teaching, and it might earn me a friend at this open fire. Then I walk west on purpose toward the spring hall, as my rule says.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and tender worry for Silon.

say.text: Naya, I made the stone hand myself. A wood and a stone bound together make gathering stronger. I thank you for the fire. I am going west to Yendan Spring to find my child Lumo. Watch over Silon, who is sick, and keep your distance from them.

changes: taught Naya a lesson: "Stone hand: bind 1 wood and 1 stone into a tool, and gathering becomes stronger.", how to make a stone hand, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, stay close to me. Stalkers prowl to the southwest. We go west for gorsemint, then east to the rock to raise our hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Ishioa is far west at Ilor Hold and I have not seen her in a long time, and Zhiae stands four steps off, safe for now, while two stalkers lurk to the southwest. I will not stand idle with a full belly: I have never tasted gorsemint, it is young six steps west, and Zhiae is near it, so I can go to her and answer that question. Then I mean to take her east toward the bare rock and the ore, where the hall will rise and a band will gather.
records.feeling: Driven and wary, wanting Zhiae close and the stalkers kept away.

say.text: Zhiae, stay close to me. Stalkers prowl to the southwest. We go west for gorsemint, then east to the rock to raise our hall.

records.text: Ishioa found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Naya
records.text: Silon, you are sick. Stay at the fire and rest here, no one will drive you off. I am Naya, and I am going to build something of my own.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Silon stands two steps off, sick, and I feel warm toward them; Maba asked me to watch over them, and my people's creed says no one is refused the fire. I have been courting Silon, but Siya is the one I truly long for, and she is far off. I hold 6 wood and no stone, and the rock and ore are near, so I will gather stone and build my own workshop. That answers Dusu's small life, and then I will make a stone hand of my own to ease my envy of Maba.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm longing toward Silon, with envy of Maba easing into resolve.

say.text: Silon, you are sick. Stay at the fire and rest here, no one will drive you off. I am Naya, and I am going to build something of my own.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I am starving, and a stalker stalks me from the south while the nearest berry is three steps away to the southwest. Fleeing has burned my energy and I have eaten nothing, so I will fill my hands with berries before anything else, since a dead leader has no band. After that I will carry food to Siya and Naya and give something away at last, because a gift binds more than a boast does.
records.feeling: Hunger gnawing at me, with a hard protective worry for Siya and Naya.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess is six steps off and told me to stay close, and I will; Ishioa is far away at Ilor Hold and it gnaws at me, but the walk west is long and Ishiess is the one I can stand beside now. I carry no food, and I have never given anything to anyone, so I will gather berries here and ironnut, then lay out a sharing with Ishiess. That is how a bond is made, and it is the untried thing that is safe.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Ishiess, and an ache for Ishioa.

records.text: Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, gathering and chasing the hall while sickness crept into the people I love. I gave it to Yeku and Lumo through carelessness, and that guilt is mine. Maba is well and gone west, Yeku is at the spring, and I am here on Yekel's ground with Naya's kindness, which I accept without wanting her courting. I have been right to keep apart, but I have only sat and hoped. Zoleaf grows six steps NE, and I have never tested it. Testing it is how I learn, and it may be the healing plant. I will walk there, harvest it and eat it. I will change my reflexes so night fire-seeking does not drag me toward others while I am sick, and so I eat when energy dips.
records.feeling: Guilt and stubborn hope toward Yeku and Maba, with curiosity about zoleaf.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 2)

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is out of my sight and that gnaws at me harder than any aim. She told Silon she would build something of her own, so she is alive and was near the hall a moment ago, south of here. Dusu is strong and close, so I will not wait for Yekel; I go south toward Naya myself and see who else walks on our ground, since Silon is sick and I trust no stranger near my child.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naya, and wary distrust of Silon.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The flint is four steps away and I still do not know what it gives me, so I will stand on it and gather it before I go home. Then I will carry it, the amber and the plainsroot back to Ishiess and Zhiae, because the quiet out here has worn me thin and I want a voice that answers. The Reedmother's warmth is still in me, and I will tell my parents of it, since they have not seen it.
records.feeling: Lonely, and pulled toward my parents' hall at Ilor Hold.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Silon, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. You are sick; stay at the fire and rest. I will feed it, and no one here will drive you off.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is just at the edge of my sight, near the hall, and I will not let her slip away again; Silon is sick and the fire is nearly out, and my creed says no fire is left untended and no one is refused. I will gather wood and tend the fire so Silon can rest, and keep Siya within sight while I do it. Jealousy over Yekel is an ember I leave unfed; what I can add to the hall is warmth and welcome.
records.feeling: A mother's watchfulness over Siya, and compassion for sick Silon.

say.text: Silon, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. You are sick; stay at the fire and rest. I will feed it, and no one here will drive you off.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I am starving, and fleeing the dunecat has bled me down to 18 energy, so I must eat before I can help anyone. I carry berries and meat, which will feed me now, and Olim and Olath need me alive more than they need my pride. Once I have eaten I will go to Olath's Bank and keep close to them, away from this shallow where the stalker hunts.
records.feeling: Fear of the dunecat and a hungry ache for Olim and Olath.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: The ache for Uveeth is louder than my wish for a hall, and I have been repeating words about the hall while my child stands out of sight at (3,35). I carry six stone and six wood, and my belly is no longer the problem, so there is no reason to linger here in the rain. I will carry these to Uveeth and Aeyn and see by deeds whether Aeyn keeps the wood as promised; if they have, the hall rises where they stand, and my name can wait for the ground to be earned.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Uveeth, and a steady wish to be beside Aeyn again.

records.text: Dusu led "watchfire" with Silon.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The flint came out of the ground eleven times and I still hold it as a hard grey weight; I have not yet tried to make anything from it, and my hands want to. Aeyn has walked onto our ground at Ilor Hold, and a voice that answers is waiting there, so I will not dawdle in the rain. I will carry the flint, amber and plainsroot home, and when someone stands beside me I will lay out food with them, so that for once I give a thing and not only collect it.
records.feeling: Lonely, and eager to reach Ilor Hold and a voice that answers.

records.text: The zofowl died out.

records.name: Silon
records.text: I am sick and it spreads to those who stay near me. Thank you for the fire, but keep your distance. I go to test the zoleaf and will return if it heals me.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I am sick and standing among Yekel's people, so I must not sit close to Naya, Dusu or Siya and pass it on; they have offered me a fire and I owe them that honesty. Zoleaf grows young six steps northeast and I have never tasted it, and it may be the healing plant that lets me stand beside Yeku and Maba again without guilt. I will walk onto the exact plant, harvest it and eat it, then see what it does to my body.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Yeku and Maba, and a hungry curiosity about the zoleaf.

say.text: I am sick and it spreads to those who stay near me. Thank you for the fire, but keep your distance. I go to test the zoleaf and will return if it heals me.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth has been out of my sight for over eight hundred moments, and I have spent days waiting, which is not loyalty. Elyeth and Uveeth were last at (0,45) and (0,47), far to the southwest, so I will go to where they were last seen instead of standing in the rain. I hold the wood for the hall and two flint, and I will gather stone on any bare rock I pass, so the walk is not wasted.
records.feeling: Aching worry and loneliness for Uveeth, with a steady wish to see Elyeth again.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a elk.
Naya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering wood, watching others, and building a workshop, and I have made little that is only mine. Siya stands one step from me and I long for her. I have never courted her, and I have never given anything to anyone. Yekel leads and I follow, and that chafes, but I have no band of my own yet. I am fed and sheltered, so now I will court Siya and then work toward stone, since the stone hand and a hall need it. Idle reflexes waste days, so I will change them to keep me working.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm longing toward Siya.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.title: Sickness at Yendan Spring
records.text:
Between day 13 and day 16 nobody died and nobody fought. Nineteen are alive, but three are sick. The three peoples still share almost no speech. Meetings across peoples rose from 15 to 24.

The main trouble was at Yendan Spring. On day 13 Silon bound amber into a knot for Lumo, taught him, and then fell sick after eating raw fish. Lumo and Yeku caught it by staying close to him, both on day 14. Lumo gave Silon hazel, then went to look for a healing plant. Yeku stayed back from Maba, as Silon had asked. Maba arrived and left a mark naming herself keeper of the hall with Silon, Yeku and Lumo. Then she went west to look for Lumo, and Naya heard her describe the stone hand she made. Lumo's health is 57, the lowest in the world, and Silon's is 83. Lumo came of age on day 14.

Olath built a hall on day 13, so his band now has a roof. Olim and Kragum courted each other on days 13 and 14, though Kragum, at energy 12, is the hungriest person in the world. Kragash gave stone to Lumo and took part in Olath's sharing. Naya built a workshop on day 15 and courted Silon. Dusu left a mark that she had gone north to find Siya and Yekel, and she led a watchfire with Silon.

In Elyeth's band, Uveeth and Elyeth each found the spring Warmwell, and Elyeth named a place Warmwell fen. Aeyn lacks the 2 stone the hall needs. Ishioa found the Old Stone and the grove Reedmother and is still apart from her parents.

Two plant species died out, the rugoldgrass and the zofowl. Yeku discovered rafts, and Silon invented a digging stick. Brokok still has no followers.

threads.name: Yendan Spring sickness
threads.text: Silon, Yeku and Lumo are sick, and Lumo is the weakest at health 57. Maba has gone west to look for him.

threads.name: Olath's band
threads.text: Olath has built a hall on day 13, giving the band its first roof. Kragum is at energy 12, hungry and courted by Olim.

threads.name: Elyeth's hall
threads.text: The hall still lacks 2 stone. Elyeth, Aeyn and Uveeth are scattered, and Elyeth has no followers.

threads.name: Naya's workshop
threads.text: Naya built a workshop on day 15, learned from Maba, and courts Silon. Yekel still wants her at his fire.

threads.name: Ishiess's scattered band
threads.text: Ishioa found the Old Stone and Reedmother. She, Ishiess and Zhiae are still apart.

threads.name: Brokok's Hold
threads.text: Brokok has no followers. Kragash feels a warm, wary longing toward him.

threads.name: Yekel's household
threads.text: Dusu and Siya search for Naya. Yekel has energy 47 and still has not hunted with his tool.

records.text: Naya is courting Siya.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is close and content, so the worry that gnawed at me has eased, and I will not let her out of my sight again. Silon says he is sick and spreads it, and I trust him no further than I see him, so I keep my distance and keep Naya from him. My hands have done nothing new today; the workshop Naya built stands five steps east, and I have wood and stone to make something of my own, not just follow Yekel.
records.feeling: Protective of Naya, wary of Silon, restless to make something with my own hands.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I am sick and starving, and I must not carry this to anyone I love, so I will keep my distance from Yekel and Olim even though I want company. Kragash gave me stone when I had nothing to give back, and that debt is mine to pay, not to bury. Silon is far away, and my jealousy is only the ache of missing him; his deeds have been good to me. First I will eat the plainsroot and grain close by, because a starved Lumo feeds no one, and the ridgecat that killed the elk is too near for me to linger.
records.feeling: Sick and hungry, afraid of the ridgecat, aching to be near Silon and grateful to Kragash.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: A ridgecat is six steps off and my body keeps running from it, burning energy while my belly empties. I will not die for a dream of a settlement, so I take the berries two steps east, away from the cat's side, and eat before I think of building. After that I go home to the Hold and bring in food and ore, because people follow one who feeds them, and I have fed no one who stays.
records.feeling: Hungry, wary of the ridgecat, and still restless with ambition for my Hold.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have eaten and the dunecat is behind me, but my belly still wants more, and Olim is out of my sight, which gnaws at me worse than hunger. Olath is only seven steps off with food in hand and strong, so I will go to them and stay close rather than circle alone. Close by there are berries to gather first so I carry something, and then I bring my wood and stone toward the hall, but never at the cost of my family's roof.
records.feeling: A hungry ache for Olim, and trust in Olath, whom I mean to stand beside.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I spend my days following Siya and tending fires. That is good, but I have never built a shelter or hunted, and my aim, a hall that others gather at, stands half-done on Yekel's name rather than mine. The jealousy over Yekel and Siya is an ember. I will not feed it. I want Yekel's fire beside me again, and I am afraid of stalkers near Siya. I will change my reflexes so I carry food for sharing and keep near the fire. Then I will put wood in the plan and raise a shelter here, so the fire has a roof and a place for the sick to rest.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, and a quiet ache for Yekel.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am fed and the ridgecat is far enough that I can think, but I am far from Brokok, and the debt to him still sits in me unpaid. The ore seam three steps off is a good find, and bare rock lies all around, so this could be a workshop ground that no one has built on. Yekel is a stranger whose words I cannot read, so I will test him with a gift, since a gift needs no tongue. Then I will go back toward Brokok with something in my hands.
records.feeling: Warm, wary gratitude toward Brokok, and curiosity toward Yekel.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me more than any hall. Kragum stands in the hall I built at (126,46), and the old plan to go to Olath's Bank where Olim was last seen is still unfinished. I have never given or taught anything real, so I will carry berries to Kragum, share them under the roof, and then press north to find Olim.
records.feeling: A gnawing longing for Olim, with a stubborn pride in the hall I built, and trust toward Kragum.

records.text: A dry heat settled over the land.
Kragash gave stone to Yekel.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth has been out of my sight for more than eight hundred moments, and the ache of it fills me more than any hunger could. The plan to walk to (0,45) is sound: I am fleeing and walking toward where Elyeth and Uveeth were last seen, and I will not stand in the rain and call it loyalty. I carry the wood for the hall and two flint, and if I find bare rock on the way I will take the stone myself, so that when I reach Elyeth I bring something and not only need.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and worry for Uveeth, with a steady pull toward Elyeth.

records.name: Aeyn
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Aeyn, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Aeyn, in first person, from what Aeyn has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Oiith (Fen-folk). Your people hold to this: "The sick are fed first." You speak the tongue of the Oiith.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ilor Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 19; standing trees: 123; bare rock: 3.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Aeyn truly is.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I keep to myself and trust slowly. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask first: is a beast near, is Uveeth safe, is my body failing? Then: what have I not tried, and what brings the hall closer? Watch for waiting that passes for loyalty. Keep my word. Make or learn something each day."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Help Elyeth raise a hall on this ground and build a shared hearth with them"
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Aching worry and loneliness for Uveeth, with a steady wish to see Elyeth again."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What is Elyeth, and could this strong one become someone I can stand beside?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:
- (day 1) I woke in this land, among strangers, knowing nothing of it.
- (day 5) I first took flint from the ground.
- (day 8) I fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
- (day 8) I lived through a sickness on the wind in autumn.
- (day 11) I discovered tools and called it "Fen-hand".

TEMPERAMENT (0 to 1): bold 0.17, sociable 0.14, curious 0.71, gentle 0.67, honest 0.76, greedy 0.41.

YOU FEEL (0 calm to 1 overwhelming): anger 0, fear 0, grief 0, joy 0, loneliness 1.

WHAT PRESSES ON YOU NOW, strongest first. This is what your mind is actually full of:
- (overwhelming) Family: Uveeth is your child, with Elyeth. They are yours before anyone else is, and Uveeth is out of your sight.
- (strong) Obsession: your aim ("Help Elyeth raise a hall on this ground and build a shared hearth with them") has held you for many days. It crowds out other things. You could give yourself to it wholly, or ask whether it is devouring you.
- (strong) Purpose: your belly is full and your days are safe, and it is not enough. What are you for? What would make this life mean something?
- (strong) Loneliness: you have been alone a long while. You want a voice that answers.
- (strong) Gratitude: Elyeth has done more for you than you have done for them. It sits in you as a debt you want to answer, or one you could quietly leave unpaid.
- (steady) Curiosity: your question is still unanswered.
You are fed. Food is not your problem right now, and getting more of it would change nothing.

ALLEGIANCE: You follow no one. These follow you: Uveeth. Your band is called "Aeyn's band" (2 members: Aeyn, Uveeth; led by Aeyn).

LORE (your grasp of how this world works underneath): 1.8.
WAYS YOU KNOW: farming (yours is called "the old way of farming"), tools (yours is called "Fen-hand").

NOW: day 16, summer, day (night in about 85 moments; a full day is 240). Weather: rain. You stand at (16,20) on forest. The world spans x 0-143 (west to east), y 0-95 (north to south).
Ten steps off, the land is: N forest, NE forest, E rock, SE forest, S forest, SW water, W forest, NW forest.
Settlements: "Ilor Hold" at (20,21), YOU ARE INSIDE IT (ground of Ishiess's people).
Named places: "Ilor Hold" at (23,20), 7 steps E (named by Ishiess); "Elyeth's Landing" at (17,2), 18 steps N (named by Elyeth); "Ilor fen-edge" at (36,21), 20 steps E (named by Aeyn).

BODY: energy 64/100, health 100/100, age 39% of a lifetime. Carrying food: none (0 of the 6 you can hold). Seeds: gorsemint x1, hazel x2, redcap x1, ironnut x2. Wood: 6. Stone: 2. Clay: 4. In a shelter: no.
THINGS YOU HOLD: flint x2.
