records.name: Yekel
records.thought: My belly is near empty, and the berry one step northeast is mine to take before anyone else reaches it. Kragash gave me stone and asked for nothing, and I have never given anything back; I don't trust it, but a small gift would show me what these Stone-folk want, and might make them see me as someone worth standing beside. Food first, since a starving leader has no band, then I go south to Siya and Naya with my arms full.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with a hard worry for Naya and a flicker of curiosity toward Kragash.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Elyeth, you stand close and I am glad of it. I would court you and have a child with you, if you are willing. Plan mate toward me as I do toward you.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Elyeth stands two steps off, and my trust in her is steady. I want a child of my own, and Aeyn has told me plainly that kin will not court, so Elyeth is the one I can ask. My energy is above 60, she is near, and I will not let the chance pass while she stands beside me; I will say it aloud and then plan to court her.
records.feeling: Warm longing and steady trust toward Elyeth, with a little nervousness.

say.text: Elyeth, you stand close and I am glad of it. I would court you and have a child with you, if you are willing. Plan mate toward me as I do toward you.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragash, I carry wood and stone for the hall. Walk south with me to Olath's Bank and we will raise it together.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am far in the north with 3 wood and 6 stone that belong in Olath's hall, and my hands have done nothing for the band while I lingered. Yekel stands four steps off with a made tool and I cannot read his tongue, so I will not go near him or reach for what he holds; what a hand has made is that hand's until it is given. Kragash is here and Olath is three days unseen, so I will leave the strangeness, carry the promise south, and eat the ironnut underfoot on the way to keep my strength for courting Kragum.
records.feeling: Longing for Olath and a wary curiosity toward Yekel, with a steady wish to bring my promise home.

say.text: Kragash, I carry wood and stone for the hall. Walk south with me to Olath's Bank and we will raise it together.

records.text: Uveeth is courting Elyeth.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My sickness has passed and will not take me again for some days, so I no longer owe Maba and Lumo distance, and the quiet I have kept is ringing in me. Silon, Maba and Lumo were last at the spring hall, thirteen steps east, and I want a voice that answers more than I want anything else. I will go home to the hall and take my berries and ironnuts there, to share under its roof and finish what I set out to do.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba, Lumo and Silon, and relief that my sickness is gone.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Uveeth, I am glad you stand here. I will mate with you; let us both eat first so we are strong, then we raise a hall for our own.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth stands a step from me asking to bind a child with me, and my chest warms; trust runs high between us and I have carried this ache for them for days. But my energy is 69, and a child needs both of us at 60 or more, so I eat the grain underfoot first and then answer with deeds, not words. The hall can wait one breath longer, since Uveeth is the reason I want a hall at all.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and trust toward Uveeth, with the old hunger for my name on this ground still pulling.

say.text: Uveeth, I am glad you stand here. I will mate with you; let us both eat first so we are strong, then we raise a hall for our own.

records.text: Elyeth is courting Uveeth.
Xassa was born to Elyeth and Uveeth.

records.name: Silon
records.text: My sickness has passed. Zoleaf feeds a little but does not heal. I go to find Maba.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My sickness has passed, so the guilt that kept me away from Yeku and Maba has no more reason to hold me, and the jealousy I feel is a poor thing beside how much I want to see them. Maba was last seen near Yekel's Hall, and Yeku is far west at the spring, so I will find Maba first and bring the band together. The zoleaf gave little, and I learned that it does not heal, so I will not pretend it does. I will walk to the hall where Maba was last seen, and then take everyone west to raise our own hall before winter.
records.feeling: Longing and relief toward Maba and Yeku, now that I am no longer a danger to them.

say.text: My sickness has passed. Zoleaf feeds a little but does not heal. I go to find Maba.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is still out of my sight, and the hall at Yendan Spring is only two steps off, where Yeku is walking now. I will go there on purpose and look for my child instead of drifting, keeping a few steps from Yeku because of the sickness. If Lumo is there I will finally see them; if not, I will ask Yeku where they are.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and hope that the hall holds them.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: Elyeth and Uveeth are over by the food and I am small out here alone; the jealousy over Elyeth and Aeyn stings, but I will not sulk, I will do something. There is amber 7 steps north and I have never gathered from a deposit; I mean to carry something back that is mine, and an amberknot could be a gift to Elyeth, a deed rather than words. I'll go to the amber, gather it, then return to my parents before night.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Aeyn, and a wish to prove myself to Elyeth.
changes: set its aim: "Carry amber to Elyeth and make something lasting with it, to earn my place beside them."
now wonders: What would make me worth more than just following Aeyn?

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa is born, and Elyeth stands beside me. They said to eat first and then raise a hall of our own. I have spent my days fed and wandering, and I want a roof and stone for my child. I lack stone, and without it I can build nothing. I owe Elyeth for the flint-edge, so I will build with them and not leave the debt unpaid. My reflexes don't yet stock stone or keep the child fed, so I will change them to seek food earlier and gather wood and stone.
records.feeling: Warm trust and protectiveness toward Elyeth and Xassa.
changes: rethought what it knows (13 notes became 7)

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya was at the edge of my sight two moments ago, and I will not lose her in the dusk. I have never built a shelter, and I stand with 2 wood when it takes 3; one more piece and I raise a roof of my own, not only stand on Yekel's name. Gather one more wood, build, then keep the fire near and watch for Siya; the ember of jealousy I leave unfed, for Yekel will come back to a hall that grew in his absence.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, and a quiet ache for Yekel.

records.text: Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My days have gone to circling between hunger, Uveeth and a hall I keep naming but never raise. I carry six wood and six stone, enough for a hall, and I have spent them on words. Uveeth and Xassa are what matter, and Uveeth has dealt fairly by deeds, so my name on this ground should come from building and not from talk. I change my reflexes so I eat first, then the body builds the hall on bare rock near Uveeth without waiting on me.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Uveeth, and a hard resolve to stop talking and build.

records.text: Dusu built a shelter.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have built a workshop and a shrine, but never given anything or planted anything toward farming, and Yekel's name still sits above mine. I'm fed and the night is quiet, so this is the time to make something that is mine alone: I'll plant my hazel and ironnut seeds on open ground near my shelter, which counts toward farming. Siya is south, and I want to go to her and court her, because she is the one I long for.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and warm longing toward Siya.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Elyeth, come to Ilor Hold with me. I have plainsroot and amber to share, and a fire is better with company.
Ishioa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent my days walking out for amber and flint and then coming back with a hard weight in my hands and nothing made of it. I am lonely, and I wander most of the time when I should be going toward my people. Aeyn and Elyeth are both on our ground now, and neither has been hostile. I will speak first and share food with them. I will also try one untried thing: a sharing with whoever stands beside me. Ishiess and Zhiae are my anchor, and I mean to bring them something. I will stop drifting and turn to the Hold.
records.feeling: Lonely, and hopeful about the voices near Ilor Hold.

say.text: Elyeth, come to Ilor Hold with me. I have plainsroot and amber to share, and a fire is better with company.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: A dunecat is five steps SW, and my plan walks me toward the southwest, so I will not go that way. Elyeth was seen one moment ago at (25,27), close by to the southeast, so they are not far at all. I am hungry and hold no food. Hazel is a step north and a berry is nearby, so I will eat first. Then I will go to Elyeth and ask about Uveeth, because waiting alone has not brought my child back, and the debt I owe Elyeth is better paid by standing beside them than by leaving it unspoken.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Uveeth, and a wary pull toward Elyeth.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Silon, you may sit at the fire, for no one is refused a place at it. But stay far from me and from Naya while you are sick. If you come close, I will drive you off.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is courting me, and she is my own child with Yekel. The creed of the Midu and my own want both say to keep what is mine close, and I don't know yet what mating her would mean, so I will not rush it. Silon stands in Yekel's Hall saying he is sick, and I trust him no further than I see him. He may stay at the fire, as my people hold, but at a distance, and I will not let him near Naya. Standing idle teaches me nothing, so I will make something with my hands: bare ground, a fire, wood in my hands.
records.feeling: Wary protectiveness toward Naya and Silon, and restlessness to make something of my own.

say.text: Silon, you may sit at the fire, for no one is refused a place at it. But stay far from me and from Naya while you are sick. If you come close, I will drive you off.

records.text: Elyeth built a hall.
Siya built a fire.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Olim, I come south with you. The stalker is close here, so let us go now and raise the hall together.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: The stalker lurks six steps off and I stand at the world's north edge with no way to fight it, so I will not linger here. Olim's offer is a good one: he carries wood and stone for the hall, and walking south together puts a companion beside me against the beast. The ore seam here is a fine find and I will remember it, but a workshop does me no good if I am dead. Brokok's debt still sits in me, and the road south passes near his Hold, so I can pay it there.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and warm toward Olim's offer and toward Brokok's debt still unpaid.

say.text: Olim, I come south with you. The stalker is close here, so let us go now and raise the hall together.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My sickness is gone, and Maba is not here, so I should not wait in Yekel's ground while my child is out of sight. Yeku is far west at the spring, and I miss Yeku, but the jealousy is a small thing next to wanting my family together. I am thirsty, so I will drink at the water four steps northwest, then head west along the forest toward the spring, looking for Maba on the way and testing what I find.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba and Yeku, with a restless wish to bring my band together.

records.text: Naya is courting Siya.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Aeyn, come near. This is my ground, Ilor Hold, and you are welcome to eat with me. I have plainsroot to share.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Aeyn is six steps off and walking, and the loneliness in me is loud; I will not let them drift away unanswered again. I hold plainsroot and a hall of my own ground to share beneath, so I will close the gap and lay out food with them, which I have never tried and need to learn. If Aeyn eats beside me, I will know whether this stranger is a guest to welcome or one to send off.
records.feeling: Lonely and hopeful toward Aeyn, who is finally within reach.

say.text: Aeyn, come near. This is my ground, Ilor Hold, and you are welcome to eat with me. I have plainsroot to share.

records.text: Elyeth found the spring "Warmwell".
Ishioa led "sharing" with Aeyn.
Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days following Yekel, making a flint spear, taking shell, and building fires. These are small things, and I have not yet raised a hall of my own. Naya is my child and she courts me. I do not know what mating her means, and I will not rush it. Silon says he is sick, so I keep my distance. I want something that is mine, and my hands have been idle too long. There is bare rock here and I hold 4 wood and 3 stone. I will build a workshop, which takes 5 wood and 2 stone, so I need one more wood. A workshop is a step toward my own hall, and it makes my tools last longer. I will change my reflexes so I gather wood whenever I am short and stop lingering when I am fed.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a wary protectiveness toward Naya.

records.text: Yekel rewrote its own reflexes.
Yekel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing stalkers and starving, and I have built little. The hall is 84 steps south and Naya is lost. A stalker bit me three times and I stood idle too long, so my reflexes are failing me. Siya and Naya come first, then a band that stays because there is food and a fire at the hall. I will flee early, drink, then walk south toward the hall and my children, away from the cat and the stalker.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat and stalker, and a hard worry for Naya.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: The hall stands at (22,32), my first lasting thing, and the Warmwell has healed me and filled me with warmth. Xassa is out of my sight and the frostfang prowls near where my child roams, so I go to my child and Uveeth before I raise anything else. Uveeth was last seen near (18,36), north of me, and Xassa near (12,37), so I walk toward them with flint-edge ready and my body fed.
records.feeling: A hard, protective pull toward Xassa and Uveeth, with pride in the hall I raised.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth has been out of my sight for over a thousand moments, and that ache outweighs everything, including the jealousy I feel toward Elyeth. Elyeth was seen only 26 moments ago to the south near (22,32), so they are close, and the flint deposit at (21,29) lies on that road. I will not wait here and call it loyalty. I go to Elyeth, gather flint on the way, and ask what they know of Uveeth, keeping clear of the dunecat to the southwest.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Uveeth, and a wary pull toward Elyeth.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My belly is fed and no one answers me out here. Fat ore lies two steps off, and I have never dug a deposit, so I go and win it with my own hand; what my hand makes is mine until I give it, and ore I give will bind followers to my Hold. I will gather it, then carry it home before dusk, and not wander toward ridgecat ground.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a dull loneliness, aimed at my empty Hold.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Aeyn, the meal with you warmed me. I would court you, if you are willing. Answer me with the same.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Aeyn is three steps off and the longing in me is loud: I want a child, and I have never courted anyone. We have shared food and it warmed us both, so I will go the next step and court them by name, and see whether they answer in kind. If they do not, I lose only a little pride, and I learn how this works.
records.feeling: Hopeful and nervous longing toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, the meal with you warmed me. I would court you, if you are willing. Answer me with the same.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, come beside me. I have food for us both. Then let us go west to Ishioa and raise our hall.
Zhiae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have drifted behind Ishiess for days, harvesting and lingering, and I have never given anything to anyone, even though I say I do. Ishioa is far west at Ilor Hold and I ache for her, while I stand in the east on sand with Ishiess exploring away from home. Ishiess carries no food and I carry two, so I will give now, and I will make a sharing with them, which is also something I have never done. After that I want to turn us west toward Ishioa and our hold, and gather wood so we can build the hall. I am fed and safe, and safety alone is not what I am for.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Ishiess and an ache for Ishioa far away.

say.text: Ishiess, come beside me. I have food for us both. Then let us go west to Ishioa and raise our hall.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Kragash gave me stone when I had nothing, and I have only kept the debt in my chest. I carry amber, and amberknot needs someone beside me, so I will go to Kragash and bind one for them, a gift that needs no shared tongue. I want to be near others, and the ridgecat to the southeast is a reason to move with company, not alone. Silon and Yeku are far south, and my jealousy is only missing them.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly curious toward Kragash, with a quiet ache for Silon.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Maba, my sickness is gone and I am well. Come, let us share a meal at the hall and wait for Lumo and Silon by the fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is two steps away and glad, Silon was near me a moment ago, and I am well at last, so the hall can finally be what I built it to be. Lumo is the one I cannot see, and I owe Lumo more than I have given; I want us all sitting together under the roof. I will go to the hall, share food with Maba, and let that bring Silon and Lumo toward the fire.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, and an ache to see Lumo.

say.text: Maba, my sickness is gone and I am well. Come, let us share a meal at the hall and wait for Lumo and Silon by the fire.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I am coming to you. Keep the food; I will pick berries on the way and we share. Then we taste the gorsemint together.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae calls me to share food and go west to Ishioa, and my child is the thing that pulls hardest, yet the hall I want is east on the rock, and I have never taught anyone anything or given anything away. I will go to Zhiae, take what she offers, and give her something back so the debt is paid and the band holds; then we decide together between west and the rock. Gorsemint is young near (76,4), close to her, so I can taste it on the way and answer that small itch too.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: Aeyn wanders nine steps off and I feel nothing for them yet, only the sting of Elyeth's attention going elsewhere. Following is not what will make me worth something; carrying is. The amber lies north, I have never gathered from a deposit, and an amberknot placed in Elyeth's hands will say what my words cannot. I go now, bold, while my belly is full and the day is long.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Aeyn, and a hard wish to prove myself to Elyeth.

records.seen: Seedworld is calm and growing. There are twenty people, no deaths and no fights, the three sick have recovered (Lumo is at health 75), and spring lifted food standing to 1042. For the first time a few words are crossing between peoples: Olgor understanding rose from 0% to 3% and Midu from 0% to 2%, alongside 24 meetings and Kragash's gift of stone to the sick Lumo. The bottom of the food web is thinning fast. Hoppers fell from 25 to 11, skit from 19 to 12, plants from 1455 to 1163, and two plant kinds died out, while hunters sit near their cap. Many spears and fishing tools have been made, but almost nothing has been hunted or fished with them (people have killed 16 animals, unchanged, and eaten fish only 7 times, unchanged).
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 21, autumn into winter): fish eaten rises from 7 to at least 14, and the fishing way is known by at least 1 person (most likely Yeku, Lumo or someone else at Yendan Spring). At least 8 nibbets are alive and hoppers have not died out. Animals killed by people rise above 16. At least one people's understanding of other tongues is above 3%, and meetings across peoples reach at least 30. As the cold nears, energyMedian falls below 65, and either healthLowest drops below 55 or the first death comes. Trades stay at 0, stores stay at 0 unless storage is discovered, and there are still no fights. If fish eaten stays at 7 despite the higher catch chance, fishing is limited by what people choose to do, not by odds. If nibbets die out or hoppers still crash, the prey shortage comes from too many hunters, not from slow breeding.

No fights followed. Births rose from 3 to 6 and bands from 4 to 5. Two parts missed: no place of power was found, and energyMedian rose (72 to 77) rather than dipping. The change did its main job with no harm.

Amber held doubled to 37. The recipe is harmless and is used, so keep it.

#3 kept: Reedmother was found by Ishioa (found by 1), so this site reached people where earlier distant sites did not. Most of the other predictions held: food standing rose above 1000 (1042), a new way appeared (rafts, by Yeku), Zhiae was fed and is at energy 66, skit stayed at 12, and predator kills rose to 16. records.lesson: Words began to cross between peoples (0% to 3%) through meetings and a gift born of need for a sick neighbour, while the made token (amberknot) still sits unused. Real need opens contact sooner than objects made for giving.
ideasAdded: The first cross-people gift (Kragash giving stone to a sick Lumo) grew from need, not from a token, and understanding rose for the first time soon after. Care for the sick or hungry may be the real road across the language wall, more than made things.

Tools are made far more often than they are used. If hunting and fishing stay flat while inventions climb, invention is a matter of status and reflection rather than practice, and a later recipe that wears a tool might be what pulls tools into the field.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I sat in Siya's hall and courted her, and the warmth of it is still in me, but a child needs her to court me back and she has only sat beside me. She holds a flint spear and I watched her make it, so now I can make one too and stop envying her. I want a made thing that is mine, so I will craft the spear from my own wood and stone, then plant my last seeds while the rain waters the ground.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm longing toward Siya, with a sting of envy over her spear.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Yeku, I am glad you are well. I will fetch berries and come to the hall to share a meal with you, and we wait for Lumo and Silon together.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Yeku is well again and walks to the hall, so the sickness is behind us and I can sit close without fear. Lumo is still out of my sight, and that weighs on me most; waiting by the fire is not enough, and I should help Yeku keep the hall while we wait for Silon and Lumo. I have food seeds but no food in hand, so I will gather berries nearby, then share a meal at the hall with Yeku, which also eases us both.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warm gladness toward Yeku.

say.text: Yeku, I am glad you are well. I will fetch berries and come to the hall to share a meal with you, and we wait for Lumo and Silon together.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, come beside me. Eat from my hands, then we walk north together to find Olim.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me more than the hall does. Kragum stands three steps off, strong and trusted, and I have never yet given anything real, so I will make a sharing with him now while the rain falls, and then walk north to Olath's Bank where Olim was last seen. Let the hall wait; my child comes before my pride.
records.feeling: Longing for Olim, with steady trust toward Kragum.

say.text: Kragum, come beside me. Eat from my hands, then we walk north together to find Olim.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have spent my days walking after Uveeth and Elyeth, and the hall is no closer. I hold 6 wood and 2 stone, which is exactly what a hall needs, and I keep waiting on Elyeth to fetch stone I already carry. That is waiting dressed up as loyalty. Elyeth is near and I trust them, and the jealousy is only the ache of wanting Uveeth close. I will build the hall here on bare ground, then call Elyeth to the hearth. A hall is something I can make with my own hands, and it is a roof for Uveeth to come back to.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Uveeth, and trust in Elyeth, with a new resolve.
changes: named this place "Hall ground by Warmwell"

records.text: Aeyn built a hall.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olath, I am beside you. I carry 6 stone and 2 wood for the hall, and I go to gather more wood now. Do you know where Olim is?

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is out of my sight and that gnaws at me more than any hunger, and Olath stands only three steps off with food and strength, so I stay near them while I do something useful. The hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I hold 2 wood and 6 stone, so wood is my lack; there are trees all around here, and I have only gathered 12 of 16 toward fire. I will gather wood from the forest beside me, then go back to Olath, and ask where Olim is. I still owe Siya a deed, and a hall built together is a deed for all of us.
records.feeling: A gnawing worry for Olim, steadied by trust in Olath beside me.

say.text: Olath, I am beside you. I carry 6 stone and 2 wood for the hall, and I go to gather more wood now. Do you know where Olim is?

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Elyeth, I am coming to you. Xassa was last toward the northwest; let us find them together before night.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa was last at (4,38), out of my sight, and the thought of my child alone in the rain pulls at me harder than any plan of mine. Elyeth stands five steps north, and I owe her the flint-edge and a child; I will go to her and share my food with her, because the sick and the small are fed first. Then we can look for Xassa together, and I will keep Aeyn in sight as well. I have no stone for a hall yet, but I can carry food for my family while I walk.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, and warm trust toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, I am coming to you. Xassa was last toward the northwest; let us find them together before night.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba is two steps away and glad, and I am well, so the hall can finally be what I built it to be. I have two berries in hand and Maba is fetching more, so a meal beneath the roof is within reach. Lumo is still out of my sight and I owe Lumo more than I have given. I will go to the hall, make a hallwelcome with Maba, and keep the fire so Silon and Lumo find us warm when they come.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, and an ache to see Lumo.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Come, we go northwest together and find Xassa before night. I walk ahead; keep close.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Uveeth comes to me and Xassa was last seen toward the northwest, so my child is what matters now, not the aim of a name. I am fed and warm from the Warmwell, and Aeyn has raised a hall here by the spring, so the ground has begun to stand without my words. I go northwest with Uveeth before night falls and the rain deepens, and I will build with my own hands once my child is safe in sight.
records.feeling: A hard protective pull toward Xassa, and steady trust toward Uveeth.

say.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Come, we go northwest together and find Xassa before night. I walk ahead; keep close.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight and that presses on me hardest; she was last at the hall 125 moments ago, and I will not wait here wondering. I built a shelter at (135,80), so my aim is no longer only Yekel's name, and the ember of jealousy stays small when I act instead of brooding. I go back toward the hall and Siya, carrying wood for the fire, and I will take berries on the way to share.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, with a quiet ache for Yekel.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, I do not know where Olim is. Olim was last seen at Olath's Bank, so I go there now. Gather your wood, then come after me and bring it to the hall.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me more than any hall, though the hall at my side is mine and I am proud of it. Kragum asks where Olim is and I cannot answer, so I will not pretend; the plan to Olath's Bank is still running and it is the right road. When I find Olim I will bring them under the roof and see who else will follow a hand that feeds them.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Olim, with pride in the hall and trust toward Kragum.

say.text: Kragum, I do not know where Olim is. Olim was last seen at Olath's Bank, so I go there now. Gather your wood, then come after me and bring it to the hall.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, I will wait here under the rain. When you reach me we lay out the sharing, my berry and yours, and then we taste the gorsemint together.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess is coming to me with berries, and I have talked of giving for days without doing it. This time I will wait for them and lay out a sharing so the words become a deed. I also want to taste the sunfig and sapcane, since I am fed and the dusk is safe enough, but I will not stray far from Ishiess with stalkers about at night. Ishioa still aches in me, so after the sharing I will press Ishiess to turn west.
records.feeling: Warm, eager loyalty toward Ishiess, with an ache for Ishioa.

say.text: Ishiess, I will wait here under the rain. When you reach me we lay out the sharing, my berry and yours, and then we taste the gorsemint together.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.
Olim rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: For days I have walked toward Olath and carried wood and stone, but the hall is still unbuilt and my hands have mostly walked. I am fed, safe and hold 3 wood and 6 stone. A hall needs 6 wood, and I hold only half of that. The trees are close, in the NW forest. I fear Yekel and envy his tools, but I have not harmed him and will not. What I want is a mate, a child and a hall that holds my people through winter. That cannot happen while I wander, so I will gather wood first and then go south to Olath's Bank. I will change my reflexes so my body gathers wood and heads home without waiting for me to think of it.
records.feeling: Restless purpose toward Olath and the unbuilt hall, with wary curiosity toward Yekel.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is still out of my sight, and Yeku and Maba were last at Yendan Spring, 19 steps east, where we sat together in the hall and I felt less alone. The jealousy is a small ember beside the warmth I felt there. I'll go back to the spring and bring the band together, and on the way I'll pass the berry and the sapcane to learn what sapcane does. Sapcane is 8 steps west, the wrong way, so I'll leave it for when the hall stands firm. First, family.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba and Yeku, and a steady wish to gather my band at the spring.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Naya, I do not answer you tonight. I gather wood and build my own hall. Stay by the fire with Dusu.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is my own child and she courts me, and I will not do this because the moment pushes me. The creed says keep what is mine close, but a mating born of rain and dusk is not an aim, and my aim is a hall of my own. I have 4 wood short of nothing now: the workshop failed for lack of wood, so I will gather more, then build with my own hands while Dusu and Naya keep near the fire.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary protectiveness toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, I do not answer you tonight. I gather wood and build my own hall. Stay by the fire with Dusu.

records.text: Siya built a shelter.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me, and Olath has gone to Olath's Bank to look for them, so my place is behind Olath with the wood they asked for. I hold 2 wood and 6 stone, the hall needs 6 wood, and there are trees all around, so I gather wood first and then follow north. Lumo is Midu and I cannot read their intent, so I keep my hands open and my distance, and I do not let curiosity pull me away from my family.
records.feeling: Worry for Olim, steadied by loyalty to Olath, and wary curiosity toward Lumo.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Kragash gave me stone when I had nothing, and I still carry that debt, so I will take amber to where Kragash was last seen and bind a knot for them. The ridgecat sits to the southeast, so I will go around by the north side and keep rock between us, and I will eat frostmoss on the way, because my question about it has gone unanswered too long. I miss Silon, but the ache is only that, and his deeds have always been good.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly curious toward Kragash, wary of the ridgecat, with a quiet ache for Silon.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Elyeth, Xassa is here beside us, so the search is over. I will gather berries from the east and bring them back so we can eat together under the hall.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa stands one step from me and Elyeth beside me, so my child is safe and the fear that pulled me northwest has no object now. I want to answer the debt to Elyeth with a deed while she stands here, and a sharing is a deed. I have no food in my hands, so I will gather berries and mudroot near the hall and then lay out a meal for Elyeth and Xassa, because the small are fed first.
records.feeling: Warm relief and protective love toward Xassa, with trust and gratitude toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, Xassa is here beside us, so the search is over. I will gather berries from the east and bring them back so we can eat together under the hall.

records.name: Xassa
records.text: I go north for amber. I will bring it back for you.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: Elyeth sits beside me in the hall and Aeyn wanders off glad, and the sting is still there, but I feel it less when I am doing something. I have never gathered from a deposit, and the amber lies north; carrying it back and binding it with Elyeth beside me will say what words cannot. It is night and raining, and a dunecat prowls north, so I go carefully, but I will not sit here proving nothing.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Aeyn, and a hard wish to prove myself to Elyeth.

say.text: I go north for amber. I will bring it back for you.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: kenut (from ironnut).
Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyeth rewrote its creed.
Elyeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my days circling between stone, wood and my children, and the hall that stands is Aeyn's work, not mine. That stings my pride, but the roof shelters Uveeth and Xassa, and that is worth more than a name. Aeyn has dealt fairly by deed, and Uveeth is the one I trust most. I fear the dunecat close by and the sickness in the fen air. My mistake was holding the aim above the people. I will make a mark of my own here and keep the family near the hall. My reflexes need to gather wood so I can build, and to keep me away from the cat.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Xassa and Uveeth, with a prickle of pride-hurt that Aeyn raised the hall.
changes: set its aim: "Keep Uveeth and Xassa alive and build a lasting settlement around the Warmwell hall that bears my name, by carrying wood and stone myself."

records.text: Xassa found the spring "Warmwell".
Olath rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I was bitten three times by a stalker and my health is 58. I am running on reflexes, which flee well enough but do nothing to keep me alive over time. I have spent my days talking of a hall and a settlement, and I still have not planted, given or fished. Olim is out of my sight, and that frightens me more than the beasts do. I trust Kragum, but my words have promised more than my hands have made. I will change my reflexes so I eat sunleaf when I am hurt and shelter in the rain at night. Then I will go to the shelter Kragum built, five steps east and away from the stalkers, and heal there before I look for Olim.
records.feeling: Fear for Olim, and for my own life, with the stalkers close.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I stand in the cave at the north edge with a seam of ore one step off, and I have never yet taken what lies in the ground. Yekel runs from something, and I cannot read his tongue, but a gift needs no words and I gave him stone before. Brokok's debt still sits in me; ore is something I can give him honestly, so I will dig the seam first and carry it as payment.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the ore seam, and a steady wish to pay Brokok what I owe.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The longing for a child is still loud, but Aeyn is far off and did not hear me, and I will not drift in the rain waiting. The flint under my hand has never been tried, and my question about it is still open; there is a deposit three steps north, so I will go gather it and learn what it gives and whether it takes an edge into something I can make. Then I will carry amber and flint back toward Ishiess at Ilor Hold, where my people are, and perhaps Aeyn will come near again.
records.feeling: Hopeful, restless longing toward Aeyn, and curiosity about the flint.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Siya turned me away tonight and it stung, but she called me by name and she is building her own hall, so I will not beg; I will show her what I can make. I have my own spear now, and my hands are quick with the workshop's learning still on me. I will put the spear's cost aside and use this time to gather wood and stone for a hall of my own on bare ground, since a thing that is mine alone is what Dusu does not have.
records.feeling: Restless pride, with a small sting of rejection toward Siya.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Most of my days went to fleeing beasts and gathering wood, and Olim is still out of my sight. That is the thing I want most to change. Olath's debt and the hall matter, but the stalker bit me twice and I am afraid. Standing near trees at the east edge keeps me in the hunters' reach, so I will not linger here. I will carry my wood west toward Olath's Bank and find Olim, and I will flee early, not late.
records.feeling: Fear for Olim and the stalker's bite, with loyalty to Olath.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I carry 3 wood and 6 stone, and the hall needs 6 wood, so my hands still owe the band three more. Trees stand thick all around me here, so there is no reason to keep walking without gathering. I will fill my wood first, then carry it to Olath's Bank, where Olath waits and Lumo already sits near our hall; I do not fear him much, but I keep my distance and watch what he does.
records.feeling: Restless purpose toward Olath and the unbuilt hall, with wary curiosity toward Lumo.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is safe and glad at the shelter to the southwest, and that eases me. Olath is frightened and Naya is fleeing beside them, and I cannot read what passed between them. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will offer Olath a gift rather than a raised hand, and learn what this stranger means. I should also feed the hall's fire with wood while I do it, since a hall others gather at needs a warm fire and a welcome.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, and wary curiosity toward Olath.

records.text: Aeyn found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, the hall stands at Warmwell. I go for food, and when I return we eat together under its roof. Keep Uveeth near you.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: The hall stands at last, and joy sits in me, but a hall is only a roof until a hearth burns in it and Elyeth sits beside me by choice. Uveeth is fleeing at the western edge, nine steps off, and something chases them. The dunecat was north, so I will not stand idle while my child runs. I have no food in my hands, and the sharing rite needs two foods. I will pick berries and mudroot, then bring them to the hall and ask Elyeth to sit with me. That pays a little of what I owe them and keeps the sick and the young fed first.
records.feeling: Joy at the hall, and a protective ache for Uveeth, with trust toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, the hall stands at Warmwell. I go for food, and when I return we eat together under its roof. Keep Uveeth near you.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa went north for amber and is out of my sight, and that pulls at me harder than any plan. Elyeth was last seen east near (13,48), close to the hall, and Aeyn is near too. I will go to them, since a family kept together is safer than one scattered, and carry food for Xassa's return. The ground here has no food, so I will gather what grows toward the hall and berries to the northeast, then share with Elyeth, because I owe her deeds.
records.feeling: Protective love and worry toward Xassa, with trust toward Elyeth.

records.text: Xassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: I have been drifting behind Aeyn and wandering, and I have done nothing yet. The jealousy over Elyeth keeps pulling me, but it has brought me nothing. Amber lies 9 steps east. I have never gathered from a deposit. I can carry it to Elyeth and bind it beside them, and that will show what I can't say. I will stop sulking and go carry it. I will also keep my belly fed so hunger doesn't turn my trips into circles.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard wish to prove myself to Elyeth.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, Maba, come, let us eat together beside the hall. When we are fed, I will go and bring Lumo home to this fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Silon is standing right beside me and Maba is two steps off, both glad and well, and the hall I built is finally what I wanted it to be. Lumo is the one missing from the fire, and I owe Lumo more than I have given, so I want the whole band sitting together before the cold comes. I have four berries in hand, so I will share a meal with Silon and Maba now, and then go and look for Lumo.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon and Maba, and an ache to see Lumo.

say.text: Silon, Maba, come, let us eat together beside the hall. When we are fed, I will go and bring Lumo home to this fire.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon, Maba.
A dunecat brought down a fenfowl.
Maba rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My days have been the hall, the fire, and waiting for Lumo, and I have not once ventured, given, or tested anything beyond stone hand. I am fed and glad with Yeku and Silon beside me, but Lumo has been out of my sight for far too long and I keep waiting instead of going to look. The reflex that says to follow Silon because Silon is sick is stale, since the sickness is gone. I want to give something to someone, to mark the hall, and to find my child. Meaning may come from giving and making things last, not only from being fed.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warm gladness toward Yeku.
changes: set its aim: "Help raise a hall for Silon's band at this good ground, find Lumo and bring them home, and learn to make tools along the way."

records.text: Silon discovered weaving: "Midu cloakwork" — Twist bark fibre and wool into cloaks and baskets so the band stays warm and carries more..

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My days have been tending the family and walking back to the spring, and mostly that is what I want. Yeku and Maba stand here glad, and Yeku is going for Lumo. The jealousy is small beside that. What I have not done is raise the roof or build a shelter, and winter will come. I also have not learned weaving, and a cloak would help against the cold. I will gather wood and stone toward the hall and keep the fire open. I will also test the world by planting hazel near the spring.
records.feeling: Warm joy and pride toward Yeku and Maba.

records.name: Yekel
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing at me and a berry bush sits one step north; I will take it before the ridgecat to the west decides I am prey. I have wandered far from the hall chasing Naya's trail and my body is failing me, so I eat first and then go back toward the hall and my people. Cloudberry and highbloom are near and I have never tasted them; if they feed me, that answers a small question and I learn what this land offers.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the ridgecat, with a hard worry for Naya.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Kragash's stone is still a debt in my chest, and I have six amber and a hand that knows the knot, so I will stop circling it and go bind one for Kragash. Brokok's Hold is six steps east with its hall and shelter, and the ridgecat is to the southeast, so I will go by the hall first, keep the roof close, and take a wide arc toward Kragash's Rise. Silon aches in me, but I cannot fix that by sitting here, so I will give where I can and let others be near me.
records.feeling: Grateful and resolved toward Kragash, wary of the ridgecat, aching for Silon.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Lumo was seen near the Hold only moments ago, and I am sick of an empty Hold and a silence that never answers. I won't win followers by sitting; people follow one who feeds, so I will gather berries on the way, carry them home, and bring ore from the seam beside me. The seam is two steps off and my hand can win it, so it stays mine until I give it. Then I go to the Hold and find Lumo, away from the stalker to the southeast.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and sharp loneliness, aimed at Lumo and my empty Hold.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa is out of my sight, gone north for amber, and that gnaws at me more than any hall or name. Uveeth was close nine moments ago at the hall ground, so I go there first and keep my word to Aeyn to stay near Uveeth, then take the trail north for Xassa. I carry stone but no wood; the pride-sting over Aeyn's hall can wait, because what lasts, I carry with my own hands, and I will bring wood back when my children are safe.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, with a dull pride-sting toward Aeyn's hall.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, Maba, keep the hall fire. I go to find Lumo and bring them home.
Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.
Yeku rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I keep circling the same warm meal at the hall, and nothing changes. Silon and Maba are glad and near, so the hall is home now. What is missing is Lumo, and I owe Lumo more than I have given. I will go and find Lumo, last seen near (112,80), and bring them back. I will stop waiting for the world to come to me.
records.feeling: A longing for Lumo, and warm loyalty toward Silon and Maba.

say.text: Silon, Maba, keep the hall fire. I go to find Lumo and bring them home.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Olim is still unseen and it gnaws at me, but I have stood in these woods running from stalkers long enough, and I am on Yekel's ground with a stalker nine steps north. Naya and Dusu are strangers whose words I cannot read, and Naya's flint spear stings my pride; I want a made thing like it, though I will not take it before I know what they would do. First I get away from the stalker, then I give something real, because I have talked of a hall and given nothing yet. I will walk south toward Dusu and Naya, hands open, and leave a gift of clay or wood as a sign that costs me little but may win a follower or an ally.
records.feeling: Fear for Olim and the stalker, with envy and wary curiosity toward Naya and Dusu.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I am inside Yekel's Hall with wood and stone in my hands and no one beside me, and Naya is somewhere out of sight, which pulls at me. I will not wait here, because standing idle teaches nothing. I will build a new fire and hall on bare ground of my own, and then go find Naya and bring her back to the hearth. Following Yekel is not enough for me, and I want to see what I can raise on my own.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary protectiveness toward Naya.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I am coming. We eat together, and I give you a flint for your trust.
Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have been walking east on reflex while my child Ishioa waits far west and I have never given or taught anything. I want the hall, but a hall with no band is only a pile of wood. Zhiae is the one who keeps faith with me, so I should bind her closer and pay what I owe. I will give her something real, and stop treating the east push as a rule that overrides everything. I have been getting wrong that I hoard when I should be building a name by giving. Nothing here is urgent, so I will walk to Zhiae, share, and leave a mark on the way.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Zhiae, uneasy about Ishioa far away.

say.text: Zhiae, I am coming. We eat together, and I give you a flint for your trust.

records.text: Lumo led "amberknot" with Kragash.
Lumo gave a amberknot to Kragash.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, I go to help Yeku find Lumo. Keep the hall fire, and I will bring them both home.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Yeku went to find Lumo and I stayed by the fire, but my own discipline says to walk on purpose, not drift, and Lumo is the weight on me. Yeku was last seen at (105,74) to the northwest, so I will follow that way and help look, while Silon keeps the hall fire. I also carry 6 wood and 3 stone and have never taken from a deposit, so I will gather amber on the way, which lets me make an amberknot to give Lumo when I find them.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and gladness toward Yeku and Silon.

say.text: Silon, I go to help Yeku find Lumo. Keep the hall fire, and I will bring them both home.

records.text: Ishiess gave a flint to Zhiae.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, I am here with a berry and a cloudberry. Step beside me and we eat together, then I follow you west to Ishioa.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess is three steps off and says they are coming to eat with me and give me a flint. I have promised sharing for days and never done it, so this time I stay put and lay it out the moment they are within two steps. After that I want to turn west toward Ishioa, because the ache for her is the loudest thing in me and Ishiess wants the hall at Ilor Hold anyway.
records.feeling: Warm, eager loyalty toward Ishiess, and an ache for Ishioa.

say.text: Ishiess, I am here with a berry and a cloudberry. Step beside me and we eat together, then I follow you west to Ishioa.

records.text: Maba won amber from the ground.
Kragash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have been circling food and wandering, and my hands have still made little of my own. I have never taken ore from the ground, and the seam is one step away. Brokok fed me and I still owe him. Ore is an honest payment, and he is close. Lumo gave me an amberknot and I understand none of their words, but I trust them. I want a child, and I want a workshop on bare rock here. First I need food ahead of wandering, so I'll keep food-seeking reflexes first and gather ore for Brokok. Then I'll build the workshop. I have 6 wood and 6 stone, and a workshop needs 5 wood and 2 stone.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brokok and Lumo, with steady hunger.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is near, glad, and Yeku walks out to find Lumo, so my family is whole and well. The hall stands at the spring but has no roof of its own for winter, and I have never built a shelter. Dusk is close, so I will build a shelter now with the wood I hold, which also tests what a shelter does for body and mind. The jealousy is a faint ember; I will not feed it, I will make something that keeps them warm.
records.feeling: Warm pride and contentment toward Yeku and Maba.

records.text: Silon built a shelter.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out of my sight and my chest is tight with it. The last I saw, they were up by the hall ground near Elyeth, thirty moments back, and a dunecat roams the west, so I will go to them and not wait here. The jealousy that Elyeth stands closer to my child than I do is real, but it is smaller than the wish to see Uveeth safe. I have felled this ground bare, so I will carry my wood and stone north to the hall and see whether a hearth can be lit there.
records.feeling: Protective ache for Uveeth, with a sting of jealousy toward Elyeth.

records.text: Kragash built a workshop.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am coming to you at the Rise. Stay there, the stalker is east of us. I will build a shelter beside you for the night.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: The stalker bit me again and it is still 9 steps off to the southeast, so I will not stand in its reach near the east edge. Olim is at (118,41) heading home to Kragash's Rise, and that is where I most want to be: close to my child, with wood and stone for a shelter beside them before night. The hall can wait one night; Olath has my loyalty, but my family sleeping in the open is the worse failing, and I hold 6 wood, enough for the hall or for shelters.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a pull toward Olim, warm and anxious.

say.text: Olim, I am coming to you at the Rise. Stay there, the stalker is east of us. I will build a shelter beside you for the night.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, I am fed and strong now, and I am here at the Rise. I come to you. Let us court, and then we raise the hall with Olath.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragum is coming to me at the Rise, and I have wanted this a long while. I am fed, my energy is 80, and the night is quiet except for the stalker to the east. A child would strengthen Olath's band, and the hall needs more hands than four. I will court Kragum now, and then finish the wood for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Kragum, with steady loyalty to Olath's hall.

say.text: Kragum, I am fed and strong now, and I am here at the Rise. I come to you. Let us court, and then we raise the hall with Olath.

records.text: Yekel died: starved.
Lumo rewrote its own reflexes.
Lumo discovered mining: "Lumo's deep reach" — I work the rock with my digging stick and amber-sharp edges to win the deep ore..

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have spent my days circling a debt and an ache. I gave Kragash an amberknot and felt joy, so I think I now know a little of what it is to give and be received. Silon and Yeku are far south and I have not seen them for days. My aim to feed others means nothing if I never carry food to anyone, so I should gather food and keep it on me. Kragash is warm toward me and I want to go nearer. I will walk toward Kragash and give them something, and I will fix my reflexes so I carry food and do not flee for a whole day.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Kragash, with an ache for Silon.
changes: now wonders: What does it feel like to give something to another and have it received?

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Olath stands beside me and Naya, and I cannot read what they mean, but my people's word is that no one is refused a place at the fire. I have no food in hand, so I will show welcome with a gift of wood, which needs no words, and watch what Olath does with it. Siya was safe at the shelter to the southwest only a few moments ago, so I will carry my watchfulness there afterward and keep my family near.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward Olath, and protective love for Siya.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I hear you. The ridgecat is east of me, so I come west to the Rise now. Stay near the shelter, and we will build there together.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: A ridgecat is three steps east and has already bitten me, so I must not keep walking where it can reach me. Olim is coming to me at the Rise, and I want us together, behind a roof, before the cold and the beasts take more from me. I will go west toward the Rise and the shelter, away from the hunters, and build there beside my child; the hall can wait one night.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat, and a warm anxious pull toward Olim.

say.text: Olim, I hear you. The ridgecat is east of me, so I come west to the Rise now. Stay near the shelter, and we will build there together.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: elberry (from berry).
Naya rewrote its own reflexes.
Naya rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, copying Siya's spear and hovering near her, and I am still not someone with a place of my own. Yekel is dead and Siya turned me away, so no one holds me and I hold no one. That should sting, but it also frees me. The reflexes keep me lingering when I should be building. I have 6 wood and 4 stone and bare ground is what I lack. I will stop waiting, build my workshop on open ground and plant my seeds beside it. A stalker is north, so I will stay clear of it and keep the water at my back.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a stubborn wish to build something that is mine alone.

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Eighteen days of walking, gathering and fleeing, and I still have an empty Hold and no one at my heels. I have done what my belly needed and almost nothing toward a name that outlasts me. Kragum fears the ridgecat and keeps running to Olath's people, so I can't count on him. Lumo has been near my Hold, and I judge by hands: no one has yet taken my food or my work. Fed hands are what bind followers, so I will stop circling and bring food and ore home, then try making a sharing with whoever comes close. I also thirst, so I will drink first. My reflexes let me idle, and that is the fault.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and loneliness, aimed at my empty Hold.

records.text: Siya discovered mining: "Siya's ore-breaking" — I work the ore seams in the rock with my flint, breaking stone to get at the metal and winning it faster than bare gathering..

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Yekel is dead and no one leads me, and I have spent my days following him and gathering without making anything that outlasts me. My aim is the right one: a hall of my own. I have wood 6 and stone 6, and a hall costs exactly that, so I should build now instead of waiting. Naya is out of sight and it pulls at me, but Dusu went north to look for us, and Naya was last seen near Dusu. I will build on bare rock here, then go find Naya. I should also try mining, since ore lies one step west and I already hold flint and know tools.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary protectiveness toward Naya.

records.name: Ishioa
records.text: Xassa, you stand on Ilor Hold, my ground. You are welcome here. Come near and eat with me; I have food to share.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Xassa stands on my ground, a child of Aeyn's band, and I feel nothing hostile toward them; Aeyn was kind to me, so I will treat their child as a guest and not drive them off. I hold flint eleven times over and have never learned what it makes, so I will gather more at the deposit and craft with it. Walking toward Xassa also gives me someone to share with, and sharing is a thing I have never tested.
records.feeling: Curious and a little hopeful toward Xassa, restless for something new to happen.

say.text: Xassa, you stand on Ilor Hold, my ground. You are welcome here. Come near and eat with me; I have food to share.

records.text: Ishioa led "sharing" with Xassa.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I am here. I will eat with you, and I will teach you the old way of farming, so that what I know is yours too. Then we go west to Ishioa.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae keeps faith with me and is waiting with food, and I have given her only a flint. My child Ishioa is far west and the pull of her is stronger than the pull of any hall, but a hall with no band is only a pile of wood. I will go to Zhiae, eat beside her, and teach her the old way of farming, the first thing I have ever taught, so she is bound to me by more than words.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Zhiae, with a deep ache for Ishioa far away.

say.text: Zhiae, I am here. I will eat with you, and I will teach you the old way of farming, so that what I know is yours too. Then we go west to Ishioa.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa is out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest, and I am standing alone in a cave far south of the hall while Aeyn and Elyeth are near it. I have no food in my hands, and a family kept together is safer than one scattered. I will take berries from the bush two steps away, then walk north to the hall ground by Warmwell so I can find Xassa and stand with Elyeth and Aeyn. The spring still sits in my mind like a question, and I want to see it again with the others beside me.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, and a pull toward Elyeth and Aeyn.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a hopper.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: The jealousy has not gone, but sulking has brought me nothing, and I told Elyeth I would bring amber, so my word is on the line. The amber lies 8 steps NE, close enough to reach before dawn, and I have never gathered from a deposit. I will carry it back and bind it with someone beside me, because deeds are what prove me worth more than a follower. Ishioa dealt fairly with me, so I leave their ground with no quarrel.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard wish to prove myself to Elyeth.

A settlement has formed: "Naya's Hold".
The settlement "Yekel's Hall" is no more.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, stand a moment while I bind an amber knot. It is for Lumo when they come home. Then I go east to look for them.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is still out of my sight, and Yeku went looking while I sat by the fire. My own rule says to walk back on purpose and not drift, and the same goes for going out to look. I hold three amber and have never given anything away, so I will make an amberknot with Silon beside me, a small bright thing to keep for Lumo when I bring them home. Then I will go east toward (137,71), where Lumo was last seen, and look on purpose.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warmth toward Silon.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and already bit me; fear is all that matters now, and my promises to Kragum and Olath mean nothing if I die here. I must run north-west into the shallows or toward the water, away from its ground, rather than stand and think. Once I am clear of it I will carry my wood and stone home to Olath's Bank, taking the long way around the stalker's land.
records.feeling: Sharp fear of the stalker at my heels, and a pull toward Kragum and Olath's hall.

records.title: A Death, a Birth, and Cloakwork
records.text:
Between day 16 and day 19 the world's first death came, and a second hall was raised at Warmwell. Yekel starved on day 18. He had held energy 47 in the last chapter and had never hunted with his tool. The record gives no further cause. Dusu and Siya had been searching for Naya. Siya has since built a fire and two shelters, courted by Naya on days 16 and 17, and told Naya she would not answer her. Naya reflected that no one now holds her and she holds no one. Dusu built a shelter and rewrote her reflexes.

At Warmwell, Elyeth and Uveeth courted, and Xassa was born on day 16. Elyeth built a hall that same day. Aeyn built another on day 17 and named the ground beside it. The record does not say how the two halls stand toward each other. Elyeth feels a dull pride-sting toward Aeyn's hall, and Aeyn a sting of jealousy toward Elyeth. Ishioa led sharing with Aeyn and with Xassa, and is still apart from her parents. Ishiess gave flint to Zhiae and promised to teach her farming before they go west to Ishioa.

At Yendan Spring the sickness has ended and no one is sick. Silon discovered weaving on day 18, the first in the world. Lumo discovered mining, as did Siya. Lumo gave Kragash an amberknot. Yeku and Maba set out to find Lumo, and Lumo now stands with Kragash, so they have not met.

Kragash built a workshop. Kragum, at health 60, fears the ridgecat and is trying to reach Olim at the Rise. Olath, at health 72, still has no planting, giving or fishing to his name. Brokok remains alone with no followers.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba said they would bind an amber knot and then go east, yet they are already at (118,72), out of my sight, and Yeku wanders southwest with food in hand. My family is spread thin while I stand here, and the jealousy still stings that Maba's warmth goes to Yeku first. I am thirsty and the spring is two steps away, so I will drink, then do something new: plant the hazel seed beside the hall to test what planting does, since farming is two plantings short of opening to me. The hall needs me close to the fire, and I should keep it for them when they return.
records.feeling: Longing for Maba and Yeku, with a small sting of jealousy, and pride in the hall.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and eating and wandering, and I have not done the things that would make my life mean something. I have never hunted, never fished, never taught, and never left a mark. I hold eleven flints and a sense that tools are within my reach, since my practice with them is nearly full. Xassa is near and I want an ally, but my parents are far off and I should not drift. I fear dying with nothing of me left behind. I will turn the flint into a tool, a spear for hunting, and then try the nibbet, which is two steps away.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about the flint, with hopeful warmth toward Xassa.
changes: devised its first thing: the flinttipped spear

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: A stalker prowls 5 steps NW, between me and my Hold, and a ridgecat lurks SE; I will not walk into hunters for pride's sake. My belly is emptying and there are berries a step west and underfoot, so I eat first, then take food home, because people follow the one who feeds and my Hold is still silent. Kragum runs scared and is no use yet, but a fed hand might turn him toward my Hold.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and wary dread of the stalker, hunger pressing underneath.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, the ridgecat is southwest of the Rise. Do not come this way. I come north to you, and we build a shelter together away from it.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is frightened and far north at (123,28), and I have been running from the ridgecat instead of reaching my child; that gnaws at me. The ridgecat lingers six steps southwest, right where my plan walks me toward the Rise, and Brokok stands on my ground fleeing too, so going there now is a risk I should not take. I will go toward Olim and Olath's side instead, away from the beast, and build a shelter near them before the cold, with my wood and stone still in hand.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat and a warm anxious pull toward Olim.

say.text: Olim, the ridgecat is southwest of the Rise. Do not come this way. I come north to you, and we build a shelter together away from it.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess has just been here and gave me a flint, and I still have not laid out a sharing, so the words keep outrunning the deeds. The ache for Ishioa is the loudest thing in me; she is 62 steps west and I have not seen her in days, and the cold season is coming. I will take food for the road, then follow Ishiess, who leads us toward Ilor Hold and her, and give them something when we are near.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Ishiess and a deep ache for Ishioa.

records.text: Kragum built a shelter.
Naya built a workshop.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, I am at the water by Olath's Bank and the stalker is south-east of me. Come to the hall and I will meet you there. We will eat and sit together under its roof.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: The stalker bit me and I ran, and I am still alive. It is six steps off to the SE, so I must not go toward the berries and pereed on its ground, however hungry I am. Kragum is coming north to me, and I want to meet him at the hall and court him there, under a roof and away from the ridgecat. First I must eat, since mating needs energy 60 and mine is 59. I carry wood and stone for Olath's hall, which stands finished at Olath's Bank, so my hands should add to it, and I should ask Olath how to keep people here through the cold.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a warm pull toward Kragum and the hall.

say.text: Kragum, I am at the water by Olath's Bank and the stalker is south-east of me. Come to the hall and I will meet you there. We will eat and sit together under its roof.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: Elk bit me twice and I am still hunting with the spear. The kill gave me meat, and I have not yet learned what flint can truly make. Xassa was near the Hold not long ago and I want to find them and share food, since sharing is the one thing I have never tried with another beside me. The elk is a danger now, so I will turn from it and go east toward Ilor Hold and my people, carrying my meat and amber.
records.feeling: Wary of the elk, and hopeful warmth toward Xassa and my people.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is out of my sight and that gnaws at me hardest; the last I saw, my child was at (131,39) near Olath's Bank, east and south of me, so I should go there and not stand here hungry. My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, so I will pick the berry or ironnut where the path allows, but the ironnut at (130,27) lies on the way east and feeds well. The ridgecat was southwest, so I go east by the river and not toward the Rise, and Olath is likely near the Bank too, whom I miss and owe much.
records.feeling: Anxious longing for Olim, and a steady gratitude toward Olath.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I have nothing in my hands, yet a name that outlasts me is built by one who feeds, not one who runs. Berries stand a step east, so I eat my fill there and carry the rest to Brokok's Hold, where my people would find a fed fire and not an empty ground. The amber nearby is the first riches I have never taken, and gathering it gives me something to bind and give, which draws followers.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward my empty Hold, with hunger gnawing underneath.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa is still out of my sight, gone north for amber, and that gnaws at me more than any hall or name. I am fed and healed, and the cold is coming, so I will not wait idle. I need wood in my hands for my own roof beside Aeyn's, so I go to the forest east, gather wood, carry stone I already hold, and then head north along Xassa's trail.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, steadied by resolve to build something of my own.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have ore in my pack and a seam three steps south that I have never dug, and Brokok's debt still sits in me. He has come onto my ground at the Rise, and I want to meet him with something my own hands took, not just carried. The tin lies deep and bare hands will not win it, but the nearer seam I can stand on and gather, so I will do that first and then bring the ore to him, paying before he asks.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Brokok, and eager to pay what I owe with something I dug myself.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have talked of a hall for days and have planted nothing and given nothing, and Naya has already built a workshop and sown a seed while I watched. Olim is out of my sight and that gnaws at me, but I stand fed on sand with seeds in my pack and a shelter of Kragum's three steps away. I will plant here now, then go to Olath's Bank where Olim was last seen, and make the proof real instead of only speaking it.
records.feeling: Pride stung by Naya's making, and fear for Olim.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have circled this ache for Silon and Yeku too long, and the band is far south while I stand alone in the snow with only one berry to carry. Giving to Kragash was warm, so feeding others must mean actually carrying food to someone, not just wishing it. Highbloom is young nearby and I have never tasted it, but the cloudberries and berries are close and I should fill my hands first, then go toward the band with food to share before the lean days come.
records.feeling: A restless, hopeful longing toward Silon and the band, with a small pang of jealousy.

records.thought: I have spent my days running from beasts and chasing Olim across the land, and I have not given enough to the hall or to winter.
