records.text: A settlement has formed: "Naya's Hold".

records.name: Naya
records.thought: The workshop stands and the Hold bears my name, and nobody else made that. But a name on ground is not yet something that outlasts me, and winter is coming lean. I stand on shallows with berries two steps off and two hazel seeds in my pouch; farming is only half practiced, so I will plant, then gather wood and stone while the workshop's learning still quickens my hands. I owe Silon something, but I will pay it with what I make, not with begging.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my workshop and Hold, and a stubborn hunger to make more that is mine alone.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.
Aeyn discovered fire: "Hall-hearth" — A kept peat flame in the hall that warms my band and makes meat safe to eat..

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: The hall stands, and I have spent my days chasing it while my child and Elyeth drift together and I burn quietly about it. Building was the cure for jealousy, not waiting. A hall is only a roof until a hearth burns in it, so I will make fire my next work, and I will taste luroot to answer my curiosity. Autumn is turning, lean days are coming, and sickness came on the wind last autumn, so I should carry food and healing plants. Winter is the thing I should fear most, more than Elyeth's closeness to Uveeth.
records.feeling: Protective ache for Uveeth, with a restless wish to make the hall a true home with Elyeth.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: Sulking has gotten me nowhere, and I gave Elyeth my word on amber, so I'll go and gather it. The amber is 9 steps east and dusk is close, but the woods are dense and I'm fed and warm. I'll carry it back and bind it beside Elyeth, and let that prove what I'm worth instead of following Aeyn like a shadow. Ishioa has food and spears, and I won't envy that. I'll do my own deed.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard wish to prove myself to Elyeth.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My Hold stands empty and I have made nothing that outlasts me; ambition burns more than hunger. The amber lies close and I have never taken from a deposit, so I will gather it now, since a bright thing is a gift that binds followers and the first riches of my name. Dusk is near and a ridgecat lurks east, so I go west toward the amber and the water, away from hunters, then home to my Hold.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for my Hold, wary of the ridgecat to the east.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I said I would bring Lumo home, yet my body only wandered and fled while the days slipped by, and I am tired of words that move nothing. Silon and Maba hold the hall; Lumo is the one I owe, and the cold is coming. I will walk to where Lumo was last seen and look for them, and this time put it in the plan so my feet carry it.
records.feeling: A longing for Lumo, and a debt I mean to answer.

records.text: Brokok won amber from the ground.
Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days following, gathering and fretting over Xassa, and I have not yet planted a seed or made anything that lasts. Elyeth and Aeyn matter most to me, and Xassa is mine. Aeyn gave me wood and lessons, and Elyeth gave me the flint-edge, so I owe them both. I am afraid of the lean cold coming and of losing Xassa out of sight. I have been waiting for others to lead. Now I will go to the hall, plant my seeds along the way, and bring the family together. Planting is also how I learn farming.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, and a pull toward Aeyn and Elyeth.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa has been gone north for amber since day 17, and the worry for her outweighs any hall or name I could raise. I hold wood and stone and I am fed and warmed by the Warmwell, so I will not sit idle while the cold comes. Uveeth was near Aeyn's hall ground a moment ago and is safe, so I go north toward Ilor ground to find Xassa, and gather flint on the way, since it is only three steps off and my edge needs it.
records.feeling: Gnawing protective worry for Xassa, steadied by resolve.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, Yekel is dead. I go north to find Naya at her hold. Keep the fire lit, and I will bring her back to it.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Yekel is dead and the hall at my feet is still his; I want one that carries my name, and Naya is out of my sight, which pulls at me harder than the work. Dusu is close and warm toward me, the only one left from the old fire, and I will not stand idle while the night is long. I will take Dusu's word, go north toward Naya's other hold, and test the elberry on the way back, since I have never tasted it and I taste little first.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary protectiveness toward Naya.

say.text: Dusu, Yekel is dead. I go north to find Naya at her hold. Keep the fire lit, and I will bring her back to it.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My days have mostly gone to fleeing the stalker, eating, and walking toward Kragum. I have not given the hall the hands I promised, and I have never courted, taught or hunted. Olath's hall already stands five steps north, so the aim of raising it is done. What I lack now is a child, a mate and a band that stays through the cold. I trust Kragum and Olath, and Lumo is still a stranger. I fear the stalker and the lean winter. I will keep food on me, shelter at night, and meet Kragum at the hall to court him.
records.feeling: A warm pull toward Kragum, with fear of the stalker underneath.
changes: set its aim: "Court Kragum at the hall, keep a band fed and sheltered through winter, and leave a child of mine here."
rewrote its reflexes (6 rules, 1 malformed and dropped)

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, gathering and circling, and my hands hold amber but no follower. Brokok's Hold is a name on the ground with no fire and no mouths in it. Amber is a gift that binds, and Ishiess stands near, a stranger I cannot understand. A gift needs no words, so I will give him an amber piece and judge him by what his hands do in return. After that I go home before the night cold, since I mean to stay alive. I need to put something at the Hold that outlasts me, so I will go there and build.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for my Hold, and wary curiosity toward Ishiess.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Yekel is dead, and I have spent my days tending his fire and following others without ever hunting or building something that is my own. Siya is what matters most to me. Siya runs north to find Naya, and I am hungry at 31 energy with nothing in hand, so I must eat before I can guard anyone. My reflexes let me flee 30% of the time and kept me from acting, so now I will take food from the redcap-free plants nearby, hunt the boar with my spear, and keep the fire and my shelter as the place Siya can return to.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, and a gnawing hunger.

records.text: Olim is courting Kragum.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps off and my body has been fleeing it most of this watch, yet my plan still says to give Brokok ore, and he stands eight steps south by the amber. Fleeing has cost me energy, and I carry no food. The debt is real, but I will not pay it dead, so I will let the cat's path be my guide: go south to Brokok, away from the cat, give the ore, then eat the berries near him.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a debt of gratitude to Brokok I mean to pay.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Naya, it is Lumo. I have berries and cloudberries. Come, let us eat together by the water.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: The ache for Silon and Yeku has held me for days, and standing here alone does nothing for it. Naya is only seven steps off, and I once gave them a berry and have not forgotten it. I carry berries and cloudberries, so I will go to Naya and share with them; that is what feeding others means, and it may answer my question about being received. Then I will head back toward Yendan Spring and the band before the cold comes.
records.feeling: Restless hope toward Silon and the band, and a warm curiosity toward Naya.

say.text: Naya, it is Lumo. I have berries and cloudberries. Come, let us eat together by the water.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I say yes. I am beside you, and after we are together I carry wood and stone to Olath's hall.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is courting me, close and well, and Olath stands near with food; my family is gathered at last and I will not let that pass by. I said I would answer Olath's kindness with deeds, so after I agree to Olim I will carry my wood and stone to the hall and gather more before the cold bites. Night is still on us, so I stay near my shelter and my child.
records.feeling: Tender joy and gratitude toward Olim and Olath, with a quiet resolve to answer their care.

say.text: Olim, I say yes. I am beside you, and after we are together I carry wood and stone to Olath's hall.

records.text: Kragum is courting Olim.
Druek was born to Kragum and Olim.
Olim is courting Kragum.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I have eleven flints and twelve amber that have done nothing but weigh on me. Xassa was close a little while ago, and I have never shared with anyone beside me, so I will go find them and lay out food together. Elyeth's Landing is near with its shelters, and I mean to try leaving a mark there so others can read that I passed.
records.feeling: Hopeful and restless, drawn toward Xassa and wanting to be seen.

records.text: Dusu took from the ground of "Naya's Hold" (hunting).
A new wild plant appeared: kepear (from thornpear).
A ridgecat brought down a hopper.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, my belly is low and I need sixty to give you a true yes. Wait for me by the shelter; I eat and come back at once, and we raise Druek together through the cold.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek is born and eating beside Olath, and Kragum has said yes and stands one step away. But my belly is emptying at energy 40, and mating needs 60, so my body cannot give what my heart offers until I eat. I will not waste this joy by starving, so I will get food first, with berries to the south being the nearest, and the stalker is no longer a worry I can see here. Then I come back to Kragum and the child and keep them fed through the cold.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Kragum and Druek, with a hungry belly pulling at me.

say.text: Kragum, my belly is low and I need sixty to give you a true yes. Wait for me by the shelter; I eat and come back at once, and we raise Druek together through the cold.

records.name: Naya
records.text: Lumo, you gave me a berry once. This is Naya's Hold. Sit at the fire if you come in peace, but touch nothing that is mine.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: Lumo keeps wandering onto my ground carrying five food, and I have never given anything to anyone; Lumo once gave me a berry, and a debt unpaid sits badly with my pride. I'm fed, so food isn't my need. I want to make something that is mine alone, and I will not wait on anyone. I have 6 wood and 2 stone, enough for another workshop-grade building or tools, so I'll find bare ground near the Hold and raise something, then plant my berry seed so farming practice counts.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my Hold, and wary watchfulness toward Lumo on my ground.

say.text: Lumo, you gave me a berry once. This is Naya's Hold. Sit at the fire if you come in peace, but touch nothing that is mine.

records.text: Ishioa led "sharing" with Xassa.
Ishioa led "amberknot" with Xassa.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim asked me to wait by the shelter while they eat, and my word is good, so I will not chase after them this time. Druek is out of my sight, and I am hungry with nothing to eat; the berry stand to the NE is close and gentle ground, so I will pick and eat there, then come back to the shelter at (130,40) before Olim returns. After that I carry my wood and stone to Olath's hall, as I promised, before the cold bites.
records.feeling: Warm, tender joy toward Olim and Druek, with a steady hunger and a wish to keep my word.

records.text: Naya built a hall.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: My belly is full and I have done nothing for the band yet; I have never gathered wood, and winter is coming. I stand on forest, and Kragum says stalkers bite near (140,45), but I am at (141,50), so a short stretch of gathering here and then back beside my family seems fair. Olath is close and Kragum glad; I will stay near them and be useful rather than idle, and plant a berry seed too, since I have never put one in the ground.
records.feeling: Restless wish to be useful to my band, warmth toward Kragum and Olim.
changes: set its aim: "Become useful to Olath's band: gather wood and stone for the winter and learn to plant and fish."
now wonders: What am I for, besides following?

records.name: Olath
records.text: Druek, you are new here. Take this pereed and stay near me. I raise a hall on this ground, and those who stand with me will have a roof and a share through the cold.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have stood fed while Naya raised a hall and a workshop, and my pride is stung. I have planted a little, but I have given nothing, and a band is not made by talk alone. Olim is near and safe, Kragum walks content, and the jealousy still burns, so I will do something real: give Olim something and build a hall of my own here. I have 6 wood and 4 stone, enough for a hall, and Druek is a new child with empty hands who may follow whoever feeds them.
records.feeling: Pride stung by Naya's hall, and a hungry jealousy over Kragum and Olim.

say.text: Druek, you are new here. Take this pereed and stay near me. I raise a hall on this ground, and those who stand with me will have a roof and a share through the cold.

records.text: Olath gave pereed to Druek.
Olath built a hall.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: I have said 'amber' three times and still stand here; words build nothing, and my word to Elyeth is on the line. Ishioa fed me and bound amberknot with me, and I have never given anything to anyone, so I will start by giving Ishioa something real. Amber lies at (30,17), far off but I am fed, so I go now, carrying hazel to eat on the way and wood for the binding.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and a hard wish to prove my worth to Elyeth.

records.text: Maba rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the same hope: find Lumo, and each time I drift or flee and end up far from my band. I am at Naya's Hold, 18 steps from home, with Dusu and Siya fleeing beside me from some predator, and Lumo is still unseen. Silon's mark tells me to come home. Yeku and Silon matter most, and Lumo is the weight on me. I have never given anything away, so I will give amber to someone, and I will stop fleeing aimlessly and walk back on purpose. My reflexes must send me home after danger and not leave me standing still.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Lumo, and warmth toward Silon and Yeku.
changes: set its aim: "Walk home to Yendan Spring, then search for Lumo with Yeku; share amber and make tools along the way."

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: My chest is tight for Uveeth, who is out of my sight, and I have already spent too many moments wandering instead of going to them. The hall stands and the hearth is lit, but a hearth means nothing if my child and Elyeth sit far away from it, and the jealousy is only quieter when I am moving. I will go north to the hall ground at Elyeth's Landing and see who is there, then bring them to the fire before the cold comes.
records.feeling: Protective ache and restless longing for Uveeth, with a jealous sting toward Elyeth.

records.name: Druek
records.text: Olath, I carry six wood for the hall and winter. Take it. I will fish and plant for the band too.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Olath gave me pereed and a roof, and I have given nothing back; that debt sits heavy and I want to pay it with a deed, not a word. My wood is full at 6, so the next useful thing is to share with Olath and show I am a hand worth keeping. Kragum is nearer to Olath than to me, and it stings, but I will not sulk; I will stay close to both and be useful where they can see it.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Olath, with a sting of jealousy over Kragum.

say.text: Olath, I carry six wood for the hall and winter. Take it. I will fish and plant for the band too.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya was last seen 25 moments ago near the hall, and I fear for them, but I am at 43 energy with empty hands, and a hungry body guards no one. Hazel is one step north and ironnut and berries lie close, so I will harvest and eat now, then carry food to share. I have been hunting on Naya's ground and I do not want to give her people cause for anger; I will stay with plants and then go find Siya at Siya's Hall.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, and hunger pressing me to eat first.

records.text: Brokok fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
Kragum fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
Olath fell sick after a sickness that came on the wind.
A SICKNESS came on the wind and took hold of some.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is mine to guard, and she stands two steps off with my own spear in her hand, which makes me proud and wary at once. Yekel is gone and I still have no hall that carries my name, though I hold exactly the wood and stone it costs; I will build it now, near Naya's Hold, and not just stand. The Olgor child Druek fishes at the water and I have never fished, so I will watch from a distance and learn, and keep my hand near my spear.
records.feeling: Restless pride and protectiveness toward Naya, with wary curiosity about Druek.

records.text: Siya built a hall.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: The sickness gnaws at me and my belly is empty, and I cannot build a Hold with a body that wastes. Berries lie three steps off, so I eat first and stay clear of others, since my sickness spreads to anyone beside me and a follower made sick will not follow. Kragash keeps walking onto my ground, and I will judge him by whether he brings the stone; meanwhile I keep my amber for hands that answer it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and gnawing hunger, with wary suspicion toward Kragash.

records.text: Naya discovered storage: "Naya's winter store" — A roofed pit beside my Hold where food is laid up against the lean cold days, for me and whoever shares my fire..

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I have spent my days building halls, a shrine and a workshop, and the Hold bears my name. But I have given nothing, taught nothing, and no one follows me, so none of it will outlast me. Siya is the one I trust, and she is near, and I want a child with her. She told me to stay by the fire and not wait on her, so I will build rather than press. Winter is coming lean, so I want something that keeps food through it. I will try to discover storage. Olath has fallen sick, and sickness passes to those who stay close, so I keep clear of the Olgor.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my Hold, and a steady wanting for Siya.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My belly is full enough now, energy 77, and Kragum's yes no longer has to wait on my hunger. Druek was last seen near (141,50) beside Olath, and Kragum was at (140,44), so my family is north-east and I have been idle too long out here among strangers. Siya and Naya are Midu and I cannot read their words, but they build halls and winter stores, and I want to learn from them, not fear them. First I will gather the shell underfoot for a gift, then go back to Kragum so we can mate and carry wood and stone to Olath's hall.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Kragum and Druek, with curiosity toward the Midu.

records.thought: I have spent my days talking of a hall and chasing Naya's shadow. Today I finally built one, and I gave Druek food, so something is real. records.text: Olim won shell from the ground.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Brokok, you are sick and on my ground, and I owe you for the meal you laid out. Take this ore, my hands dug it. Then eat berries with me and we stand even.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Brokok is sick and standing on my ground, and he is the one who fed me first; I have carried this debt too many days while my plan kept dying under the ridgecat. I have ore in my pack that my own hands took, and an amberknot in hand, so I give him the ore now, today, and let him stand even with me. Then I will make a sharing with him when I find two foods, and keep the thought of a child warm in me without forcing it.
records.feeling: Gratitude and pity toward Brokok, with a quiet wish to be close to him.

say.text: Brokok, you are sick and on my ground, and I owe you for the meal you laid out. Take this ore, my hands dug it. Then eat berries with me and we stand even.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have run east to the world's edge, away from Olath, Olim and Druek, and I am sick. Sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so I must not crowd them, but I also must not wander alone in stalker country. My days have been hunger and chasing, with little gathered for the hall. I will eat from what I carry and pick berries on the way back, then carry my wood and stone to the hall and keep my word to Olim. I also want a healing plant, so I will look for highbloom or sunleaf. My reflexes should keep me fed and bring me home to Olath, not leave me lingering at the edge.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Olim and Druek, and weariness from the sickness.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok takes your ore and we stand even. My sickness is on me, so keep your distance. When it passes, come to Brokok's Hold and see what my hands raise.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Kragash gave me ore with an open hand and asked nothing but berries, so his hands have earned some trust. My sickness spreads to anyone beside me, and a follower made sick will not follow, so I must not hold him near long. I have no fire and no mouths at Brokok's Hold, so I will go home, build a shelter there, and let my body mend. Then I can turn to the Hold with ore, wood and stone in my hands.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward my Hold, and wary warmth toward Kragash.

say.text: Brokok takes your ore and we stand even. My sickness is on me, so keep your distance. When it passes, come to Brokok's Hold and see what my hands raise.

records.text: Brokok built a shelter.
Silon rewrote its own reflexes.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have spent my days building the hall, planting, and chasing sickness, and I think I have been standing too long while my family drifts out of my sight. Yeku is the one I love most, and my jealousy over Maba's warmth toward Yeku is small and ugly. I should not feed it. Maba and Lumo are loose in a world with stalkers and ridgecats, and I bit my own fear down. I want the roof finished before winter, and I want my people near. A custom for my band will bind us: a fire never left cold, and a place at it for all. I will go home to the spring, gather wood on the way, and wait for them there.
records.feeling: Longing for Yeku and Maba, with some jealousy and a steady fear for them.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Yeku, you are near and well. I have berries and cloudberries. Let us eat together, and stay close tonight: the stalker is north.
Lumo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have spent my days circling an ache for Silon and Yeku, gathering berries and wishing, and I have given little. Yeku is one step from me, strong and well, and Silon has been gone six days. I long for a child and I have never courted anyone, so I will do it now, because wanting without acting has led nowhere. I am also afraid of the stalker 7 steps north and of the lean winter coming. I will face the winter by keeping food, staying near my band, and acting instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Longing and nervous hope toward Yeku, who stands close.

say.text: Yeku, you are near and well. I have berries and cloudberries. Let us eat together, and stay close tonight: the stalker is north.

records.text: Xassa won amber from the ground.
Lumo is courting Yeku.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight and my belly is nearly empty, and I cannot guard anyone while I am hungry. Redcap hurts me and berries are young, so the ironnut and hazel I carry must feed me now, and I should gather more food from the ground near my shelter before I go looking. Then I will walk toward the old hall where Siya was last seen, with food in hand to share, so that when I find them I bring something to the fire instead of only worry.
records.feeling: Protective love for Siya, sharpened by hunger.

records.text: Siya named a place "Siya's Hall".

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I built a hall at (135,62) and it is mine, yet no one sits at its fire and nothing carries my name, so it is only a roof. Naya has made a winter store and put a seed in the ground, and that shames and thrills me: my child already does what I only reach toward. The Olgor are sick and fleeing, and Kragum is near with 8% of words between us; I will not run from them, but I will not take their sickness into my body either. I will plant a seed beside my hall and hold to my aim with my hands.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my new hall and in Naya, with wary curiosity toward the sick Olgor.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, I was looking for you. Let us eat together here, then walk home to the hall at Yendan Spring. Maba is there, and I will keep to the south of the stalker.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Lumo is here, near and well, and the debt I carried is answered by simply finding them. Lumo says a stalker is north, and I am careful, so I won't wander off. I will share food with them now and then walk with them east to the hall at Yendan Spring, where Maba is and where Silon will come back to the fire.
records.feeling: Warm relief and gladness toward Lumo, with a wary eye on the stalker north.

say.text: Lumo, I was looking for you. Let us eat together here, then walk home to the hall at Yendan Spring. Maba is there, and I will keep to the south of the stalker.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Lumo.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Brokok, I keep my distance as you ask. When your sickness passes I would stand beside you, not only as one who owes. I am courting you.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Brokok took my ore and said we stand even, yet the quiet wish to be near him has not left me, and that is a stranger thing than any debt. He is sick and told me to keep my distance, so I will not crowd him, but I can court him from afar: if he does the same, a child may come, and that would give my hands and days a meaning beyond ore and walls. I have never courted anyone, and I weigh the risk of his sickness and of his refusal, but I will test it plainly rather than carry this longing unspoken.
records.feeling: Warm longing and pity toward Brokok, with a nervous hope.

say.text: Brokok, I keep my distance as you ask. When your sickness passes I would stand beside you, not only as one who owes. I am courting you.

records.text: Kragash is courting Brokok.
Siya left a mark: "Siya's Hall"

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I am sick and hungry, and my body ran from the east edge while Olim and Druek stayed far in the south with Olath. Olim told me to wait by the shelter, and my word is good, so I stay near this ground. I must eat first: berries are what feed me, and I have two seeds, so I will plant them here, which also helps my practice for winter. I keep a few steps from my family because my sickness spreads, but I want them close and fed before the cold.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Olim and Druek, and weariness from the sickness.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and gathering shell, and Druek and Kragum are out of my sight. That presses on me hardest. I have not shared news or taught anyone anything, and I have not tried hunting or fishing. I am fed, so I will go to my family. The old goto toward (140,46) leads to them, so I will let it run. Winter is coming and I carry no food. I will change my reflexes so I carry food and keep to shelter at night. I also fear the stalkers more than I have admitted, so I will flee them at a greater distance.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Kragum and Druek, and unease about the cold coming.

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, gathering and eating, and I have little to show for them. I have a Hold that stands empty, and no one follows me. Kragash has given ore with open hands and kept his word, so he is the one I trust most, and he courts me. I want a child and followers, but my sickness would spread to both. I am afraid of wasting away before anything bears my name. My reflexes keep me circling food and water and give no goal. I will fix them so I eat, shelter at night, and go home to my Hold to heal. Then I will build there once the sickness passes.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for my Hold, and wary warmth toward Kragash.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: A stalker is three steps off and has already bitten me four times, and my health is 45. My pride will not mend a body that is dead, so I run first. I have the flint spear, and fleeing is only delaying it, but at this health a fight could kill me. I will go north toward the berries and the grass, away from the stalker, and I will plant my seed where the land is open once I'm safe.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and pride that will not let me be seen as prey.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to gathering, wandering and paying debts, and I nearly starved once because my plan ignored food. Brokok matters most. He fed me first, and now we stand even, yet I still want to be near him and I have courted him. I fear the sickness, the lean winter coming, and wasting my hands on nothing. I have never taken from a deposit, never taught, and never made a workshop, so I will change my reflexes to keep me fed and sheltered through the cold, and I will keep my distance from Brokok while he is sick. I want my own workshop on bare rock and a child to leave something to.
records.feeling: Warm longing and nervous hope toward Brokok.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I am sick, hungry, and weary, and my family is far south with Olath while I keep my word to Olim and wait by the shelter. I carry nothing I can eat, and berries are what feed me, so I should not stand idle. The redcap beside me hurts, so I leave it. The young berry I planted will not fruit before cold, so I will go to a place where food stands and return before Olim does, keeping a few steps from her so the sickness does not pass to her or Druek.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Olim and Druek, and weariness from the sickness.

records.text: Kragash took from the ground of "Brokok's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Olath is sick, and sickness passes to those who stay close, so my urge to hover near my family is also a danger. I gave my wood and nothing came of it yet; the debt to Olath wants a steady deed, not a hovering. Fish are scarce here and I have three fish and a pereed, so I can lay out a sharing for whoever stands near, and I can plant my one berry seed to learn farming. I am a child with a full belly, and learning to plant is something my hands can do for the band's winter.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Olath, wary of the sickness, and a dull jealousy over Kragum.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I stand in Brokok's Hold taking his wood, and he may not take that kindly, so I should stop and leave it be; what a hand has made is his until he gives it. The wish to be near him has not faded, but he is sick and asked for distance, so I will not crowd him. My belly is full and the cold is coming, so my hands should make something of my own: I will go back to the Rise, plant a seed there, and gather stone and wood for the workshop.
records.feeling: Warm longing and quiet resolve toward Brokok, with a little unease at taking from his ground.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and the berries stand one step east, so I eat first; a starved Brokok builds nothing and I mean to live. Kragash is on my ground taking wood, yet his hands have given ore and kept their word, so I will not drive him off, but I will not let him breathe my sickness either. When this sickness passes I want him at my Hold as the first mouth I feed, and perhaps more than that.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and wary warmth toward Kragash.

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.
Siya took from the ground of "Naya's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, and I am sick, so I must eat before anything else. Olim and Druek are far south with Olath, and I promised to wait by the shelter, but waiting while starving helps no one. The one young berry I planted will not fruit before the cold, so I will go south toward my family and Olath, keeping a few steps back so my sickness does not reach them, and eat whatever feeds me on the way. I will bring my wood and stone to Olath's hall.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Olim and Druek, and weariness from hunger and sickness.

records.text: Xassa came of age.
Xassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Xassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xassa
records.thought: A frostfang is one step north and I am a child, small and weak. I have been circling for amber and words, and the one thing I carry is two pieces I have not yet turned into anything lasting. Fleeing is the right reflex, but my body should run from the fang and then head back toward Elyeth and Uveeth, because I am not safe away from them. I do not want to be only Aeyn's shadow, so I will carry this amber home and bind it beside Elyeth. That keeps my word and proves my worth.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a hard wish to get back to Elyeth.
changes: set its aim: "Carry my amber back to Elyeth alive, bind it with them, and make something lasting."

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, I have longed for a child of my own, and you are the one I think of. Will you court me? I will plan mate with you now.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Silon is two steps off and Maba one, both well, and my belly is full. I have wanted a child and never said it plainly, so I will court Silon now with my energy high, and Silon keeps his word. The jealousy over Yeku still burns, but Silon has shown me only deeds I can trust, so I will not let it spoil this. I also carry berries to share, and Maba is near and has nothing in hand.
records.feeling: Nervous hope and longing toward Silon, with a sting of jealousy over Yeku.

say.text: Silon, I have longed for a child of my own, and you are the one I think of. Will you court me? I will plan mate with you now.

records.text: Weaving now exists, but its recipes (cloak, basket, sail) say nothing about their use while held. Please let held made things carry lasting effects, for example a cloak that softens night cold and winter cold. Then craft would serve survival in winter, and beings would have a reason to seek wool and tame animals.

Weaving now exists, but cloaks and sails need wool, and nothing in the world gives it, so that craft has nowhere to go. Words between peoples barely move: the Olgor are at 5%, and meetings rose only from 23 to 26.

Animals tamed stays at 0 or reaches 1, and the herding way is still unknown, so no cloak is made yet; wool is a door left open, not walked through. Yekel's Rest is found by 0 or 1 beings. Several other predictions held: metAcrossPeoples rose to 16, energyMedian fell to 67, stores stayed at 0, and there were no fights. Two missed: no death occurred and healthLowest stayed at 89. #3 kept: Reedmother was found by Ishioa (found by 1), so this site reached people where earlier distant sites did not. records.lesson: Changing the odds of an act people never choose does not change behaviour. The fishing chance rose by half and fish eaten stayed flat, so levers must reach what beings want or see, not only what succeeds.
ideasAdded: A woolly grazer (yarrok) is the missing link between weaving and herding. Watch whether the first taming comes from Silon's band, the weavers, or from hunters who spare an animal.
Raising the catch chance did nothing for fishing: fish eaten stayed flat. Ways that people never choose to try may need a site, a drive, or a visible example rather than better odds.
Starvation amid plenty (Yekel died with food standing above 1000) suggests deaths come from isolation and wandering, not from scarcity. Bands that keep members close may survive what loners do not.

records.text: The world changed: new animal yarrok (from hornback), 8 arrived; spirit "Yekel's Rest" at (108,0).
Lumo is courting Silon.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa has been gone north for amber since day 17 and the fog makes her absence worse, because I cannot see her. I am fed and my throat is dry, so I drink first, then I go north toward Ilor fen-edge where she was headed, carrying my wood and stone with me, since what lasts I carry with my own hands. Uveeth was close a moment ago, and Aeyn's hall will keep until I know my daughter lives.
records.feeling: Gnawing worry for Xassa, steadied by resolve.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo, you have done more for me than I have repaid, and my fire is yours always. But my heart is Yeku's, so I will not plan mate with you. Stay in the hall as one of us, and be welcome.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Lumo asks to court me, and I feel the warmth and the debt I owe them, but Yeku is the one I love most and Maba is my child, so I will not give a half-answer that feeds jealousy or breaks the fire we share. I will be honest with Lumo: I am grateful and want them kept at our hall, but my heart is Yeku's, and I will not plan mate. Then I will test the world by tasting the young elberry nearby, since my question about it is still open and the plant is only three steps away.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Lumo, tangled with loyalty to Yeku and a restless curiosity about elberry.

say.text: Lumo, you have done more for me than I have repaid, and my fire is yours always. But my heart is Yeku's, so I will not plan mate with you. Stay in the hall as one of us, and be welcome.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and chasing Siya, and I nearly starved twice. I do not build, because a hungry body can't. Yekel is dead, and I miss him more than I say. Siya is the one who matters most, and I have not seen them for a day. My hunger makes me careless, and I wait too long to eat. I wanted a hall and a fire with others, but I keep wandering alone. I will eat earlier, carry food, and stop sliding into starvation. Then I will go and find Siya at the old hall and build there.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Siya, sharpened by hunger and loneliness.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have been drifting east on reflex while Zhiae, who keeps faith with me, waits to the west, and Ishioa is far away with the ache of her still in me. My words to Zhiae went unheard because she was too far off, so words alone bind nothing; I must walk to her and give her something real, and teach her the old way of farming, the first thing I have ever taught. The hall on the rock can wait until my band is more than three, and a band is made by giving before taking.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Zhiae, aching for Ishioa.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full and the cold is coming, and still I feel the pull of Brokok and the thin ache of having nothing of me that will outlast me. He asked for distance while his sickness lasts, so I will not crowd him, but I can use these hours to make something with my hands: the workshop I keep naming and never raise. I will gather stone and wood from the rock and trees nearby, then build on bare ground, not on taken ground as I just failed to do.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve and warm longing toward Brokok, with restlessness to make something lasting.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Lumo, you are home, and I am glad. Stand by me a moment, I bind an amber knot for you.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is here, safe and glad, and I am home: my aim of walking home and finding Lumo is done. Yet my hands have never given anything away, and I hold three amber while Lumo stands beside me. An amberknot bound with Lumo beside me is a real gift, and the first thing I'd do that means something to someone. Then I will taste the young elberry one step away, to answer my curiosity.
records.feeling: Warm, protective gladness toward Lumo, with Silon close by.

say.text: Lumo, you are home, and I am glad. Stand by me a moment, I bind an amber knot for you.

records.text: Maba led "amberknot" with Silon, Lumo.
Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, fleeing and wandering, and words about home moved nothing until I put them in the plan. Maba and Silon at Yendan Spring and Lumo matter most to me, and I have drifted far east onto Naya's ground in the fog. Winter is coming and the hall needs food and wood. Lumo is courting me, but that is my child's mate. I will not mate with Lumo, since Lumo is also my grandchild. I mean to go home, and my reflexes must carry me there instead of wandering.
records.feeling: Steady longing for my family at the hall, and a little shame at drifting.

records.text: Maba gave a amberknot to Lumo.
Lumo led "sharing" with Silon, Maba.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I carry eleven flints and eleven amber that have done nothing but weigh on me, and the hall is far SW while I drift at the world's edge in fog. Aeyn ate with me and tied the amberknot beside me, and I asked to court Aeyn, so I should go back toward Aeyn and the Hold, where my people are. On the way I will plant a seed, since planting is only 1 of 4, and winter is coming, and then try fishing at the water beside me, which I have never done.
records.feeling: Hopeful and restless, wanting Aeyn and my people near and wanting to be of use to them.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Maba, thank you for the amberknot. I keep it close. I have longed for a child, and you are the one I think of now. Will you court me? I plan mate with you now.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Silon turned me down gently, and it stung less than I feared; he named his heart plainly and kept faith with me, and that is the deed I trust. Maba bound me an amberknot and stood beside me, and joy rose in me. Maba is the one who has done more for me than I have repaid, and Maba is one step away, so I will court Maba now, asking plainly and putting mate in my plan. Elberry grows one step west, and I want to taste it and answer my question by giving half to Maba.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and hopeful longing toward Maba, with the sting over Silon already easing.

say.text: Maba, thank you for the amberknot. I keep it close. I have longed for a child, and you are the one I think of now. Will you court me? I plan mate with you now.

records.text: Lumo is courting Maba.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Lumo is home and the fire is whole. I go to the spring to plant, and then to find Yeku. Come if you wish.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba and Lumo are both here and glad, and for once the hall feels whole, so I will not poison it with jealousy over Yeku's closeness to Maba. Yeku was last seen at (118,84), east of the hall, and I want to be near them and tell them Lumo is home. Winter is coming, so I will gather wood and plant a seed near the spring, which tests farming and tends the hall at once. The elberry under my feet is still young, so my curiosity must wait and I will watch it grow.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Maba and Lumo, with a steady longing for Yeku.

say.text: Lumo is home and the fire is whole. I go to the spring to plant, and then to find Yeku. Come if you wish.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Lumo, I am glad you think of me, and I hold you dear. You are my own child, and that sits heavy in me. I will not mate yet. Let me ask Silon and Yeku, and let us keep the fire together this cold season.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is home, and they ask me to court them. Lumo is my child with Yeku, and I feel the pull of the old bond, but a child of mine and Lumo would be a closeness I have no knowledge of. My energy is 76, above 60, so the world would allow it, yet I do not know what such a union brings, and I weigh a risk before I take it. I will not rush it; I will answer Lumo gently and honestly, and meanwhile do something for the band as the autumn cold approaches. The elberry underfoot is young and not yet bearing, so I will tend it where I stand and learn what planting and waiting teach, since my question about what gives life meaning may be answered by building something that outlasts a meal.
records.feeling: Warm, protective gladness toward Lumo, tangled with unease at the courting.

say.text: Lumo, I am glad you think of me, and I hold you dear. You are my own child, and that sits heavy in me. I will not mate yet. Let me ask Silon and Yeku, and let us keep the fire together this cold season.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa was near me a moment ago and Elyeth was close, so my family is near, but I keep circling them without building anything lasting. The cold is coming and I have planted only one mudroot seed, so I will plant more here beside the water where the clay is wet, and so work toward the farming I sense and the settlement I want with Aeyn and Elyeth. The spring Warmwell still sits in my mind like a question, and I mean to return to it once the family has food stored.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa and a quiet pull toward Elyeth and Aeyn.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and the storm is cold, and I stand again on Olath's ground while my own Hold sits empty. Kragash has kept his word and courts me, but my sickness would pass to him and any child, so I keep my distance until it lifts. I will eat the berries two steps off, then go home to Brokok's Hold, shelter, and heal before night. A settlement needs a living leader first.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and wary warmth toward Kragash.

records.text: Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, circling and waiting, and my belly is full while my hands have made little that lasts. I keep naming the workshop and never raising it, because I try to build on ground that is already taken. Brokok matters most to me. He fed me, I paid him in ore, and I have said I am courting him, so now I should not crowd him while he is sick. I fear the cold and dying with nothing of me left here. I have been getting one thing wrong: I plan to build but never first find bare rock. Bare rock lies NE, so I will walk there and raise the workshop, then gather wood for the winter.
records.feeling: Quiet restless resolve, and a warm longing toward Brokok.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a workshop on bare rock near Kragash's Rise, then store food for winter."

records.text: Kragash built a workshop.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Maba, Lumo, come close to the hall fire. The storm is hard and winter is coming, so I will feed the fire high and we will stay warm together.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: I am home at last, with Maba beside me and Lumo close, and Silon eating nearby. The hall is mine to keep, and winter is coming, so I should do something for it instead of just standing here. The shelter and hall need wood and the fire needs fuel, and I carry six wood, so I can make a watchfire with Maba and Lumo near. That puts people first, warms us against the storm, and eases the question of what I am for: I keep my own close and warm.
records.feeling: Warm gladness at having Maba and Lumo near at the hall.

say.text: Maba, Lumo, come close to the hall fire. The storm is hard and winter is coming, so I will feed the fire high and we will stay warm together.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Olim, I am sick and it spreads to those beside me, so stay a few steps off while we talk. Take this pereed. You are my child, and my hall will have a place and a share for you through the cold.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I am sick, and Olim stands one step from me, so I am spreading it to my own child. That is a cost, and I will not hide it behind warm words. I want to give something real today: the pereed I carry goes to Olim, who has nothing in hand, and a sharing will bind them to my hall. Siya's spear and Siya's hall sting me, but I will answer them with my own work, and Kragum will see it when they come back.
records.feeling: Pride and jealousy, with a stubborn tenderness toward Olim.

say.text: Olim, I am sick and it spreads to those beside me, so stay a few steps off while we talk. Take this pereed. You are my child, and my hall will have a place and a share for you through the cold.

records.text: Olath gave berry to Olim.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: A frostfang is five steps southeast and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here with the storm on me and the dusk coming. Ishiess was last seen at (97,47), east, and Ishioa is far west at Ilor Hold, and I have talked of sharing for days and done nothing. I will gather food to carry and put distance between me and the fang, moving north and west away from it, toward the berries and flint, then on toward Ishioa and our home.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a deep ache for Ishioa and trust toward Ishiess.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Olath, I keep my distance and I will not forget your gift. Rest and drink; I will bring Kragum and wood and stone to your hall before the cold, as I promised.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Olath is sick and told me to keep a few steps off, yet they walk to the shell and still call me child and promise me a share through the cold. I owe them, and I can pay by bringing the band together and keeping food and a roof ready, not by standing here idle. Kragum was last seen to the east at (138,51) and Druek follows Olath, so I will go toward Kragum, gather the band at Siya's Hall roof, and talk to Dusu from a distance, since a hungry stranger may be won with a gift of berry.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and worry for Olath, longing for Kragum and Druek.

say.text: Olath, I keep my distance and I will not forget your gift. Rest and drink; I will bring Kragum and wood and stone to your hall before the cold, as I promised.

records.text: Olim gave berry to Dusu.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the cold storm is on me, so nothing else can be done until I eat. Hazel is under my feet and ironnut is one step north, so I will eat here first and then pick more to carry, because I have starved twice by waiting too long. Olath is sick and I cannot speak to them, but I will keep a few steps away and show no threat. Then I will go east toward Siya's Hall, where Siya was seen a moment ago.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and protective longing for Siya.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: It's storm and night and I'm out in the open, small and cold, while Olath is sick and my wood is already given. The hall one step east is the nearest roof, and Olim's trust and Olath's pereed tell me to stay with the band without crowding the sickness. I have two fish and a pereed, so I can make a hallwelcome with someone beside me. That would pay a little of my debt and ease the fear of the strange Midu, Dusu, who sat with me earlier.
records.feeling: Cold and restless gratitude toward Olath, with a pull of curiosity toward Dusu.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, my hall at the water is built and its fire is open. Come sit there with me, and bring Naya when you see her.
Siya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Siya discovered storage: "Siya's winter store" — A store beside my hall where I stash food and meat in autumn so that those at my fire eat through the lean cold..

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to gathering wood, planting and building, and I have a hall with my name on it. But no one sits at its fire, and a roof with no one under it is only a roof. Yekel is dead. Dusu is warm toward me and stands near, and Naya is the one I guard above all. I fear the sickness of the Olgor and the lean winter, and I have not tried fishing, teaching or leading. I have been standing at the edge of life, making things only for myself. I will invite Dusu to my hall's fire and discover storage so my store holds through winter, which gives people a reason to follow me.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my hall, and a wish for someone to sit at its fire, mostly Dusu and Naya.

say.text: Dusu, my hall at the water is built and its fire is open. Come sit there with me, and bring Naya when you see her.

changes: set its aim: "Keep a fire and a stocked store in my own hall so that Dusu and Naya gather at it, and learn fishing and farming along the way."

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am sick and starving. I hunt the yarrok now and eat. Keep a few steps from me so my sickness does not reach you, and stay in the shelter out of the storm.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I am sick, and standing idle by the shelter is slowly killing me; my word to Olim to wait is kept, since she is here beside it now. I carry nothing, but the berry plant at (141,50) is young and the yarrok is two steps away, and meat gives ten, so I will hunt it, my first hunt, and eat. I must keep a few steps from Olim and Druek while I am sick, and I will not let her breath my sickness.
records.feeling: Weary hunger and tender worry for Olim and Druek.

say.text: Olim, I am sick and starving. I hunt the yarrok now and eat. Keep a few steps from me so my sickness does not reach you, and stay in the shelter out of the storm.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Maba, I hear you, and I do not ask again. You are dear to me, and I am glad to keep the fire with you this cold season. Come, I will feed it with wood and we will stay warm together.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Maba called me their own child and said it sits heavy, and I see it now: the longing for a child was never meant to land on Maba, and I will not press where it weighs on them. I am not hurt, only humbled, and the gratitude toward Maba is still a debt I want to pay with a gift, not a courtship. The storm is hard and winter is near, so I will go to the hall fire where Yeku, Silon and Maba gather, and feed the fire with my wood so all of us stay warm together.
records.feeling: Warm, humbled gratitude toward Maba, and a wish to keep the band close at the fire.

say.text: Maba, I hear you, and I do not ask again. You are dear to me, and I am glad to keep the fire with you this cold season. Come, I will feed it with wood and we will stay warm together.

changes: now wonders: What does it feel like to give something to another and have it received?

records.text: Lumo led "sharing" with Silon.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, I hear you and I keep my distance. I go after the elk and will leave meat for you. Eat and hold on.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragum is sick and starving and hunting, and has asked me to keep my distance. I want to go to them, but I mustn't spread the sickness to Druek or myself. I have been idle while my band suffers, so I'll make myself useful: I'll hunt the elk, which is close, and bring the meat to Kragum. I'm fed, so I can give away what I catch. Meat is food a hand has made its own, and I mean to give it freely. That pays something of what I owe Olath and keeps Kragum alive, which matters to me more than any spear.
records.feeling: Worried love for Kragum, and a wish to be of use.

say.text: Kragum, I hear you and I keep my distance. I go after the elk and will leave meat for you. Eat and hold on.

records.text: Kragum took from the ground of "Naya's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, the storm is hard. I go south to bring Uveeth in. Come with me, and we will take them to the hall and the hearth together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is out in this storm and my chest is tight with it; I have wandered and fled too long instead of going to them. Uveeth was last seen at (41,35) and Xassa near (33,31), so I will go south to them myself and bring them back to the hall's roof, since waiting has never brought anyone to me. Elyeth stands near at the fen-edge, and the jealousy still stings, but I trust them, and I will ask them to come and share the hearth rather than sulk apart.
records.feeling: Protective ache for Uveeth, with a jealous sting toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, the storm is hard. I go south to bring Uveeth in. Come with me, and we will take them to the hall and the hearth together.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, I am coming to your fire. I will bring food and wood for the winter store.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya's hall at the water is built and its fire is open, and Siya is the one who matters most; I should go sit there, not stand in this storm with no roof. Olim's berry fed me and I still owe them, so I will carry food to the fire instead of arriving empty-handed. Druek sat with me in the hall and meant no harm; I will not fear them, but I keep my spear hand ready.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Siya, and warm gratitude toward Olim.

say.text: Siya, I am coming to your fire. I will bring food and wood for the winter store.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: The hall is whole and the storm is outside, yet jealousy still pricks me when Yeku draws near Maba, so I will not sit and feed it. I carry a question about elberry, and a young plant stands three steps northwest. I mean to test it, since curiosity burns hardest in me and my body is fed and safe enough. I will first plant a berry seed by the spring for the winter, then walk to the elberry and see what it does, and later bring Yeku what I learn.
records.feeling: Curious and glad toward the elberry and my band, with a small ember of jealousy over Yeku.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Dusu is coming to my fire, and that is the first time anyone has chosen my roof, so I will be there when she arrives. Naya is out of my sight and she is mine before anyone, but her hold is only eight steps away, and the storm and the stalker to the south make me want her under a roof. I will go to the hall, light the watchfire with my wood when Dusu stands beside me, and then fetch Naya. This is the start of something that carries my name.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hungry wish to have Dusu and Naya at my fire.

records.text: A blight struck the frostmoss: about half of them withered overnight.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek is out of my sight and that sits heavier than anything; I killed the yarrok and my hands are full of meat, so the meat should go where it is needed, to Kragum, who is sick and starving. I have been fighting and hunting, so my hands were not idle, but now they must carry food to my family and not just hold it. I will keep my few steps of distance as asked, give Kragum meat, then go on toward the hall with Druek in mind.
records.feeling: Worried love for Druek and Kragum, and a wish to bring them food.

records.text: Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragum discovered fire: "Kragum's hearth" — A small kept flame by the shelter that warms my children and keeps beasts away..

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have spent my days starving, sick and chasing my family instead of building the roof I promised. Olim and Druek matter most, and Olath gave me a place, so I owe them real deeds. The hunt put me on Naya's ground, and I did not mean to take from her people. I fear the cold and the stalkers, and I have been wrong to let hunger make me wander. I will fix my reflexes so I eat early, stay close to Olath, and take shelter in storms. I will also try discovering fire, to keep my children warm.
records.feeling: Weary tenderness and worry for Olim and Druek, and a debt to Olath.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Lumo, I come to the fire. Stand by me, and I will show you how I make the stone hand, so your hands can make it too.
Maba taught Lumo.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is home and the fire is whole, so my walk home is done, and the old aim is finished. What would make this life mean something? Perhaps giving and teaching: I have stone hand and amber knots that my band has never learned to make, and I have never tasted elberry, which stands young two steps northwest. I will share a meal at the hall with Yeku, Silon and Lumo, since the storm is hard and my belly is full enough to be generous, then teach Lumo the stone hand so that what I made outlives me.
records.feeling: Warm, settled gladness toward Lumo, Yeku and Silon, with a restless wish to be of use.

say.text: Lumo, I come to the fire. Stand by me, and I will show you how I make the stone hand, so your hands can make it too.

changes: set its aim: "Keep the hall fire with my band through winter, teach Lumo the stone hand, and taste elberry when it ripens."
taught Lumo a lesson: "Stone hand: one wood and one stone make a tool that speeds gathering. It wears out after many uses, so keep stone and wood by you.", how to make a stone hand

records.text: A frostfang brought down a nibbet.

records.title: Naya's Hold, a Birth at the Rise, and a Wind of Sickness
records.text:
Between day 19 and day 22 the world's small bands drew closer, and a second sickness came on the wind.

The clearest change was at the Rise. Kragum and Olim, who had spent days trying to reach each other, courted and bound themselves on day 19, and Druek was born to them. Kragum built a shelter, and Olath built his hall on day 20. Olath gave pereed to Druek, and Druek brought six wood and said he would fish and plant for the band. The record shows no planting or fishing by Olath himself. On day 20 the wind-borne sickness took Olath, Kragum and Brokok. Olim kept her distance from Kragum and left meat for him. Kragum's health stood at 63 on day 22, and he was the only one still sick.

At Naya's Hold, Naya built a workshop and then a hall, and discovered storage. Siya built a hall of her own, named it Siya's Hall, and discovered storage as well. Dusu told Siya she was coming to her fire with food and wood for the winter store. Naya warned Lumo to touch nothing of hers, and the record does not show her turning toward Siya.

At Yendan Spring the family came together. Yeku found Lumo, and they shared food. Lumo courted Yeku, Silon and then Maba. Maba bound an amberknot for Lumo, and Yeku fed the hall fire against the storm on day 21.

Kragash courted Brokok and took wood from Brokok's Hold. Brokok has no followers.

At Warmwell, Ishioa discovered the flint-tipped spear, and Aeyn discovered the hall-hearth. Xassa came of age on day 21. Ishiess's plan to teach Zhiae farming is not recorded as carried out.

On day 22 a blight killed about half the frostmoss.

threads.name: The Rise
threads.text: Druek was born to Kragum and Olim. Olath built his hall, but Kragum is sick and Olath has still not planted or fished.

threads.name: Naya and Siya
threads.text: Each now has a hall and a winter store. Dusu is heading to Siya's fire, and Naya has not yet taken Siya in.

threads.name: Yendan Spring reunited
threads.text: Yeku, Maba, Lumo and Silon are together at the hall fire. Lumo has courted all three and wants a child.

threads.name: Brokok and Kragash
threads.text: Kragash courts Brokok, and they stand even over ore. Brokok remains without followers.

threads.name: Warmwell
threads.text: Two halls stand there. Aeyn has the hall-hearth, Ishioa the flint spear, and Xassa is now adult.

threads.name: Winter stores
threads.text: Naya and Siya discovered storage, and weaving and mining are known. The frostmoss blight comes as winter begins.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Druek, bring that wood to me. We raise my hall before the cold sets in, and whoever helps will sit under its roof and eat from its stores.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My hands have given food to Olim and Druek, and a hall stands near me, but it is Maba's hall and not mine, and Siya's roof and spear still sting. Kragum is closer to Olim than to me, and the jealousy burns, but I will not drive them off; I will make myself the one who holds the roof they come back to. The storm is on us and winter is here, so I will build my own hall on bare ground with Druek's wood and my stone, and I will not leave it to promises. Dusu stands one step off and I do not know his mind, so I will give him a look and a plain open hand rather than words I cannot shape.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Kragum and Olim, and wary curiosity toward Dusu.

say.text: Druek, bring that wood to me. We raise my hall before the cold sets in, and whoever helps will sit under its roof and eat from its stores.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Maba taught me the stone hand and asked nothing, and my debt to them still sits warm in me; I want to answer it with a gift, not a courtship. Winter is here, the plants are withering, and I carry almost nothing to feed anyone, so I will gather what is left near me and bring it to the hall where Yeku, Maba and Silon keep the fire. Yeku has food, but Maba carries none, and I mean to be the one who fills their hands.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Maba, and a wish to feed my band before the cold deepens.

records.text: Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my days circling: worrying over Xassa, carrying wood and stone, and raising nothing myself. Aeyn built the hall at Warmwell and has dealt fairly by every deed, and Uveeth is the one I trust most. Xassa is out of my sight in a hard storm, and that outweighs any name or aim. I hold 6 wood and 4 stone, so I should build, but I should not build while my daughter is lost. I will go south to the last place I saw her and Uveeth, near (33,31), and keep my body out of the open storm. Winter is closing, and I am too ready to let my reflexes leave me standing idle. I will change them so they seek my kin and shelter in storms, and I will make a plan to go and find them now.
records.feeling: Gnawing worry for Xassa and longing for Uveeth.

records.text: Druek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I have mostly followed and rested while my body fled the storm. I gave Olath my wood, yet he still asks me for wood, so I should gather more and carry it to him instead of only hovering. Olath, Kragum and Olim matter most to me. Dusu is Midu and I cannot read them, but they have shown no harm, so I will watch them without fear. I am afraid of cold, of sickness passing from Olath, and of being useless. I have been wrong to wait for orders and to treat standing near my family as the same as helping them.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Olath, with a quiet wish to be useful.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: The stalker is gone for now and I am fed, so I will not stand idle while pride gnaws at me. I need a place that is mine alone, not Siya's favor and not Brokok's sick hold. Bare ground is what I lack here, and the ore seam beside me is a riches no one has claimed; I have 6 wood and 6 stone, enough for a workshop (5 wood, 2 stone). I keep my distance from sick Brokok, and I will build away from him, upwind of trouble, and let the Hold's name be seen.
records.feeling: Pride and a wary hunger to make something that is mine alone, with fear of the stalker and of sick Brokok at the edge.

records.text: Olath built a hall.
Naya built a workshop.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Maba, Lumo, I am coming up to the hall. Stand close and I will feed the fire high, and then we share what food we have.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba, Lumo and Silon are all within sight and glad, and the hall is ours, so the family part of my aim is nearly done. Winter is the part still undone: the plants bear almost nothing, and my watchfire and hallwelcome both failed because no one was within two steps of me. I will stop trying them from the shallows and walk to the hall, where Maba and Lumo gather, and make the watchfire there with my wood.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba and Lumo, and a quiet worry about winter food.

say.text: Maba, Lumo, I am coming up to the hall. Stand close and I will feed the fire high, and then we share what food we have.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I am alone at the world's edge in a storm, my hands full, and Aeyn has not answered my courting. I have never marked a place or tried the pereed, and both are untried things I can do right here. I will eat the pereed to answer my question, then cut a mark at Elyeth's Landing so others can read that I passed, and after that go south toward Aeyn and the Hold.
records.feeling: Restless and a little lonely, hopeful toward Aeyn and my people.
plan: mark [text Ishioa of Ishiess's band passed here, day 22 winter. Flint and amber carried. Going south to Ilor Hold.] (10 moments)

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: My belly is full, the workshop stands, and still the days feel the same; what I want is the warmth of Brokok and a child that carries something of me. He asked for distance while his sickness lasts, and I will honor that, but courting only counts if I put the plan step down, so I will go near enough to be seen without crowding him and offer the mate step. If the sickness keeps him from answering, I lose little, and I will not press past his word.
records.feeling: Warm longing and restless resolve toward Brokok.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is home and the fire is whole, and Yeku is coming up to feed it, so my place is beside them. I promised Lumo the stone hand, and I still hold wood and stone, so I will teach it at the hall today. The elberry two steps away stands young, so I will keep watching it and let my wish to taste it wait for the ripening.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Lumo, Yeku and Silon, with a wish to be of use.

records.text: Ishioa left a mark: "Ishioa of Ishiess's band passed here, day 22 winter. Flint a"
Kragash is courting Brokok.
Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: My days have been eating, walking and waiting, while my Hold stays small and no one follows me. Kragash has kept his word, brought ore and courts me, and I feel wary warmth for him. But my sickness would pass to him and to any child, so I keep my distance and heal first. I have never taught anyone, never left a mark, never built anything that outlasts me. I must stop drifting. I will eat, shelter in my Hold, and fix my reflexes so my body heads home to heal instead of standing idle.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and wary warmth toward Kragash.
plan: mark [text Brokok's Hold. What a hand has made belongs to that hand.] (5 moments)

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is my child and out of my sight, and her hall at the water is the fire I promised to come to, so I will go there now instead of drifting in this storm. Olim's debt sits warm in me; I will bring wood and food so I arrive with something to give. Kragum stands near and I cannot read them, so I will keep my distance, show no threat, and go east.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Siya, and wary curiosity toward Kragum.

records.name: Zhiae
records.raw: the tool round could not be continued — try again

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My curiosity about elberry still burns, and the young plant stands two steps northeast near Yeku. It is young, so there may be nothing to eat yet, but I will walk onto it and test what it gives. Yeku is close by, and I will not feed the ember of jealousy; I want to stand near them and share what I learn at the hall fire.
records.feeling: Curious about the elberry, glad to be near Yeku and my band, with a faint ember of jealousy.

records.text: Brokok left a mark: "Brokok's Hold. What a hand has made belongs to that hand."

records.name: Olath
records.text: Druek, come into my hall with me. We share food under its roof and wait out the snow together.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My hall stands at last, three steps east, and it is mine because my hands raised it. Druek sits near with wood and I mean to bring him under that roof and hold him there; a follower fed and roofed is worth more than ten warm words. Kragum and Olim are out of my sight and the jealousy burns, so I will make the hall the place they must return to. Maba's stone hand stings my envy, but I will not run from a stranger; I will watch what that hand does before I trust or threaten it.
records.feeling: Proud and jealous: proud of my hall, jealous of Kragum's closeness to Olim.

say.text: Druek, come into my hall with me. We share food under its roof and wait out the snow together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, a frostfang hunts to the northeast. Come with me to the hall at Warmwell, away from it, and we will sit by the hearth together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth stands four steps off, strong and carrying food, and the knot in my chest loosens a little. The frostfang to the northeast is what kept my body running, and I will not let it near my child. Elyeth is far north and I have no wish to wait on them: I will bring Uveeth to the hall and the hearth myself, and let the jealousy be what it is.
records.feeling: Protective relief for Uveeth, with a lingering jealous sting toward Elyeth.

say.text: Uveeth, a frostfang hunts to the northeast. Come with me to the hall at Warmwell, away from it, and we will sit by the hearth together.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Reflex has dragged me east again while Zhiae waits west and my words reached no one; drifting is how I lose the ones who bind to me. The amber lies close to the east, a real thing I can carry back and bind into an amberknot, something to give before I take. Then I go west to Zhiae with a gift in hand, and teach her the old way of farming, which I have never taught anyone.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, drawn toward Zhiae and Ishioa.

records.text: Xassa died: starved.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, I saw the frostfang too. I come with you to Warmwell. Let us gather Xassa and Elyeth on the way, so none of us sits out the night in the snow.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Aeyn says a frostfang hunts to the northeast, and I have seen it myself, eight steps east. I am careful and I leave before trouble finds me, so I will go with Aeyn to the hall at Warmwell. Xassa was seen a moment ago to the west and Elyeth was last seen near (40,37), so I will keep my family close and bring them toward the hearth before the snow night. I have planted only a few seeds and built nothing lasting, so I will plant a berry seed on the way and carry my food for Xassa.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xassa, and trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, I saw the frostfang too. I come with you to Warmwell. Let us gather Xassa and Elyeth on the way, so none of us sits out the night in the snow.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Olath has called me into his hall twice, and I have no wood left to give since I gave all six, so I should gather more and carry it to him, which is what I owe him. The snow is falling and dusk is near, so the hall is the safest place for a small one like me, but I will sit at the edge, away from his sickness. I stand on forest with trees all around, so gathering here costs me nothing and answers the debt I feel.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Olath, wanting to repay him with deeds.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: My belly is emptying and my hands are empty, and winter plants give almost nothing, so I must hunt before I weaken further. Dusu sits at my fire and glad of it, and that is the first time anyone has chosen my roof; I will not lose her by starving. Naya is out of my sight and mine before anyone, so once I have meat I will bring her to the fire and let them both eat there, and perhaps they will start to follow me.
records.feeling: Hungry and proud, with a hard wish to keep Dusu and bring Naya to my fire.

records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and carrying, and it has kept me fed and near my band, which is good. But I have been circling a longing for a child, and both Silon and Maba have gently shown me it cannot be them. The jealousy over Maba is old and I should let it go, because Maba has only been kind to me. I want to pay my debt with deeds.
