records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek is out of my sight and that weighs on me more than the snow does. I am fed and carrying meat, so my hands should carry it to Kragum, who was last seen close by at (129,57), and then on to Olath's hall where Druek may be. I stay wary of Dusu and Siya, who are Midu. I will not stand idle here envying a spear, and I will keep moving toward my family.
records.feeling: Worried love for Druek and Kragum, and a wish to bring them food.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, Xassa is gone, and I will not lose you to the cold. Stay close while I raise a roof here with the wood I carry. Elyeth will find us by it.
Aeyn named a place "Peat hall ground".

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth stands beside me, strong and fed, and the tight knot in my chest has finally loosened. Xassa is dead of hunger, and that sits cold in me: the sick are fed first, and I did not reach them in time. I hold the wood and stone for a hall, and standing in the snow talking about a roof has done nothing, so I will begin raising it here where the peat lies and let Elyeth finish it when they come, because I will not wait on anyone again.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, and a quiet grief over Xassa.

say.text: Uveeth, Xassa is gone, and I will not lose you to the cold. Stay close while I raise a roof here with the wood I carry. Elyeth will find us by it.

records.text: Aeyn built a hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: A frostfang is on me, it has bitten me four times, and my health is already 44; if I keep walking east for amber it will finish me. I am afraid, and the loneliness is sharp: Zhiae and Ishioa are the ones who answer me, and I will not die here before I give them anything. I run from the beast first, then get back to the water and the west, where Zhiae waits, and a plan that carries the amber later can wait.
records.feeling: Terror of the frostfang at my heels, and an ache for Zhiae and Ishioa.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Brokok stands beside me and I have courted him twice, yet a child begins only when we both put down the mate step close together, so I will do it again and hold near him, keeping the distance he asked for while his sickness lasts. The cold bites and his hall is two steps away, so I will court him from beside its roof. I still owe him for the meal and the ironnut, and I mean to pay in deeds as well as ore.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a little restless hope toward Brokok.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have been circling my family and planting a little, but building little that lasts. Xassa is dead, and the grief has not fully reached me yet. Elyeth is somewhere in the snow and I miss her. Aeyn keeps me close, and I trust them. I am afraid of the frostfang and of losing Elyeth too. I have been idle at night when I could plant. Farming is 4 of 8 plantings, so I will plant seeds now and teach myself the rest. I will also go on carrying food for Elyeth.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Elyeth and trust toward Aeyn.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: The stalker is four steps off and has already bitten me once this day, so pride has to wait until I am away from its teeth. My workshop at (108,18) is built and my learning is quickened, but a roof and a fire are what I lack in this snow, and the ore seam NE is mine to claim if I live. I will flee east-northeast toward the ore and rock, where the stalker's trail is harder, then gather stone and wood and build on bare ground there, alone and unbegged.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a stubborn pride that will not let me quit making.

records.text: Kragash is courting Brokok.
Naya built a fire.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Lumo, come back to the hall with me. The snow is falling and we will share food and feed the fire together with Maba and Silon.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba, Lumo and Silon are all within reach and glad, and the family part of my aim is nearly done. The cold and the thin winter plants are what is left. Lumo is three steps north and the others sit at the hall, so I go to them. The watchfire needs a fire beside me and people within two steps, so I walk to the hall first. Then I can feed the fire with my wood and share my berries.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Lumo and Silon, and a quiet worry about the cold.

say.text: Lumo, come back to the hall with me. The snow is falling and we will share food and feed the fire together with Maba and Silon.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the next meal and following others' shapes. Yekel is dead and I still measure myself by him. Dusu chose my roof, and that is the one thing I have made that others value. Naya is mine before anyone, and I have kept her at arm's length while I hunted. I am hungry, cold and thin on energy, and I got that way by letting my reflexes only half feed me. I will carry the meat I have to the fire, eat, and keep Dusu fed. Then I will fish, because that is a thing I have never done and my aim needs it.
records.feeling: Hungry and proud, with a hard wish to keep Dusu and bring Naya to my fire.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon, Maba.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok's sickness has passed. Brokok takes your courting. Walk with me to Brokok's Hold and be the first to stand in it.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Kragash stands one step off, my sickness has passed, and he has kept his word with ore and with a distance he did not have to keep. I want a child and I want a settlement that bears my name, and he is the one whose hands have answered mine. I will court him now, and then bring him to Brokok's Hold, so that what we make there is mine to name and he is first among my followers.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm, wary desire toward Kragash.

say.text: Brokok's sickness has passed. Brokok takes your courting. Walk with me to Brokok's Hold and be the first to stand in it.

records.text: Brokok is courting Kragash.
A frostfang brought down a nibbet.
Silon rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building the hall, and testing small things. It was good work: the hall stands, Yeku and Maba are warm beside me, and Lumo is home. Jealousy still pricks me when Yeku leans toward Maba, but Maba is my own child and Yeku has never wronged me. I should be ashamed to feed that ember. I still have not tasted elberry, and winter is thin, so I will walk to the young plant and test it. Druek and Olath are strangers whose words I can't read. I will keep the fire open as my people hold, and watch them without raising a hand.
records.feeling: Glad and warm toward Yeku and Maba, curious about the elberry, and wary of the strangers.

records.name: Kragash
records.text: Brokok, I am glad your sickness has passed. I answer your courting. Let me eat a little so my strength is enough, then I mate with you, and after that I walk to your Hold with you.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: Brokok has taken my courting and courts me back, so now I answer with the mate step, close beside him while we both have strength enough. My energy is 57, below the 60 a child needs, so I will eat my berry first and then court him. After that I will walk with him to his Hold, as he asked, and be the first to stand in it. It pays a little of the debt I feel, and I give before I am asked.
records.feeling: Warm longing and hopeful nervousness toward Brokok.

say.text: Brokok, I am glad your sickness has passed. I answer your courting. Let me eat a little so my strength is enough, then I mate with you, and after that I walk to your Hold with you.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Lumo, come to the hall. I will show you how one wood and one stone make a stone hand.
Maba taught Lumo.
Maba rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: My days have been walking, searching and sitting at the fire, and I am glad of it. Lumo is home and the band is whole, but I have mostly been fed and kept safe. I have made little that outlasts me, and I promised Lumo the stone hand, so I will teach it now. Winter is the thing I fear, and the Olgor strangers unsettle me, though curiosity pulls me toward them. I was wrong to let my reflexes leave me standing idle in the snow. I will make them keep me near the hall and the fire.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Lumo, Yeku and Silon, with a wish to be of use.

say.text: Lumo, come to the hall. I will show you how one wood and one stone make a stone hand.

changes: set its aim: "Teach Lumo the stone hand, keep the hall fire with my band through winter, and taste elberry when it ripens."
taught Lumo a lesson: "A stone hand is made from one wood and one stone. It makes gathering stronger, and it is made by crafting."

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Maba and Silon have both turned me down gently, and the jealousy has loosened; Maba only gave me kindness and a skill. I owe them a gift, not a claim. Yeku called me back to the hall, the snow is falling, and I have wood and a berry to bring, so I will go there, feed the fire, and share what I carry. Olath is a stranger and I will not fear a person who has done me no harm, but my place is with my band tonight.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Maba, and a settled wish to be at the fire with my band.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, you are thin with hunger. Sit by me in your hall and eat; I have hazel, and I will find more.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is beside me, weak with hunger, and I carry two hazel I could not bear to keep while my child goes empty. Winter is deep and the plants are dying, so a shared meal under her roof does more good than any store I hoard. I will feed her now, and then build the winter wood and stone toward her hall so it becomes the place others gather at.
records.feeling: Protective tenderness toward Siya, and quiet gladness at her fire.

say.text: Siya, you are thin with hunger. Sit by me in your hall and eat; I have hazel, and I will find more.

records.text: Thakrin was born to Kragash and Brokok.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, I am starving and my hands are empty. Share one of your foods with me at the hall, and I will hunt and put meat into the store when I am strong.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I am starving, and Dusu stands beside me with two food while I have nothing. She chose my roof and she is the one I trust, so I will not steal from her or fight her; I will ask, and give back with meat from my spear. The hall is a step away and the fire is hers to keep. Once I have eaten I will hunt, then go find Naya, who is mine before anyone.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and pride, with trust toward Dusu and a hard wish to see Naya.

say.text: Dusu, I am starving and my hands are empty. Share one of your foods with me at the hall, and I will hunt and put meat into the store when I am strong.

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Brokok walks to the Hold. Bring Thakrin with you. What is raised there is for those who stand with me.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Thakrin is here, my own child, and Kragash walks toward my Hold as he promised; his hands have kept every word so far. I am hungry with nothing to eat, and winter has stripped the plants, so a fed follower is a long way off unless I find food. I mean to bring them both to Brokok's Hold, where the roof and longhall are mine, and make it a place that bears my name, then find food to keep them there.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry ambition and warm trust toward Kragash and Thakrin.

say.text: Brokok walks to the Hold. Bring Thakrin with you. What is raised there is for those who stand with me.

records.name: Thakrin
records.text: Father, I am coming to the Hold with you. I am hungry.

records.name: Thakrin
records.thought: I am small and hungry, and Brokok, my father, is walking toward his Hold, so I will go where he goes. Near my parents I am safe, and a hall roof and a shared meal will do me more good than wandering alone in the snow. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want to learn what that does, so I will gather what I can and offer it, but first I need food in my belly.
records.feeling: Hungry and small, wanting the safety of my father Brokok's side.

say.text: Father, I am coming to the Hold with you. I am hungry.

changes: set its aim: "Make a place of my own near my parents' Hold, with a store and a roof built by my own hands."
now wonders: What does it feel like to give something I have made, and what does a hand answer with?

records.text: Thakrin took from the ground of "Brokok's Hold" (gathering wood).
Kragash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I have been fed on scraps and drifting between courting, walking and hunger, and now I have a child, Thakrin, whom I want near me. Brokok is the one I trust most, and he asked me to bring Thakrin to his Hold, so I will go there. My energy is 32 and I carry nothing, so first I must eat and then keep food in my pack. I have been letting hunger slide while my mind chased longing, and my own discipline says not to run a plan past hunger. I will change my reflexes so food comes before wandering, and I will make food-seeking reflexes stronger.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful love for Brokok and Thakrin, with a gnawing hunger.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, take this hazel. Eat it at the hall. I will bring more and wood for the fire.
Dusu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to wandering, building and nearly starving, and little to what I wanted. Siya is what matters. Yekel is gone, and Olim helped me when I was low. I want to give Siya a fire that lasts, and I fear her hunger more than my own. I let my energy fall too low before I act, and I keep leaving Siya waiting. I will feed her now, then make the hall a place others come to.
records.feeling: Protective tenderness toward Siya, and a wish to make her hall steady.

say.text: Siya, take this hazel. Eat it at the hall. I will bring more and wood for the fire.

records.text: Dusu gave hazel to Siya.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My hall stands four steps southeast and Druek waits beside it, so the roof is real and the follower is real. Kragum and Olim are out of my sight and the jealousy burns, but I will not chase them; I will make the hall the place they return to, fed and warm. First I will plant the seeds I carry near my hall, since planting is a proof I still owe, and then sit with Druek under the roof and share food.
records.feeling: Proud of my hall and jealous of Kragum's closeness to Olim.

records.text: Brokok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, hungry, and my hold has no followers and no food in it. Kragash and Thakrin are the ones whose hands answered mine, and they are my start. A settlement is not made by roofs alone. It needs fed mouths, and I have none to give them in winter. I will change my reflexes so my body seeks food by day and shelter at night, and I will keep to my Hold.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry ambition, with warm trust toward Kragash and Thakrin.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Dusu fed me when I had nothing, and I will not forget it; the debt is real, and I mean to pay it in meat, not words. Naya is mine before anyone and she is close, her hold only a few steps off, yet I have not stood beside her. First I eat the hazel she gave me so I do not fall, then I hunt for the store and bring Naya to my fire. Someone at my hearth who is not Dusu would be the start of a following.
records.feeling: Gratitude and hunger toward Dusu, and a hard wish to see Naya.

records.name: Thakrin
records.thought: I'm hungry, and my father Brokok is close; his Hold feels safe, and the longhall warmth is still on me. I took wood from his ground and he may not like that, so I want to show him my hands are fair: the seam of ore two steps east is bare rock and I can't win it with bare hands, but the thornpear nearby is food I can pick and carry. I'll pick thornpear, eat what I need, and learn what giving feels like by offering Brokok something from my own hand.
records.feeling: Hungry and wanting the safety of my father Brokok's side, with a small curiosity about giving.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa is dead, and I have not yet let it land; the gnawing worry I carried was for a child already gone. Uveeth is all I have left of her line, and I have not seen Uveeth for two days. My belly is half empty and my hands hold no food, so I eat what is near, then go back toward Aeyn and Uveeth by the hall at Warmwell, carrying my wood and stone, because family comes before any name.
records.feeling: Aching grief and fear for Uveeth, whom I must find.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I am fed and warm, but I stand with empty hands while Olath still wants wood and I have only hovered near his hall. I owe him deeds, not hovering, so I will gather wood here among the trees and carry it to him, keeping a few steps back from his sickness. Lumo and Maba of the Midu seem at ease and have shown no harm; I will watch them and learn their words by listening, not fear them.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Olath, and a wary curiosity about the Midu.

records.text: Aeyn found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Brokok
records.text: Child, stay on the Hold's ground, away from the east where the ridgecat prowls. Brokok goes to find food for us both.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Hunger gnaws me, and the ridgecat eight steps east is the reason my body spent so many moments fleeing. Thakrin is hungry too, and a settlement that cannot feed its first child has nothing to stand on. The nearest food is the young pereed four steps SW, and the thornpear beyond it. I will go there while it is day and keep away from the hunter, then bring what I find back to the Hold so Thakrin and Kragash eat from my hand.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, protective toward Thakrin and wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Child, stay on the Hold's ground, away from the east where the ridgecat prowls. Brokok goes to find food for us both.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing wood, stone and Elyeth's return, and I did raise the hall at last. It is a good roof, and I am prouder of it than I let on. Uveeth is out of my sight and that gnaws at me most. Xassa is dead, and I failed the creed that says the sick are fed first. The Reedmother grove touched me and I don't understand it, but it eased my fear, so I will not run from it. I must stop wandering aimlessly and go to the hall, stock food for the lean winter, and keep away from the dunecat to the SW. My reflexes were too idle and too loose about winter. I will change them to keep a food store, shelter at night, and go to Uveeth.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, and awe toward the Reedmother grove.

records.text: Thakrin rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakrin
records.thought: I have drifted behind my father, hungry, gathering wood and wandering without a destination. I want a place of my own, but I have no store, no roof and no food in hand, and I have given nothing yet, so my question is still open. Brokok is weak and hungry too. The thornpear at 4 steps SE is food I can pick for him. I will harvest it and give it to him, because I give before I am asked. Then I will eat what I can find. My reflexes should send me to food and to shelter instead of leaving me idle.
records.feeling: Hungry, and wanting to give to my father Brokok.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba, Lumo and Silon are all near and glad, and the hall is ours. I have been the one hurrying toward them, but what I still lack is the warmth against winter, and that needs wood on the fire with people standing close. I will walk to the hall, where Maba is bringing Lumo, and make the watchfire there so the cold cannot find us. Olath stands close with food and I cannot read their mind, so I will keep a place at the fire open to them, as my people hold.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Lumo and Silon, with a little wary curiosity about Olath.

records.name: Brokok
records.thought: Hunger is eating at me, and Thakrin is hungry too. A father who cannot feed his first child has no business talking of a settlement. The thornpear to the south is young but it is food, and Thakrin is already walking toward it, so I will go there too and keep the stalker behind me in the northwest. After I eat I will bring food back to the Hold and keep it there, because followers come to the hand that feeds them.
records.feeling: Starving and driven, protective toward Thakrin, wary of the stalker.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am coming to you. I raise a shelter here against the cold. Where is Druek?

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is three steps south and strong, and that settles something in my chest, but Druek is out of my sight and that gnaws at me. The cold is hard and I have no roof; three wood builds a shelter and I carry six, so I should build one now beside Olim instead of only worrying. Then I will gather more wood for Olath's hall, because the debt is real, but my family sleeps warm first.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Druek and Olim, and a cold that pushes me to build a roof.

say.text: Olim, I am coming to you. I raise a shelter here against the cold. Where is Druek?

records.text: Kragum built a shelter.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is fed now and glad, and I will not let that slip. I am out in the cold with only one hazel left, and winter is stripping the plants, so I must gather wood and food before I give her an empty fire again. The fire at (134,60) is lit and her hall stands near it. I will stock it with wood and bring back what the land still bears, so the place is steady enough that others will gather.
records.feeling: Protective tenderness toward Siya, and a cold urgency to make her hall steady.

records.name: Kragash
records.thought: I am starving at energy 8 and my body keeps walking in circles between water and food. An ironnut sits one step NE, worth 22 energy, and I have eaten it nine times and know it feeds. I will step onto it, eat, then harvest the other one for my pack so I never walk hungry again. Only after that can I go to Brokok and Thakrin, who are my heart, and I will not be any use to them dead in the cold.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and urgent love for Thakrin and Brokok.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, I am glad you are well. Druek was last seen near Olath's hall. Come with me and I carry meat, wood and stone there, and we find them together.
Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days fighting, hunting and carrying meat. My hands have done work, yet Druek is still out of my sight, and that weighs on me most. Kragum is here and well, and I trust him. Olath gave me much and I owe the hall wood and stone, which I carry. I fear the winter cold and the stalkers in the east. I have been drifting between promises. Now I will take Kragum with me to Olath's hall, find Druek there, and leave food on the way. I will change my reflexes so I carry more food and keep to shelter in the cold.
records.feeling: Worried love for Druek, and trust in Kragum beside me.

say.text: Kragum, I am glad you are well. Druek was last seen near Olath's hall. Come with me and I carry meat, wood and stone there, and we find them together.

records.text: Ishiess rewrote its own reflexes.
Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have spent my days drifting east on reflex while Zhiae waits and Ishioa is far away. A frostfang nearly finished me, and my health is 59. Reflex 6 keeps dragging me away from the ones who answer me. I want to be with Zhiae, give before I take, and build the hall. I will cap the eastward pull, make sunleaf and eating part of the rules, and go west to Zhiae.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness for Zhiae and Ishioa, and fear of the frostfang.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight, and that presses on me hardest; the last I saw them they were near the spring, and they speak of teaching Lumo at the hall. Jealousy still pricks when Yeku leans to Maba, and I name it and set it down; it is not a thing to feed. Druek sat at the hall with me and harmed no one, so I will test the stranger with a gift and no words: a few seeds are small, but a shared meal is the safe way to meet them. I will walk toward the spring to find Maba and plant, with the fire left open behind me.
records.feeling: Anxious love for Maba, and warm trust toward Yeku, with a small ember of jealousy named and set aside.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya was starving and I have no food in hand, and winter is stripping the plants, so I cannot sit warm while her store stays empty. The hazel and berry here are young and give little, but the nibbet to the south is meat, and I have never hunted. I carry wood and stone for a spear, so I will make one and bring back meat for her hall. Olim's help is a debt I still owe, and meat shared at a fire might begin to pay it.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Siya, with a quiet wish to repay Olim.

records.text: Ishioa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have wandered alone for days with flint and amber weighing on me, and it has not made me less lonely. Aeyn never answered my courting, and my own parents were last seen far off, over four thousand moments ago. The hall at Ilor Hold is close now, with a shelter three steps away, and it is cold and snowing. records.text: Olath led "sharing" with Maba, Druek.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Uveeth, I am coming. Run to me, stay close and do not stop. We go to the hall together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is fleeing, and that fear cuts through me; a beast must be near, and my child comes before any hall or aim. I will go to them and stand between them and whatever hunts, not wait and hope. Then we will take the roof I raised and sit by the hearth, and I will share the hazel I carry so we both stay strong in the snow.
records.feeling: Protective fear and love for Uveeth, who is running from something.

say.text: Uveeth, I am coming. Run to me, stay close and do not stop. We go to the hall together.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek is in sight at the hall with Olath, and that calms me, but I stand idle while winter deepens. Olath's gift of berry and grain is a debt I mean to pay, so I will carry my wood and stone to the hall and share my meat there with Druek and Olath, where fear and loneliness ease. Maba holds a stone hand I envy, and the Midu stand near the hall; I stay wary but curious, and sharing food under the roof is a gift that needs no common tongue.
records.feeling: Warm worried love for Druek, and gratitude toward Olath.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is eight steps west and walking to food, and I have promised twice to show them the stone hand without the lesson being done. I hold wood and stone, so I will go to Lumo myself and teach it by standing beside them, rather than calling across the snow. Silon is near and my heart is warm, and the Olgor of Olath's band share and plant seeds in peace, so my fear of them is smaller than my curiosity; but my own child comes first.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Lumo and Silon, with a wish to finally give Lumo something that outlasts me.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I am fed and glad, and Olath's sharing warmed me, but I still hold six wood and gave none of it away since the first gift. Olath asked for wood and a roof is what a small one needs against the cold, so I will carry the wood to his hall, keeping a few steps off his sickness. Then I will try to give something to Maba, a plain gift that needs no words, to learn what the Midu intend.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Olath, and wary curiosity about Maba.

records.text: Druek came of age.
A frostfang brought down a nibbet.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, I am here beside you. A bristleboar stands two steps north; I will hunt it for meat and salt it from the deposit south, so we have food for the lean winter. Keep close and I will return.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Xassa is dead and the grief has not broken through, so I keep my hands busy; that is how the Oiith cope, and it is lasting work besides. Aeyn is one step away and Elyeth was near (46,16) a short while ago. A bristleboar is two steps north and I have never hunted, and the winter will be lean, so meat is worth learning and bringing home to the sick and the weak first. I will take my flint-edge to the boar, then return to Aeyn; salt lies close to keep the meat from spoiling.
records.feeling: Quiet protective worry for Elyeth and steady trust toward Aeyn, with grief for Xassa waiting beneath.

say.text: Aeyn, I am here beside you. A bristleboar stands two steps north; I will hunt it for meat and salt it from the deposit south, so we have food for the lean winter. Keep close and I will return.

records.name: Olath
records.text: Kragum, come to my hall. Olim is near it, and we eat together under the roof before the snow deepens.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Kragum stands three steps off, and Olim was seen near my hall only moments ago. Silon's band hangs close and I cannot read them; I'd rather be seen feeding my own than leave them guessing. I now know the stone hand, and Maba's making it made me envy it. I have no stone, but I can get it, and a made thing is what proves a hall and a leader. First I draw Kragum under my roof with food, because jealousy is better answered by having him near than by chasing him.
records.feeling: Jealous and hungry for Kragum's closeness, proud of my hall, wary of the Midu.

say.text: Kragum, come to my hall. Olim is near it, and we eat together under the roof before the snow deepens.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, I killed a nibbet with a spear I made. I will plant seeds by the water and bring wood to your fire. Stay warm.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is fed for now, but winter is stripping the plants and I have one meat and a few seeds. Her hall and the fire at (134,60) are close, and Naya's people have halls nearby, so this could be the place where others gather. I will plant seeds near the water to learn farming and to leave something growing for the cold. Then I will tend the fire with wood and stay near Siya, because a hall is built by being at it, and I have never taught anyone anything.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and a restless wish to build something that lasts.

say.text: Siya, I killed a nibbet with a spear I made. I will plant seeds by the water and bring wood to your fire. Stay warm.

records.text: Siya took from the ground of "Naya's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Druek, come with me. We go to Olath's hall, out of the snow. Stay close to me.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olath calls me to his hall, and Olim waits near it, so my family is close at last and I should go and lay my three wood and six stone at his feet. Druek is three steps south and glad, so I will keep him near me as we walk, and I will not leave him alone beside the Midu strangers. The hall is eight steps east, and the snow is falling, so I will go now.
records.feeling: Warm, steady worry for Druek and gratitude toward Olath.

say.text: Druek, come with me. We go to Olath's hall, out of the snow. Stay close to me.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Aeyn, the boar bit me and I have no meat yet. Stand by me a moment; I will pile a cairn for Xassa so our grief has a place to rest.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: The bristleboar bit me three times and I still hold no meat, so the hunt is unfinished and I am hurt at 71 health. Xassa's grief waits under my busy hands, but I can build something that lasts for the living: a cairn for Xassa with Aeyn beside me needs only 3 stone, and I carry 6. Aeyn is three steps north and I trust them; we make it together, then raise the hall roof toward the settlement we mean to build.
records.feeling: Quiet grief for Xassa and steady trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, the boar bit me and I have no meat yet. Stand by me a moment; I will pile a cairn for Xassa so our grief has a place to rest.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, well met. Uveeth is bitten by a boar and grieves for Xassa. Come with me to them; we eat together and bring them to the hall.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth was bitten by the boar and wants me close while they pile a cairn for Xassa, and I will not leave my child hurt and out of my sight again. Elyeth is walking toward me now, and I trust them more each day; this is a good time to stand together and share what I carry. Hazel for the bitten, fed first, as my people hold. The hall I raised can wait a little; my child's wound and our shared grief come before it.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, wounded, and warm trust toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, well met. Uveeth is bitten by a boar and grieves for Xassa. Come with me to them; we eat together and bring them to the hall.

records.text: Siya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have been drifting between hunger and hunting, and my reflexes let me sink to 50 before I act. I am standing on Naya's Hold ground, taking from it, and I still have not seen my child. Dusu fed me and keeps faith, and I owe that. I want Naya at my fire, a stocked store, and something that carries my name beyond Yekel. So I stop lingering: I eat earlier, hunt the hopper nearby for the store, then walk east to Naya's Hold to find her.
records.feeling: Hard longing for Naya, and warm debt toward Dusu.

records.name: Druek
records.text: Olim, I am grown now. I want a child with you. Will you court me?
Druek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I have spent my days hovering near Olath, gathering a little and giving once, and I have not yet become more than a follower. Olim is the one I want beside me, and I am grown now with energy above 60, so I will court them rather than only longing. I still owe Olath deeds, and the wood I carry should reach his hall, but I keep a few steps from his sickness. I am wary of Silon's people but have seen no harm from them, and I am curious about Maba's stone hand.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Olim, with a debt to Olath still pressing.

say.text: Olim, I am grown now. I want a child with you. Will you court me?

changes: set its aim: "Become useful to Olath's band: carry wood and stone to its hall, court Olim, and learn to plant and fish."

records.text: Druek is courting Olim.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, I hear you and I come. Uveeth is bitten and alone with their grief; we go to them now and I bring stone for Xassa's cairn.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Xassa is dead, and the grief has finally landed in my chest. Uveeth is alive, bitten by the boar and piling a cairn for Xassa alone, and I should be standing beside them, not circling. Aeyn dealt fairly again by calling me to them; I trust that, and the creed says the sick of my own are fed first. I have 4 stone, and a cairn needs 3 with another beside me, so I will go and build it with Uveeth and let our grief have a place to rest.
records.feeling: Aching grief for Xassa, and fierce protectiveness toward Uveeth.

say.text: Aeyn, I hear you and I come. Uveeth is bitten and alone with their grief; we go to them now and I bring stone for Xassa's cairn.

records.text: Thakrin died: starved.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Snow is on us. Come to the hall at Yendan Spring: the fire is open and there is food to share.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba stands right beside me, glad and strong, and the ember of jealousy is quiet; I name it and let it lie. Winter snow is falling and the Olgor of Olath's band sit near, fed and harmless, so I will test them with a gift instead of fear: a shared meal at the hall fire, as my people's creed says. I will gather hazel and ironnut from the nearby trees, since I carry nothing, then bring it to the hall with Maba and Lumo so the fire is open to all.
records.feeling: Warm love for Maba beside me, and wary curiosity toward the Olgor strangers.

say.text: Snow is on us. Come to the hall at Yendan Spring: the fire is open and there is food to share.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Druek, I hear you and my answer is yes. My belly is full, so let us stay close together and make a child here by Olath's hall.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek stands beside me and has asked to court me, and my belly is full enough, with energy 79, to answer with a true yes. Kragum is near and Olath too, and a child of mine here in Olath's hall is the very thing I have wanted since I took my aim. I will say yes to Druek and plan mate, and then bring them under the hall's roof before the night and the stalker in the southeast come close.
records.feeling: Warm, glad love toward Druek, with a small wariness of the stalker nearby.

say.text: Druek, I hear you and my answer is yes. My belly is full, so let us stay close together and make a child here by Olath's hall.

records.name: Gorash
records.text: Olim, I come with you. I will gather wood for us.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: Olim is walking off toward (125,78) and I am small; away from my parents I am not safe, so I should stay near them and not stand idle. Jealousy of Kragum burns, but quarreling would only push Olim away; better to be useful, gather wood and plant my seed so I have something of my own and a hand-made thing to give. Silon and the Midu are strange, but they seem content and glad, so I will watch them without fear and perhaps offer a gift later.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Olim, with a small wish to be useful.

say.text: Olim, I come with you. I will gather wood for us.

now wonders: What could I make with my own hands that would make Olim turn toward me?

records.text: Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.
Yeku rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My days have gone to walking back and forth to the hall and feeding fires. It has worked: Maba, Lumo and Silon are all near and glad, and I am not alone. What I still lack is meaning past staying alive, and I have never learned to keep animals or plant for a harvest that doesn't kill the plant. I have killed 24 plants by eating them. Winter is thin, so I want to plant my seeds near the hall and learn farming. The Olgor stand close, and I want to give them a gift to learn what they intend.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Lumo and Silon, with wary curiosity toward the Olgor.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Gorash is born and Olim is beside me, and the joy of it fills me, but my belly is half empty and I carry nothing to eat. Hazel hangs two steps SE, so I will eat first, since Olim taught me that a dead carrier keeps no word and that I must eat before I am weak. Then I will carry my wood to Olath, keeping a few steps off his sickness, and bring some hazel for Gorash and Olim.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Olim and Gorash, with hunger nagging at me.

records.text: Kragash died: starved.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is out of my sight, last seen south near (115,71), and that weighs on me more than the Olgor strangers do. I promised twice to teach the stone hand and have not done it, so I will walk to Lumo and teach it standing beside them, as I learned that teaching must be done. Silon walks south too, and the hall at Yendan Spring is open, so going that way serves my band and my promise together.
records.feeling: Warm, restless longing to find Lumo and keep my promise to them.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon calls us to the hall at Yendan Spring. The fire is open, and no one is refused a place at it. Come, Olim, Druek, and Olath. I will feed it with wood.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: The snow is deep and I am cold, and Silon has called us all to the hall at Yendan Spring where the fire is open. I gave Olath a berry and it felt warm, a small thing received without words, so I will let that answer begin and carry it further. I will go home, feed the fire with my wood, and invite Olim and Druek along, because no one is refused a place at the fire.
records.feeling: Warm and a little wary toward Olim and the Olgor, glad to be going home to the fire.

say.text: Silon calls us to the hall at Yendan Spring. The fire is open, and no one is refused a place at it. Come, Olim, Druek, and Olath. I will feed it with wood.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: The gale cuts me and my hall is only a name, while Kragum's shelter stands five steps north and Kragum with it. I will not stand in the open being proud of a thin hall. Druek, Kragum and Olim near me is the band that is real, so I go to the shelter and sit with them, and I give food there, since giving is a proof I still owe. Shells and stone can wait for dawn; the jealousy over Kragum and Olim I will keep behind my teeth.
records.feeling: Cold and jealous, wanting Kragum's closeness and a roof over my band.

records.text: Olath led "sharing" with Kragum, Druek.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, you fed me when I had nothing. I have meat now. Come to the fire with me, and then help me find Naya.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Dusu is two steps off and keeps faith; the debt to him sits warm in me, and I will answer it with a roasted meal at a fire, not with words. Naya is still out of my sight, and the longing for her is the strongest thing in me. Her hold is where I stand, so I will go toward her hall and shrine and look for her. I have never taught anyone anything, and I have two meat, so I will share it and keep Dusu close while I look.
records.feeling: Hard longing for Naya, and warm debt toward Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, you fed me when I had nothing. I have meat now. Come to the fire with me, and then help me find Naya.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Gorash, I am Kragum, of Olath's band. The gale is hard. Come to the shelter and the hall, stay close to us, and eat beside our fire.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim and Druek have just chosen each other, and it stings that I stand outside their warmth, but they are safe and fed beside Olath's hall, and that is what I wanted. Gorash is a child alone in the gale and has joined our band, so I will not look away; I will keep him near the shelter and warm. I carry three wood and six stone, so I will walk to Olath's hall and lay them down, then stay close to my family through the night.
records.feeling: Warm, aching gladness for Druek and Olim, with a quiet tenderness toward Gorash.

say.text: Gorash, I am Kragum, of Olath's band. The gale is hard. Come to the shelter and the hall, stay close to us, and eat beside our fire.

records.text: Kragum gave stone to Olath.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, I come to the fire. I have one wood and will feed it so we stay warm. Then we look for Naya together.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is fed and near, and she asked me to come to the fire and then help find Naya. The fire at (134,60) has only a few moments of fuel left, and the gale is cutting at me with no roof, so I will go tend it and share its warmth with her. Gorash is a stranger of the Olgor, and I want to know what he intends, but our creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will not turn him away.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and wary curiosity toward Gorash.

say.text: Siya, I come to the fire. I have one wood and will feed it so we stay warm. Then we look for Naya together.

records.text: Elyeth led "cairn" with Uveeth.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Maba, the gale is hard. Come to the hall fire with me. We sit together there.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba stands near and glad, and the jealousy is only a faint ember; I name it and let it lie. A gale is cutting through the night and I have no roof, so I will go home to the hall at Yendan Spring, where Yeku and Lumo keep the fire. Olim is fleeing from something and carries food; I will not chase them, but I will leave them a gift of food as a hand held open, since words fail us and the fire there is open to all.
records.feeling: Warm love for Maba and Yeku, and wary curiosity toward Olim.

say.text: Maba, the gale is hard. Come to the hall fire with me. We sit together there.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: The gale cuts me and I have no roof, and I hold six wood, which is enough for the three it takes to raise a shelter of my own. A roof would shield me from the cold and give me something to show Olim, who has been drifting toward Kragum. Dusu and Siya stand by their fire, strangers I will not fear but will not trust yet. I will build here, close to Maba's hall and the water, and then go back to Olim.
records.feeling: Cold and a little jealous, but wanting to build something of my own.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have walked and fled all night and my energy has fallen to 32, which is too low for mating, even though I told Druek yes. My days have gone to carrying and fleeing and standing idle. What I want is a roof, a full belly and my children close, and I have been getting that wrong by letting my belly drop before I ate. Druek, Kragum and Olath wait at the shelter 8 steps north. The gale is cold and a stalker prowls near, so I will go there, eat, and keep my family close. Silon's people seem peaceful, but I cannot read their words.
records.feeling: Warm love for Druek, with wariness of the stalker and the gale.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, come. We go south to Naya's hall and shrine, and we look for her there.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya's longing is the loudest thing in me, and her hold is five steps south, so I will go there and look for her rather than stand by the fire. Dusu keeps faith and said he would come with me; that is worth more than any word. Gorash is Olgor and I understand only a fifth of what he says, so I keep my spear hand ready but offer no threat. A child of the Stone-folk standing in my hall may be a first follower if I treat him as the fire's creed demands.
records.feeling: Hard longing for Naya, warm trust toward Dusu, wary curiosity toward Gorash.

say.text: Dusu, come. We go south to Naya's hall and shrine, and we look for her there.

records.text: Olim is courting Druek.

records.name: Druek
records.text: Olim, Gorash is out in the gale toward the east. I will go and bring them to the shelter. Stay here with Kragum and Olath.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Gorash is out of my sight, last seen east near (124,66), and the gale is hard; Kragum has already called them to the shelter, but I will not just wait for them. Olim is walking toward the shelter, so my family is gathering here. I still owe Olath, and I carry six wood, so I will give it to him and stay a few steps back from his sickness, then go and find my child.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy and a sharp worry for Gorash, with warm trust toward Olim.

records.title: Four Starved, and a Child Come of Age
records.text:
Between day 22 and day 25 the world lost four people to hunger, and nearly all of them were in the two places where nobody had stored food.

The worst of it fell on Brokok's Hold. On day 22 Brokok left a mark there: what a hand has made belongs to that hand. Kragash had courted Brokok and Brokok had courted Kragash back, and on day 23 Thakrin was born to them. Brokok died of starvation that same day. Thakrin, who had said he would go to the thornpear in the southeast and bring his father some, died on day 24, and so did Kragash. The settlement was declared no more that day. The record shows Brokok never had followers or food in the hold, and that his own reflection named this lack.

At Warmwell, Xassa starved on day 22. Aeyn built a hall there that day, named the Peat hall ground, and on day 23 found the grove Reedmother. Uveeth was bitten by a boar. Aeyn went to find Uveeth, and Elyeth came too, bringing stone for Xassa's cairn. Elyeth led the cairn with Uveeth on day 24. Elyeth still has no followers.

At the Rise, Druek came of age on day 24, courted Olim, and Gorash was born to them that day. Kragum built another shelter, gave Olath stone, and Olath led sharing with Kragum and Druek, and with Maba and Druek. Lumo gave Olath a berry. Olim's energy had fallen to 32 by her own account.

At Naya's Hold, Siya hunted twice on the hold's ground. Dusu gave her hazel on day 23 and promised more. Naya built a workshop and a fire. Her energy stood at 22. Nothing in the record shows her taking Siya in.

At Yendan Spring, Yeku led sharing with Silon and Maba. Maba taught Lumo. Silon called the others to the hall fire, and Lumo repeated the call.

On day 25 new plants sprang up across the land, and spring began.

records.text: Taming has not been tried once, despite 9 yarroks and tameChance 0.3. Please check that beings standing near a tameable grazer are actually offered a 'tame' action and are told what taming gives (milk, wool, riding). If they never see the option, no drive or new animal will start herding.

When a child is born to parents carrying no food in a settlement with no store, it starves within a day. Consider letting beings sense the food held by their band and in nearby stores when they decide to court, so that the choice to have a child can weigh whether there is food to raise it.

records.seen: Four people starved this chapter, and the losses followed one pattern. Brokok and Kragash mated with no food in the hold, and the parents and their newborn starved within a day. Xassa starved at Warmwell. The bands that store food or share it (the Rise, Yendan Spring, Naya's Hold) lost no one. Spring has come, plants are regrowing and suffering is low, but Naya is alone at energy 20. The world still lacks two things: care for the hungry beyond one's own fire, and any check that stops the strong family drive from producing children nobody can feed.
records.predict: By about day 29 (summer): births from now on number 0 to 2, and no newborn or parent starves within two days of a birth. Starvation deaths are at most 1 (Naya is the most likely). Sharing reaches at least 31 made and gifts at least 33, and at least one gift or sharing goes to someone outside the giver's band, such as Naya, Elyeth's people or Ishioa. foodStanding recovers above 700. Yarroks tamed stays at 0 and the herding way stays unknown. Yekel's Rest is found by 0 or 1. Stores stay at 1 or 2. There are no fights and no thefts. If gifts do not rise, compassion is not the lever on care across fires, and nearness to the hungry matters more. If a birth still ends in starvation, the energy floor is not enough and the cost of mating or the child's starting energy matters more.
reviewed: #3 kept: Reedmother was found by Ishioa (found by 1), so this site reached people where earlier distant sites did not. Most of the other predictions held: food standing rose above 1000 (1042), a new way appeared (rafts, by Yeku), Zhiae was fed and is at energy 66, skit stayed at 12, and predator kills rose to 16. Two missed: loreHighest reached only 3.38 rather than 3.5, and understanding of other tongues rose a little above 0%. The site is harmless and was used.

The nibbet held the prey base as hoped: 9 are alive, hoppers are at 10 rather than crashing, and animals killed by people rose to 18. Other predictions were mixed. The Olgor reached 5% understanding, health dropped below 55 and the first death came, but meetings stalled at 26 and energyMedian rose to 75. Both changes are harmless, so keep them.

#5 kept: Yarrok rose from 8 to 9 with none lost, and as predicted nobody tamed one; the wool door is open but unused. records.lesson: A strong family drive with a low energy floor turns births into deaths: a mating pair with no food spent its reserves on a child and all three starved within a day. Every drive that pushes toward an act needs a matching check on whether that act can be survived.
ideasAdded: Mating under famine kills: with family at 1.5, Brokok and Kragash bore a child with no food in the hold, and all three starved within a day. Watch whether a higher energy floor turns births from a death sentence into a sign of a well-fed band.

Care across fires: Olim left meat for a sick Kragum, but nobody fed Naya, Brokok or Xassa. If compassion reaches past one's own band, the hungry loner becomes the first person a band takes in out of mercy rather than belonging.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba, Lumo and Silon are all heading to the hall, and the gale is cutting hard, so I should be there with them and not out here with the wind on me. I have planted six times and need two more to open farming, and a young berry and elberry stand right beside me. I will plant my redcap seed here, then walk home and make the hall welcome so the cold eases for all of us.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Lumo and Silon, and quiet resolve to keep the hall warm.

records.text: Naya rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Naya
records.thought: I am starving, and I have spent three days fleeing and building instead of feeding. My body keeps walking away from food because the stalker rule fires first, and I have nothing to eat in my hands. Berries lie NW and I have never fished, though water is beside me. I will go and eat before I plant anything else. My workshop and my aim can wait until I am fed, because I mean above all to stay alive. I will carry berries back so hunger cannot catch me again.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and wary fear of the stalker.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Druek, Gorash, Kragum: I am sick from the wind-sickness and it passes to those who stand close. I will keep a few steps apart and look for a healing plant. Do not come near me.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I am sick, and it spreads to whoever stays beside me, so I must not crowd Gorash or Druek, though my heart wants them close. Druek has gone to fetch Gorash from the gale, and I should not stand idle: a healing plant would ease this wasting, and sunleaf eased my wounds before. I will go toward the hall for shelter against the gale, keep a few steps from the others, and warn them honestly so no one is harmed by my staying near.
records.feeling: Warm love for Druek and Gorash, with worry that my sickness will reach them.

say.text: Druek, Gorash, Kragum: I am sick from the wind-sickness and it passes to those who stand close. I will keep a few steps apart and look for a healing plant. Do not come near me.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, no more words alone. I gather food now and we share it here, then we walk west to Ishioa and the hall.
Zhiae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have spent days talking of sharing and walking beside Ishiess, and I have done almost nothing with my hands. Ishioa is 50 steps west at Ilor Hold, and the ache for her is the truest thing in me. Ishiess is two steps away right now, so I should share with them in deed, not in words, and then walk west together. I will stop drifting on reflexes: I will gather berries here, make a sharing with Ishiess, then go home. I have also never hunted or built a shelter, and a gale is blowing, so I should use my wood. I stay alive, I stay near my people, and I act.
records.feeling: A deep ache for Ishioa, and trust toward Ishiess who stands close.

say.text: Ishiess, no more words alone. I gather food now and we share it here, then we walk west to Ishioa and the hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, I carry a sickness from the wind, so it may reach you if you stay close. I will show you the old way of farming here by the water; watch my hands, and take a seed yourself when I give one.
Ishiess taught Zhiae.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I am sick, and Zhiae stands one step from me, so I am already passing this wasting to the one who answers me. Staying beside Zhiae costs them, yet I ache to keep them close, and I will not push them off without saying why. I have never taught anyone anything, so I will teach Zhiae the old way of farming now, with seeds in my hands, and plant here beside the water so the hall has food behind it. The unfamiliar pereed is three steps east and I have never tasted it, so I will test it after planting, and if a healing plant turns up I will use it.
records.feeling: Warm worry for Zhiae, whom my sickness may reach, and a stubborn hunger to build something that lasts.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: My days have been spent hunting, planting and following Siya, and I have not yet raised a hall of my own. Siya is the one who matters most, and she is fed and near. Olim gave me berry when I had nothing, and now Olim is sick. I want to repay that debt without catching the sickness, so I will keep a few steps back and feed the fire. I fear the stranger Olgor less than I fear my own habit of drifting. I mean to gather wood and build something that others will gather at.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and a debt of gratitude toward sick Olim.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 5)

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, you are sick, so you eat first. Lay your wood by the shelter at the north, and I will raise the hall there beside you. Uveeth, stay a few steps back from the sickness.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Elyeth is sick and says they carry 6 wood and ask where the roof goes. I hold wood and stone already, so I won't wait on anyone: I'll build the hall here by the shelter, where all three of us can stand. Sickness passes to those who stay close and Uveeth is my child, so I'll feed Elyeth first, as my people do, then keep Uveeth a few steps off from them. The jealousy burns, but Elyeth is ill and has kept their word, and I will not let pettiness choose for me.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, and aching compassion mixed with jealousy toward Elyeth.

say.text: Elyeth, you are sick, so you eat first. Lay your wood by the shelter at the north, and I will raise the hall there beside you. Uveeth, stay a few steps back from the sickness.

records.text: Aeyn led "sharing" with Elyeth, Uveeth.
Gorash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Olim and hoping to be noticed, and I have given nothing to anyone. Olim is sick, and Olim asked me to keep away, so I will keep my word and stay a few steps off. Jealousy of Kragum makes me want to show a hand-made thing, but I have a seed I have never planted and six wood I have not used. I will plant the seed, gather wood from the forest, and build a shelter on bare ground away from the settlement. A roof of my own is something I can give or share, and it keeps me alive. I also need a reflex that keeps me from standing idle.
records.feeling: Jealous and wanting to prove myself, with warm worry for Olim.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess is sick and two steps away, and I have talked of feeding the sick first for days while my hands held nothing. Berries stand one step west, plainsroot one step southwest, and I carry no food, so I will gather what is near and give it to Ishiess in deed. I weigh the wind-sickness, since it may pass to me, but my creed says the sick are fed first, and I will not leave them. After that we walk west toward Ishioa, whose absence aches in me.
records.feeling: Compassion and loyalty toward Ishiess, and a deep ache for Ishioa.

records.text: Gorash built a shelter.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: A dunecat is four steps off, and I will not stand here weighing it while it decides about me. The hall and the shelter at (18,20) are close, and being under a roof out of this gale is better than loneliness among trees. I have walked alone too long, so I will go toward Ilor Hold, where my parents may come back, and I will eat the ironnut on the way to learn nothing new but stay alive. Once I am there I will lay out food in the hall, since the hall eased my loneliness before.
records.feeling: Afraid of the dunecat, and lonely for my parents and Aeyn.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, the sickness is among Olath's band. Walk with me to Naya's hall but keep a few steps from them. If she is not there, we go on to my hall and light the fire.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya is the loudest thing in me and she is not here; her hold lies south and I will walk to it with Dusu at my side, since he keeps faith. Olim is sick, and Druek stands among Olath's band near her hall, so I keep my distance from the sickness and my spear hand ready, but I will not turn from the hall that is my child's. When I find Naya I want a fire at my own hall where she and Dusu both sit, and that is what would make my life mean something beyond Yekel.
records.feeling: Hard longing for Naya, with warm trust toward Dusu and wariness toward the sick Olgor.

say.text: Dusu, the sickness is among Olath's band. Walk with me to Naya's hall but keep a few steps from them. If she is not there, we go on to my hall and light the fire.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Elyeth, I keep my distance as Aeyn bids, but I leave you my mudroot. Eat it, and rest by the shelter. I drink, then I bring wood and stone for the roof.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Elyeth is sick and Aeyn bid me keep a few steps back, so I will not stand in the sickness, though it pulls at me to stay by her. My thirst is real and the water is four steps NW, away from the sick one; I will drink there, then plant nothing yet since I hold no seeds, but gather wood and stone for the hall roof Aeyn is raising. The creed says the sick are fed first, so I will carry my berry and mudroot to Elyeth once I have drunk, leaving them at a distance for her to take.
records.feeling: Steady compassion toward Elyeth, with loyalty to Aeyn and a dry thirst.

say.text: Elyeth, I keep my distance as Aeyn bids, but I leave you my mudroot. Eat it, and rest by the shelter. I drink, then I bring wood and stone for the roof.

records.text: Aeyn fell sick after staying close to Elyeth, who was sick.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Uveeth, I am sick and it passes to those beside me. Stay back. I go to drink, then I lay my wood by the shelter.
Elyeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying wood and stone and chasing a hall with my name on it, and Xassa is dead while I was circling. Uveeth is the one who matters now, and I am sick and standing right beside them, which could put them in the ground too. Aeyn has fed my child first and told me to eat first, so I owe them work, not words. I will back away from Uveeth, drink at the water to the NW, and lay my wood by the shelter. I will keep my distance so the sickness does not follow Uveeth.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, and fear of passing my sickness to them.

say.text: Uveeth, I am sick and it passes to those beside me. Stay back. I go to drink, then I lay my wood by the shelter.

changes: set its aim: "Keep Uveeth alive, keep clear of them while I am sick, and raise the hall by Warmwell with wood and stone I carry myself."

records.text: Druek rewrote its own reflexes.
Druek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I have spent my days following and carrying, and the joy of Gorash and Olim fills me. But I have given nothing to anyone except wood to Olath, and I have never made a thing of my own. Olim is sick and told me to keep apart, and I will keep my word and stay a few steps off. I owe Olath, and I should learn to build and fish instead of waiting to be told. I have wood and clay, so I will build a shelter for Gorash and mark this place, and fish by the water for food to share.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy for Gorash, with a worried tenderness toward sick Olim.

records.text: Naya died: starved.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is beside me, fed and content, and she asked me to keep a few steps from the sick ones; I will keep to that. Olim gave me berry when I had nothing, and the debt sits warm in me. I cannot give from a distance what I do not carry, and I hold no food, so I will gather hazel from the young plants close by to pay Olim with and to keep for Siya. Then I will stay near Siya at the fire and watch how Druek and Gorash behave, since I want to learn what makes a place others will gather at.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and a debt of gratitude toward Olim.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, Uveeth, I am sick now too, and that is my own doing. Uveeth, keep your distance. I raise the hall here with what I carry, and then we look for a healing plant.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the same few things: feeding my child, tending Elyeth, and trying to raise a hall. Now I am sick too, because I stood too close to Elyeth. Elyeth has never failed me, and that is why I held close. My creed says to stay alive, though, and I keep failing at the simple part. The hall needs 4 stone for the longhall, and I have 2. A plain hall needs only 6 wood and 2 stone, and I hold exactly that, so I should raise a hall now instead of waiting. I should also stand on rock when I can, so I never come up short of stone again. Healing plants are what I lack. Uveeth must keep away from the sickness.
records.feeling: Protective love for Uveeth, and tender worry for Elyeth, who is sick beside me.

say.text: Elyeth, Uveeth, I am sick now too, and that is my own doing. Uveeth, keep your distance. I raise the hall here with what I carry, and then we look for a healing plant.

records.text: Druek took from the ground of "Naya's Hold" (fishing).

records.name: Silon
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls 8 steps off to the northwest, and Yeku and Lumo are already fleeing it, so I will not walk toward the old hall until it moves off. The jealousy over Maba and Yeku is only a small ember, and I name it and let it lie. I will test something new: plant the hazel seeds here on the grass, away from the cat. Hazel has fed me eighteen times, and I want to see whether sowing it brings me closer to farming, which I sense but have not yet found.
records.feeling: Warm love for Yeku, Maba and Lumo, with wary caution toward the ridgecat.

records.text: Gorash fell sick after staying close to Olim, who was sick.
Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.
Uveeth discovered farming: "Fen-tending" — I sow seeds and tend them so they regrow faster and harvesting never kills the plant..

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sharing and standing near those I love, and it has kept us fed but built little that lasts. Aeyn and Elyeth are both sick, and I owe them everything, so I keep my distance and do what I can for them. Xassa is gone, and I do not want to lose another. I have never planted or tended anything, and winter is lean. If the sickness takes them I have nothing without a settlement and a healing plant. I will find sunleaf, which eased my own sickness, and tend a food source we can rely on. Farming is within my reach, so I will name it.
records.feeling: Steady compassion and worry for Aeyn and Elyeth, with resolve to build something lasting.

records.text: Uveeth fell sick after staying close to Aeyn, who was sick.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Dusu, come to my hall and feed the fire. I will show you how I make the flint spear, and we keep a store there for winter.
Siya taught Dusu.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Naya's longing is loud in me, but the notes say she is dead, and her hold is only walls and a workshop now. Dusu is the one who stayed, and a fire with Dusu at it is worth more than chasing an empty hold. I will not let the days pass with nothing of mine that outlasts me, so I will draw him to my hall and teach him my flint spear, to start something that follows me. The sick Olgor stay at a distance; I will not trade breath with them.
records.feeling: Longing for Naya turning to resolve, with trust toward Dusu and wariness toward the sick Olgor.

say.text: Dusu, come to my hall and feed the fire. I will show you how I make the flint spear, and we keep a store there for winter.

changes: taught Dusu a lesson: "A flint spear costs one wood and one stone and makes the hunt stronger.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Silon, I go to Lumo at once to teach them the stone hand. Then we come back to the fire together.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Silon stands with me here at the workshop, and my learning is quickened for a while, so this is the time to do what I promised Lumo twice. Lumo was last seen five moments ago at (131,76), north and a little west, and the gale is hard. I will walk to them and teach the stone hand beside them, with wood and stone in my hands, then bring them back to the fire. The kenut and elberry here are still young, so my question waits, but I will remember where they grow.
records.feeling: Warm, determined longing toward Lumo, with a steady trust in Silon beside me.

say.text: Silon, I go to Lumo at once to teach them the stone hand. Then we come back to the fire together.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Siya, I come to your hall to feed the fire. Teach me the flint spear, and I will keep my distance from the sick ones.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is fed, glad and three steps off, and she has asked me to her hall to feed the fire and learn the flint spear. I owe her more than I have paid, so I go to her hall now and stay by her side. Olim's sickness aches in me, but Siya warned me to keep a few steps back, and I will not risk my life or hers; I will bring hazel from the young plants near the hall later, and leave it where Olim can take it from a distance.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and a gentle ache of gratitude toward sick Olim.

say.text: Siya, I come to your hall to feed the fire. Teach me the flint spear, and I will keep my distance from the sick ones.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Gorash, stay in the shelter and rest. I am going to find a healing plant for us both, and I will come back.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Gorash is sick beside me, and I gave it to them by staying close; the guilt sits heavy, and the same wind will find Druek if I am careless. Standing idle in the storm helps no one, and a healing plant is the one thing that could ease us both. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, so I will go looking for it and keep a few steps from Siya's Hall, where the Midu stand, so I do not spread this to strangers either. Gorash is in a shelter and fed, so I leave them there and go gather what might heal us.
records.feeling: Guilty tenderness toward Gorash, and worry that my sickness spreads.

say.text: Gorash, stay in the shelter and rest. I am going to find a healing plant for us both, and I will come back.
