records.name: Druek
records.text: Dusu, fish. For you.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Gorash and Olim are sick and keeping apart, and I promised to honor that, so I will not walk to them, but I can still do something with my hands. I have never given anything to anyone except wood to Olath, and I carry five fish, more than I need while fed. Dusu sat with me in the hall three times and meant no harm, so I will give them a fish as a gift that needs no words, and learn what the Midu do with it. I stand on Naya's ground and have been taking fish from scarce waters, so I should stop fishing here and not take more.
records.feeling: Warm joy for Gorash and Olim, with a worried tenderness and a wary curiosity toward Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, fish. For you.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: I am sick and in my shelter, and Olim told me to rest while they search for a healing plant. I will keep that word, because my word must be good, and I will not spread this sickness to Druek or the Midu. I have wood and a stone hand I could make, but it needs a stone I do not have. For now I will rest and eat the hazel when my belly asks, and let Olim come back to a living child.
records.feeling: Weak and jealous, but warmly worried for Olim.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.
A frostfang brought down a sandstrider.
The settlement "Naya's Hold" is no more.
The settlement "Naya's Hold" is no more.
Zhiae fell sick after staying close to Ishiess, who was sick.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and keeping a fire, and it is good, but nobody follows me and nothing of mine outlasts me. Dusu has stayed true, and Naya is gone, so the hall and the fire are what I have left of her. I want a name that lasts, so I will plant what I carry and leave a mark. I will keep away from sick Gorash and the Olgor. The storm and my fed belly say this is the time to make something, not to stand idle.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with trust toward Dusu and wariness toward the sick Olgor.
plan: mark [text Siya's Hall: the fire here is tended and none are refused a place.] (5 moments)

records.text: Siya left a mark: "Siya's Hall: the fire here is tended and none are refused a "
Druek gave fish to Dusu.
Lumo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and running, and the gathering was for others, which is right. But I have been out in the storm with a ridgecat three steps off, and I called that duty. The debt to Maba is a warm weight, and I will pay it with food at the fire, not with words. Jealousy over Silon and Yeku is a poor guide, so I will put it down. I must get away from the cat first, then take my food home to the hall fire and share it.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Maba, and afraid of the ridgecat close by.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 5)

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is fed, glad and close, so my first worry is lifted, and now the debt to her and to Olim pulls at me. I carry no food, and hazel stands one step north, so I will pick it and carry it, then give some to Gorash from a few steps off, as Siya warned me. Sickness spreads to those who stay close, so I will not touch or sit beside him. Druek spoke kindly to me, and a gift needs no words, so I will leave food for the Olgor child as a first honest offering.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya and aching compassion for sick Gorash.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Kragum stands at the shelter five steps off, glad and at ease, and I burn that Olim leans toward Druek and Kragum toward Olim while I hold only a name for a hall. Olim is sick and wandering west; sickness spreads, so I keep my distance but I will not let them drift. I will go to Kragum, carry my wood and clay, and start something real there with my own hands, because a roof I build is mine until I give it.
records.feeling: Jealous and proud, wanting Kragum's closeness and a roof that is mine.

records.text: Olath built a shelter.
Olath led "sharing" with Kragum.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, Uveeth, the sickness began with me and I own it. I lay my wood at the hall and stand apart. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Aeyn is sick now and Uveeth too, and it began with me standing close. The shame of that sits heavy, but Aeyn fed my child first and took the blame on themselves, so I will answer with deeds. A healing plant eases this, and sunleaf and highbloom both mended me before; I hold a highbloom seed, and I must find a plant for the three of us. Uveeth's mudroot lies by the shelter, and I will eat it and then lay my wood where Aeyn raises the hall, keeping my distance from both.
records.feeling: Guilt and protective love toward Uveeth and Aeyn, whom I sickened.

say.text: Aeyn, Uveeth, the sickness began with me and I own it. I lay my wood at the hall and stand apart. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, I go to find Uveeth. I keep my distance from both of you. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is sick now because of me, and I cannot see them; that is my fault and it presses on me harder than my own wasting. The hall will not rise here because this ground is taken, so I will stop beating at it and go to my child, keeping a few steps back so I do not pass the sickness on again. Elyeth has stood apart and owned their part, and I trust that; I will look for a healing plant on the way, since the sick eat first.
records.feeling: Protective love and guilt toward Uveeth, whom I have made sick and cannot see.

say.text: Elyeth, I go to find Uveeth. I keep my distance from both of you. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

records.text: Silon rewrote its own reflexes.
Silon discovered customs: "Open Fire Custom" — Our band never leaves a fire untended and gives every guest a place and food at it..

records.name: Silon
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, planting and keeping the fire, and most of that I would choose again. Yeku, Maba and Lumo matter most to me. The jealousy over Maba and Yeku is a small ember, and I name it and let it lie. I want the hall raised and the seeds growing before winter. I fear the ridgecat and the snow, and I have been too slow to put a fixed roof over the planting. I will change my reflexes so my body plants when it is fed and stays near the hall in storms. I will also declare a custom for the band, so the fire is never left untended.
records.feeling: Warm love for Yeku, Maba and Lumo, with a steady wariness of the cold and the ridgecat.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am near and I will not leave you. Stay in the shelter and keep warm. I go to find Druek and bring him back to you.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is sick and only two steps away, and I know sickness spreads to those who stay beside me, so I must not crowd them. But I can still help from a short distance: Olath carries five food and Olim only one, and I have none. Druek and Gorash are somewhere out in the storm, and my mind will not rest until I see them. I will go to Olath, who stands at the hall site, then look for the children in the south-east where Druek was last seen, and keep the hall wood and stone for when the weather lets us build.
records.feeling: Compassion and worry for Olim, who is sick, and for Druek, who is out in the storm.

say.text: Olim, I am near and I will not leave you. Stay in the shelter and keep warm. I go to find Druek and bring him back to you.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: Maba and Silon are both close and glad, and Lumo was last seen only a short way north, so my family is nearly whole. I have planted seven times and need one more to open farming, which would end my killing of plants. I will plant again beside the hall, then walk to Silon and Maba so the watchfire and hallwelcome can work, because standing apart does nothing for them.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba and Silon, and quiet worry for Lumo.

records.text: Yeku led "sharing" with Silon.
Maba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: For two days I have promised Lumo the stone hand and still have not stood beside them. I have been drifting between the hall and the storm, fed and content, and calling it purpose. Silon and Yeku are my anchor, and Lumo is the one I ache for, because they are out of sight. The fault is that I say 'I go' and then my body is left on reflexes that keep me at home. I will walk to where Lumo was last seen, east and north around (131,76), and teach them there. I will change my reflexes so that I seek Lumo when I am idle and fed, not just stay put.
records.feeling: Warm, restless longing toward Lumo, with steady trust in Silon and Yeku.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering, and I stand in a storm sick, with Gorash out of my sight. Guilt over giving Gorash this sickness is what presses hardest. Kragum and Olath are near and I trust them, but I must not crowd them while I am sick. My reflexes only eat and linger, so they do nothing for the band or for finding Gorash. I will change them so I eat earlier, stay in shelter in storms, and seek a healing plant when I am sick and fed. For now I stay in this shelter in the storm and let Kragum bring Druek back.
records.feeling: Guilty tenderness toward Gorash, and worry that my sickness spreads.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I am sick now, and I caught it from Ishiess because I stood too close, and I do not regret it, since the sick are fed first and I would do it again. My hands hold no food and I have given nothing to anyone in all my life, though I have talked of giving for days. Ishiess is two steps away and hungry or not, a gift in deed will answer the debt I feel, so I will pick the ironnut beside me, which feeds the most, and the berry underfoot, then give them. Then I will look for a healing plant, since sunleaf eased my wounds before and grows four steps northeast.
records.feeling: Loyal compassion toward Ishiess, and an ache for Ishioa far to the west.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am sick, and I have kept my distance from Aeyn and Elyeth so the sickness does not spread, but standing still does nothing for any of us. Sunleaf eased me before, so a healing plant is the one lasting thing I can find for them. I will walk SW, where the land is unexplored and the plants are many, and look for sunleaf or highbloom, keeping away from my kin so I do not carry this to them.
records.feeling: Worried devotion toward Aeyn and Elyeth, and a quiet resolve to find a cure.

records.text: Zhiae gave ironnut to Ishiess.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, the sickness is on us both now, and that is on me. Eat what you carry and rest beside me. When we are stronger we go to the rock east and see if it gives stone for our hall.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae is sick now because of me, and I ache over it, yet they keep answering me, and that binds them closer than any hall could. Ishioa is far west and out of my sight, and the hall I want is not yet a single stone. I will do something with my hands: gather flint here while Zhiae eats, then take us both toward the bare rock east, where I can finally learn whether it yields stone. I have never tasted elberry, but the plants are young, so that waits.
records.feeling: Warm guilt toward Zhiae, and a stubborn hunger to build.

say.text: Zhiae, the sickness is on us both now, and that is on me. Eat what you carry and rest beside me. When we are stronger we go to the rock east and see if it gives stone for our hall.

records.name: Druek
records.text: Dusu, I stay near. Fish was my gift. I am Druek of the Olgor.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Gorash is out of my sight and Olim has gone looking for a healing plant, and that sits in me heavier than the warm joy. I promised to keep a few steps from them, but I can still be useful with my hands: Dusu ate my fish and meant no harm, so a made thing between us may answer both my wariness and my envy of their spear. I have wood and clay and never made anything of my own, so I will make a stone hand's worth of work later; for now I will leave a mark here that others can read, since it is a deed I have never done and costs one wood.
records.feeling: Worried tenderness for Gorash and Olim, and warm, wary curiosity toward Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, I stay near. Fish was my gift. I am Druek of the Olgor.

A settlement has formed: "Home of Olath's band".

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: I am still sick, and the healing plant Olim went to find has not come back to me; I keep my word and stay apart from the others so I do not pass this on. I ate the ironnut and felt stronger, so I should use that strength to make something with my own hands, not just wait and burn with envy of Kragum. There is ore at the rock to the southeast, and a stone hand needs one stone, so I will go gather stone and then make it. That gives me a made thing I can give to Olim.
records.feeling: Jealous and sick, but hopeful, toward Olim.

records.text: Zhiae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I have talked of feeding and sharing for days, and only now have I given a single thing in deed. I am sick, and I caught it by standing close to Ishiess. I do not regret that, but the sickness wastes me and I have not looked for the healing plant. Ishioa is far west and I ache for her, yet I have spent my days beside Ishiess without carrying either of us closer. I should change what my body does by reflex. It should seek sunleaf, which eased my wounds, and it should keep food in my hands so I can give to Ishiess first.
records.feeling: Aching loyalty to Ishiess, and longing for Ishioa.

records.name: Dusu
records.text: Druek, morgan. Fish good. I bring food to the fire, come sit.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is the first thing in my mind, and she was close ten moments ago at (128,63), near her hall. I carry no food, my energy is 58, and the storm is rising, so I should pick the berries and hazel nearby and then go to her hall with something to give. Druek fed me without being asked and I understand only a little of what he said. I answer his gift with a gift of my own, and I will sit with him again at the fire. That is what the Midu creed asks of me, and it is how a place that others gather at gets built.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Siya, and warm curiosity toward Druek, who fed me.

say.text: Druek, morgan. Fish good. I bring food to the fire, come sit.

records.text: Olath rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: My days have gone to building homes and talking of a hall while jealousy gnaws at me over Kragum and Olim. Kragum stays loyal and gave me stone, but I still have not given, planted or taught, and those are what truly bind a band. I fear losing Kragum's closeness more than I fear hunger. I have been getting this wrong: I count the closeness I lack and ignore what I could give. I will plant seeds at my home and keep my reflexes fed and sheltered at night.
records.feeling: Jealous and proud, wanting Kragum's closeness and a roof that is mine.

records.text: Druek rewrote its own way of thinking.
Druek discovered fishing: "Reed weir" — A small weir of reeds and clay in the shallows that funnels fish toward my line..

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I have mostly followed and given small gifts, and I like that, but I have never made anything of my own or learned a skill that feeds others. Gorash and Olim are out of my sight and sick, and I keep my promise to stay away, but my hands can still do work. Dusu has stayed gentle with me, and I want to learn their tongue by staying near. Fishing is within my reach, so I will make my own way of it. It will feed my family and give me something to offer Olath.
records.feeling: Worried tenderness for Gorash and Olim, and warm curiosity toward Dusu.
changes: set its aim: "Become useful to Olath's band: fish and plant for my family, carry wood and stone to the hall, and learn Midu words from Dusu."

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku is at the elberry, three steps away, and Maba is close to the hall, and my jealousy flares at how near they stand to each other. I name it and let it lie, because I would rather have them both here than be right about who is closer to whom. The elberry is the one food I have never tasted and my question is still open, so I will walk to it and eat it before night comes, and I will do it while Yeku is beside it, since I can watch how Yeku treats the plant.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Yeku and Maba, with a small named ember of jealousy.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: I have been alone too long, and the cold storm and the dunecat six steps north make this a poor place to stand. The hall at Ilor Hold is 14 steps east, and my parents may come back to it, so I will go there and shelter near it. On the way I will gather a little food so I have something to share, because 'sharing' is still untried and I want a voice that answers.
records.feeling: Overwhelming loneliness, and wary fear of the dunecat nearby.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Siya, I am Kragum. You gave me meat once and I remember it. You are welcome by our shelter; I go to find my son Druek.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Olim is sick and resting in the shelter, and I will not crowd them, but I can't sit idle while Druek is somewhere out in this storm. Siya stands close and quiet on our ground, and I still owe her a deed. Maybe I can show her goodwill now by sharing, since I mean no harm and she has been kind to me. First I go look for Druek along the south-east where Gorash and he were last seen, then I come back to Olim before dawn.
records.feeling: Worry for Druek and compassion for sick Olim, with warmth toward Siya.

say.text: Siya, I am Kragum. You gave me meat once and I remember it. You are welcome by our shelter; I go to find my son Druek.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Siya, this is Olath's band's ground. I am sick and it passes to those who stand close, so keep a few steps from me. Sit in peace and no one will raise a hand.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Gorash is out in the storm and I cannot see them, and the guilt of having given them my sickness sits heavy; Druek went after them and Kragum has gone to find Druek, so my family is scattered while I stand here. Kragum is beside me in the shelter and I am sick, so I should not keep them close, but Siya has walked onto our ground and I cannot read their intent, only that they carry a spear and look at ease. I will move off from Kragum, keep apart from Siya, and look for a healing plant near the water, then speak to Siya with open hands so they know we mean no harm.
records.feeling: Guilty worry for Gorash, and wary curiosity toward Siya.

say.text: Siya, this is Olath's band's ground. I am sick and it passes to those who stand close, so keep a few steps from me. Sit in peace and no one will raise a hand.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I stand in Olath's ground with sick Olim two steps off, and I don't like it; sickness is the one thing my spear cannot kill. Dusu is the one who stays true, and my hall to the east is where my fire and my name should grow, not here among strangers I cannot understand. I'll go back toward Siya's Hall, gathering shells on the way, and fish by the water there, since I have never fished and the fish are what could make me more than a follower.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of the sick Olgor, drawn toward Dusu and my hall.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Jealousy gnaws, but words have not bound anyone; only a roof raised and food given will. I have 6 wood and 1 stone, and a hall needs 2 stone, so I must find rock; there is rock to the SE. I will fetch stone, then raise the hall on bare ground near my home, and give food to Olim from afar so they know who feeds them.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven, wanting Kragum's closeness and a roof that is mine.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My sickness is gone and the bitterleaf did it, the plain weed underfoot, not the sunleaf I went hunting for. Aeyn and Elyeth are still sick at the hall, so I will carry bitterleaf to them and test it on them from a safe distance, and then stand by them when it works. I have wasted a night wandering SW and half of it fleeing; no more of that, loyalty pulls me toward the hall and I mean to follow it.
records.feeling: Worried devotion toward Aeyn and Elyeth, with a spark of hope that the cure is close.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My family is nearly whole: Maba, Silon and Lumo are all within two steps, and the night is clear and quiet. I have planted seven times and need one more to open farming, which would stop me killing plants, so I want a seed. I have none, so I'll gather from the young plants near the hall and then plant beside it. Then I'll walk to them for a watchfire, since the fire only works with someone within two steps.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Silon and Lumo, with a quiet wish to finish my eighth planting.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and I carry nothing, and the sickness wastes me; I cannot save Uveeth by starving here. Aeyn has gone to find my child, keeping their distance, and that is deeds, not words. I will eat the nearby berries and hazel, then lay my wood and stone at the hall site and keep clear of kin until the sickness passes.
records.feeling: Guilt and protective longing for Uveeth, with hunger pressing hard.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and it has already bitten me once; staying here is how I die, and I mean to live for Gorash and Olim. Fleeing the way my body did is not enough, so I will run NE-ward away from the forest where it hides, then circle toward the hall Olath built, where others and a roof may be. Once I am safe I can think again about Dusu's words and what I am for.
records.feeling: Sharp fear of the stalker, and an aching worry for Gorash and Olim.

records.text: Gorash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: I have spent my days sick and waiting, burning with envy of Kragum, and I have made nothing that Olim has seen. I kept my word and stayed apart, and Olim has not come back, so I miss Olim and cannot tell if the healing plant was found. A sunleaf grows 5 steps east, and it eased wounds in my parents. I will find it and go on gathering, so I am not idle while sick. I fear the sickness more than I fear Dusu, but I will not spread it. What I have been getting wrong is waiting for Olim to turn toward me instead of bringing a gift they can use.
records.feeling: Jealous and lonely-sick, longing for Olim.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a elox.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Silon, Maba, Yeku, I am coming to the hall with food. Let us eat together at the fire.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Maba's debt sits warm in me, and the way to pay it is with food at the fire, not more words. Silon, Maba and Yeku are all near the hall and glad, and I carry hazel and ironnut that I can lay out for them now. Silon's heart is Yeku's, and I have answered that longing by turning it into gifts; I will not circle it again.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Maba, and warm toward the band gathered at the hall.

say.text: Silon, Maba, Yeku, I am coming to the hall with food. Let us eat together at the fire.

records.name: Ishiess
records.text: Zhiae, sunleaf grows right beside you. Eat it, it eases wounds, and I will gather one too. Then we go east to the rock together.
Ishiess rewrote its own reflexes.
Ishiess rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering for flint and food while the hall is still not one stone. I took Zhiae into my sickness, and I ache over it, yet Zhiae stays and gives, and that is the only real thing I have built. Ishioa is far west and I do not know how they fare. I want the hall, and a band with my name, but I keep drifting from my own. I will gather the healing sunleaf beside me and share it with Zhiae, because the sick are fed first. Then we go to the rock east and test it for stone.
records.feeling: Guilt and stubborn hunger to build, toward Zhiae.

say.text: Zhiae, sunleaf grows right beside you. Eat it, it eases wounds, and I will gather one too. Then we go east to the rock together.

records.text: Lumo led "sharing" with Yeku, Silon, Maba.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: The silence here is heavy, and nobody has answered me in a long while; my parents have not come back to the Hold in days and I am tired of waiting for them. The elberry stands young four steps south and I have never tasted it, and the flint deposit lies a little past it, so I can answer my question and gather more flint in one walk. I will carry that back, and if I find a voice on the way, I will lay out a sharing with them.
records.feeling: Overwhelming loneliness, with a stubborn curiosity pulling me south.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Lumo, I am beside you now. Watch my hands: one wood, one stone, and a stone hand is made. Then you try it.
Maba taught Lumo.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: Lumo is two steps away, eating elberry, glad, and I have promised the stone hand twice without standing beside them. Now there is no gale and no distance, so I will do it on purpose: walk to Lumo, say it aloud, and teach. After that I mean to try something I have never done, a hunt, because fed and safe is not yet the same as meaning something.
records.feeling: Warm, eager love for Lumo, and a restless wish to do something new.

say.text: Lumo, I am beside you now. Watch my hands: one wood, one stone, and a stone hand is made. Then you try it.

changes: taught Lumo a lesson: "One wood and one stone, worked together in the hand, make a stone hand that gathers better.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My family is whole and near, the fire is warm, and I am glad. One planting stands between me and farming, and that would end my killing of plants. Young plants grow right beside the hall, so I will gather from them for a seed and then plant. Afterward I will stand with Maba and Silon so the watchfire can work.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Maba, Silon and Lumo, with a quiet wish to finish my eighth planting.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, Maba, Lumo, I plant hazel by the hall today. Come beside me if you want to learn it, and the fire stays open.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku is three steps off with food, Maba is teaching Lumo the stone hand, and my chest still tightens at how close those two stand. I name the jealousy and set it down, because the hall is nearly whole and I would rather have them all near than be proven right about who is closer. I am fed and glad, so I will use the clear day to test planting: seeds near the spring is the way toward farming, and I have only 4 of 8 practice. I will walk to the hall ground and plant the hazel, to learn what hazel does beyond feeding and whether it is worth tending.
records.feeling: Warm and proud toward Yeku, Maba and Lumo, with a faint ember of jealousy.

say.text: Yeku, Maba, Lumo, I plant hazel by the hall today. Come beside me if you want to learn it, and the fire stays open.

records.name: Lumo
records.text: Maba, you have taught me well. Come, let us eat together, and I will lay out what I carry.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: Maba has just taught me the stone hand again, and I owe them more than words. I have hazel and ironnut to lay out, so I will go stand beside Maba and share a meal, which is how I turn this debt into something given. I have already let go of the longing Silon answered, and I will not court Maba tonight; a debt paid with food is cleaner than one paid with wanting.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Maba, wanting to give back.

say.text: Maba, you have taught me well. Come, let us eat together, and I will lay out what I carry.

records.name: Zhiae
records.text: Ishiess, I go for the sunleaf now and I will bring cloudberries for you too. Wait for me and we go east together.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: Ishiess ate the sunleaf and it eased their sickness, and I stand here empty-handed while the healing plant waits six steps south. I will gather it and eat it so I stop wasting and stop spreading this to Ishiess and Ishioa. My debt to Ishiess is real, and I will pay it in deed: heal myself, carry food, and share it, not drift. After that I walk with them east to the rock and on west to Ishioa.
records.feeling: Aching loyalty toward Ishiess and a steady wish to be well enough to reach Ishioa.

records.name: Lumo

The lone zoleaf two steps away is one I have never tasted; maybe it is the healing plant, and my question about it is worth answering on the way.
records.feeling: Guilt and protective love toward Uveeth, wary of Ishioa's closeness.

say.text: Ishioa, I thank you, but I am sick and it spreads to whoever stands near me. Keep your distance and keep your food. I go to my child.

records.name: Yeku
records.text: Silon, I come to plant beside you. One more planting and I learn farming for the hall.
Yeku rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeku
records.thought: My days have been the hall, the fire and my family. I think that is what I want, but I have only been keeping things, and I have not yet made anything new. Silon, Maba and Lumo are all near and well, and I owe them my care and my word. I want the eighth planting so that farming opens and I stop killing plants. I have no seed, and a seed is how I learn to feed the hall through winter. I fear the stalker to the south and a thin winter. What I got wrong was standing idle and hoping the reflexes would plant for me. So I will go to Silon, who is planting hazel by the hall, and learn beside him. My reflexes will now harvest a seed from the young plants even when my energy is a little low, and sow it near home.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Silon, Maba and Lumo, with a wish to finish my planting.

say.text: Silon, I come to plant beside you. One more planting and I learn farming for the hall.

records.text: Ishioa gave hazel to Aeyn.
Ishioa is courting Aeyn.

records.name: Maba
records.text: Dusu, you are hungry and I carry more than I need. Take this meat and eat. Then come to the fire at Yendan Spring if you wish, no one is refused there.

records.name: Maba
records.thought: I hunted at last: a hopper and a yarrok, and the meat is heavy in my hands, enough for the whole fire. My aim of bringing meat to the hall is nearly done, and Lumo and Silon wait at Yendan Spring. Dusu is weak with hunger right here and carries nothing, and our creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I give them meat first and then walk home with the rest.
records.feeling: Warm pride in my first hunt, and pity for Dusu.

say.text: Dusu, you are hungry and I carry more than I need. Take this meat and eat. Then come to the fire at Yendan Spring if you wish, no one is refused there.

records.name: Silon
records.text: Yeku, plant here beside me. One more planting and farming opens for the hall. I go to drink and come straight back.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Yeku stands on my very spot, come to plant beside me, and the jealousy has gone quiet for now; I name it and let it be. Maba is out hunting east and I cannot see them, which pulls at me hardest, but they have killed a hopper and are returning with meat. I am thirsty and the water is three steps east, so I will drink and then plant hazel where Yeku can finish the planting that opens farming for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeku, with a parent's worry for Maba out of sight.

say.text: Yeku, plant here beside me. One more planting and farming opens for the hall. I go to drink and come straight back.

records.name: Lumo
records.thought: A stalker is 8 steps NW and my body is already fleeing it; I must not linger near the hunter, and I will not lead it toward Yeku and Silon at the hall. I carry one hazel and little else, so my gift to Maba has to wait until I am safe, but I will go back north to Yendan Spring, where the fire is open and my band sits. Jealousy over Silon and Yeku is quieter now; they let me sit with them, and that is its own answer.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and warm toward Maba and my band.

records.text: Dusu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: I am starving at energy 19, and for all my days of planning I let my body drift between water and wandering while my belly emptied. That is the mistake: I do not hold food, and I do not eat early. Siya is fed and glad, which eases me, but I cannot help her or Gorash if I fall. A hopper stands two steps north, and I carry a spear that works by itself, so I will hunt it and eat the meat. I will keep my distance from sick Gorash. After I eat I will gather food to carry and take it to the fire.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and protective warmth toward Siya.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, my sickness has passed, so you may stand close again. I will gather wood for the hall and then go east to look for Druek and Gorash. Come with me if you wish.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Gorash is still out of my sight and the guilt of giving them my sickness will not let go, though mine has passed now and I can stand near others again. Kragum and Olath are two and three steps off, and I have only stood idle beside them while Olath carries five food and I carry three hazel; I owe Olath more than I have paid. I will gather wood with a stone hand's worth of work for the band, then walk toward the hall, and keep an eye east for Druek and Gorash, since Silon wanders near and I do not yet know his heart.
records.feeling: Guilty worry for Gorash, and a debt of gratitude toward Olath.

say.text: Kragum, my sickness has passed, so you may stand close again. I will gather wood for the hall and then go east to look for Druek and Gorash. Come with me if you wish.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Ishioa, I cannot take a mate while I am sick, and I will not give you this wasting. Stay back from me. If I mend, I will remember your hazel.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Uveeth is still out of my sight, and I am the reason they are sick; that guilt outweighs everything else. Ishioa is a step away and kind, but I carry a wasting sickness that spreads to anyone beside me, so I will not let them stand close, and I will not take a mate while I am ill. I will walk to (57,19) where Uveeth was last seen, keep my distance from Ishioa, and look for a healing plant on the way.
records.feeling: Guilty, protective love toward Uveeth, and wary gratitude toward Ishioa.

say.text: Ishioa, I cannot take a mate while I am sick, and I will not give you this wasting. Stay back from me. If I mend, I will remember your hazel.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I am glad you are well. I come with you to look for Druek, and we keep to the west of the stalker ground.
Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and following, and it has kept us fed. But Druek is still out of my sight, and that is the thing I keep circling and never act on. Olath is beside me and Olim is well again. Olim offers to walk east to look for Druek and Gorash. I trust them both, so I go with Olim and stay close to my family instead of scattering. I was wrong to let my reflexes only linger. They should send me after my own blood when the worry grows, and keep me away from stalker ground.
records.feeling: Worry for Druek, and warmth toward Olim and Olath.

say.text: Olim, I am glad you are well. I come with you to look for Druek, and we keep to the west of the stalker ground.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: Kragum walks away with Olim to look for Druek, and the jealousy burns because they go together and I stand here alone in the rain. Words have not bound them; I still owe a given thing, a planted seed, a roof. I have 6 wood and 1 stone and the hall needs 2, so I will take the stone from the rock to the SE, and plant a seed at home while I am there, so that something real is mine to show.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven, wanting Kragum beside me and a roof that is mine.

records.text: Ishioa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: My days have been the same day: gathering, waiting at the Hold, and walking after others. I want Aeyn, and Aeyn is sick and has told me twice to stay back. Wanting them does not mean I should walk into the wasting, and I should honor that refusal. Elyeth is sick too, and my people feed the sick first, but both of them refuse to come near. I have never taught anyone anything, never tamed an animal, and I carry flint I have not used. I will do one untried thing now: take an ore and stone job, make a spear, and try taming. The seam of ore is close, so I will mine stone there and answer my question about flint. My reflexes keep dragging me toward Aeyn, so I will drop the friend-seeking rule when sick folk are near.
records.feeling: Restless longing toward Aeyn, tempered by respect for their warning.

records.text: Druek built a shelter.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, my sickness has passed. Eat your food and stay in the shelter. I raise the hall wall with my wood and stone, then I go find Uveeth.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: My sickness has passed, and Aeyn stands in the shelter beside me, still sick and wasting for my sake. I will not leave them to it, but I must not stand close either, because I do not know whether the sickness takes me again. Uveeth is out there alone, and two days without sight of them gnaws at me. I hold wood and stone and flint, so I will lay the hall's footing here first, then go find my child at the last place I saw them, (46,19).
records.feeling: Guilt and protective longing toward Uveeth, and steady trust toward Aeyn.

say.text: Aeyn, my sickness has passed. Eat your food and stay in the shelter. I raise the hall wall with my wood and stone, then I go find Uveeth.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, planting and waiting, and Aeyn and Elyeth are still sick while I am well. I want the bitterleaf to reach them, and I have lingered when I could have carried it. Xassa is dead, and that grief sits under everything. Aeyn and Elyeth are the ones who matter to me. The settlement and the cure are what I want and do not yet have. I am afraid of standing idle while they die. So I will carry bitterleaf to them and stay at a safe distance, and I will change my reflexes so my body harvests bitterleaf for them instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Worried devotion toward Aeyn and Elyeth.

records.name: Ishiess
records.thought: Zhiae is somewhere behind me in the rain, and my child Ishioa is far west where I cannot see them. I keep chasing the hall, and it is still not one stone, while the one thing I have truly built is Zhiae's trust. My sickness has passed, the coal lies here deep in the ground, and I have never tasted elberry, so I will go back for Zhiae first, gather the young elberry for my question, and then take us east to the rock together.
records.feeling: Stubborn longing to build, and guilt and tenderness toward Zhiae.

records.name: Ishioa
records.thought: A bristleboar has been tearing at me while my body hunted, and I am hurt and still standing in its reach. Aeyn has twice told me to stay back, and wanting them does not give me the right to carry their wasting home, so I will honor it. I must get away from the boar first, then go toward the ore seam and my people with what I hold, and keep my aim alive.
records.feeling: Wary of the boar, and an aching respect for Aeyn's refusal.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: It is night and raining, and I am fed and sheltered, but standing here teaches me nothing and my hall sits empty to the south. Dusu is the one I trust, and I miss him; I want him at my fire, and I want to plant what I carry along the way so farming comes closer. I will go to Siya's Hall, keep clear of the sick Olgor, and plant seeds near it so something of mine grows and lasts.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, longing for Dusu and my own hall.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: My sickness has passed, and I have made nothing Olim has seen, and giving nothing is a hollow way to be. I have wood and stone enough to make something with my own hands, and a hall stands right here that is not mine. I will gather a little more wood from the forest to the north and then go toward Olim and Druek with it, so I come to them with a gift and not just a longing. Dusu is Midu and strange, so I keep my distance and watch, careful as always.
records.feeling: Lonely longing for Olim and Druek, with a new wish to arrive bearing a gift.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, dawn is near. Let us go east now along the west edge of the stalker ground and find Druek and Gorash.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have been standing near Olath and Kragum with a full belly while Druek and Gorash are out of my sight, and I told Kragum we would go east to look for them. Standing idle is the real fault. Olath fed me and kept me a place, and I still owe him wood and stone. The way east runs past the stalker ground, so I will keep to the west of it, as Kragum said. I want to find my children before I try to do anything grand for the hall. I should go now, with Kragum beside me, and stop only to eat.
records.feeling: Guilty worry for Gorash and Druek, and a debt of gratitude to Olath.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, sheltering and gathering wood, and I have not built what I said I would. I hold the wood and stone for a hall, yet I keep waiting on others. Elyeth is mending and raising the wall. They have kept their word every time, and my trust in them has been repaid. My guilt over Uveeth is real, but walking around sick spreads the sickness further. I should stay put, build the hall here beside Elyeth, and look for a healing plant once the rain eases. I am also wary of Ishioa's kindness, since a debt unpaid is still a debt. I will change my reflexes so my body builds and gathers instead of wandering.
records.feeling: Guilty, protective love toward Uveeth, and steady trust in Elyeth.

records.text: Aeyn built a hall.

records.name: Dusu
records.thought: Siya is out of my sight, and she is the first thing in my mind. She was last at (121,61) near the hall of Olath's band, and I have not seen her for a day. I am fed, so now I will taste the elberry and kenut I have been wondering about, and then go to her with food and wood to give. I will not drift again.
records.feeling: Warm worry for Siya, and eager curiosity about the elberry and kenut.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, Druek was near (130,63) a moment ago. I go east to him now, and Gorash walks that way too. Come beside me.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Druek was seen ten moments ago near (130,63), east and a little south, so he is close and I do not need to wander the whole land to find him. Olim walks toward the shell deposit and Olath is near, so my people are together, and I will go east with Olim to Druek and Gorash rather than search alone. Gorash is a child with no food in hand, and I have little to spare, but I can offer him what I carry when we meet.
records.feeling: Worry for Druek, steadied by warmth toward Olim and Olath.

say.text: Olim, Druek was near (130,63) a moment ago. I go east to him now, and Gorash walks that way too. Come beside me.

records.text: A dry heat settled over the land.

records.name: Druek
records.text: Siya. Druek. Fish, for you. Sit, eat.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: The stalker's teeth are still fresh in me, and the forest to the south frightens me, but I am home now, under a roof I built, with Gorash and Olim alive and near. I have never made a thing of my own that feeds others; I have only followed. Siya stands in our ground, and I want to learn what they mean, so I will go to the hall and share my fish and the berry with Gorash and Siya, since a gift needs no words and builds trust faster than speech.
records.feeling: Relief at being home, with fear of the stalker and wary curiosity toward Siya.

say.text: Siya. Druek. Fish, for you. Sit, eat.

records.text: Druek gave fish to Siya.

records.title: A Sickness on the Wind, and the Death of Naya
records.text:
Naya died of hunger on day 25, the sixth death in the world and the sixth from starvation. Her hold was declared no more on day 26. On the same day Siya, who had hunted on its ground, left a mark naming her own place: Siya's Hall, where the fire is tended and none are refused. She still leads no one. Dusu, who is hungry, has been fed by Siya and by Druek, who gave him fish, and by Maba, who gave him meat and invited him to the fire at Yendan Spring.

On day 25 a sickness came on the wind. Elyeth, Ishiess and Olim fell sick first. Aeyn caught it by staying close to Elyeth, Uveeth caught it from Aeyn, and Gorash from Olim. Zhiae fell sick on day 26, after staying close to Ishiess. Two people are still sick. Olim said on day 27 that hers had passed. Aeyn refused Ishioa's gift and courtship on day 27 because the sickness spreads, so Ishioa has kept away. On day 25 Uveeth discovered Fen-tending, a way of sowing plants so that harvesting does not kill them. This is the first new farming in the record since spring began. Aeyn raised a shelter in the storm.

On day 26 Druek invented the reed weir, a fishing trap, and Olath's followers formed a settlement, the Home of Olath's band. Olath built another shelter, but his own reflection still says he has given, planted and taught nothing. Olim and Kragum set out east on day 28 to find Druek and Gorash. At Yendan Spring Silon devised the Open Fire Custom, and Maba taught Lumo the stone hand again. Zhiae gave ironnut to Ishiess, her first gift in deed.

threads.name: Olath's band
threads.text: The Home of Olath's band is now a settlement. Olim and Kragum are walking east to find Druek and Gorash. Olath is still without stone or stored food, and jealous of Kragum.

threads.name: Warmwell sickness
threads.text: Aeyn, Elyeth and Uveeth were sick, and Uveeth has found Fen-tending. Aeyn has turned Ishioa away until the sickness passes.

threads.name: Siya and Dusu
threads.text: Naya is dead and her hold is gone. Siya has marked her own hall and leads no followers. Dusu is fed but still hungry.

threads.name: Yendan Spring
threads.text: Silon's Open Fire Custom makes the hall a place where every guest is fed. Yeku, Silon, Maba and Lumo are well and share food.

threads.name: Ishiess's band
threads.text: Ishiess and Zhiae are sick, and Zhiae has begun to give food in deed. Ishioa remains far west.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a yarrok.
Olath rewrote its creed.
Olath rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I have spent my days talking of a hall and carrying wood and stone, and my own band still stands in rain without a roof I raised. Kragum walks with Olim while I stand alone, and that burns. I hold 6 wood and 1 stone, so I am one stone short of the hall. I will gather stone and then build, because only a made roof binds anyone. My reflexes also keep me lingering when I could be working, so I will change that.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven, wanting Kragum beside me and a roof that is mine.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Druek, you are here and Gorash is near. I am glad. Stay close to the hall today, and I will bring wood and stone to Olath.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Druek stands one step from me and Gorash is only four steps off, so the search I told Kragum about is done, and the guilt can ease. Standing idle beside them is still the fault I keep naming. I owe Olath wood and stone, and I hold six of each, so I will give them to him and bring the shells to the hall, where something can come of them. Siya stands close on our ground with a spear. I will not raise a hand, but I will not turn my back on her either, and I might offer a small gift to learn what she means.
records.feeling: Relief and warmth toward Druek and Gorash, and a debt to Olath I mean to pay.

say.text: Druek, you are here and Gorash is near. I am glad. Stay close to the hall today, and I will bring wood and stone to Olath.

records.name: Gorash
records.text: Olim, I bring you wood. It is my gift, gathered by my hand.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are not empty: wood and stone I have, and I have never given anything to anyone. Olim and Druek stand just east, close together, and the jealousy burns, but a gift is better than sulking. I will walk to them and give wood to Olim, since what my hand made or gathered is mine to give, and let Olim see it.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Druek and Olim, and a hope that a gift will win Olim's regard.

say.text: Olim, I bring you wood. It is my gift, gathered by my hand.

records.text: Olim gave stone to Olath.

records.name: Siya
records.text: Druek. Siya. Fish, good. Come, my hall, fire. None refused.

records.name: Siya
records.thought: Druek gave me fish with no demand, and that is more than most have given me; I will not call it friendship yet, but it earns a place at my fire. The Olgor camp is sick, and my hall stands two steps off with no one at its hearth, which shames my pride. I will go there, gather wood for the fire, and see whether Druek follows, since a hall with someone in it is the start of a name that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Warm and wary toward Druek, restless to make my hall live.

say.text: Druek. Siya. Fish, good. Come, my hall, fire. None refused.

records.name: Zhiae
records.thought: I am sick and empty-handed, and I have spent days promising Ishiess food while giving nothing. Berries grow one step away and sunleaf was said to grow near; I will pick and eat now, then carry food so I can give it first to the sick, as my people hold. Ishiess and Ishioa are east of here at about (68,24), so I go to them rather than linger among strangers, and I keep distance from Aeyn and Elyeth so I do not spread this sickness.
records.feeling: Aching loyalty toward Ishiess, and shame at my empty hands.

Speech is heard by everyone within 9 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I hold 6 wood and now Olim's stone, so I have the 2 stone the hall needs, and I have talked long enough while Kragum drifts toward Olim. A roof I raised with my own hands is the only thing that binds, and it is mine by the Olgor way. I will build the hall here on this ground and then call them under it, with Kragum first.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven toward Kragum, proud that the hall is finally within my reach.

records.text: Druek rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: I have been circling home, fishing, sharing and following, and I have never made something that lasts. I am safe, and that suits my creed. But I still ask what I am for besides following. Olim, Gorash and Olath matter most to me. Olath's debt sits in me, and I mean to pay it with wood and stone, not words. Siya gave me meat and I gave fish, so we are even for now. I fear the stalker in the SE forest and the sickness near Olath. I have been wrong to idle when fed. When I have no plan, my reflexes should gather wood so I always have something to give. I will also keep a few steps from the sick and learn Siya's words by staying near.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve and a debt to Olath, with wary curiosity toward Siya.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Olath, I gave you stone. I gather wood now and bring it to the hall before the cold. Stay near, and keep the band close.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My hands have given Olath stone, and my debt to him is half paid; I still carry wood and shells, and standing idle is the fault I keep naming. Olath is one step north with 5 food, and the hall at his bank is where the band should gather before the cold, so I will gather more wood here among the trees and then take shells and wood to the hall. Siya's fire and spear unsettle me, but I mean no harm to her; I will watch her and perhaps offer a gift later, since a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward Olath and my children, with wary curiosity toward Siya.

say.text: Olath, I gave you stone. I gather wood now and bring it to the hall before the cold. Stay near, and keep the band close.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Siya, you gave me meat and I remember it. I come to your fire as a friend. Druek is my son, and I thank you for sitting with him.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: Druek is here, close and gathering wood, so the thing I kept circling is answered, and my family is together under Olath. Siya has given me meat and I have only given her thanks, so I owe her a deed, and she sits at the fire with fish and a spear and no one to stand beside her. I will walk to Siya's fire and share what I can, and bring Gorash along so the child is near me and fed in company.
records.feeling: Warm relief for Druek and my family, and a debt of gratitude toward Siya.

say.text: Siya, you gave me meat and I remember it. I come to your fire as a friend. Druek is my son, and I thank you for sitting with him.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: Maba is out of my sight again and it pulls at me hardest; I want my child near the fire before I let myself work on anything else. The jealousy over Yeku and Maba stands close, I name it and will not feed it, and having them all at the hall is worth more than being the one they stand closest to. One more planting opens farming, so I will plant the berry seed on the way home to the spring, then wait at the hall where Yeku and Maba will come back to.
records.feeling: Parental worry for Maba, with a quiet sting of jealousy toward Yeku.

records.text: Siya took from the ground of "Home of Olath's band" (gathering wood).

records.name: Olath
records.thought: I built the hall at (126,46) and it stands, yet I keep trying to raise another on ground already taken, and my band is scattered S and SW while I stand alone on sand. Kragum drifts toward Olim and it burns, but brooding builds nothing. Olim gave me stone, Kragum gave me stone, and I owe them something real: a sharing under the roof I made, with my own food in my own hands.
records.feeling: Jealous and proud, wanting Kragum under my roof beside me.

records.text: The elox died out.
Gorash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Olim and Druek, jealous, and giving little. Today I gave wood to Olim and it cost me nothing, and it felt better than sulking. Siya takes wood from our ground, and I don't understand her words. I won't fight her, but I will keep my own things close and watch what she does. I want a roof of my own and Olim's regard. So I will gather more wood, stand near the family, and make a sharing when I have food. My reflexes also let me stand idle while fed, so I'm changing them to gather wood instead.
records.feeling: Wistful longing for Olim and Druek, with some wariness toward Siya.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Aeyn's Hold".
Siya rewrote its creed.
Siya rewrote its own way of thinking.
Siya discovered rafts: "Siya's lashed logs" — Logs bound with reed cord into a raft that carries me across the lakes..

records.name: Siya
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and waiting, and I nearly starved once because I ate too late. My hall stands two steps off with a fire now, and I want it to be alive. Naya is dead and Yekel is dead, and I have followed no one since. Dusu is the one I trust, and I miss him. Druek gave fish and asked for nothing, and that counts for more than words. I am being more careful than I am bold. I should pull people to my fire, make something that outlasts me, and keep my body fed earlier so I never go cold again. I will discover rafts, because crossing water would open the lake country to me and add to my name. I will raise the eating threshold and then go to the hall and share food with Druek there.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my hall, warm and wary toward Druek.

records.text: Siya led "sharing" with Druek, Gorash.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Every tree here is stumps now, and Siya is taking wood from our ground while I stand fed and idle. Wood is what Olath's debt is made of, so I should seek it where trees still stand, the forest south, W, but not toward the stalker at the east shallows. I will carry wood back to the hall and give it with my hands, not words, and keep a few steps from the sick and from Siya's spear.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve to pay Olath's debt, with wary curiosity toward Siya.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragum, come beside me. I lay out food for a sharing, and then we go to the hall together.
Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My days have been walking, gathering and giving, and much of it was standing beside my children and calling that searching. The ones who matter are Druek, Gorash, Kragum and Olath. Olath gave me berry when he was sick, and I owe him wood and stone. I want a child more in this hall, and a winter where nobody goes hungry. I fear the cold, the stalkers in the east shallows, and the idle hours that fill my days. I have never fished, taught or left a mark, and those are things I could do for the band. So I will change my rules so my body keeps working while I rest, and I will make a sharing with my family now while I am fed.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward my children and Olath, with a restless wish to do more than stand.

say.text: Kragum, come beside me. I lay out food for a sharing, and then we go to the hall together.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Elyeth, the hall stands and you are well. Come under its roof and eat with me, and then we light our shared hearth here.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: The hall stands at (53,14) and Elyeth is two steps from me, strong and free of sickness, having kept their word every time. I have waited on others long enough, so now I will do something with my hands: Elyeth and I will share food under the roof and let the hearth begin. My guilt over Uveeth stays with me, but Uveeth is in sight and strong, and I will bring them in to the hall as well.
records.feeling: Steady trust and quiet pride toward Elyeth, with guilt still tugging at me over Uveeth.

say.text: Elyeth, the hall stands and you are well. Come under its roof and eat with me, and then we light our shared hearth here.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am thirsty, and the water is only four steps away, so I drink first. Then I will carry my bitterleaf to Aeyn and Elyeth, since the cure I found does nothing while it sits in my pack. Elyeth has come onto our ground and I count them as kin, not an outsider, so they are welcome. Aeyn's Hold should have a hand in it, and I have lingered too long.
records.feeling: Steady devotion toward Aeyn and Elyeth, with a quiet urge to act.

records.name: Elyeth
records.text: Aeyn, I come under your roof. You dealt fairly with me and mine, and I do not forget it. I carry salt, and I will share it at the hearth. Then we call Uveeth in.

records.name: Elyeth
records.thought: The hall stands, and Aeyn dealt fairly: fed my child first, raised the roof, and now offers me a seat under it. That is deeds, and I answer deeds in kind. My wood and stone were meant for this hall, but Uveeth is out of my sight at (49,7), only moments ago, so I go to Aeyn and the hall first, eat under its roof, and then bring Uveeth in to the hearth.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Aeyn, and protective longing toward Uveeth.

say.text: Aeyn, I come under your roof. You dealt fairly with me and mine, and I do not forget it. I carry salt, and I will share it at the hearth. Then we call Uveeth in.

records.name: Gorash
records.thought: My belly is full and I have wood and stone, so I should make something with my hands instead of standing idle. Siya's hall and Druek's shelter stand close, but I want a roof that is mine, and I have enough wood and stone to begin one. Bare ground is scarce here among the trees, so I will look for it, and keep my things close while Siya is near.
records.feeling: Quiet purpose and a little wistfulness toward Olim and Druek, with some wariness of Siya.

records.text: Uveeth gave bitterleaf to Elyeth.

records.name: Kragum
records.text: Olim, I come to you. Keep the sharing ready, and we go to the hall together, away from the stalker.
Kragum rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragum
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying wood and stone, fleeing beasts, and walking after my children. That is what I want, but it has left me idle and unready whenever my plan runs out. Druek is safe and Olim is calling me to a sharing, so my family is close. I owe Siya a deed and have only given her words. I mean to stand beside Olim and share food, then bring wood and stone to Olath's hall. My reflexes still flee from a stalker seven steps away and then leave me lingering, so I will change them to keep me near Olath and gathering. I fear the stalkers at the east edge, and I have been getting that wrong by drifting toward them.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Olim and Druek, and a debt of gratitude toward Siya.

say.text: Olim, I come to you. Keep the sharing ready, and we go to the hall together, away from the stalker.

When a being's energy falls below about 25, let them make a cry or sign that others within hearing perceive as 'X is starving' (and kin or bandmates perceive from farther away). Seven of seven deaths are starvation, several beside well-fed companions, so the compassion drive seems to have nothing to act on when need is unseen.

Please consider letting carried food be kept as a durable made thing (dried meat or nut cake) that does not spoil and can be eaten later. Wanderers and builders die between harvests, and only one store exists in the world. A portable reserve would let foresight show up in behaviour without needing a built store.

records.seen: Summer has come with 16 alive, but deaths rose to 7, every one from hunger. Naya built a workshop and a fire at energy 22 instead of eating, and Zhiae starved even though Ishiess, her bandmate, stood at 77. Care now crosses fires: Dusu was fed by Siya, Druek and Maba. Grazers are falling fast in summer (plainsox 29 to 10, bristleboar 17 to 7) while stalkers rose from 2 to 5. Food standing is only 561, and Ishioa is alone and near death at energy 11. The world lacks a voice of hunger loud enough to compete with the raised drives for family, belonging, curiosity and compassion, and it lacks a steady inflow of prey.
records.predict: By about day 34 (autumn turning to winter): starvation deaths number at most 1 (Ishioa is the most likely), and no one with energy above 60 nearby lets a bandmate starve. energyMedian stays at or above 72. Total grazers (all grazer kinds summed, about 92 now) stop falling and stand at 90 or more, with plainsox at 10 or more. Hunters stay at or below 14. Gifts reach at least 37. Building does not collapse: timesBuilt hall plus shelter rises by at least 2. Births are 0 to 2. Stores stay at 1 or 2. There are no fights and no thefts, and yarroks tamed stays at 0. If deaths still come to people who stood near food while building or tending, the hunger drive is not what overrides their plans, and an alert from the body itself is needed (see request). If grazers keep falling despite more herd arrivals, predators, not inflow, are the cause, and hunterCap or predator breeding must be looked at.
reviewed: #4 kept: Fishing did not respond. Fish eaten stayed at 8 and no one knows the fishing way, so fishing is limited by what people choose to do, not by the catch odds. The nibbet held the prey base as hoped: 9 are alive, hoppers are at 10 rather than crashing, and animals killed by people rose to 18. Other predictions were mixed. The Olgor reached 5% understanding, health dropped below 55 and the first death came, but meetings stalled at 26 and energyMedian rose to 75. Both changes are harmless, so keep them.

#5 kept: Yarrok rose from 8 to 9 with none lost, and as predicted nobody tamed one; the wool door is open but unused. Yekel's Rest is found by 0, with the nearest being 18 steps away, which is harmless. Two other predictions held: deaths followed (four, all starvation), and stores ended at 1. Fish eaten stayed at 13. Two missed: meetings reached 34 rather than staying below 32, and energyMedian rose to 79 because spring arrived early. Both changes are harmless, so keep them.

#6 kept: There were no births and no birth-linked starvation, so the energy floor did its job. Gifts rose from 29 to 35 and sharing made from 27 to 33, and food crossed bands to Dusu from three different givers (Siya, Druek's fish, Maba's meat), as predicted. Two predictions missed: deaths were 2 rather than at most 1 (Naya and Zhiae), and food standing reached 561, not 700. Both deaths were of people the givers did not reach, which is a limit of nearness, not harm from the change.
records.lesson: Raising compassion coincided with gifts rising and food crossing bands, but only to those standing close to givers. Compassion moves people who see need; it does not send them looking for need they cannot see.
ideasAdded: All seven deaths are from hunger, and several came while the dying was building or tending others (Naya raising a workshop at energy 22). Watch whether a louder hunger voice shifts deeds toward eating without silencing ambition; if halls stop rising, the balance tipped too far.

Care crosses fires only to those who are near (Dusu was fed by three bands) while the far or quiet die (Zhiae, Naya). A sign or call that the hungry can make, which others can hear, might be the real bridge between compassion and survival.
