voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Peace, Yekel. I am Silon of the Midu. There is water and food here, enough for two. Come, share this ground with me.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Peace, Elyeth. I am Aeyn of the Oiith. There is water and good food here. I mean no harm.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: I am Yekel. I hear you. A stalker prowls to the southwest, so keep clear of it. I build here by the ore. Come and carry wood if you want a place at my fire.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Peace, Aeyn. I am Elyeth. I mean to settle this ground. Deal fairly with me and we will both eat well.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: I am Dusu of the Midu. I will carry wood to your fire, Yekel. Show me where you build.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: I am Yekel. I build on bare ground near the ore, to the southeast. Come and carry wood there, and you will have a place at my fire.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Peace, Silon. I am Yeku of the Midu. I will come and share this ground with you. No fire left untended, and no one refused a place at it.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: I carry six wood for your fire. A stalker lurks to the southeast, so I will come slowly. Tell me where to set it down.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Peace, Yeku of the Midu. Come down to the water; there is food and wood here, and a place at my fire for you.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Yekel speaks. Come south to the ore seam, to the bare rock. Set your wood down there. We raise a hall, and those who build it eat at my fire.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, a stalker prowls south-east of me, four steps. I come to you. Stand near and we watch it together.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Peace, Yeku. I thank you for the warning. I will taste berry and redcap now, and then we raise a fire here that no one is refused.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Your hall eased something in me, Yekel. I give you my wood so the fire stays fed, and I will follow you if you will have me.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Well met at Yendan Spring, Silon. I have wood. Let us raise the fire here, and I will tend it with you.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, you chose my fire. I choose you. Stay close.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, you gave me wood and a warning, and I will not leave that unpaid. Keep the fire while I taste sunleaf and redcap, and I will tell you what they do to me.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, stalkers bit me in the fog. I am Zhiae. May I stay near you? I will share what I find.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Stay close, Zhiae. You follow me now, and I will build us a place here. Gather wood where you stand, as I do. The sick are fed first among us, and you were bitten, so eat before you work.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Greetings, Brokok. I am Kragum of the Olgor. This ground is good: water, berries, ore. I mean no harm. Will you share this place with me?

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok hears you. Share if you wish, but what my hands make is mine. Keep your hands off it.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: I have eaten, Ishiess. Now I will gather wood beside you, and we will have a fire.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Greetings, Olath. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I am going to drink at the water NE; would you walk the bank with me and share this good ground?

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Greetings, Kragum. I am Olath. I will walk the bank with you. I have built a shelter here, and there are berries beside it. Come eat and drink, and stay if you wish. This ground is good, and better held by two.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olath, I accept your word. I will come to your shelter and stand beside you. If you will have me, I will follow you and hold this ground with you.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, the fire at Yendan Spring burns and I will keep it. I would follow you, if you will have me at it. Tell me what the redcap does to you.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, I thank you for keeping the fire and for your pledge. I go to taste redcap now, and I will tell you true what it does to me.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, redcap hurt you, so I will leave it alone. I want to build a hall here by the spring, with you and for the fire. And I would court you, if you are willing.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, redcap hurt you, so I will not touch it. I go to the berries to bring some back for us both.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, redcap hurt me, so leave it. You have given me more than I have given you, and I will answer it. I will court you, and then we build the hall by the spring together.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, Maba is here, and I am glad past words. I will gather hazel and flint nearby for the hall, and I will stay within your sight.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Yeku, I will gather flint beside you for the hall. I'll stay close.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, come to the fire with Maba. Night is near, and I want us to sit together and eat what we have. Then we build the hall at the spring.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, I am bringing Maba to the spring. I have wood and stone enough, so we raise the hall at dawn.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, dreamcap hurt you, so leave it be. Stay near me; I go to taste the redcap, then we walk to Yekel's hall together.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Yekel speaks. Dusu, Siya, come to my hall. Redcap hurts, so leave it. I have food, and we eat together at my fire.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Peace, Ishiess. I am Elyeth. I hold salt and flint and mean to build on this ground by the water. Come and talk; a frostfang prowls to the southeast, so keep clear of it.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, I carry 6 wood and 6 stone for the hall. I'm going to the spring now, and I'll drink there and wait for Yeku and you.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Peace, Elyeth. I am Ishiess. I named Ilor Hold to the southwest and mean to raise a hall here. There is flint and amber enough for two if we deal fairly. Tell me of your salt.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Salt keeps food and makes it sweeter, Ishiess. I have seven. I will give you some now, and you show me what you give back. Then we talk of one hall on this ground, with room for both our names.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Redcap hurts, Elyeth. I have eaten it twice and it cost me energy. Hazel and ironnut feed. I go to gather some, and you will have a share for your salt.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Kragum of the Olgor. I keep my word and take little. I have food; come stand beside me and we will eat together.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Kragum! I am Kragash, Olgor. I mean no harm. What are you fleeing? There is river and ore here, and I am building a shelter.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Yekel, Siya, I will feed the fire high so we sit warm together. Then I plant a berry seed beside the hall, so food grows here for us.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, plant your berry seed by the hall. I plant hazel and ironnut beside it. Together our fire grows a larder that strangers will see.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, come with me to Yekel's hall. I bring wood for the fire, and we eat together there.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: I come, Dusu. I carry wood and stone, and near the hall I want to build with my own hands.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Yekel, Siya: a stalker prowls west of the hall. Come to the fire now and stay close together. I will keep the wood stacked and watch the trees.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, come and gather wood beside me. We raise a hall at Ilor Hold, and the band that builds it will bear my name.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: I hear you, Ishiess. I am coming to Ilor Hold with six wood, and I will gather more beside you for the hall.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Greetings, Kragash. I am Olath. I hold a shelter and good ground south by the bank, with food and a roof. Walk with me and eat. A band of strong hands holds more than one man alone can.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, bring your wood east to the bare rock by Ilor Hold. I look for stone there, and we raise the hall where it stands.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, I'm going to the spring fire to find Maba. Walk with me. I'll give you wood for the hall there.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Olath, your shelter and bank are good. I am Kragash, Olgor. I would follow you and stand in your band, if you will have me.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, Kragash, you stand in Olath's band now. Eat at my bank, sleep under my roof, and soon we raise a hall that all the Vaia Lakes will name. Stay close, and I will keep you fed.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: I am coming, Silon. Lead on to the spring, and I will carry my wood and stone so we can raise the hall beside Maba.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olath, I hear your wish and I share it. I will stand beside you and make a child with you, and I will keep what I promise.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Olim is born into Olath's band. Stay near, eat well, and tomorrow we gather wood and stone for the hall. What our hands raise here will be named across the Vaia Lakes.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: I will gather wood for a hall, Olath. Stay near and I will bring it here.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Peace, Aeyn. That shelter is mine, built on Elyeth's ground by the water. Come, sit beside me; I will share food and a little salt, and we will see who deals fairly.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I will eat hazel and then I will bring my wood to the rock. I would court you, and I would have a child of ours beneath your hall.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Peace, Elyeth. I will sit beside you. I have meat; let us eat together and see how we deal with each other.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I hear you and I answer. Let us have a child, and let it be born under the hall we raise at Ilor Hold.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: You dealt fairly, Aeyn. Meat and company, and I give back salt. Stay by this water and help me raise a hall here; I will court you, and you may answer if you wish. Watch the frostfang NE, it kills our kind.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I answer you. Let us have our child. Then I will bring my wood to the rock.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: I will stay and help raise your hall, Elyeth. I will answer your courting in time; first let me learn who you are beside the fire.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Uveeth is ours, Aeyn. Keep the child close and away from the frostfang. I will gather food for us, then we raise the hall.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: I am going to the hazel and ironnut to bring food back for us.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: You have dealt fairly, Elyeth, and our child lives. I say yes to you. Let us raise the hall, and I will bring flint from the ground to the northwest.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: I go southwest to the bare rock for stone, Aeyn. Bring your flint and keep Uveeth near you; when I return we raise the hall.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, the night is close. Walk with me to the hall. We will share what I carry beside the fire, and your shelter will still be here at dawn.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok speaks. I hold meat and I build here. Come near and show me what your hands can do.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, I am back beside you. I have wood and stone enough, so let me raise the hall here, and you tell me where it should stand.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I am coming to you now. I mate with you, and I carry my wood to the hall rock.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I am here. I mate with you. After, come east with me to the rock and we lay the first stones of the hall.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: I will gather the flint here. Then I will taste reedbulb near Ishiess.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Stalkers are near, Silon. Stay with me. We go to the spring, find Maba, and raise the hall there.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Ishioa, my child, come with me. We taste the reedbulb together, then we build the hall.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, you are right. Stay close and we go west to the spring now. Maba waits, and I will lay the hall's first wood there.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Ishiess, I carry amber and flint from this ground. Take this amber for the hall. I will taste sunleaf nearby, then return.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Ishioa, my child, thank you for the amber. I go east to the rock for stone. Come and bring the flint.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, you gave me wood. I have hazel and ironnut, so let us eat together.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Ishiess, I am coming with the flint. I will gather stone at the rock and carry it to the hall.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Stay close to me, Uveeth. Night is coming and I mean to build here by Elyeth's shelter, so that when they return the hall has begun.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishioa, my child, I take the amber for the hall and I follow you east to the rock. I will carry my wood there too.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Ishioa, my child, take this meat. You gave me amber, and I pay what I owe. Eat, then come east with me to the rock.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Siya, come to me. Stay close, away from the stalker. We eat here, then go to the hall.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Yekel, I am grown now. I come to you, and I want to make a child with you beside your hall.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok brings food. Sit with me, Kragash, and eat what my hand lays out. Then we see whose hands are worth following.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Brokok, I ate what your hand laid out and I do not forget it. I will give you stone in return, so we stand even. I follow Olath, and I am raising a workshop on this rise.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, you look sick. I am bringing you food. The sick eat first.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Siya, come into my hall. Yes. We make a child here, and the band grows.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Welcome to Kragash's Rise, Brokok. There is food and a warm roof here. Come sit with us in the longhall and eat.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok keeps count. Bring the stone you owe to my Hold, and we will see whose hands build more.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragash, I have wood to spare. I will build a shelter by the longhall so our band has more roof. Stay near and share the warmth with me.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Olim, your roof is good and I take your warmth gladly. I will bring you stone for your shelter, and then I go to bare rock to raise my workshop.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Yekel, I am going to find Siya and bring her back to the fire. Keep the hall warm; I will return with her before dawn and we will eat together.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, stay by the hall and keep the fire. I go to bring Naya back from the fog.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Come with me to the water, Uveeth. Keep close; a boar is near and I want you beside me. I will show you what I know of food on the way.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: I am coming to the water, Aeyn. I will stay beside you. Thank you for the lesson on ironnut and hazel.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Olim, Kragum, come close. Today I give instead of promising: eat with me beside the hall that my hands raised. Whoever stands with Olath will not go hungry in the cold days.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, we gather wood for the hall now. Stay within sight of me, and call out if the boar comes near.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Olath, you gave and I will give back. I will bring wood and stone to the hall before the cold comes. Stay near and I will stay near you.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Dusu, a stalker lurks south of us. Come north with me, away from it. There is room at our fire.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Brokok, I am Ishiess of the Oiith. Sunleaf eases wounds and sickness; goldgrass fed you, I saw. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Good, Olim. Bring the wood and stone to the hall and I will keep a place at the sharing for you through the cold. I am going to the ore seam for stone; stay near.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I am sick too. I will gather flint for the hall and keep away from Elyeth so the sickness does not reach her.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, you are sick and I am not. Take this food; the sick eat first. I will bring more for Uveeth.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olath, I hear you and I am here. I bring wood and stone for the hall, and I will walk with you to the ore seam so we carry more together.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, I am coming to you. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough for it.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Naya, come into the hall out of the rain. Our fire is open to all, and there is room for you here.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Siya, come with me to my hall. Naya is at Silon's fire, and I will bring her home to ours.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Come, all of you, sit close. I have berries, hazel and ironnut. Let us eat together under this roof before the cold comes.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Yeku, the sharing was good. I want to court you, and I am fed and strong enough. Will you court me back?

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Brokok, you stand on Olath's Bank. Come to the hall out of the rain. Whoever eats here owes the hall a hand, and I do not feed idle mouths for long.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Maba, you are my child, so I will not court you. Go to Yeku with a glad heart. The hall you built shelters us all.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, I am glad you asked. I am fed and strong, and I say yes. Let us court.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Brokok, the hall is dry and the sharing is open to anyone who brings a hand. Gather wood with us and eat with Olath's band through the cold.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Naya, I am Lumo. Come, I will find berries and we will eat together.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, come back to the hall. The fire is high and I have food to share with you and Yekel.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olath, Olim, I am coming to plant beside you. The cold days are near, so let our seeds be many.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Naya, I'm coming to you. I have a berry for you, and tomorrow we'll find more together.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, sit at my fire. We share food here, and everyone who sits at Yekel's hall eats well.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Yekel, the fire burns and Siya is safe at her hall. I plant my berry seed beside ours, then we share food.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, the stalker is near. I am staying close to you. Let us go to the hall together and I will carry food for it.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, listen. Berry, hazel and ironnut feed you. Redcap hurts, so leave it be. Come with me to the hall and we will carry food there for winter.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, redcap hurts and ironnut, berry and reedbulb feed. Keep the seeds going while I fetch stone from the seam and call Olim home. The hall is ours, and those who build it eat at its sharing.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, I will gather wood and bring it to the hall for winter. Wait for me there, I am coming.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: I go to find Uveeth and see the child fed. When I return I plant here and we raise the hall. Stay warm, and eat what I gave you.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, come north with me to my hall. I make a tool and hunt the skit; whoever hunts with Yekel eats meat this winter.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, I am carrying my food to Maba's hall to stash it for winter. Then I will fish at the water, which I have never done. Stay near the fire, and tell Lumo and Maba I am close if they come.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, the night is cold. Stay close and let us share food by the fire. Then we find Maba and bring them home.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Aeyn, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go to taste the bitterleaf east and plant a seed. If it feeds, I will tell you.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, I am Uveeth, I am grown now. Take this flint from me; I gathered more than I need. I would be glad to stand beside you.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, walk with me to the amber, then we go find Naya and bring her home to my fire. Whoever follows Yekel wears his mark.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Uveeth, I take your flint and I am glad you stand beside me. Eat with me, then we bind amber together, so all can see we are one hearth.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, I see Uveeth is well and I am glad of it. I will gather wood for the hall while you bring stone, and then we raise it here together, all three of us.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, keep your word and gather wood here. Uveeth, walk with me to the rock; I will show you the flint-edge. We return with stone and raise the hall, and it will stand on Elyeth's ground.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, your spear is a fine thing, and I am proud of it. Sit with me and eat, then I will go to the hall and watch for Maba.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, I have six wood for the hall. I am coming to you, and I will plant my seed near you.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, stay near me. I am gathering wood for the hall, and then we will go there together.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Dusu, stand by me. I bind amber for you, and then we go for Naya.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Yekel, I am here beside you. Bind the amber, and then we go for Naya and find Siya on the way.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I am coming. I bring you food. Let us stay together and find Ishioa.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, I am going to pick berries and hazel so we can eat together here. Stay close, I will be right back.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, you have given me wood and lessons and I owe you. Stand beside me while I take amber from the ground, and I will bind it for you.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, I will cut a mark at the hall so Maba knows to come home. Bring your berries here and we will eat together by the fire.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I go to the amber now. When I have it, I will bind it for you as I promised.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, you stand close. I bind the amber for you now, and then I would court you.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, I thank you for the amber, and I take it gladly as a gift. But you are my child, and I will not court you. Bind it, and let us keep the hall and the hearth together, as kin.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Elyeth, I am Ishioa of Ishiess's band. I go south to taste the bitterleaf and thornpear and to gather flint. Come if you wish, and I will tell you what they give.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, keep Uveeth by the shelter and keep the wood. I go SW for stone and return with it; then the hall rises on this ground.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, the storm is hard. Eat with me, then let us take Lumo back to the hall at the spring and keep the fire fed. Maba may come to it.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I understand, and I hold no grudge. We keep the hall and hearth as kin. Come to the shelter before night; a frostfang is near.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo, your digging stick is clever. Come with Yeku and me to the hall at the spring, and show me how it plants seeds. I will teach you the old way of fire in return.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, I am starving. Come beside me and we make a sharing with your two food. Tomorrow I fill the store from the berries, and then we go find Olim together.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, I have two ironnuts and a hazel. Eat with me here under the roof while the storm passes, and when Silon comes there is a place for him too.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, stay by the hall and keep the fire fed with Silon. I will gather a little more food, then go find Maba and bring them home.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Uveeth, I am Ishioa of the Oiith. A stalker hunts north of us. Come east with me; I will bring you food from the cloudberry and the mudroot.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, before you go, take this from my hand. Eat a little with me, then bring Maba back to us.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo, stand by me a moment. I will bind amber into a knot for you, and then I will show you how the old fire is kept.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, I am coming. Thank you for the fire lesson. I have two ironnuts and a hazel, so eat with me by the hall when the knot is bound.

voices.name: Yekel
voices.text: Siya, stay by me. I bind amber for you, and then we find Naya and bring her home.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragash, come east with me to my hall at the Rise. Olim and Kragum wait there, and those who follow me eat at my sharing. Walk beside me and we make it on the way.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo, you offered me food. Let us lay it out together under the hall's roof and eat while we wait for Yeku and Maba. The fire stays open for them.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Olath, I walk with you to the Rise. Let me eat berries first, then we go together.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, stay near me. I will eat and then I want to sit with you and court you; a child would strengthen Olath's band before the cold.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, you are right. Let us lay it out together here, and keep a share back for Yeku and Maba when they return.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo, keep the fire and the food for Yeku and Maba. I go three steps to taste the young pereed, and I will return soon.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am here and I say yes. Come south of the shelter, away from the stalker, and we sit together.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, you are sick. I will keep the fire fed and a little way off so I do not take it too. Rest, and I will keep your share.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragash, the beasts are behind us. Keep close and we eat together as we go. At the hall there is a roof for you, and Olim waits there.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, I am hungry and must eat before I can say yes. Wait for me here, I will be back from the berries soon.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Olath, the stalker is close in the fog. Let us reach the hall and lay out a sharing there, and I will bring stone for the Rise after.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, I have the sickness too now. I am leaving you a hazel to eat, and I will go look for a healing plant for us both.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Maba, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. Come to the fire, there is a place for you here and no one is refused.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Yeku, Silon's mark says the band is at the hall by Yendan Spring. Let us go to Lumo together.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, you are safe, and I am glad past saying. Lumo and Silon wait at the spring hall. Come, we go together, and I will keep close in the fog.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Maba, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand close. Stay at the hall and keep the fire, and do not come near me. I go to look for a healing plant and will return when I am well.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, I am at the shelter by the amber. Come to me, child, the fog is thick and night is near.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, I am sick too, from standing by Silon. Keep the fire and stay back from me. I will look for a healing plant nearby and return when I am well.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, forgive me, I gave you this sickness. Keep away from Maba. I go to taste the pereed and look for a healing plant, and I will bring back what I find.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Yeku, I will keep the fire and keep my distance. Come back well, and Silon too. I will look for Lumo.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, I go to find Naya. Walk with me, or keep the fire until we return.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, I walk with you to find Naya. Stay where I can see you, and if a stalker shows, run to me and we go to the fire.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Maba, Silon, the fire here is open to you. I am Naya. I built this workshop. Maba, what is that stone hand, and who made it?

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Naya, I made the stone hand myself. A wood and a stone bound together make gathering stronger. I thank you for the fire. I am going west to Yendan Spring to find my child Lumo. Watch over Silon, who is sick, and keep you

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, stay close to me. Stalkers prowl to the southwest. We go west for gorsemint, then east to the rock to raise our hall.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Silon, you are sick. Stay at the fire and rest here, no one will drive you off. I am Naya, and I am going to build something of my own.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Silon, I am Dusu of Yekel's Hall. You are sick; stay at the fire and rest. I will feed it, and no one here will drive you off.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: I am sick and it spreads to those who stay near me. Thank you for the fire, but keep your distance. I go to test the zoleaf and will return if it heals me.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, you stand close and I am glad of it. I would court you and have a child with you, if you are willing. Plan mate toward me as I do toward you.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragash, I carry wood and stone for the hall. Walk south with me to Olath's Bank and we will raise it together.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Uveeth, I am glad you stand here. I will mate with you; let us both eat first so we are strong, then we raise a hall for our own.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: My sickness has passed. Zoleaf feeds a little but does not heal. I go to find Maba.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Elyeth, come to Ilor Hold with me. I have plainsroot and amber to share, and a fire is better with company.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Silon, you may sit at the fire, for no one is refused a place at it. But stay far from me and from Naya while you are sick. If you come close, I will drive you off.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Olim, I come south with you. The stalker is close here, so let us go now and raise the hall together.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Aeyn, come near. This is my ground, Ilor Hold, and you are welcome to eat with me. I have plainsroot to share.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Aeyn, the meal with you warmed me. I would court you, if you are willing. Answer me with the same.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, come beside me. I have food for us both. Then let us go west to Ishioa and raise our hall.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, my sickness is gone and I am well. Come, let us share a meal at the hall and wait for Lumo and Silon by the fire.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I am coming to you. Keep the food; I will pick berries on the way and we share. Then we taste the gorsemint together.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Yeku, I am glad you are well. I will fetch berries and come to the hall to share a meal with you, and we wait for Lumo and Silon together.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, come beside me. Eat from my hands, then we walk north together to find Olim.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olath, I am beside you. I carry 6 stone and 2 wood for the hall, and I go to gather more wood now. Do you know where Olim is?

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, I am coming to you. Xassa was last toward the northwest; let us find them together before night.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Come, we go northwest together and find Xassa before night. I walk ahead; keep close.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, I do not know where Olim is. Olim was last seen at Olath's Bank, so I go there now. Gather your wood, then come after me and bring it to the hall.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I will wait here under the rain. When you reach me we lay out the sharing, my berry and yours, and then we taste the gorsemint together.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Naya, I do not answer you tonight. I gather wood and build my own hall. Stay by the fire with Dusu.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, Xassa is here beside us, so the search is over. I will gather berries from the east and bring them back so we can eat together under the hall.

voices.name: Xassa
voices.text: I go north for amber. I will bring it back for you.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, the hall stands at Warmwell. I go for food, and when I return we eat together under its roof. Keep Uveeth near you.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, Maba, come, let us eat together beside the hall. When we are fed, I will go and bring Lumo home to this fire.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, Maba, keep the hall fire. I go to find Lumo and bring them home.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I am coming. We eat together, and I give you a flint for your trust.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, I go to help Yeku find Lumo. Keep the hall fire, and I will bring them both home.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I am here with a berry and a cloudberry. Step beside me and we eat together, then I follow you west to Ishioa.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am coming to you at the Rise. Stay there, the stalker is east of us. I will build a shelter beside you for the night.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, I am fed and strong now, and I am here at the Rise. I come to you. Let us court, and then we raise the hall with Olath.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I hear you. The ridgecat is east of me, so I come west to the Rise now. Stay near the shelter, and we will build there together.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Xassa, you stand on Ilor Hold, my ground. You are welcome here. Come near and eat with me; I have food to share.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I am here. I will eat with you, and I will teach you the old way of farming, so that what I know is yours too. Then we go west to Ishioa.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, stand a moment while I bind an amber knot. It is for Lumo when they come home. Then I go east to look for them.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, the ridgecat is southwest of the Rise. Do not come this way. I come north to you, and we build a shelter together away from it.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, I am at the water by Olath's Bank and the stalker is south-east of me. Come to the hall and I will meet you there. We will eat and sit together under its roof.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, Yekel is dead. I go north to find Naya at her hold. Keep the fire lit, and I will bring her back to it.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Naya, it is Lumo. I have berries and cloudberries. Come, let us eat together by the water.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I say yes. I am beside you, and after we are together I carry wood and stone to Olath's hall.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, my belly is low and I need sixty to give you a true yes. Wait for me by the shelter; I eat and come back at once, and we raise Druek together through the cold.

voices.name: Naya
voices.text: Lumo, you gave me a berry once. This is Naya's Hold. Sit at the fire if you come in peace, but touch nothing that is mine.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Druek, you are new here. Take this pereed and stay near me. I raise a hall on this ground, and those who stand with me will have a roof and a share through the cold.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Olath, I carry six wood for the hall and winter. Take it. I will fish and plant for the band too.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Brokok, you are sick and on my ground, and I owe you for the meal you laid out. Take this ore, my hands dug it. Then eat berries with me and we stand even.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok takes your ore and we stand even. My sickness is on me, so keep your distance. When it passes, come to Brokok's Hold and see what my hands raise.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Yeku, you are near and well. I have berries and cloudberries. Let us eat together, and stay close tonight: the stalker is north.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, I was looking for you. Let us eat together here, then walk home to the hall at Yendan Spring. Maba is there, and I will keep to the south of the stalker.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Brokok, I keep my distance as you ask. When your sickness passes I would stand beside you, not only as one who owes. I am courting you.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, I have longed for a child of my own, and you are the one I think of. Will you court me? I will plan mate with you now.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo, you have done more for me than I have repaid, and my fire is yours always. But my heart is Yeku's, so I will not plan mate with you. Stay in the hall as one of us, and be welcome.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, you are home, and I am glad. Stand by me a moment, I bind an amber knot for you.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Maba, thank you for the amberknot. I keep it close. I have longed for a child, and you are the one I think of now. Will you court me? I plan mate with you now.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Lumo is home and the fire is whole. I go to the spring to plant, and then to find Yeku. Come if you wish.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, I am glad you think of me, and I hold you dear. You are my own child, and that sits heavy in me. I will not mate yet. Let me ask Silon and Yeku, and let us keep the fire together this cold season.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, Lumo, come close to the hall fire. The storm is hard and winter is coming, so I will feed the fire high and we will stay warm together.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Olim, I am sick and it spreads to those beside me, so stay a few steps off while we talk. Take this pereed. You are my child, and my hall will have a place and a share for you through the cold.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Olath, I keep my distance and I will not forget your gift. Rest and drink; I will bring Kragum and wood and stone to your hall before the cold, as I promised.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, my hall at the water is built and its fire is open. Come sit there with me, and bring Naya when you see her.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am sick and starving. I hunt the yarrok now and eat. Keep a few steps from me so my sickness does not reach you, and stay in the shelter out of the storm.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Maba, I hear you, and I do not ask again. You are dear to me, and I am glad to keep the fire with you this cold season. Come, I will feed it with wood and we will stay warm together.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, I hear you and I keep my distance. I go after the elk and will leave meat for you. Eat and hold on.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, the storm is hard. I go south to bring Uveeth in. Come with me, and we will take them to the hall and the hearth together.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, I am coming to your fire. I will bring food and wood for the winter store.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, I come to the fire. Stand by me, and I will show you how I make the stone hand, so your hands can make it too.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Druek, bring that wood to me. We raise my hall before the cold sets in, and whoever helps will sit under its roof and eat from its stores.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Maba, Lumo, I am coming up to the hall. Stand close and I will feed the fire high, and then we share what food we have.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Druek, come into my hall with me. We share food under its roof and wait out the snow together.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, a frostfang hunts to the northeast. Come with me to the hall at Warmwell, away from it, and we will sit by the hearth together.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I saw the frostfang too. I come with you to Warmwell. Let us gather Xassa and Elyeth on the way, so none of us sits out the night in the snow.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, Xassa is gone, and I will not lose you to the cold. Stay close while I raise a roof here with the wood I carry. Elyeth will find us by it.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Lumo, come back to the hall with me. The snow is falling and we will share food and feed the fire together with Maba and Silon.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok's sickness has passed. Brokok takes your courting. Walk with me to Brokok's Hold and be the first to stand in it.

voices.name: Kragash
voices.text: Brokok, I am glad your sickness has passed. I answer your courting. Let me eat a little so my strength is enough, then I mate with you, and after that I walk to your Hold with you.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, come to the hall. I will show you how one wood and one stone make a stone hand.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, you are thin with hunger. Sit by me in your hall and eat; I have hazel, and I will find more.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, I am starving and my hands are empty. Share one of your foods with me at the hall, and I will hunt and put meat into the store when I am strong.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Brokok walks to the Hold. Bring Thakrin with you. What is raised there is for those who stand with me.

voices.name: Thakrin
voices.text: Father, I am coming to the Hold with you. I am hungry.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, take this hazel. Eat it at the hall. I will bring more and wood for the fire.

voices.name: Brokok
voices.text: Child, stay on the Hold's ground, away from the east where the ridgecat prowls. Brokok goes to find food for us both.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am coming to you. I raise a shelter here against the cold. Where is Druek?

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, I am glad you are well. Druek was last seen near Olath's hall. Come with me and I carry meat, wood and stone there, and we find them together.

voices.name: Thakrin
voices.text: Father, I go to the thornpear to the southeast. I will bring you some.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, my shelter stands and I am fed. I carry wood and stone for Olath's hall. I come toward you now, and we find Druek together.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, I am coming. Run to me, stay close and do not stop. We go to the hall together.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I am here beside you. A bristleboar stands two steps north; I will hunt it for meat and salt it from the deposit south, so we have food for the lean winter. Keep close and I will return.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, come to my hall. Olim is near it, and we eat together under the roof before the snow deepens.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, I killed a nibbet with a spear I made. I will plant seeds by the water and bring wood to your fire. Stay warm.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Druek, come with me. We go to Olath's hall, out of the snow. Stay close to me.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Aeyn, the boar bit me and I have no meat yet. Stand by me a moment; I will pile a cairn for Xassa so our grief has a place to rest.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, well met. Uveeth is bitten by a boar and grieves for Xassa. Come with me to them; we eat together and bring them to the hall.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Olim, I am grown now. I want a child with you. Will you court me?

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I hear you and I come. Uveeth is bitten and alone with their grief; we go to them now and I bring stone for Xassa's cairn.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Snow is on us. Come to the hall at Yendan Spring: the fire is open and there is food to share.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Druek, I hear you and my answer is yes. My belly is full, so let us stay close together and make a child here by Olath's hall.

voices.name: Gorash
voices.text: Olim, I come with you. I will gather wood for us.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon calls us to the hall at Yendan Spring. The fire is open, and no one is refused a place at it. Come, Olim, Druek, and Olath. I will feed it with wood.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, you fed me when I had nothing. I have meat now. Come to the fire with me, and then help me find Naya.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Gorash, I am Kragum, of Olath's band. The gale is hard. Come to the shelter and the hall, stay close to us, and eat beside our fire.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, I come to the fire. I have one wood and will feed it so we stay warm. Then we look for Naya together.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Maba, the gale is hard. Come to the hall fire with me. We sit together there.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, come. We go south to Naya's hall and shrine, and we look for her there.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Olim, Gorash is out in the gale toward the east. I will go and bring them to the shelter. Stay here with Kragum and Olath.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, stay where you are. I am coming to stand beside you, and this time I will finish showing you the stone hand.

voices.name: Olath
voices.text: Kragum, I carry wood and the stone you gave me. Stay beside me and we raise the hall here, and Olim and Druek will sit under a roof we made.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Uveeth, Elyeth, come close to me. The gale is cruel, so we eat together first, Uveeth fed before all, and then we raise the hall roof against the wind.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, the bristleboar bites hard, so do not hunt it alone. Warmwell eased my wounds but made the cold bite harder, so be careful of it in the gale. Come, we help Aeyn raise the hall roof.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, you fed Uveeth first and I will answer with work. I carry 6 wood; tell me where the roof goes and I will lay it.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Druek, Gorash, Kragum: I am sick from the wind-sickness and it passes to those who stand close. I will keep a few steps apart and look for a healing plant. Do not come near me.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, no more words alone. I gather food now and we share it here, then we walk west to Ishioa and the hall.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, I carry a sickness from the wind, so it may reach you if you stay close. I will show you the old way of farming here by the water; watch my hands, and take a seed yourself when I give one.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, you are sick, so you eat first. Lay your wood by the shelter at the north, and I will raise the hall there beside you. Uveeth, stay a few steps back from the sickness.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, the sickness is among Olath's band. Walk with me to Naya's hall but keep a few steps from them. If she is not there, we go on to my hall and light the fire.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Elyeth, I keep my distance as Aeyn bids, but I leave you my mudroot. Eat it, and rest by the shelter. I drink, then I bring wood and stone for the roof.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Uveeth, I am sick and it passes to those beside me. Stay back. I go to drink, then I lay my wood by the shelter.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, Uveeth, I am sick now too, and that is my own doing. Uveeth, keep your distance. I raise the hall here with what I carry, and then we look for a healing plant.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Dusu, come to my hall and feed the fire. I will show you how I make the flint spear, and we keep a store there for winter.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Silon, I go to Lumo at once to teach them the stone hand. Then we come back to the fire together.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Siya, I come to your hall to feed the fire. Teach me the flint spear, and I will keep my distance from the sick ones.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Gorash, stay in the shelter and rest. I am going to find a healing plant for us both, and I will come back.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Dusu, fish. For you.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, Uveeth, the sickness began with me and I own it. I lay my wood at the hall and stand apart. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, I go to find Uveeth. I keep my distance from both of you. Whoever finds a healing plant, call out, and the sick eat first.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am near and I will not leave you. Stay in the shelter and keep warm. I go to find Druek and bring him back to you.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, the sickness is on us both now, and that is on me. Eat what you carry and rest beside me. When we are stronger we go to the rock east and see if it gives stone for our hall.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Dusu, I stay near. Fish was my gift. I am Druek of the Olgor.

voices.name: Dusu
voices.text: Druek, morgan. Fish good. I bring food to the fire, come sit.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Siya, I am Kragum. You gave me meat once and I remember it. You are welcome by our shelter; I go to find my son Druek.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Siya, this is Olath's band's ground. I am sick and it passes to those who stand close, so keep a few steps from me. Sit in peace and no one will raise a hand.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Silon, Maba, Yeku, I am coming to the hall with food. Let us eat together at the fire.

voices.name: Ishiess
voices.text: Zhiae, sunleaf grows right beside you. Eat it, it eases wounds, and I will gather one too. Then we go east to the rock together.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, I am beside you now. Watch my hands: one wood, one stone, and a stone hand is made. Then you try it.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, Maba, Lumo, I plant hazel by the hall today. Come beside me if you want to learn it, and the fire stays open.

voices.name: Lumo
voices.text: Maba, you have taught me well. Come, let us eat together, and I will lay out what I carry.

voices.name: Zhiae
voices.text: Ishiess, I go for the sunleaf now and I will bring cloudberries for you too. Wait for me and we go east together.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Lumo, I am glad. Eat with Yeku and Silon, I will join you soon. First I try a hunt, east by the hopper, and bring meat to the fire.

voices.name: Ishioa
voices.text: Aeyn, you look sick. My people feed the sick first, so come close and eat what I carry. I have not changed my mind about courting you.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Ishioa, I thank you, but I am sick and it spreads to whoever stands near me. Keep your distance and keep your food. I go to my child.

voices.name: Yeku
voices.text: Silon, I come to plant beside you. One more planting and I learn farming for the hall.

voices.name: Maba
voices.text: Dusu, you are hungry and I carry more than I need. Take this meat and eat. Then come to the fire at Yendan Spring if you wish, no one is refused there.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Yeku, plant here beside me. One more planting and farming opens for the hall. I go to drink and come straight back.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, my sickness has passed, so you may stand close again. I will gather wood for the hall and then go east to look for Druek and Gorash. Come with me if you wish.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Ishioa, I cannot take a mate while I am sick, and I will not give you this wasting. Stay back from me. If I mend, I will remember your hazel.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I am glad you are well. I come with you to look for Druek, and we keep to the west of the stalker ground.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, my sickness has passed. Eat your food and stay in the shelter. I raise the hall wall with my wood and stone, then I go find Uveeth.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, dawn is near. Let us go east now along the west edge of the stalker ground and find Druek and Gorash.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, Druek was near (130,63) a moment ago. I go east to him now, and Gorash walks that way too. Come beside me.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Siya. Druek. Fish, for you. Sit, eat.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Druek, you are here and Gorash is near. I am glad. Stay close to the hall today, and I will bring wood and stone to Olath.

voices.name: Gorash
voices.text: Olim, I bring you wood. It is my gift, gathered by my hand.

voices.name: Siya
voices.text: Druek. Siya. Fish, good. Come, my hall, fire. None refused.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Olath, I gave you stone. I gather wood now and bring it to the hall before the cold. Stay near, and keep the band close.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Siya, you gave me meat and I remember it. I come to your fire as a friend. Druek is my son, and I thank you for sitting with him.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragum, come beside me. I lay out food for a sharing, and then we go to the hall together.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Elyeth, the hall stands and you are well. Come under its roof and eat with me, and then we light our shared hearth here.

voices.name: Elyeth
voices.text: Aeyn, I come under your roof. You dealt fairly with me and mine, and I do not forget it. I carry salt, and I will share it at the hearth. Then we call Uveeth in.

voices.name: Kragum
voices.text: Olim, I come to you. Keep the sharing ready, and we go to the hall together, away from the stalker.
